Nnan: "kunwi, s tidet, d imdanen kan, am nekwni. Tebɣam ad aɣ tesṭixxṛem, seg wayen llan ɛabden imezwura nneɣ. Awit aɣ d adabu n ṣṣeḥ".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ ⴷⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ? ⵉⵏⵛⵛⴷ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵊ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ". ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ. ⵜⴱⵖⴰⵎ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵜⵙⵟⵉⵅⵅⵕⵎ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⴰⵡⵉⵜ ⴰⵖ ⴷ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ".

ayah_content: Nnan asen imazanen nnsen: "nekwni d imdanen kan, am kunwi, maca Öebbi Iteg ccan i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Ur a$ ippunefk ara ad awen d nawi adabu, siwa s wannuf n Öebbi. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Nnan asen imazanen nnsen: "nekwni d imdanen kan, am kunwi, maca Ṛebbi Iteg ccan i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Ur aɣ ittunefk ara ad awen d nawi adabu, siwa s wannuf n Ṛebbi. ɣef Ṛebbi ara tteklen lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⴳ ⵛⵛⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵏⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⴼ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵖⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⴽⴰⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵖⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵎⵍⴰ ⵢⴰⵖ ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ; ⵏⵚⴱⵕ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉ ⵍⵎⵔⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵜⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ. ⵖⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ, ⴰⵜ ⵍⵜⴽⴰⵍ".

latin_inalco: Nnan wid ijehlen i imazanen nnsen: "war ccekk, a kwen nessuffeɣ si tmurt nneɣ, neɣ a d tuɣalem ar ddin nneɣ". Iweḥḥa yasen d Mass nnsen: "s tidet, a Nesqucc imednas,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ ⴰⵔ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ". ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰ ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ,

Tifinagh: ⴷⵖⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵔⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⴷⴰⵖ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ". ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⴰⴱⵔⵔⵉ ⵡ.

latin_inalco: Ssarmen lɣelb. Ixseṛ yal aqehhaṛ amnafeq.

latin_inalco: Lǧahennama deffir es, ad ites aman iwexmiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵙ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵡⵅⵎⵉⵢⵏ.

latin_inalco: Tissit d tijeɣwimin, ur izmir ad isseblaɛ. Tamettant a d tettas si yal tamnaṭ, netta ur itmettat. Deffir es aɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵊⵖⵡⵉⵎⵉⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴱⵍⴰⵄ. ⵜⴰⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵙ ⵙⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⴰⵎⵏⴰⵟ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵜ. ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Amedya n wid ijehlen, ar Mass nnsen: igiten nnsen am i$i$den i$ef iédem wavu, ass n tbucivant. Ur d ppawin acemma, seg wayen kesben. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.
latin_inalco: Amedya n wid ijehlen, ar Mass nnsen: igiten nnsen am iɣiɣden iɣef iẓdem waḍu, ass n tbuciḍant. Ur d ttawin acemma, seg wayen kesben. D wagi ay d ttelfan uɣmiq.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⵎ ⵉⵖⵉⵖⴷⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵥⴷⵎ ⵡⴰⴹⵓ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⴱⵓⵛⵉⴹⴰⵏⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⵓⵖⵎⵉⵇ.

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara, Öebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep? Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara, Ṛebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidet? Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ? ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⵙ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵡⵉ ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵎⴰⵢⵏⵓⵜ.

ayah_content: Ayagi, i Öebbi, ur illi d ayen izzenzafen.
latin_inalco: Ayagi, i Ṛebbi, ur illi d ayen izzenzafen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵣⵣⵏⵣⴰⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: A d rsen akw zdat Öebbi. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "s tidep, nella nedda yidwen, ma tzemrem ad a$ tsellkem kra, seg uâaqeb n Öebbi"? A d inin: "lemmer i $ Inha Öebbi, yili nwelleh ikwen. Iâuva fella$, neêmeq ne$ neûbeô, ur a$ illi ssôan".
latin_inalco: A d rsen akw zdat Ṛebbi. Ad inin uṛhifen i imzuxiyen: "s tidet, nella nedda yidwen, ma tzemrem ad aɣ tsellkem kra, seg uɛaqeb n Ṛebbi"? A d inin: "lemmer i ɣ Inha Ṛebbi, yili nwelleh ikwen. Iɛuḍa fellaɣ, neḥmeq neɣ neṣbeṛ, ur aɣ illi ssṛan".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵔⵙⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵓⵕⵀⵉⴼⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ: "ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⴰ ⵢⵉⴷⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵎ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵜⵙⵍⵍⴽⵎ ⴽⵔⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵏⵀⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵏⵡⵍⵍⵀ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ. ⵉⵄⵓⴹⴰ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ, ⵏⵃⵎⵇ ⵏⵖ ⵏⵚⴱⵕ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵙⵙⵕⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Mi isuyya lameô, a d yini Cciîan: "Öebbi, d ûûeê, Iweââd awen lemâahda n tidep. Weââde$ awen, $uôe$ kwen. Ur sâi$ adabu fellawen, siwa anecced nnwen. Tu$em awal iw. Ur iyi plummut, lummet iman nnwen. Ur zmire$ a kwen âawne$, ur tezmirem ad iyi tâawnem. Nekôe$ wid iyi tepcarakem, zik. I imednas, s tidep, aâaqeb aqeôêan".
latin_inalco: Mi isuyya lameṛ, a d yini Cciṭan: "Ṛebbi, d ṣṣeḥ, Iweɛɛd awen lemɛahda n tidet. Weɛɛdeɣ awen, ɣuṛeɣ kwen. Ur sɛiɣ adabu fellawen, siwa anecced nnwen. Tuɣem awal iw. Ur iyi tlummut, lummet iman nnwen. Ur zmireɣ a kwen ɛawneɣ, ur tezmirem ad iyi tɛawnem. Nekṛeɣ wid iyi tetcarakem, zik. I imednas, s tidet, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵙⵓⵢⵢⴰ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ: "ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⵚⵚⵃ, ⵉⵡⵄⵄⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵡⵄⵄⴷⵖ ⴰⵡⵏ, ⵖⵓⵕⵖ ⴽⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵉⵖ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵏⵛⵛⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵜⵓⵖⵎ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵡ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜⵍⵓⵎⵎⵓⵜ, ⵍⵓⵎⵎⵜ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵖ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵄⴰⵡⵏⵖ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵉⵔⵎ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⵡⵏⵎ. ⵏⴽⵕⵖ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵎ, ⵣⵉⴽ. ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Ad skecmen wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen dinna, s wannuf n Mass nnsen. Azul nnsen dinna d: "tifrat"!
latin_inalco: Ad skecmen wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar leǧnanat, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen, ad wekkṛen dinna, s wannuf n Mass nnsen. Azul nnsen dinna d: "tifrat"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵙⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⴼ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⵣⵓⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴷ: "ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ"!

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara, amek id Ifka Öebbi amedya? Awal lâali am ttejôa lâali, iéuôan is ôûan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara, amek id Ifka Ṛebbi amedya? Awal lɛali am ttejṛa lɛali, iẓuṛan is ṛṣan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ? ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵍⵄⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⵎ ⵜⵜⵊⵕⴰ ⵍⵄⴰⵍⵉ, ⵉⵥⵓⵕⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵕⵚⴰⵏ, ⵉⴼⵔⴽⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵙ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴳⵏⵡⵜ.

ayah_content: Teppak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Ippawi d Öebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.
latin_inalco: Tettak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Ittawi d Ṛebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵍⴼⴰⴽⵉⴰ ⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⴼ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵜⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejôa tucmip, teqlaâ sennig wakal, war leqôaô.
latin_inalco: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejṛa tucmit, teqlaɛ sennig wakal, war leqṛaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ, ⴰⵎ ⵜⵜⵊⵕⴰ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ, ⵜⵇⵍⴰⵄ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵍⵇⵕⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeôt. Öebbi Itellif imednas. Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeṛt. Ṛebbi Itellif imednas. Ṛebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⴱⴱⵉⵜ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵍⵍⵉⴼ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara wid ineûfen l$it n Öebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twa$it.
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid ineṣfen lɣit n Ṛebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twaɣit.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵚⴼⵏ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉ? ⵙⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Loahennama ad ô$en degs: a yir leqôaô!
latin_inalco: Lǧahennama ad ṛɣen degs: a yir leqṛaṛ!
Tifinagh: ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵕⵖⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ: ⴰ ⵢⵉⵔ ⵍⵇⵕⴰⵕ!

ayah_content: Gan aS i Öebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tidep, leqôaô nnwen d times".
latin_inalco: Gan aS i Ṛebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tidet, leqṛaṛ nnwen d times".
Tifinagh: ⴳⴰⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⴰⵏⵓⴷⴷⴰ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵍⴼⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵣⵣⵀⵓⵜ! ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵍⵇⵕⴰⵕ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ".

ayah_content: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i téallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra u âinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.
latin_inalco: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i tẓallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten Nɣat, s tuffra u ɛinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴱⴷⴷⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⴷⴷⵇⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵖⴰⵜ, ⵙ ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵔⴰ ⵓ ⵄⵉⵏⴰⵏⵉ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵙⵙⵓⵇ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉ ⵜⴷⵓⴽⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issufu$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuô i iteddun di yill, s lameô iS.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isseɣlayen aman seg igenni, Issufuɣ ed yissen ttemṛa, d ṛṛeẓq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuṛ i iteddun di yill, s lameṛ iS.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⵓⵖ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵜⵜⵎⵕⴰ, ⴷ ⵕⵕⵥⵇ ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ. ⵉⵏⵓⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ, ⵓ ⵙ ⵍⴱⴰⴱⵓⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵢⵉⵍⵍ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Inub fellawen s yiîij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiv akked wass.
latin_inalco: Inub fellawen s yiṭij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiḍ akked wass.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵓⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵟⵉⵊ ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉⵢⵏ. ⵉⵏⵓⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵢⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ.

ayah_content: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma pêesbem l$it n Mass nnwen, ur tessawavem. Ih, amdan, s tidep, d amednus, d ajehli.
latin_inalco: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma tḥesbem lɣit n Mass nnwen, ur tessawaḍem. Ih, amdan, s tidet, d amednus, d ajehli.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵙ ⵜⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵎ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵃⵙⴱⵎ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⴹⵎ. ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⵏⵓⵙ, ⴷ ⴰⵊⵀⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Âatq a$, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tâancuôin.
latin_inalco: Mi inna Ibṛahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Ɛatq aɣ, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tɛancuṛin.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵔⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ ⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⵄⴰⵜⵇ ⴰⵖ, ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ ⵉⵡ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ ⵏ ⵜⵄⴰⵏⵛⵓⵕⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tidep, telfent aîas n medden. Win iddan yidi, neppa, s tidep, sgi. Win iyi âuûan, Keçç, s tidep, Tepsemmiêev, Tepêunuv.
latin_inalco: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tidet, telfent aṭas n medden. Win iddan yidi, netta, s tidet, sgi. Win iyi ɛuṣan, Kečč, s tidet, Tetsemmiḥeḍ, Tetḥunuḍ.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵜⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵜⵍⴼⵏⵜ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵉ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵙⴳⵉ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵄⵓⵚⴰⵏ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵜⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⴹ, ⵜⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓⴹ.

ayah_content: A Mass nne$! Nek rri$ tanezdu$t, i kra n warraw iw, di te$zut ibuôen, ar Uxxam iK iôqan. A Mass nne$! Iwakken ad bedden i téallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iêninen $uôsen, £it iten s ppemôat, amar ad snemmren.
latin_inalco: A Mass nneɣ! Nek rriɣ tanezduɣt, i kra n warraw iw, di teɣzut ibuṛen, ar Uxxam iK iṛqan. A Mass nneɣ! Iwakken ad bedden i tẓallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iḥninen ɣuṛsen, ɣit iten s ttemṛat, amar ad snemmren.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵏⴽ ⵔⵔⵉⵖ ⵜⴰⵏⵣⴷⵓⵖⵜ, ⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ ⵉⵡ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵖⵣⵓⵜ ⵉⴱⵓⵕⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵕⵇⴰⵏ. ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴱⴷⴷⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ. ⵔⵔ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵏⵉⵏⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵖⵉⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵜⵎⵕⴰⵜ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵏⵎⵎⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, Teéôiv ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Öebbi, di tmurt ne$ deg igenni.
latin_inalco: A Mass nneɣ! Kečč, s tidet, Teẓṛiḍ ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Ṛebbi, di tmurt neɣ deg igenni.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵜⵥⵕⵉⴹ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵏⴼⴼⵔ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵏⴰ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵏⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ.

ayah_content: Ccekôan i Öebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaâil akked Isêaq. Mass iw, s tidep, Issemêas i tnaâôit.
latin_inalco: Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaɛil akked Isḥaq. Mass iw, s tidet, Issemḥas i tnaɛṛit.
Tifinagh: ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ ⵉⴼⴽⴰⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵡⵙⵔ ⵉⵡ, ⵉⵙⵎⴰⵄⵉⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵙⵃⴰⵇ. ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵜⵏⴰⵄⵕⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad bedde$ i téallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steôêeb s unuju w.
latin_inalco: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad beddeɣ i tẓallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steṛḥeb s unuju w.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵔⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⴷ ⴱⴷⴷⵖ ⵉ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ. ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴽⵔⴰ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵔⵡⴰ ⵡ. ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵙⵜⵕⵃⴱ ⵙ ⵓⵏⵓⵊⵓ ⵡ.

ayah_content: A Mass nne$! Semmeê ane$, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeîîi".
latin_inalco: A Mass nneɣ! Semmeḥ aneɣ, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeṭṭi".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⴰⵏⵖ, ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⵍⵡⴰⵍⴷⵉⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ".

ayah_content: Ur p$ili ar I$fel Öebbi, $ef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iooa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beêêren allen.
latin_inalco: Ur tɣili ar Iɣfel Ṛebbi, ɣef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iǧǧa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beḥḥren allen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵖⵉⵍⵉ ⴰⵔ ⵉⵖⴼⵍ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ. ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴱⵃⵃⵔⵏ ⴰⵍⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad p$awalen, iqweôôa ff$en d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.
latin_inalco: Ad tɣawalen, iqweṛṛa ffɣen d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵜⵖⴰⵡⴰⵍⵏ, ⵉⵇⵡⵕⵕⴰ ⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⴷ, ⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴼⵔⵣⵏⵜ, ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵍⵎⴰⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uâaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur tep$abem?
latin_inalco: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uɛaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nneɣ! Efk aneɣ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur tetɣabem?
Tifinagh: ⵏⴰⴱⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⴼⴽ ⴰⵏⵖ ⵍⵎⵓⴷⴷⴰ ⵡⵣⵣⵉⵍⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵊⴰⵡⴱ ⵉ ⵓⵏⴰⴱⵉ ⴽ, ⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⵓ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ". "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⴳⴳⵓⵍⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵣⵉⴽ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵖⴰⴱⵎ?

ayah_content: Tzed$em ixxamen n wid ivuôôen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".
latin_inalco: Tzedɣem ixxamen n wid iḍuṛṛen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".
Tifinagh: ⵜⵣⴷⵖⵎ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴹⵓⵕⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵓ ⵏⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵏⴳⴰ, ⵓ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵜⵏ".

ayah_content: Ni$ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Öebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isse$lin idurar.
latin_inalco: Niɣ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Ṛebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isseɣlin idurar.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵓⵏⴷⵉⵏ ⵛⵛⴱⵓⴽⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵛⵛⴱⵓⴽⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵀⴰⴰⵜⵏⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵅⴰⵙ ⵎⴰ ⵛⵛⴱⵓⴽⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: £uôek a p$ilev Öebbi ad Izgel lemâahda S, i imazanen. S tidep, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
latin_inalco: ɣuṛek a tɣileḍ Ṛebbi ad Izgel lemɛahda S, i imazanen. S tidet, Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Ittara d ttaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵖⵓⵕⴽ ⴰ ⵜⵖⵉⵍⴹ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵣⴳⵍ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵙ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg tamurt a ppu$al maççi d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg tamurt a ttuɣal mačči d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Ṛebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ; ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ; ⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⵇⵀⵀⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: A pwaliv, assen, ibe$wviyen pwaqqnen wa $er wa.
latin_inalco: A twaliḍ, assen, ibeɣwḍiyen twaqqnen wa ɣer wa.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵇⵇⵏⵏ ⵡⴰ ⵖⵔ ⵡⴰ.

ayah_content: Lebsa nnsen d qevôan, times t$umm udmawen nnsen.
latin_inalco: Lebsa nnsen d qeḍṛan, times tɣumm udmawen nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴱⵙⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵇⴹⵕⴰⵏ, ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⵜⵖⵓⵎⵎ ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi yal amdan, $ef wayen ikseb. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal di leêsab.
latin_inalco: Iwakken ad Ikafi Ṛebbi yal amdan, ɣef wayen ikseb. Ṛebbi, s tidet, Itɣawal di leḥsab.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴽⵙⴱ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵜⵖⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴷⵉ ⵍⵃⵙⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad pwanedôen yis, ad éôen ar siwa Neppa ay d Öebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uâqilen.
latin_inalco: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad twanedṛen yis, ad ẓṛen ar siwa Netta ay d Ṛebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uɛqilen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵏⵛⵛⴷ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⴷⵕⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt, u d Leqwôan ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Alṛ. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt, u d Leqwṛan itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵍⵕ. ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ahat wid ijehlen ssaramen ad ilin d imvuâen.
latin_inalco: Ahat wid ijehlen ssaramen ad ilin d imḍuɛen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵀⴰⵜ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵙⵙⴰⵔⴰⵎⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Eoo iten ad ççen, ad zhun, a ten issedhu usirem. Deqqal ad éôen.
latin_inalco: Eǧǧ iten ad ččen, ad zhun, a ten issedhu usirem. Deqqal ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⴻⴷⴷⵊ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵛⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵣⵀⵓⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴷⵀⵓ ⵓⵙⵉⵔⵎ. ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur Nesquccu tamdint, siwa ma d ayen i s iuran, ipwassnen.
latin_inalco: Ur Nesquccu tamdint, siwa ma d ayen i s iuran, itwassnen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛⵓ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵓⵔⴰⵏ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur illi lois ara d isqeôben, ne$ ara iswexxôen lajel is.
latin_inalco: Ur illi lǧis ara d isqeṛben, neɣ ara iswexxṛen lajel is.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵇⵕⴱⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵙⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "a win u$uô d irs usmekti! Keçç, war ccekk, d aôehbani.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "a win uɣuṛ d irs usmekti! Kečč, war ccekk, d aṛehbani.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵙ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ! ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵕⵀⴱⴰⵏⵉ.

ayah_content: Acimi ur a$ d tusiv ara, s lmalayek, ma d tidep ay tessawalev"?
latin_inalco: Acimi ur aɣ d tusiḍ ara, s lmalayek, ma d tidet ay tessawaleḍ"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵉⵎⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⵉⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵙ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⴹ"?

ayah_content: Ur Nesrusu lmalayek, siwa s tidep. Imiren, ur pganin.
latin_inalco: Ur Nesrusu lmalayek, siwa s tidet. Imiren, ur tganin.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴳⴰⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, Nekwni Nessers ed asmekti. Ih, Nekwni a Nêareb fellas.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nekwni Nessers ed asmekti. Ih, Nekwni a Nḥareb fellas.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰ ⵏⵃⴰⵔⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, i ikabaren imezwura.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, i ikabaren imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵉⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur ten id ippas umazan, mebla ma ttahan fellas.
latin_inalco: Ur ten id ittas umazan, mebla ma ttahan fellas.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵙ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵀⴰⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Akka ay t Nessekcam deg ulawen ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: Akka ay t Nessekcam deg ulawen ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵜ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵛⴰⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur uminen yis, ulamma ooan d imezwura tannumi.
latin_inalco: Ur uminen yis, ulamma ǧǧan d imezwura tannumi.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵓⵎⵉⵏⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⵓⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⴷⴷⵊⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵏⵏⵓⵎⵉ.

ayah_content: Xas ad asen Nelli tabburt igenni, ad ppalin $uôes,
latin_inalco: Xas ad asen Nelli tabburt igenni, ad ttalin ɣuṛes,
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵙ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⵜⴰⴱⴱⵓⵔⵜ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ,

ayah_content: a d inin, war ccekk: "ittules iéôi nne$, ne$ nekwni d agdud iwumi sseêren".
latin_inalco: a d inin, war ccekk: "ittules iẓṛi nneɣ, neɣ nekwni d agdud iwumi sseḥren".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ: "ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵍⵙ ⵉⵥⵕⵉ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵏⵖ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵙⵙⵃⵔⵏ".

ayah_content: Ni$ Nerra itran deg igenni. Ncebbeê iten i wid ipmuqulen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nerra itran deg igenni. Ncebbeḥ iten i wid itmuqulen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ. ⵏⵛⴱⴱⵃ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵎⵓⵇⵓⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Nesdari ten, si yal cciîan imenfi.
latin_inalco: Nesdari ten, si yal cciṭan imenfi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⴷⴰⵔⵉ ⵜⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⵏⴼⵉ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed win d issemêessen s tufra, A p iddu, fellas, ujajiê n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed win d issemḥessen s tufra, A t iddu, fellas, ujajiḥ n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⵙⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵓⴼⵔⴰ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷⴷⵓ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Tamurt Nessewsaâ p; Nerra fellas idurar; Nessem$i d, degs, yal cci, s lmizan.
latin_inalco: Tamurt Nessewsaɛ t; Nerra fellas idurar; Nessemɣi d, degs, yal cci, s lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵏⵙⵙⵡⵙⴰⵄ ⵜ; ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ; ⵏⵙⵙⵎⵖⵉ ⴷ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nerra, degs, lqut i kunwi, akw i wid ur tecceççayem ara.
latin_inalco: Nerra, degs, lqut i kunwi, akw i wid ur tecceččayem ara.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵍⵇⵓⵜ ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵛⵛⵜⵜⵛⴰⵢⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Lexzayen n yal cci, $uône£ kan. Siwa s lkil ipwassnen i ten id Nesrusu.
latin_inalco: Lexzayen n yal cci, ɣuṛneɣ kan. Siwa s lkil itwassnen i ten id Nesrusu.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵅⵣⴰⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ ⴽⴰⵏ. ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵙ ⵍⴽⵉⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ.

ayah_content: Nuzen ed avu isswayen. Nesse$li d aman seg igenni, yissen Nessew ikwen. Ur llin ara lexzayen is $uôwen.
latin_inalco: Nuzen ed aḍu isswayen. Nesseɣli d aman seg igenni, yissen Nessew ikwen. Ur llin ara lexzayen is ɣuṛwen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴹⵓ ⵉⵙⵙⵡⴰⵢⵏ. ⵏⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⵡ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵍⵅⵣⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, d Nekwni i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. D Nekwni ay d Iweôôaten.
latin_inalco: Ih, d Nekwni i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. D Nekwni ay d Iweṛṛaten.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵏⵇⵇⵏ. ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵡⵕⵕⴰⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nessen imezwura nnwen, Nessen ineggura.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nessen imezwura nnwen, Nessen ineggura.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵏⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, Mass ik, Neppa, a ten id Ifser. Ih, Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Ih, Mass ik, Netta, a ten id Ifser. Ih, Netta, d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⵙⵔ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nexleq amdan si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nexleq amdan si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵅⵜ ⵜⴰⴱⵔⴽⴰⵏⵜ ⵉ ⵎⵙⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Nexleq loenn, iu$ lêal, si tmes n ccili.
latin_inalco: Nexleq lǧenn, iuɣ lḥal, si tmes n ccili.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏ, ⵉⵓⵖ ⵍⵃⴰⵍ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ ⵏ ⵛⵛⵉⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek Xelqe$ amdan, si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
latin_inalco: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek Xelqeɣ amdan, si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ: "ⵏⴽ ⵅⵍⵇⵖ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵅⵜ ⵜⴰⴱⵔⴽⴰⵏⵜ ⵉ ⵎⵙⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi t Mesle$, u Üûuve$ as si ôôuê iW, ersemt $uôes, knumt".
latin_inalco: Mi t Mesleɣ, u Üṣuḍeɣ as si ṛṛuḥ iW, ersemt ɣuṛes, knumt".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜ ⵎⵙⵍⵖ, ⵓ Üⵚⵓⴹⵖ ⴰⵙ ⵙⵉ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵉⵡ, ⵔⵙⵎⵜ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⴽⵏⵓⵎⵜ".

ayah_content: Knant akw lmalayek, akken ma llant,
latin_inalco: Knant akw lmalayek, akken ma llant,
Tifinagh: ⴽⵏⴰⵏⵜ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏⵜ,

ayah_content: siwa Iblis, iugi ad yili ar wid iknan.
latin_inalco: siwa Iblis, iugi ad yili ar wid iknan.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉⴱⵍⵉⵙ, ⵉⵓⴳⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⴰⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⵏⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Inna: "a yIblis, acu ik iu$en, ur telliv ar wid iknan"?
latin_inalco: Inna: "a yIblis, acu ik iuɣen, ur telliḍ ar wid iknan"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵢⵉⴱⵍⵉⵙ, ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⴹ ⴰⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⵏⴰⵏ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "ur kennu$ i umdan, i Txelqev si talaxt taberkant i meslen".
latin_inalco: Inna: "ur kennuɣ i umdan, i Txelqeḍ si talaxt taberkant i meslen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵓⵔ ⴽⵏⵏⵓⵖ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵜⵅⵍⵇⴹ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵅⵜ ⵜⴰⴱⵔⴽⴰⵏⵜ ⵉ ⵎⵙⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "effe$ segs! Aql ak, ihi, d imenfi.
latin_inalco: Inna: "effeɣ segs! Aql ak, ihi, d imenfi.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴼⴼⵖ ⵙⴳⵙ! ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⵏⴼⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, fellak ddell alamma d ass uqeîîi".
latin_inalco: Ih, fellak ddell alamma d ass uqeṭṭi".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ ⴷⴷⵍⵍ ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ".

ayah_content: Inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi alamma d ass n tnekra nnsen".
latin_inalco: Inna: "a Mass iw! Eǧǧ iyi alamma d ass n tnekra nnsen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⴷⴷⵊ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "ih, keçç seg wid ipganin,
latin_inalco: Inna: "ih, kečč seg wid itganin,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵉⵀ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⴳⴰⵏⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: ar ass n yiùmir ipwassnen".
latin_inalco: ar ass n yiùmir itwassnen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵢⵉùⵎⵉⵔ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "a Mass iw! Imi yi Terriv d a$ewway, war ccekk, ad asen cebbêe$ ddunit, a ten $ewwu$, akken ma llan.
latin_inalco: Inna: "a Mass iw! Imi yi Terriḍ d aɣewway, war ccekk, ad asen cebbḥeɣ ddunit, a ten ɣewwuɣ, akken ma llan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵉⵎⵉ ⵢⵉ ⵜⵔⵔⵉⴹ ⴷ ⴰⵖⵡⵡⴰⵢ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵛⴱⴱⵃⵖ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵖⵡⵡⵓⵖ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed imdanen iK izedganen garasen".
latin_inalco: Kkes ed imdanen iK izedganen garasen".
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "$uôI, wagi d abrid uwqim.
latin_inalco: Inna: "ɣuṛI, wagi d abrid uwqim.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵖⵓⵕⵉ, ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: War ccekk, ur tesâiv adabu $ef imdanen iW, siwa wid i k ivefôen seg imjaêen".
latin_inalco: War ccekk, ur tesɛiḍ adabu ɣef imdanen iW, siwa wid i k iḍefṛen seg imjaḥen".
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵄⵉⴹ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴹⴼⵕⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵊⴰⵃⵏ".

ayah_content: Loahennama, s tidep, d ppaâud nnsen akw.
latin_inalco: Lǧahennama, s tidet, d ttaɛud nnsen akw.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵄⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ.

ayah_content: D m ûa tebbura; ar yal tabburt, s urbaâ ines.
latin_inalco: D m ṣa tebbura; ar yal tabburt, s urbaɛ ines.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵎ ⵚⴰ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ; ⴰⵔ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⴰⴱⴱⵓⵔⵜ, ⵙ ⵓⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⵉⵏⵙ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ipêezziben, di leonanat akked tliwa:
latin_inalco: Ih, wid itḥezziben, di leǧnanat akked tliwa:
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ:

ayah_content: kecmet pen di tifrat, akked laman"!
latin_inalco: kecmet ten di tifrat, akked laman"!
Tifinagh: ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵜⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ"!

ayah_content: Nekkes i illan d dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. D atmaten, deg imîeôêen, mqabalen.
latin_inalco: Nekkes i illan d ddɣel, deg idmaren nnsen. D atmaten, deg imṭeṛḥen, mqabalen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⴽⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴷⴷⵖⵍ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴷ ⴰⵜⵎⴰⵜⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ, ⵎⵇⴰⴱⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur âaggun degsen, ur ten id ssuffu$en segsen.
latin_inalco: Ur ɛaggun degsen, ur ten id ssuffuɣen segsen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵄⴰⴳⴳⵓⵏ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵓⵖⵏ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Xebbeô ixdimen iW; Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$, Pêunu$.
latin_inalco: Xebbeṛ ixdimen iW; Nek, s tidet, Psemmiḥeɣ, Pḥunuɣ.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴱⴱⵕ ⵉⵅⴷⵉⵎⵏ ⵉⵡ; ⵏⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, Pⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵖ, Pⵃⵓⵏⵓⵖ.

ayah_content: U aâaqeb iW d aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: U aɛaqeb iW d aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵡ ⴷ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Xebbeô iten $ef inebgawen n Ibôahim.
latin_inalco: Xebbeṛ iten ɣef inebgawen n Ibṛahim.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴱⴱⵕ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵏⴱⴳⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Mi kecmen $uôes, nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "s tidep, nugad ikwen".
latin_inalco: Mi kecmen ɣuṛes, nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "s tidet, nugad ikwen".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ"! ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵓⴳⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "ur ppagwad, a k nbecceô kan, s uqcic amusnaw".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "ur ttagwad, a k nbecceṛ kan, s uqcic amusnaw".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷ, ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵓⵇⵛⵉⵛ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ".

ayah_content: Inna: "tbecceôm iyi d, mi wessre$. Acu iyi d tbeccôem"?
latin_inalco: Inna: "tbecceṛm iyi d, mi wessreɣ. Acu iyi d tbeccṛem"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵜⴱⵛⵛⵕⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ, ⵎⵉ ⵡⵙⵙⵔⵖ. ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ ⵜⴱⵛⵛⵕⵎ"?

ayah_content: Nnan: "Nbecceô ik id, s tidep, ur ppili seg wid iuysen".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "Nbecceṛ ik id, s tidet, ur ttili seg wid iuysen".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉⴽ ⵉⴷ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵢⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "anwa iuysen aêunu n Mass is, siwa im$eôôqen"?
latin_inalco: Inna: "anwa iuysen aḥunu n Mass is, siwa imɣeṛṛqen"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉⵓⵢⵙⵏ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇⵏ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "d acu ay d lmeqsud nnwen, a yimceggâen"?
latin_inalco: Inna: "d acu ay d lmeqsud nnwen, a yimceggɛen"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵇⵙⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⵛⴳⴳⵄⵏ"?

ayah_content: Nnan: "Nekwni, s tidep, neppuceggaâ d s agdud ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "Nekwni, s tidet, nettuceggaɛ d s agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⵓⵛⴳⴳⴰⵄ ⴷ ⵙ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed tawacult n Luî, ara nsellek akw,
latin_inalco: Kkes ed tawacult n Luṭ, ara nsellek akw,
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵟ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⴰⴽⵡ,

ayah_content: siwa tameîîut is. Ih, Nseyya a ppili, neppat, seg ineggura".
latin_inalco: siwa tameṭṭut is. Ih, Nseyya a ttili, nettat, seg ineggura".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵟⵟⵓⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵜ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ".

ayah_content: Mi ôuêen imceggâen ar twacult n Luî,
latin_inalco: Mi ṛuḥen imceggɛen ar twacult n Luṭ,
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵕⵓⵃⵏ ⵉⵎⵛⴳⴳⵄⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵟ,

ayah_content: inna: "kunwi, s tidep, d imdanen ur nessin".
latin_inalco: inna: "kunwi, s tidet, d imdanen ur nessin".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵙⵉⵏ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "xaîi, Nusa d, $uôek, s wayen rran di ccekk.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "xaṭi, Nusa d, ɣuṛek, s wayen rran di ccekk.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵏⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ, ⵖⵓⵕⴽ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ.

ayah_content: Nusa d, $uôek, s tidep. Nekwni, war ccekk, nessawal tidep.
latin_inalco: Nusa d, ɣuṛek, s tidet. Nekwni, war ccekk, nessawal tidet.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ, ⵖⵓⵕⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵏⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ.

ayah_content: Öuê akked twacult ik, mi mazal yiv. Ddu deffir sen. Ur d itezzi yiwen degwen! Âaddit anda i wen ippunefk lameô".
latin_inalco: Ṛuḥ akked twacult ik, mi mazal yiḍ. Ddu deffir sen. Ur d itezzi yiwen degwen! Ɛaddit anda i wen ittunefk lameṛ".
Tifinagh: ⵕⵓⵃ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⴽ, ⵎⵉ ⵎⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⵢⵉⴹ. ⴷⴷⵓ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵣⵣⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴷⴳⵡⵏ! ⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉⵜ ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ".

ayah_content: Nseyya yas lameô agi: a d gwrin ad pwagezmen wakali.
latin_inalco: Nseyya yas lameṛ agi: a d gwrin ad twagezmen wakali.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⴰⴳⵉ: ⴰ ⴷ ⴳⵡⵔⵉⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⴳⵣⵎⵏ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Usan d, imezda$ n temdint, feôêen.
latin_inalco: Usan d, imezdaɣ n temdint, feṛḥen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⴷ, ⵉⵎⵣⴷⴰⵖ ⵏ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ, ⴼⵕⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Inna: "wigi, s tidep, d inebgawen iw, ur iyi cmmatet.
latin_inalco: Inna: "wigi, s tidet, d inebgawen iw, ur iyi cmmatet.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵏⴱⴳⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵛⵎⵎⴰⵜⵜ.

ayah_content: Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi sdullut"!
latin_inalco: Ḥezbet i Ṛebbi, ur iyi sdullut"!
Tifinagh: ⵃⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵓⵜ"!

ayah_content: Nnan: "day ur ak negdil ara imdanen"?
latin_inalco: Nnan: "day ur ak negdil ara imdanen"?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴰⴽ ⵏⴳⴷⵉⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "atent an issi, ma taânam".
latin_inalco: Inna: "atent an issi, ma taɛnam".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰⵜⵏⵜ ⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⴰⵄⵏⴰⵎ".

ayah_content: S tudert ik, ar ddebdeben si ssekôan nnsen!
latin_inalco: S tudert ik, ar ddebdeben si ssekṛan nnsen!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵓⴷⵔⵜ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵔ ⴷⴷⴱⴷⴱⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵙⵙⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ!

ayah_content: Iwwet iten usu$u, tafrara.
latin_inalco: Iwwet iten usuɣu, tafrara.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵙⵓⵖⵓ, ⵜⴰⴼⵔⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Nesrewt ip. Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur n yiéôa n talaxt.
latin_inalco: Nesrewt it. Nesseɣli d fellasen ageffur n yiẓṛa n talaxt.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵔⵡⵜ ⵉⵜ. ⵏⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵏ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵅⵜ.

ayah_content: Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i wid issnen ad ssikden.
latin_inalco: Deg waya, s tidet, d issekniyen i wid issnen ad ssikden.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵙⵉⴽⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Apan, ih, deg ubrid n yal ass.
latin_inalco: Atan, ih, deg ubrid n yal ass.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⴰⵏ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵙⵙ.

ayah_content: Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Deg waya, s tidet, d assekni i lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, llan At Teégi, war ccekk, d imednas.
latin_inalco: Ih, llan At Teẓgi, war ccekk, d imednas.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵥⴳⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Nerra d ppaô segsen. Ihi, atent an, snat nni, deg ubrid ibanen.
latin_inalco: Nerra d ttaṛ segsen. Ihi, atent an, snat nni, deg ubrid ibanen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵜⵏⵜ ⴰⵏ, ⵙⵏⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵉ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ At Lêioô skaddben imazanen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ At Lḥiǧṛ skaddben imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⵜ ⵍⵃⵉⴷⵊⵕ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Nebbwi yasen d issekniyen nne£. Wexxôen asen.
latin_inalco: Nebbwi yasen d issekniyen nneɣ. Wexxṛen asen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Llan qqazen ixxamen n laman, deg idurar.
latin_inalco: Llan qqazen ixxamen n laman, deg idurar.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵇⵇⴰⵣⵏ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Iwwet iten usu$u, taûebêit.
latin_inalco: Iwwet iten usuɣu, taṣebḥit.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵙⵓⵖⵓ, ⵜⴰⵚⴱⵃⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Ulay sen ixdem wayen la keppben.
latin_inalco: Ulay sen ixdem wayen la kettben.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵍⴰⵢ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⴰ ⴽⵜⵜⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tidep. Imir a d ias, war ccekk. Ihi, ssuref s lekyasa.
latin_inalco: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tidet. Imir a d ias, war ccekk. Ihi, ssuref s lekyasa.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵅⵍⵉⵇ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵉⵎⵉⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵙⵙⵓⵔⴼ ⵙ ⵍⴽⵢⴰⵙⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, Mass ik d Axellaq, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Ih, Mass ik d Axellaq, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka yak d ûa i usniles, akked Leqwôan ameqwôaêan.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nefka yak d ṣa i usniles, akked Leqwṛan ameqwṛaḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵚⴰ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵏⵉⵍⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur pmuqul ar wayen is N$at kra n twaculin nnsen. Ur $webbel ilmend nnsen. Zger tacvaî ik $ef lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Ur tmuqul ar wayen is Nɣat kra n twaculin nnsen. Ur ɣwebbel ilmend nnsen. Zger tacḍaṭ ik ɣef lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵎⵓⵇⵓⵍ ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵏⵖⴰⵜ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵖⵡⴱⴱⵍ ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵣⴳⵔ ⵜⴰⵛⴹⴰⵟ ⵉⴽ ⵖⴼ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "nekkini, s tidep, d aneddaô ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Ini: "nekkini, s tidet, d aneddaṛ itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽⴽⵉⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Akken id Nessers i wid ibvan,
latin_inalco: Akken id Nessers i wid ibḍan,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴱⴹⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: i irran Leqwôan d iêricen.
latin_inalco: i irran Leqwṛan d iḥricen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵃⵔⵉⵛⵏ.

ayah_content: S Mass ik, ard a ten Nesteqsi akw
latin_inalco: S Mass ik, ard a ten Nesteqsi akw
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ ⴰⴽⵡ

ayah_content: $ef wayen xeddmen!
latin_inalco: ɣef wayen xeddmen!
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ!

ayah_content: Ihi, emdeê ayen i$ef i k ippunefk lameô, îixxeô i imcurak.
latin_inalco: Ihi, emdeḥ ayen iɣef i k ittunefk lameṛ, ṭixxeṛ i imcurak.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵎⴷⵃ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ, ⵟⵉⵅⵅⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ.

ayah_content: Ih, a k Nqennaâ mgal wid ittihin,
latin_inalco: Ih, a k Nqennaɛ mgal wid ittihin,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⵇⵏⵏⴰⵄ ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵀⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: i irran ôebbi nniven, ar tama n Öebbi. Deqqal ad éôen.
latin_inalco: i irran ṛebbi nniḍen, ar tama n Ṛebbi. Deqqal ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Neéôa ar ul ik, keçç, iaâûeô seg wayen qqaôen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Neẓṛa ar ul ik, kečč, iaɛṣeṛ seg wayen qqaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵉⴰⵄⵚⵕ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Sbuccaâ Mass ik s ccekôan. Ili seg wid ikennun.
latin_inalco: Sbuccaɛ Mass ik s ccekṛan. Ili seg wid ikennun.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ. ⵉⵍⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⵏⵏⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Aâbed Mass ik, ar k id ias utebbet!
latin_inalco: Aɛbed Mass ik, ar k id ias utebbet!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵔ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜ!

ayah_content: Ad ias lameô n Öebbi, ur pêirit $uôes. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay, sennig wayen pcaraken.
latin_inalco: Ad ias lameṛ n Ṛebbi, ur tḥirit ɣuṛes. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aɛlay, sennig wayen tcaraken.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵃⵉⵔⵉⵜ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙ! ⴰⵢ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: Issrusu d lmalayek s ôôuê si lameô iS, $ef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedôet ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, êezzbet iyI".
latin_inalco: Issrusu d lmalayek s ṛṛuḥ si lameṛ iS, ɣef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedṛet ar ur illi ṛebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, ḥezzbet iyI".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ ⴷ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵙ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵙⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⴷⵕⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⴽ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ".

ayah_content: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ay Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
latin_inalco: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidet. Ay Aɛlay sennig wayen tcaraken!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⴰⵢ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ!

ayah_content: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iu$al aS, d axûim n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iuɣal aS, d axṣim n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⵇⵇⵉⵜ; ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴰⵙ, ⴷ ⴰⵅⵚⵉⵎ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceîîiven iêman, aba$uô, u, segsen, teppeppem.
latin_inalco: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceṭṭiḍen iḥman, abaɣuṛ, u, segsen, tettettem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ ⵉⵃⵎⴰⵏ, ⴰⴱⴰⵖⵓⵕ, ⵓ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵜⵎ.

ayah_content: D ccbaêa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.
latin_inalco: D ccbaḥa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵛⵛⴱⴰⵃⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵔⵔⵎ, ⵓ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵜⴽⵙⵎ.

ayah_content: Ppawin tiâkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur teppawvem, siwa ma tâapbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umâin, d Aênin.
latin_inalco: Ptawin tiɛkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur tettawḍem, siwa ma tɛatbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umɛin, d Aḥnin.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵜⵉⵄⴽⴽⵡⵎⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵡⴹⵎ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⵜⴱⵎ. ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵃⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Iâewdiwen, iserdyan, i$wyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaêa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.
latin_inalco: Iɛewdiwen, iserdyan, iɣwyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaḥa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵄⵡⴷⵉⵡⵏ, ⵉⵙⵔⴷⵢⴰⵏ, ⵉⵖⵡⵢⴰⵍ, ⵉ ⵔⵔⴽⴱⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵛⵛⴱⴰⵃⴰ. ⵉⵅⵍⵍⵇ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵙⵉⵏⵎ.

ayah_content: D Öebbi i Ippawin d ubrid. Ff$en segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meôôa.
latin_inalco: D Ṛebbi i Ittawin d ubrid. Ffɣen segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meṛṛa.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ. ⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵏⵀⵓ ⵎⵕⵕⴰ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i wen d Isse$layen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuô i itepp lmal.
latin_inalco: D Netta i wen d Isseɣlayen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuṛ i itett lmal.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ. ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⵜⵜⵊⵓⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⵜ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Isskar awen d yissen nnaâma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiéuôin, akked yal ppemôa. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.
latin_inalco: Isskar awen d yissen nnaɛma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiẓuṛin, akked yal ttemṛa. Deg waya, s tidet, assekni i ugdud itxemmimen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⴽⴰⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵏⵏⴰⵄⵎⴰ, ⴰⵣⵎⵎⵓⵔ, ⵜⵉⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ, ⵜⵉⵥⵓⵕⵉⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⵜⵎⵕⴰ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵅⵎⵎⵉⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Inub awen d s yiv akked wass, iîij akked waggur. Itran ppemnuben s lameô iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
latin_inalco: Inub awen d s yiḍ akked wass, iṭij akked waggur. Itran ttemnuben s lameṛ iS. Deg waya, s tidet, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵓⴱ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵙ ⵢⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ, ⵉⵟⵉⵊ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ. ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ ⵜⵜⵎⵏⵓⴱⵏ ⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴼⵀⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: I wen d Ixleq di tmurt, degs initen imgarraden. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ismektayen.
latin_inalco: I wen d Ixleq di tmurt, degs initen imgarraden. Deg waya, s tidet, assekni i ugdud ismektayen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷⴳⵙ ⵉⵏⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Inuben s yill, iwakken a pteppem, segs, aksum aleqqaq, a d teksem, segs, rrêuê i teppeqqnem. A pwaliv lbabuô ipcerrig it, iwakken a pnadim si lfevl iS, amar a ppesnemmrem.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Inuben s yill, iwakken a ttettem, segs, aksum aleqqaq, a d teksem, segs, rrḥuḥ i tetteqqnem. A twaliḍ lbabuṛ itcerrig it, iwakken a tnadim si lfeḍl iS, amar a ttesnemmrem.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵏⵓⴱⵏ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵍⵍ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵎ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⴰⴽⵙⵓⵎ ⴰⵍⵇⵇⴰⵇ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴽⵙⵎ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⵔⵔⵃⵓⵃ ⵉ ⵜⵜⵜⵇⵇⵏⵎ. ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵍⴱⴰⴱⵓⵕ ⵉⵜⵛⵔⵔⵉⴳ ⵉⵜ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵏⴰⴷⵉⵎ ⵙⵉ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⵏⵎⵎⵔⵎ.

ayah_content: Issers idurar $ef tmurt, ur teppembwiwil yiswen; isaffen, iberdan, amar a ppepwanham;
latin_inalco: Issers idurar ɣef tmurt, ur tettembwiwil yiswen; isaffen, iberdan, amar a ttetwanham;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⵎⴱⵡⵉⵡⵉⵍ ⵢⵉⵙⵡⵏ; ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ, ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵎ;

ayah_content: timuliwin: s yitran, nitni pwanhan.
latin_inalco: timuliwin: s yitran, nitni twanhan.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵓⵍⵉⵡⵉⵏ: ⵙ ⵢⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Day Win Ixelqen am win ur nxelleq? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
latin_inalco: Day Win Ixelqen am win ur nxelleq? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⴰⵎ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵅⵍⵍⵇ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Lemmer a pêesbem l$it n Öebbi, ur tezmirem. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Lemmer a tḥesbem lɣit n Ṛebbi, ur tezmirem. Ih, Ṛebbi, war ccekk, Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵃⵙⴱⵎ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵉⵔⵎ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen teqqaôem.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen teffrem akked wayen teqqaṛem.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴼⴼⵔⵎ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵇⵇⴰⵕⵎ.

ayah_content: Wid u$uô pnujun, war Öebbi, ur illi wayen xelqen. D nitni i ipwaxelqen.
latin_inalco: Wid uɣuṛ tnujun, war Ṛebbi, ur illi wayen xelqen. D nitni i itwaxelqen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⵍⵇⵏ. ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵅⵍⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: D lmeggtin ur d imuddiren, ur éôin melmi ara ten id ssekren.
latin_inalco: D lmeggtin ur d imuddiren, ur ẓṛin melmi ara ten id ssekren.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵍⵎⴳⴳⵜⵉⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵓⴷⴷⵉⵔⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵏ ⵎⵍⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⴽⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, d ulawen nnsen i iugin. U nitni pzzuxun.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi nnwen d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, d ulawen nnsen i iugin. U nitni tzzuxun.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴷ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵓⴳⵉⵏ. ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵜⵣⵣⵓⵅⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: War ccekk, Öebbi Iéôa ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara imzuxiyen.
latin_inalco: War ccekk, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaṛen. Netta, s tidet, ur Iḥemmel ara imzuxiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴼⴼⵔⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma nnan asen: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? Qqaôen: "d timucuha imezwura".
latin_inalco: Ma nnan asen: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? Qqaṛen: "d timucuha imezwura".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ"? ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵓⵛⵓⵀⴰ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ".

ayah_content: Ad bibben, ass n tnekra, tiâakkwmin nnsen, s pmam nnsent, akked wumur si tâakkwmin n wid telfen, mebla ma faqen. Day maççi dir it wayen bubben?
latin_inalco: Ad bibben, ass n tnekra, tiɛakkwmin nnsen, s tmam nnsent, akked wumur si tɛakkwmin n wid telfen, mebla ma faqen. Day mačči dir it wayen bubben?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴱⵉⴱⴱⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⵜⵉⵄⴰⴽⴽⵡⵎⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵎⴰⵎ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵓⵎⵓⵔ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⴽⴽⵡⵎⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵜⵍⴼⵏ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⴼⴰⵇⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷⵉⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴱⵓⴱⴱⵏ?

ayah_content: Ih, undin p, wid i ten id izwaren. Öebbi Iaâtad lebni nnsen, si llsas. I$li d ssqef fellasen. Iusa ten id uâaqeb seg wanda ur bnin.
latin_inalco: Ih, undin t, wid i ten id izwaren. Ṛebbi Iaɛtad lebni nnsen, si llsas. Iɣli d ssqef fellasen. Iusa ten id uɛaqeb seg wanda ur bnin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵓⵏⴷⵉⵏ ⵜ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⴰⵄⵜⴰⴷ ⵍⴱⵏⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵍⵍⵙⴰⵙ. ⵉⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵇⴼ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ. ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, ass n tnekra, a ten Idull, ad Yini: "anda ten icriken iW, i$ef temnamarem"? Nnan imawlan n tussna: "war ccekk, ddell akked ddens, assa, $ef ijehliyen
latin_inalco: Sinna, ass n tnekra, a ten Idull, ad Yini: "anda ten icriken iW, iɣef temnamarem"? Nnan imawlan n tussna: "war ccekk, ddell akked ddens, assa, ɣef ijehliyen
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷⵓⵍⵍ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵛⵔⵉⴽⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵎ"? ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵙⵙⵏⴰ: "ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷⴷⵍⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴷⴷⵏⵙ, ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⵖⴼ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ

ayah_content: iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, nitni densen iman nnsen". A d ssutren tifrat: "ur nexdim kra n tucmip". Xaîi, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: iwumi ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ, nitni densen iman nnsen". A d ssutren tifrat: "ur nexdim kra n tucmit". Xaṭi, Ṛebbi, s tidet, Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⴷⴷⵎⵏⵜ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵍⵕⵡⴰⵃ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷⵏⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ". ⴰ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ: "ⵓⵔ ⵏⵅⴷⵉⵎ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ". ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama; degs a pwekkôem. A yicmet uxxam imzuxiyen!
latin_inalco: Kecmet si tebbura, ar Lǧahennama; degs a twekkṛem. A yicmet uxxam imzuxiyen!
Tifinagh: ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ; ⴷⴳⵙ ⴰ ⵜⵡⴽⴽⵕⵎ. ⴰ ⵢⵉⵛⵎⵜ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ!

ayah_content: Ad inin i wid ipêezziben: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d lxiô". I wid imaânen, ise$ di ddunit agi. Pifxiô, war ccekk, axxam aneggaru. Ay d umâin uxxam n wid ipêezziben!
latin_inalco: Ad inin i wid itḥezziben: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d lxiṛ". I wid imaɛnen, iseɣ di ddunit agi. Pifxiṛ, war ccekk, axxam aneggaru. Ay d umɛin uxxam n wid itḥezziben!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴷ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ". ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵄⵏⵏ, ⵉⵙⵖ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⴰⴳⵉ. Pⵉⴼⵅⵉⵕ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⴰⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔⵓ. ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ!

ayah_content: Ad kecmen leonanat n Âaden, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen; degsen, i nitni, ayen i sen ihwan. Akka i Ipkafi Öebbi wid ipêezziben,
latin_inalco: Ad kecmen leǧnanat n Ɛaden, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen; degsen, i nitni, ayen i sen ihwan. Akka i Itkafi Ṛebbi wid itḥezziben,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵄⴰⴷⵏ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ; ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵜⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ,

ayah_content: wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, nitni maânen, ad asen inint: "tifrat fellawen! Kecmet Loennet, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".
latin_inalco: wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ, nitni maɛnen, ad asen inint: "tifrat fellawen! Kecmet Lǧennet, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⴷⴷⵎⵏⵜ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵍⵕⵡⴰⵃ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵎⴰⵄⵏⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⵏⵜ: "ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ! ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ".

ayah_content: Day a pôaoun kan tisin n lmalayek $uôsen, ne$ a d iawev lameô n Mass ik? Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi, maca densen iman nnsen.
latin_inalco: Day a tṛaǧun kan tisin n lmalayek ɣuṛsen, neɣ a d iaweḍ lameṛ n Mass ik? Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Ur ten Idnis Ṛebbi, maca densen iman nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⵕⴰⴷⵊⵓⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⵉⵙⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵡⴹ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ? ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷⵏⵉⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⴷⵏⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: D tucmitin xeddmen, i ten iwwten. Izzi yasen wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.
latin_inalco: D tucmitin xeddmen, i ten iwwten. Izzi yasen wayen iɣef tmmaɛliken.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ, ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵡⵡⵜⵏ. ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⵎⴰⵄⵍⵉⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan wid ipcaraken: "Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur naâbed acemma, war Neppa, nekwni akked imezwura nne$. Ur negdel acemma, war ayen Igdel". Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Day illa wayen iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal ipbegginen?
latin_inalco: Nnan wid itcaraken: "Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, ur naɛbed acemma, war Netta, nekwni akked imezwura nneɣ. Ur negdel acemma, war ayen Igdel". Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Day illa wayen iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal itbegginen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⵓⵔ ⵏⴳⴷⵍ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴳⴷⵍ". ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ?

ayah_content: Ni$ Nuzen ed amazan i yal lois: "âabdet Öebbi, janbet iôebbiten n tkerkas". Garasen, llan wid Inha Öebbi; garasen, wid i$ef iura ttelfan. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d inekkaôen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nuzen ed amazan i yal lǧis: "ɛabdet Ṛebbi, janbet iṛebbiten n tkerkas". Garasen, llan wid Inha Ṛebbi; garasen, wid iɣef iura ttelfan. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek teḍṛa d inekkaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ: "ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵊⴰⵏⴱⵜ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵜⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ". ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵀⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ; ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵓⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ. ⵉⵏⵉⴳⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵜ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⴹⵕⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Xas tôe$wbev $ef nnhaya nnsen, Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu wid Itlef. Ur asen illi usettaô.
latin_inalco: Xas tṛeɣwbeḍ ɣef nnhaya nnsen, Ṛebbi, s tidet, ur Inehhu wid Itlef. Ur asen illi usettaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵙ ⵜⵕⵖⵡⴱⴹ ⵖⴼ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵙⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ggulen s Öebbi, liman iûeêêan nnsen, ar ur d Ippara ara Öebbi wid immuten. Xaîi, lemâahda fellas d tidep, maca tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Ggulen s Ṛebbi, liman iṣeḥḥan nnsen, ar ur d Ittara ara Ṛebbi wid immuten. Xaṭi, lemɛahda fellas d tidet, maca tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⴳⴳⵓⵍⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵚⵃⵃⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵎⵓⵜⵏ. ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Iwakken ad asen d ibeggen ayen i$ef mgarraden, iwakken ad éôen wid ijehlen, ar nitni, war ccekk, llan d ikeddaben.
latin_inalco: Iwakken ad asen d ibeggen ayen iɣef mgarraden, iwakken ad ẓṛen wid ijehlen, ar nitni, war ccekk, llan d ikeddaben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Awal nne£ kan, i t$awsa, ma Neb$a p, ad as Nini: "ili"! A ppili.
latin_inalco: Awal nneɣ kan, i tɣawsa, ma Nebɣa t, ad as Nini: "ili"! A ttili.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵜⵖⴰⵡⵙⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⵏⴱⵖⴰ ⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵍⵉ"! ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Wid iunagen i Öebbi, mbaâd ma pwadensen, a ten Nesserked di ddunit s yise$. Arraz n laxeôt a t i$leb, war ccekk, lemmer éôin
latin_inalco: Wid iunagen i Ṛebbi, mbaɛd ma twadensen, a ten Nesserked di ddunit s yiseɣ. Arraz n laxeṛt a t iɣleb, war ccekk, lemmer ẓṛin
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵏⴰⴳⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴱⴰⵄⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⴽⴷ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙⵖ. ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵖⵍⴱ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵏ

ayah_content: wid iûebôen u ppeklen $ef Mass nnsen.
latin_inalco: wid iṣebṛen u tteklen ɣef Mass nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵚⴱⵕⵏ ⵓ ⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Id Nuzen, uqbel ik, siwa irgazen iwumi Nweêêa. Steqsit imawlan usmekti, ma ur teéôim ara.
latin_inalco: Id Nuzen, uqbel ik, siwa irgazen iwumi Nweḥḥa. Steqsit imawlan usmekti, ma ur teẓṛim ara.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉⵔⴳⴰⵣⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ. ⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉⵜ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵥⵕⵉⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: S ubeggen akked Ihellilen, Nuzen ak d asmekti, iwakken a pbeggnev i medden, ayen i sen d irsen, amar a d mmektin.
latin_inalco: S ubeggen akked Ihellilen, Nuzen ak d asmekti, iwakken a tbeggneḍ i medden, ayen i sen d irsen, amar a d mmektin.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵀⵍⵍⵉⵍⵏ, ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⴱⴳⴳⵏⴹ ⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵙⵏ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid iundin tucmitin, aâni $ilen ur Iôemmu ara Öebbi di tmurt, ne$ ur ten id ippawev ara uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin?
latin_inalco: Wid iundin tucmitin, aɛni ɣilen ur Iṛemmu ara Ṛebbi di tmurt, neɣ ur ten id ittaweḍ ara uɛaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin?
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵏⴷⵉⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ, ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵕⵎⵎⵓ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ne$ ur ten id ikkat ara di cce$l nnsen, ur sfunnugen?
latin_inalco: Neɣ ur ten id ikkat ara di cceɣl nnsen, ur sfunnugen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⴽⴰⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⵖⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⴼⵓⵏⵏⵓⴳⵏ?

ayah_content: Ne$ ur ten ikkat ara cwiî, cwiî. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, Issuruf, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Neɣ ur ten ikkat ara cwiṭ, cwiṭ. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, Issuruf, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⴰⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ, ⵛⵡⵉⵟ. ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵙⵙⵓⵔⵓⴼ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Day ur walan ara ayen akw Ixleq Öebbi, ippara tili s yeffus, zelmev; tkennu i Öebbi, s wannuz.
latin_inalco: Day ur walan ara ayen akw Ixleq Ṛebbi, ittara tili s yeffus, zelmeḍ; tkennu i Ṛebbi, s wannuz.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵙ ⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ, ⵣⵍⵎⴹ; ⵜⴽⵏⵏⵓ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: I Öebbi ikennu meôôa wayen illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt, imexlaq akked lmalayek. Nitni ur sme$wôen iman nnsen.
latin_inalco: I Ṛebbi ikennu meṛṛa wayen illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt, imexlaq akked lmalayek. Nitni ur smeɣwṛen iman nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⴽⵏⵏⵓ ⵎⵕⵕⴰ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⵎⵅⵍⴰⵇ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵎⵖⵡⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ppagwaden Mass nnsen, sennig sen, xeddmen ayen i sen ippumôen.
latin_inalco: Ptagwaden Mass nnsen, sennig sen, xeddmen ayen i sen ittumṛen.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵙⵏ, ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵎⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Inna Öebbi: "ur sâut sin iôebbiten. Neppa, d Öebbi Yiwen kan. Ihi, Nek, agwadet iyI".
latin_inalco: Inna Ṛebbi: "ur sɛut sin iṛebbiten. Netta, d Ṛebbi Yiwen kan. Ihi, Nek, agwadet iyI".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵓⵜ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⴽ, ⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ".

ayah_content: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ddin, ineS i lebda. Day a têezzbem i war Öebbi?
latin_inalco: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ddin, ineS i lebda. Day a tḥezzbem i war Ṛebbi?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⴷⴷⵉⵏ, ⵉⵏⵙ ⵉ ⵍⴱⴷⴰ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⵃⵣⵣⴱⵎ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ?

ayah_content: S$uô Öebbi, ayen akw ikwen i$aten. D$a mi kwen têuza lemveôôa, $uôeS ay tnedhem.
latin_inalco: Sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen akw ikwen iɣaten. Dɣa mi kwen tḥuza lemḍeṛṛa, ɣuṛeS ay tnedhem.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵖⴰⵜⵏ. ⴷⵖⴰ ⵎⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵜⵃⵓⵣⴰ ⵍⵎⴹⵕⵕⴰ, ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵏⴷⵀⵎ.

ayah_content: Sinna, mi wen Ikkes lemveôôa, arbaâ segwen, atnan pcaraken i Mass nnsen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, mi wen Ikkes lemḍeṛṛa, arbaɛ segwen, atnan tcaraken i Mass nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵎⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⵙ ⵍⵎⴹⵕⵕⴰ, ⴰⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Nekôen, akka, i sen Nefka. Zhut, deqqal a ppeéôem.
latin_inalco: Nekṛen, akka, i sen Nefka. Zhut, deqqal a tteẓṛem.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵕⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ. ⵣⵀⵓⵜ, ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵥⵕⵎ.

ayah_content: La qesden, i wur ssinen, amur seg wayen is iten Neôzeq. S Öebbi, ar fellawen asteqsi, $ef wayen id tesnulfuyem!
latin_inalco: La qesden, i wur ssinen, amur seg wayen is iten Neṛzeq. S Ṛebbi, ar fellawen asteqsi, ɣef wayen id tesnulfuyem!
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰ ⵇⵙⴷⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ, ⴰⵎⵓⵔ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵕⵣⵇ. ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵔ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⴰⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⵓⵢⵎ!

ayah_content: Gern aS d, i Öebbi, tullas. Gedha s yiS! I nitni, ayen ssarmen.
latin_inalco: Gern aS d, i Ṛebbi, tullas. Gedha s yiS! I nitni, ayen ssarmen.
Tifinagh: ⴳⵔⵏ ⴰⵙ ⴷ, ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⵓⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙ! ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵙⵙⴰⵔⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma becceôn yiwen s teqcict, ad yibrik wudem is, ad iqbeô.
latin_inalco: Ma becceṛn yiwen s teqcict, ad yibrik wudem is, ad iqbeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴱⵛⵛⵕⵏ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵇⵛⵉⵛⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⴱⵔⵉⴽ ⵡⵓⴷⵎ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵇⴱⵕ.

ayah_content: Ad iveôôef iman is, si medden, ilmend n yir usali it id ibbwven. A p ijmaâ, tamara, ne$ a p irr seddaw wakal? Ay dir wamek debbiôen!
latin_inalco: Ad iḍeṛṛef iman is, si medden, ilmend n yir usali it id ibbwḍen. A t ijmaɛ, tamara, neɣ a t irr seddaw wakal? Ay dir wamek debbiṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⴹⵕⵕⴼ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵔ ⵓⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⴹⵏ. ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵊⵎⴰⵄ, ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵔⴰ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵙⴷⴷⴰⵡ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍ? ⴰⵢ ⴷⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵎⴽ ⴷⴱⴱⵉⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: I wid ur numin ara s laxert: amedya ucmit. I Öebbi: amedya aâlayen mavi. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: I wid ur numin ara s laxert: amedya ucmit. I Ṛebbi: amedya aɛlayen maḍi. Netta d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵍⴰⵅⵔⵜ: ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ. ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ: ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Öebbi, lemmer Ipqissi medden, $ef ddens nnsen, ur d Ippaoa, degs, amexluq. Maca, Iswexxiô iten ar lajel ipwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen, ur t id seqôaben, s ssaâa.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi, lemmer Itqissi medden, ɣef ddens nnsen, ur d Ittaǧa, degs, amexluq. Maca, Iswexxiṛ iten ar lajel itwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiṛen, ur t id seqṛaben, s ssaɛa.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵜⵇⵉⵙⵙⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⵖⴼ ⴷⴷⵏⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴷⵊⴰ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴰⵎⵅⵍⵓⵇ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵉⵙⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵙⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵇⵕⴰⴱⵏ, ⵙ ⵙⵙⴰⵄⴰ.

ayah_content: Garen aS d, i Öebbi, ayen keôhen. Skaddben yilsawen nnsen, mi qqaôen ar ayen ilhan, nnsen. Ay nnsen, war ccekk, d times. Ih, nitni ad zwiren.
latin_inalco: Garen aS d, i Ṛebbi, ayen keṛhen. Skaddben yilsawen nnsen, mi qqaṛen ar ayen ilhan, nnsen. Ay nnsen, war ccekk, d times. Ih, nitni ad zwiren.
Tifinagh: ⴳⴰⵔⵏ ⴰⵙ ⴷ, ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵕⵀⵏ. ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵢⵉⵍⵙⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵎⵉ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ ⴰⵔ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⵢ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵣⵡⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: S Öebbi, ni$ Nuzen ed, i leoyus, uqbel ik. Cciîan icebbeê asen igiten nnsen. Assa, d bab nnsen. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: S Ṛebbi, niɣ Nuzen ed, i leǧyus, uqbel ik. Cciṭan icebbeḥ asen igiten nnsen. Assa, d bab nnsen. I nitni, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ, ⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵢⵓⵙ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ. ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⵉⵛⴱⴱⵃ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nessader ak edTazmamt, iwakken kan ad asen tbeggnev ayen i$ef mgarraden, akw i nnhaya akked uêunu i ugdud iumnen.
latin_inalco: Nessader ak edTazmamt, iwakken kan ad asen tbeggneḍ ayen iɣef mgarraden, akw i nnhaya akked uḥunu i ugdud iumnen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴰⴽ ⴷⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵜⴱⴳⴳⵏⴹ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ, ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni. Issader yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud isellen.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Isseɣli d aman, seg igenni. Issader yissen akal, deffir tmettant is. Deg waya, s tidet, assekni i ugdud isellen.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ. ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⴰⴽⴰⵍ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙⵍⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, ameyyez, i kunwi, di lmal. Nesswa kwen s wayen illan deg ufwad nnsen, ger lfert d idamen, i$i iûfan, aéidan i wid itessen.
latin_inalco: Ih, ameyyez, i kunwi, di lmal. Nesswa kwen s wayen illan deg ufwad nnsen, ger lfert d idamen, iɣi iṣfan, aẓidan i wid itessen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵎⵢⵢⵣ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ. ⵏⵙⵙⵡⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴼⵡⴰⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴳⵔ ⵍⴼⵔⵜ ⴷ ⵉⴷⴰⵎⵏ, ⵉⵖⵉ ⵉⵚⴼⴰⵏ, ⴰⵥⵉⴷⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵙⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Si ppemôa n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, teppawim d ayen iûûekôen, akked ôôezq igerzen. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ifehmen.
latin_inalco: Si ttemṛa n tezdayin akked tfeṛṛant, tettawim d ayen iṣṣekṛen, akked ṛṛezq igerzen. Deg waya, s tidet, assekni i ugdud ifehmen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵜⵜⵎⵕⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴼⵕⵕⴰⵏⵜ, ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵎ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵚⵚⴽⵕⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵕⵕⵣⵇ ⵉⴳⵔⵣⵏ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴼⵀⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Iweêêa Mass ik i tzizwa: "gemt ixxamen deg durar, di ttjuô, di te$wôasin.
latin_inalco: Iweḥḥa Mass ik i tzizwa: "gemt ixxamen deg durar, di ttjuṛ, di teɣwṛasin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵉ ⵜⵣⵉⵣⵡⴰ: "ⴳⵎⵜ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⴷⴳ ⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵊⵓⵕ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵖⵡⵕⴰⵙⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, eççemt si yal ppemôa. Ddumt s wannuz, iberdan n Mass nnkwent. Iteffe$ ed seg iâabbav nnsent ayen tessen, n yal ini, degs êellu i imdanen". Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, eččemt si yal ttemṛa. Ddumt s wannuz, iberdan n Mass nnkwent. Iteffeɣ ed seg iɛabbaḍ nnsent ayen tessen, n yal ini, degs ḥellu i imdanen". Deg waya, s tidet, assekni i ugdud itxemmimen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵜⵜⵛⵎⵜ ⵙⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⵜⵎⵕⴰ. ⴷⴷⵓⵎⵜ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ, ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⴽⵡⵏⵜ. ⵉⵜⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵄⴰⴱⴱⴰⴹ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵙⵙⵏ, ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵏⵉ, ⴷⴳⵙ ⵃⵍⵍⵓ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ". ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵅⵎⵎⵉⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Ixelq ikwen Öebbi, sinna, ad awen Iddem ôôuê. Kra, segwen, ad ccerfeffen mavi, alamma ur ppissinen acemma mbaâd ma ssnen. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Aêernuk.
latin_inalco: Ixelq ikwen Ṛebbi, sinna, ad awen Iddem ṛṛuḥ. Kra, segwen, ad ccerfeffen maḍi, alamma ur ttissinen acemma mbaɛd ma ssnen. Ih, Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Aḥernuk.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵎ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ. ⴽⵔⴰ, ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵛⵛⵔⴼⴼⴼⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ, ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵎⴱⴰⵄⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⵏⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ, ⴷ ⴰⵃⵔⵏⵓⴽ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Ismenyaf ad I$it kra i wiyav. Wid Ismenyaf, ur ilaq ara ad rren, ôôeéq nnsen, i waklan nnsen, d$a ad âadlen yidsen. Day ara nekôen l$it n Öebbi?
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Ismenyaf ad Iɣit kra i wiyaḍ. Wid Ismenyaf, ur ilaq ara ad rren, ṛṛeẓq nnsen, i waklan nnsen, dɣa ad ɛadlen yidsen. Day ara nekṛen lɣit n Ṛebbi?
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵖⵉⵜ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⴰⵇ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵔⵔⵏ, ⵕⵕⵥⵇ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⴰⴽⵍⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵄⴰⴷⵍⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ?

ayah_content: Iga yawen Öebbi, seg iman nnwen, tilawin nnwen. Ifka yawen, si tlawin nnwen, arraw d warraw n warraw. Iôeéq ikwen s wayen ilhan. Day ad amnen di tkerkas, ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?
latin_inalco: Iga yawen Ṛebbi, seg iman nnwen, tilawin nnwen. Ifka yawen, si tlawin nnwen, arraw d warraw n warraw. Iṛeẓq ikwen s wayen ilhan. Day ad amnen di tkerkas, ad nekṛen lɣit n Ṛebbi?
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ. ⵉⵕⵥⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵎⵏⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ?

ayah_content: Âabden, war Öebbi, wid ur nesâi acemma, swayes ara ten ôeéqen, si tmurt akked igenwan, u ur zmiren.
latin_inalco: Ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, wid ur nesɛi acemma, swayes ara ten ṛeẓqen, si tmurt akked igenwan, u ur zmiren.
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵄⵉ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⵙⵡⴰⵢⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵕⵥⵇⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵓ ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur d ppawit imedyaten i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
latin_inalco: Ur d ttawit imedyaten i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵜ ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵜⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵙⵉⵏⵎ.

ayah_content: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n wakli, d ayla, ur izmir i wacemma, akked yiwen iwumi Nefka, s $uône£, ôôeéq ilhan. Ipseddiq, segs, s tuffra ne$ âinani. Day âadlen? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Maca, tegwti, segsen, ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n wakli, d ayla, ur izmir i wacemma, akked yiwen iwumi Nefka, s ɣuṛneɣ, ṛṛeẓq ilhan. Itseddiq, segs, s tuffra neɣ ɛinani. Day ɛadlen? Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi. Maca, tegwti, segsen, ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵡⴰⴽⵍⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵍⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ, ⵙ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⵕⵕⵥⵇ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⵉⵜⵙⴷⴷⵉⵇ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⵙ ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵔⴰ ⵏⵖ ⵄⵉⵏⴰⵏⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵄⴰⴷⵍⵏ? ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n sin irgazen. Yiwen d agugam, ur izmir i wacemma. D taâkkwemt i bab is. Anda it iuzen, ur d ippawi lxiô. Day iaâdel akked win ippamôen lêeqq, u neppa deg ubrid uwqim?
latin_inalco: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n sin irgazen. Yiwen d agugam, ur izmir i wacemma. D taɛkkwemt i bab is. Anda it iuzen, ur d ittawi lxiṛ. Day iaɛdel akked win ittamṛen lḥeqq, u netta deg ubrid uwqim?
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵔⴳⴰⵣⵏ. ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴳⵓⴳⴰⵎ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ. ⴷ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⴽⵡⵎⵜ ⵉ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵓⵣⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⴰⵄⴷⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵎⵕⵏ ⵍⵃⵇⵇ, ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ?

ayah_content: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Lameô n yimir, am unqaj n tiî kan, ne$ ur ibbwiv. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
latin_inalco: N Ṛebbi tabaḍnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Lameṛ n yimir, am unqaj n tiṭ kan, neɣ ur ibbwiḍ. Ih, Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⴰⴱⴰⴹⵏⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵎ ⵓⵏⵇⴰⵊ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵟ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉⴹ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Issuffe$ ikwen id si tâabbav n tyimmatin nnwen, ur tessinem acemma. Ifka yawen timejjin, iéôi, ul, amar a ppesnemmrem.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Issuffeɣ ikwen id si tɛabbaḍ n tyimmatin nnwen, ur tessinem acemma. Ifka yawen timejjin, iẓṛi, ul, amar a ttesnemmrem.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴱⴰⴹ ⵏ ⵜⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵙⵉⵏⵎ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ. ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵜⵉⵎⵊⵊⵉⵏ, ⵉⵥⵕⵉ, ⵓⵍ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⵏⵎⵎⵔⵎ.

ayah_content: Day ur walan ara ifôax, têeppem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iîîif yiwen siwa Öebbi? Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
latin_inalco: Day ur walan ara ifṛax, tḥettem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iṭṭif yiwen siwa Ṛebbi? Deg waya, s tidet, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⴼⵕⴰⵅ, ⵜⵃⵜⵜⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵍⵀⴰⵡⴰ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵟⵟⵉⴼ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezdu$t. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduî nnsen, ccâaô nnsen, inéaden nnsen, i leêwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezduɣt. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduṭ nnsen, ccɛaṛ nnsen, inẓaden nnsen, i leḥwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵏⵣⴷⵓⵖⵜ. ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ, ⵙ ⵉⴳⵡⵍⵎⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴼⵙⵙⵓⵙⵉⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵏⵉⴳ, ⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵇⴳⴳⵍ. ⵜⴰⴷⵓⵟ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵛⵛⵄⴰⵕ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵏⵥⴰⴷⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵍⵃⵡⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴷⴷⵓⵣⴰⵏ, ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⴽⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Deg wayen Ixleq, Öebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ûûôanat. Ifka yawen iceîîiven i kwen isdarayen seg u$amac, iceîîiven i kwen ipfukkun si lbe$wv nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim l$it iS. Amar a ppanzem.
latin_inalco: Deg wayen Ixleq, Ṛebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ṣṣṛanat. Ifka yawen iceṭṭiḍen i kwen isdarayen seg uɣamac, iceṭṭiḍen i kwen itfukkun si lbeɣwḍ nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim lɣit iS. Amar a ttanzem.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵍⵉ. ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ, ⵚⵚⵕⴰⵏⴰⵜ. ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ ⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⴷⴰⵔⴰⵢⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵖⴰⵎⴰⵛ, ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ ⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⴼⵓⴽⴽⵓⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵍⴱⵖⵡⴹ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵉⵎ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵏⵣⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma wexxôen, i illan fellak, siwa awal ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Ma wexxṛen, i illan fellak, siwa awal itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Âaqlen l$it n Öebbi, sinna, nekôen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Ɛaqlen lɣit n Ṛebbi, sinna, nekṛen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⵇⵍⵏ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵜ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lois, anagi, imiren ur ippili tesriê i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur ste$fiôen
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lǧis, anagi, imiren ur ittili tesriḥ i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur steɣfiṛen
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵔ, ⵙⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ, ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵜⵖⴼⵉⵕⵏ

ayah_content: Mi walan, imednas, aâaqeb, ur ippifsus fellasen, ur ppestaâfun.
latin_inalco: Mi walan, imednas, aɛaqeb, ur ittifsus fellasen, ur ttestaɛfun.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ, ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⴼⵙⵓⵙ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵙⵜⴰⵄⴼⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi walan, wid ipcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! D wigi i d icriken nne$ u$uô nepnuju, war Keçç". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".
latin_inalco: Mi walan, wid itcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nneɣ! D wigi i d icriken nneɣ uɣuṛ netnuju, war Kečč". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵛⵓⵔⴽⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⴷ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵛⵔⵉⴽⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵏⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ". ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵔⵔⵏ: "ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵉⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱⵏ".

ayah_content: Assen, ad fken mayna i Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
latin_inalco: Assen, ad fken mayna i Ṛebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴼⴽⵏ ⵎⴰⵢⵏⴰ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⵓⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ijehlen, u sîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, Nerna yasen aâaqeb sennig wayev, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.
latin_inalco: Wid ijehlen, u sṭixxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, Nerna yasen aɛaqeb sennig wayeḍ, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⵓ ⵙⵟⵉⵅⵅⵉⵕⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵏⵔⵏⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴹ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵙⵙⴼⵙⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lois, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aêunu, u d abecceô i imvuâen.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lǧis, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aḥunu, u d abecceṛ i imḍuɛen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵔ, ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ, ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵏⴰⵡⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ. ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ, ⵓ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, Öebbi Iumeô ed lêeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeôk. A kwen Ipnabi, amar a d temmektim.
latin_inalco: Ih, Ṛebbi Iumeṛ ed lḥeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeṛk. A kwen Itnabi, amar a d temmektim.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵓⵎⵕ ⴷ ⵍⵃⵇⵇ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵡⵇⴰⵎⴰ, ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵍⵜ ⵉ ⵍⵍⵣⵎ. ⵉⴳⴷⵍ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵏ ⴷⵉⵔ, ⴷⴷⵕⴽ. ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⴱⵉ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Eîîfet di lemâahda n Öebbi ma tâahdem. Ur êentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu txeddmem.
latin_inalco: Eṭṭfet di lemɛahda n Ṛebbi ma tɛahdem. Ur ḥentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa acu txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵟⵟⴼⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⵀⴷⵎ. ⵓⵔ ⵃⵏⵜⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⴱⴱⵜⵎ, ⵓ ⵜⵛⵓⴱⴽⵎ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiv is, mbaâd ma tcudd it, s loehd. Tepparam tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lois sennig wayev. Öebbi Ipjeôôib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen i$ef temgarradem.
latin_inalco: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiḍ is, mbaɛd ma tcudd it, s lǧehd. Tettaram tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lǧis sennig wayeḍ. Ṛebbi Itjeṛṛib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen iɣef temgarradem.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵛⴱⴱⵓⵜ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⵙⵉⵏ ⵍⵅⵉⴹ ⵉⵙ, ⵎⴱⴰⵄⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵛⵓⴷⴷ ⵉⵜ, ⵙ ⵍⴷⵊⵀⴷ. ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰⵎ ⵜⴰⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴽⵍⵍⵅ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ: ⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⴽ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴹ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵊⵕⵕⵉⴱ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵢⵉⵙ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴱⴳⴳⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵎ.

ayah_content: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Öebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lois. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tidep, a ppepusteqsim $ef wayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Ṛebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lǧis. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tidet, a ttetusteqsim ɣef wayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ, ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵉⵜⵍⵍⵉⴼ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉⵎ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Ur pparat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad iccev uvaô mbaâd ma iîîef. A pjeôbem tawa$it, ilmend n wayen tveôôfem seg ubrid n Öebbi. I kunwi, aâaqeb abarar.
latin_inalco: Ur ttarat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad icceḍ uḍaṛ mbaɛd ma iṭṭef. A tjeṛbem tawaɣit, ilmend n wayen tḍeṛṛfem seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. I kunwi, aɛaqeb abarar.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰⵜ ⵜⴰⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴽⵍⵍⵅ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵛⵛⴹ ⵓⴹⴰⵕ ⵎⴱⴰⵄⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵟⵟⴼ. ⴰ ⵜⵊⵕⴱⵎ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴹⵕⵕⴼⵎ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Ur ppa$et s lemâahda n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan $eô Öebbi, lemmer teéôim.
latin_inalco: Ur ttaɣet s lemɛahda n Ṛebbi ayen ṛxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, lemmer teẓṛim.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵖⵜ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵕⵅⵉⵙⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵢⵉⴼ ⵉⵜ ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵖⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵜⵥⵕⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Ayen illan $uôwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan $eô Öebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iûebôen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
latin_inalco: Ayen illan ɣuṛwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan ɣeṛ Ṛebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iṣebṛen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴼⵓⴽⴽ; ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵖⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵎ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⵏⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵚⴱⵕⵏ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⴼⵓⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumâint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
latin_inalco: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeṛ neɣ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumɛint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ, ⵓ ⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⵉⴷⵔ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵜⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏⵜ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⴼⵓⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Mara te$ôev Leqwôan, ssuter a k Iaâteq Öebbi, si Cciîan imenfi.
latin_inalco: Mara teɣṛeḍ Leqwṛan, ssuter a k Iaɛteq Ṛebbi, si Cciṭan imenfi.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵖⵕⴹ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔ ⴰ ⴽ ⵉⴰⵄⵜⵇ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⵏⴼⵉ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, ur isâi adabu $ef wid iumnen, i ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, ur isɛi adabu ɣef wid iumnen, i itteklen ɣef Mass nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵄⵉ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Adabu ines, $ef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S ipcaraken.
latin_inalco: Adabu ines, ɣef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S itcaraken.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵉⵏⵙ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "keçç, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaîi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "kečč, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaṭi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⴱⴷⴷⵍ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵙ ⵓⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵓ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⴼ ⴰⴽⵡ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⵓⵢⵏ". ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "Issers it id ôôuê iôqan, s$uô Mass ik, s tidep, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceô i imvuâen".
latin_inalco: Ini: "Issers it id ṛṛuḥ iṛqan, sɣuṛ Mass ik, s tidet, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceṛ i imḍuɛen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵉⵕⵇⴰⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⴱⴱⵜ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ; ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵓ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ".

ayah_content: Ih, Neéôa, qqaôen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeôôanit, wagi d awal aâôab n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ih, Neẓṛa, qqaṛen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeṛṛanit, wagi d awal aɛṛab n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵥⵕⴰ, ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵙⵙⵍⵎⴰⴷⵏ". ⵜⴰⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢⵜ ⵏ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴷ ⴳⵔⵏ, ⴷ ⵜⴰⴱⵕⵕⴰⵏⵉⵜ, ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten Inehhu Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ur ten Inehhu Ṛebbi. I nitni, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.
latin_inalco: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴳⵔⵏ ⴷ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Win inekôen Öebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma êeppmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
latin_inalco: Win inekṛen Ṛebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma ḥettmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izɛaf Ṛebbi fellasen. Fellasen aɛaqeb abarar.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵃⵜⵜⵎⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⵓⵍ ⵉⵙ ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⵉⵓⵎⵏ…. ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵣⵄⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ. ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeôt. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeṛt. Ih, Ṛebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰⵛⴽⵓ ⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: D wigi iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iéôi nnsen. Wigi d i$efliyen.
latin_inalco: D wigi iwumi Isleɣ Ṛebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iẓṛi nnsen. Wigi d iɣefliyen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵉⵙⵍⵖ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵉⵎⵊⵊⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵥⵕⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵖⴼⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeôt, ad ilin d imexsuôen.
latin_inalco: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeṛt, ad ilin d imexsuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Mass ik, s tidep, i wid iunagen mbaâd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ûebôen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Mass ik, s tidet, i wid iunagen mbaɛd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ṣebṛen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵏⴰⴳⵏ ⵎⴱⴰⵄⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵀⵡⵡⵍⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵊⵓⵀⴷⵏ, ⵚⴱⵕⵏ; ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer $ef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iîîukafi $ef wayen ixdem, nitni ur pwadensen.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer ɣef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iṭṭukafi ɣef wayen ixdem, nitni ur twadensen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⴰⵎⵔ ⵖⴼ ⵢⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵓ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵟⵟⵓⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u îîmana. Ippas ip id ôôeéq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeô l$it n Öebbi. Isukk Öebbi fellas tawa$it n llaé akked lweêc, ilmend n wayen la ûûenâan.
latin_inalco: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u ṭṭmana. Ittas it id ṛṛeẓq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeṛ lɣit n Ṛebbi. Isukk Ṛebbi fellas tawaɣit n llaẓ akked lweḥc, ilmend n wayen la ṣṣenɛan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵓ ⵟⵟⵎⴰⵏⴰ. ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵙ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵕⵕⵥⵇ ⵉⵙ, ⵙ ⵍⵓⴼⴰ, ⵙⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⴰⵎⴰ. ⵜⵏⴽⵕ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵙⵓⴽⴽ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵍⴰⵥ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵡⵃⵛ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵚⵚⵏⵄⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uâaqeb, nitni densen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uɛaqeb, nitni densen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵜ, ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Eççet seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi, i iêellen, i imaânen. Snemmret l$it n Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.
latin_inalco: Eččet seg wayen is ikwen Iɣat Ṛebbi, i iḥellen, i imaɛnen. Snemmret lɣit n Ṛebbi, ma d Netta ay tɛabdem.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵜⵜⵛⵜ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵖⴰⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉ ⵉⵃⵍⵍⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵄⵏⵏ. ⵙⵏⵎⵎⵔⵜ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴷⵎ.

ayah_content: I yawen Igdel siwa loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Öebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuô, ur inufeq, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: I yawen Igdel siwa lǧifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Ṛebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuṛ, ur inufeq, Ṛebbi, s tidet, Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴳⴷⵍ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⴼⴰ, ⵉⴷⵉⵎ, ⴰⴽⵙⵓⵎ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵍⴼ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵔⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙⵎ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵜⵔⵔⴰ ⵜⵎⴰⵔⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵊⵓⵕ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⵓⴼⵇ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ur qqaôet tikerkas id ppawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leêlal, aya d leêôam". A d tegrem tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen.
latin_inalco: Ur qqaṛet tikerkas id ttawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leḥlal, aya d leḥṛam". A d tegrem tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi, ur rebḥen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵜ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵙⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ: "ⴰⵢⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵃⵍⴰⵍ, ⴰⵢⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵃⵕⴰⵎ". ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴳⵔⵎ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⵖⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴳⴳⴰⵔⵏ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⵖⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵔⴱⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Drus ara zhun, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Drus ara zhun, fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵔⵓⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵣⵀⵓⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: I wudayen, Negdel ayen i$ef i k Neêka, iu$ lêal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.
latin_inalco: I wudayen, Negdel ayen iɣef i k Neḥka, iuɣ lḥal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵡⵓⴷⴰⵢⵏ, ⵏⴳⴷⵍ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉ ⴽ ⵏⵃⴽⴰ, ⵉⵓⵖ ⵍⵃⴰⵍ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴷⵏⵉⵙ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷⴷⵏⵏⵉⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceôô, ur ssinen, d$a steôoâen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceṛṛ, ur ssinen, dɣa steṛǧɛen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵛⵛⵕⵕ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵄⵏ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵓ ⵙⵡⵇⵎⵏ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ibôahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tidep, i iunzen i Öebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.
latin_inalco: Ibṛahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tidet, i iunzen i Ṛebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉ ⵉⵓⵏⵣⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ.

ayah_content: Isnemmar l$it iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.
latin_inalco: Isnemmar lɣit iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵏⵎⵎⴰⵔ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⴼⵔⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵓ ⵉⵏⵀⴰ ⵜ ⵙ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Nefka yas di ddunit ise$, u, di laxeôt, neppa, s tidep, ad yili seg izedganen.
latin_inalco: Nefka yas di ddunit iseɣ, u, di laxeṛt, netta, s tidet, ad yili seg izedganen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⵉⵙⵖ, ⵓ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Nweêêa yak d a ppedduv d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Nweḥḥa yak d a ttedduḍ d ddin n Ibṛahim, i imalen ar tidet. Ur illi seg imcurak.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵢⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴷⴷⵓⴹ ⴷ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ.

ayah_content: Ssebt, iu$al kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen llan mgarraden.
latin_inalco: Ssebt, iuɣal kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iḥudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen llan mgarraden.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵙⴱⵜ, ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ûûwab akked nnhaya tumâint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aéidan mavi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iff$en seg ubrid iS. Neppa Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i ipwanhan.
latin_inalco: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ṣṣwab akked nnhaya tumɛint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aẓidan maḍi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iffɣen seg ubrid iS. Netta Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i itwanhan.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵏⵛⴷ ⵙ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵜⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏⵜ. ⵎⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⵙ ⵢⵉⵍⵙ ⴰⵥⵉⴷⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵢⵉⴼ ⴰⴽⵡ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵉⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⵙ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵢⵉⴼ ⴰⴽⵡ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma tâaqbem, âaqbet akken teppuâaqbem. Ma tûebôem, yif it i iûebôiyen.
latin_inalco: Ma tɛaqbem, ɛaqbet akken tettuɛaqbem. Ma tṣebṛem, yif it i iṣebṛiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⵇⴱⵎ, ⵄⴰⵇⴱⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱⵎ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵚⴱⵕⵎ, ⵢⵉⴼ ⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵉⵚⴱⵕⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Eûbeô. Üûebô ik s Öebbi kan. Ur $webben ilmend nnsen, ur pveyyiq si tcengal nnsen.
latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ. Üṣebṛ ik s Ṛebbi kan. Ur ɣwebben ilmend nnsen, ur tḍeyyiq si tcengal nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ. Üⵚⴱⵕ ⵉⴽ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵖⵡⴱⴱⵏ ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴹⵢⵢⵉⵇ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵛⵏⴳⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, Öebbi Atan ar wid ipêezziben, akked wid issewqamen.
