latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara, sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ifrax deg waffug. Issen taẓallit akked usbuccaɛ n yal yiwen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen xeddmen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ? ⵉⴼⵔⴰⵅ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⴼⴼⵓⴳ. ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵜⴰⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. £uô öÖebbi tu$alin.
latin_inalco: N Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. ɣuṛ ṛṚebbi tuɣalin.
Tifinagh: ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isselêay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issem$weô? D$a a pwaliv ageffur a d iffe$ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iveôôef $ef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebôaq iS qôib a ppeglu s yiéôi.
latin_inalco: Ur twalaḍ ara Ṛebbi Isselḥay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issemɣweṛ? Dɣa a twaliḍ ageffur a d iffeɣ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iḍeṛṛef ɣef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebṛaq iS qṛib a tteglu s yiẓṛi.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵍⵃⴰⵢ ⴰⵙⵉⴳⵏⴰ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵣⴷⵉ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵖⵡⵕ? ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⴰⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴼⴼⵖ ⵙⵉ ⵣⴷⴰⵅⵍ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ ⴷ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴱⵔⵓⵔⵉ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴹⵕⵕⴼ ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵍⴱⵕⴰⵇ ⵉⵙ ⵇⵕⵉⴱ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴳⵍⵓ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵥⵕⵉ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Ismizwar iv akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tidep, d aselmed i wid isâan iéôi.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Ismizwar iḍ akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tidet, d aselmed i wid isɛan iẓṛi.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵎⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔ ⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵍⵎⴷ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵉⵥⵕⵉ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Ixleq akw lêayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win ippeênunufen $ef uâabbuv is, win ileêêun $ef sin ivaôôen, win ileêêun $ef kué. Ixelleq Öebbi ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Ixleq akw lḥayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win itteḥnunufen ɣef uɛabbuḍ is, win ileḥḥun ɣef sin iḍaṛṛen, win ileḥḥun ɣef kuẓ. Ixelleq Ṛebbi ayen i S ihwan. Ṛebbi, s tidet, Izmer i yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵍⵃⴰⵢⴰⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ. ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵃⵏⵓⵏⵓⴼⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵓⵄⴰⴱⴱⵓⴹ ⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵃⵃⵓⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⴹⴰⵕⵕⵏ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵃⵃⵓⵏ ⵖⴼ ⴽⵓⵥ. ⵉⵅⵍⵍⵇ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Ṛebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⴱⵔⵔⵣⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Qqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked Umazan, nu$ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeô urbaâ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Qqaṛen: "numen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan, nuɣ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeṛ urbaɛ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⵏⵓⵎⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⵏⵓⵖ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ". ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕ ⵓⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi pwanecden ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, arbaâ segsen iwexxeô.
latin_inalco: Mi twanecden ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iḥudd garasen, arbaɛ segsen iwexxeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕ.

ayah_content: Ma sâan lêeqq, a d asen $uôes, d imvuâen.
latin_inalco: Ma sɛan lḥeqq, a d asen ɣuṛes, d imḍuɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵍⵃⵇⵇ, ⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Day helken wulawen nnsen, ne$ cukken, ne$ ugaden a ten Isneêyaf Öebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaîi, widak d imednas.
latin_inalco: Day helken wulawen nnsen, neɣ cukken, neɣ ugaden a ten Isneḥyaf Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaṭi, widak d imednas.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵀⵍⴽⵏ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵛⵓⴽⴽⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵏⵃⵢⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ? ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aêuddu n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nôuva". D wigi ay d imerbaê.
latin_inalco: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aḥuddu n Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iḥudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nṛuḍa". D wigi ay d imerbaḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵏⵏⴰ ⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ ⴰⵃⵓⴷⴷⵓ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴳⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ: "ⵏⵙⵍⴰ, ⵏⵕⵓⴹⴰ". ⴷ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵔⴱⴰⵃ.

ayah_content: Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ippagwaden Öebbi, ipêezziben, nitni d isaâdiyen.
latin_inalco: Win iṛuḍan Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ittagwaden Ṛebbi, itḥezziben, nitni d isaɛdiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵕⵓⴹⴰⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵙⴰⵄⴷⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar ma tumôev asen, ard ad ff$en, war ccekk. Ini: "ur pgallat, annuz ipwassen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen txeddmem".
latin_inalco: Ggulen s Ṛebbi, tagallit meqqwṛen, ar ma tumṛeḍ asen, ard ad ffɣen, war ccekk. Ini: "ur tgallat, annuz itwassen. Ṛebbi, s tidet, Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem".
Tifinagh: ⴳⴳⵓⵍⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵎⵇⵇⵡⵕⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵎⵕⴹ ⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⴰⴷ ⴼⴼⵖⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⵜⴳⴰⵍⵍⴰⵜ, ⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ".

ayah_content: Ini: "ôavit Öebbi, ôavit Amazan". Ma wexxôen, fellas, neppa, ayen kan i s sbabben, fellawen kunwi ayen i wen sbabben. Ma tôuvam T, a ppeppwanhum. I iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Ini: "ṛaḍit Ṛebbi, ṛaḍit Amazan". Ma wexxṛen, fellas, netta, ayen kan i s sbabben, fellawen kunwi ayen i wen sbabben. Ma tṛuḍam T, a ttettwanhum. I iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵕⴰⴹⵉⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵕⴰⴹⵉⵜ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ". ⵎⴰ ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵙⴱⴰⴱⴱⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵙⴱⴰⴱⴱⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵕⵓⴹⴰⵎ ⵜ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵓⵎ. ⵉ ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Iâahed Öebbi, i wid iumnen segwen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ara ten Irr, war ccekk, d igensas di tmurt, akken Irra wid i ten id izwaren; ara ad asen Isseqâad ddin nnsen i$ef i ten Iôuva; ar ad asen Issegwri laman, deffir tugdi. Âabden iyI, ur iyI pcaraken acemma. Wid ijehlen, deffir waya, widak d iballa$en.
latin_inalco: Iɛahed Ṛebbi, i wid iumnen segwen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ara ten Irr, war ccekk, d igensas di tmurt, akken Irra wid i ten id izwaren; ara ad asen Isseqɛad ddin nnsen iɣef i ten Iṛuḍa; ar ad asen Issegwri laman, deffir tugdi. Ɛabden iyI, ur iyI tcaraken acemma. Wid ijehlen, deffir waya, widak d iballaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵄⴰⵀⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵓ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵔⵔ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵙⴰⵙ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ; ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵇⵄⴰⴷ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵕⵓⴹⴰ; ⴰⵔ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴳⵡⵔⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵓⴳⴷⵉ. ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ ⵉⵢⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵍⵍⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Beddet i téallit, zekkit, a$et awal i Umazan. Amar aêunu fellawen.
latin_inalco: Beddet i tẓallit, zekkit, aɣet awal i Umazan. Amar aḥunu fellawen.
Tifinagh: ⴱⴷⴷⵜ ⵉ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ, ⵣⴽⴽⵉⵜ, ⴰⵖⵜ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ. ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: £uôwat a p$ilem wid ijehlen sfunnugen di tmurt. Axxam nnsen d times. A tu$alin tucmip!
latin_inalco: ɣuṛwat a tɣilem wid ijehlen sfunnugen di tmurt. Axxam nnsen d times. A tuɣalin tucmit!
Tifinagh: ⵖⵓⵕⵡⴰⵜ ⴰ ⵜⵖⵉⵍⵎ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵙⴼⵓⵏⵏⵓⴳⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ. ⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ!

ayah_content: A wid iumnen! S uâammed nnwen ara d kecmen, $uôwen, waklan nnwen akw wid, degwen, ur nebli$ ara, krav iberdan ideg ur telsim ara: uqbel taéallit n tafrara, $ef îîhuô mara tekksem iceîîiven, deffir téallit n lâica. Ulac u$ilif fellawen ne$ fellasen, ma wa iéuô wa, deffir lewqat agi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: A wid iumnen! S uɛammed nnwen ara d kecmen, ɣuṛwen, waklan nnwen akw wid, degwen, ur nebliɣ ara, kraḍ iberdan ideg ur telsim ara: uqbel taẓallit n tafrara, ɣef ṭṭhuṛ mara tekksem iceṭṭiḍen, deffir tẓallit n lɛica. Ulac uɣilif fellawen neɣ fellasen, ma wa iẓuṛ wa, deffir lewqat agi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Ṛebbi issekniyen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ! ⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵎⵎⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⵡⴰⴽⵍⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵡⵉⴷ, ⴷⴳⵡⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⴱⵍⵉⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴽⵔⴰⴹ ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵙⵉⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ: ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵜⴰⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵜⴰⴼⵔⴰⵔⴰ, ⵖⴼ ⵟⵟⵀⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴽⴽⵙⵎ ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵄⵉⵛⴰ. ⵓⵍⴰⵛ ⵓⵖⵉⵍⵉⴼ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵡⴰ ⵉⵥⵓⵕ ⵡⴰ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵍⵡⵇⴰⵜ ⴰⴳⵉ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Ma bel$en warrac nnwen, s uâammed nnwen, am wid i ten id izwaren. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen iS. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Ma belɣen warrac nnwen, s uɛammed nnwen, am wid i ten id izwaren. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Ṛebbi issekniyen iS. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴱⵍⵖⵏ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵛ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵎⵎⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Ulac u$ilif $ef tâuqaô i iâaddan i jwao, ma kksent iceîîiven nnsent, mebla ma sseknent ccbuê nnsent. Ma setêant, yif it i nitenti. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Ulac uɣilif ɣef tɛuqaṛ i iɛaddan i jwaǧ, ma kksent iceṭṭiḍen nnsent, mebla ma sseknent ccbuḥ nnsent. Ma setḥant, yif it i nitenti. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵍⴰⵛ ⵓⵖⵉⵍⵉⴼ ⵖⴼ ⵜⵄⵓⵇⴰⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵊⵡⴰⴷⵊ, ⵎⴰ ⴽⴽⵙⵏⵜ ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⴽⵏⵏⵜ ⵛⵛⴱⵓⵃ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ. ⵎⴰ ⵙⵜⵃⴰⵏⵜ, ⵢⵉⴼ ⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵜⵉ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵍ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin, ne$ degwen, ma teççam deg ixxamen nnwen, deg wid n ibabaten nnwen, deg wid n tyimmatin nnwen, deg wid n watmaten nnwen, deg wid n tsetmatin nnwen, deg wid iâammiten nnwen, deg wid n tâammitin nnwen, deg wid ixaliten nnwen, deg wid n txaltitin nnwen, deg wid ideg tesâam tisura, ar uêbib nnwen. Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma teççam d agraw, ne$ d ifôiden. Mara tkecmen ixxamen, msalamet s wazul iôqan, aêmayan, s$uô Öebbi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen. Amar a pfehmem.
latin_inalco: Ur telli tiyta deg uderɣal, neɣ deg urejdal, neɣ deg umuḍin, neɣ degwen, ma teččam deg ixxamen nnwen, deg wid n ibabaten nnwen, deg wid n tyimmatin nnwen, deg wid n watmaten nnwen, deg wid n tsetmatin nnwen, deg wid iɛammiten nnwen, deg wid n tɛammitin nnwen, deg wid ixaliten nnwen, deg wid n txaltitin nnwen, deg wid ideg tesɛam tisura, ar uḥbib nnwen. Ulac uɣilif fellawen ma teččam d agraw, neɣ d ifṛiden. Mara tkecmen ixxamen, msalamet s wazul iṛqan, aḥmayan, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Ṛebbi issekniyen. Amar a tfehmem.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉ ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴷⵔⵖⴰⵍ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵔⵊⴷⴰⵍ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⵓⴹⵉⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴳⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵛⴰⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵉⴱⴰⴱⴰⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵜⵎⴰⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵙⵜⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵄⴰⵎⵎⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵄⴰⵎⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⴰⵍⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵅⴰⵍⵜⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵜⵙⵄⴰⵎ ⵜⵉⵙⵓⵔⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵃⴱⵉⴱ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵓⵍⴰⵛ ⵓⵖⵉⵍⵉⴼ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵛⴰⵎ ⴷ ⴰⴳⵔⴰⵡ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵉⴼⵕⵉⴷⵏ. ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ, ⵎⵙⴰⵍⴰⵎⵜ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵣⵓⵍ ⵉⵕⵇⴰⵏ, ⴰⵃⵎⴰⵢⴰⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ. ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⴼⵀⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Lmumnin, siwa wid iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma llan yides $ef lameô iten icerken, ur pôuêun alamma ssutren as tsriê. Ih, wid i k issuturen tsriê, d nitni i iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma ssutren ak tsriê, $ef kra iten iaânan, serreê i win i k ihwan, segsen. Ssuter i Öebbi ad sen Isemmeê. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Lmumnin, siwa wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma llan yides ɣef lameṛ iten icerken, ur tṛuḥun alamma ssutren as tsriḥ. Ih, wid i k issuturen tsriḥ, d nitni i iumnen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma ssutren ak tsriḥ, ɣef kra iten iaɛnan, serreḥ i win i k ihwan, segsen. Ssuter i Ṛebbi ad sen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi, s tidet, Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⵖⴼ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⵛⵔⴽⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵕⵓⵃⵓⵏ ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ. ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⵜⵓⵔⵏ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ, ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ ⴰⴽ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ, ⵖⴼ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⴰⵄⵏⴰⵏ, ⵙⵔⵔⵃ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ur êepbet asiwwel garawen i Umazan, am mara temsawalem. Ih, Iéôa Öebbi wid, segwen, ippensaren s tuffra. Ad steêdren wid mgirrden lameô iS: ad ppuhewwlen, ne$ ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Ur ḥetbet asiwwel garawen i Umazan, am mara temsawalem. Ih, Iẓṛa Ṛebbi wid, segwen, ittensaren s tuffra. Ad steḥdren wid mgirrden lameṛ iS: ad ttuhewwlen, neɣ ad sɛaddin aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵃⵜⴱⵜ ⴰⵙⵉⵡⵡⵍ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵎⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵎ. ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵉⵜⵜⵏⵙⴰⵔⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵔⴰ. ⴰⴷ ⵙⵜⵃⴷⵔⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵎⴳⵉⵔⵔⴷⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ: ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵓⵀⵡⵡⵍⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, day maççi n Öebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ni$ Iéôa amek tellam $uôeS. Ass n tu$alin nnsen $uôeS, ad asen Imel d acu xedmen. Öebbi Issen yal cci.
latin_inalco: Ih, day mačči n Ṛebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Niɣ Iẓṛa amek tellam ɣuṛeS. Ass n tuɣalin nnsen ɣuṛeS, ad asen Imel d acu xedmen. Ṛebbi Issen yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ? ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⵍⵍⴰⵎ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⵍ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ad Iôqu Win id Issadren afraz, i umdan iS, iwakken ad yili d aneddaô imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ad Iṛqu Win id Issadren afraz, i umdan iS, iwakken ad yili d aneddaṛ imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⵇⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⴰⴼⵔⴰⵣ, ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Win Ilan tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan; ur Isâi mmi S; ur aS illi ucrik di tgelda. Ixleq yal cci, Iwezn it s lmizan.
latin_inalco: Win Ilan tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan; ur Isɛi mmi S; ur aS illi ucrik di tgelda. Ixleq yal cci, Iwezn it s lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ; ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵄⵉ ⵎⵎⵉ ⵙ; ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵛⵔⵉⴽ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴳⵍⴷⴰ. ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⵉⵡⵣⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ddmen, war Neppa, iôebbiten ur nexliq acemma. D nitni i ipwaxelqen. Ur pseyyin vveô ne$ aba$uô, i iman nnsen. Ur pseyyin di tmeppant ne$ di tmeddurt, ne$ di tnekra.
latin_inalco: Ddmen, war Netta, iṛebbiten ur nexliq acemma. D nitni i itwaxelqen. Ur tseyyin ḍḍeṛ neɣ abaɣuṛ, i iman nnsen. Ur tseyyin di tmettant neɣ di tmeddurt, neɣ di tnekra.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴷⵎⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵅⵍⵉⵇ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ. ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵅⵍⵇⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵢⵢⵉⵏ ⴹⴹⵕ ⵏⵖ ⴰⴱⴰⵖⵓⵕ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵢⵢⵉⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⵏⵖ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ayagi, d tikerkas kan. Isnulfa tent id, iâawen it, fellas, ugdud nniven. Ni$ densen u skaddben".
latin_inalco: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ayagi, d tikerkas kan. Isnulfa tent id, iɛawen it, fellas, ugdud nniḍen. Niɣ densen u skaddben".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ: "ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⴽⴰⵏ. ⵉⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⴰ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵉⵄⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵜ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⴷⵏⵙⵏ ⵓ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "d timucuha imezwura, i iura; qqaôen as tent ûûbeê, tameddit".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "d timucuha imezwura, i iura; qqaṛen as tent ṣṣbeḥ, tameddit".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵓⵛⵓⵀⴰ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ, ⵉ ⵉⵓⵔⴰ; ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵚⵚⴱⵃ, ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ".

ayah_content: Ini: "Issader it id, Win Issnen sser n tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, s tidep, Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
latin_inalco: Ini: "Issader it id, Win Issnen sser n tmurt akked igenwan. Netta, s tidet, Izga Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵏ ⵙⵙⵔ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "d acut Umazan agi i iteppen lqut, iteddun ar leswaq? A lemmer id irs $uôes lmelk, ara yilin yides d aneddaô,
latin_inalco: Nnan: "d acut Umazan agi i itetten lqut, iteddun ar leswaq? A lemmer id irs ɣuṛes lmelk, ara yilin yides d aneddaṛ,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓⵜ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⵜⵏ ⵍⵇⵓⵜ, ⵉⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵍⵙⵡⴰⵇ? ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵔⵙ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⵍⵎⵍⴽ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ,

ayah_content: ne$ ippunefk as ugerruj, ne$ isâa aqwiô itepp segs"! Nnan imednas: "la teppeddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseêren".
latin_inalco: neɣ ittunefk as ugerruj, neɣ isɛa aqwiṛ itett segs"! Nnan imednas: "la tetteddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseḥren".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⴰⵙ ⵓⴳⵔⵔⵓⵊ, ⵏⵖ ⵉⵙⵄⴰ ⴰⵇⵡⵉⵕ ⵉⵜⵜⵜ ⵙⴳⵙ"! ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ: "ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⴷⴷⵓⵎ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵓⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵙⵙⵃⵔⵏ".

ayah_content: Wali amek id ppaken fellak imedyaten. Nnetlafen, ur zmiren ad pwanhun.
latin_inalco: Wali amek id ttaken fellak imedyaten. Nnetlafen, ur zmiren ad twanhun.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⴽⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵜⵏ. ⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad Iôqu Win ad ak Ifken, ma Irad, i ifen ayagi: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Ad ak Issali lebôuo.
latin_inalco: Ad Iṛqu Win ad ak Ifken, ma Irad, i ifen ayagi: leǧnanat, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen. Ad ak Issali lebṛuǧ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⵇⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⵉⴼⴽⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵔⴰⴷ, ⵉ ⵉⴼⵏ ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ: ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵍⴱⵕⵓⴷⵊ.

ayah_content: Xaîi, nekôen imir. Nhegga d times i win inekôen imir.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi, nekṛen imir. Nhegga d times i win inekṛen imir.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ. ⵏⵀⴳⴳⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Mi ten twala si tama ibaâden, ad as slen s leêôaôa akked zzhir.
latin_inalco: Mi ten twala si tama ibaɛden, ad as slen s leḥṛaṛa akked zzhir.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⴰⵄⴷⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵙⵍⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵃⵕⴰⵕⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵣⵣⵀⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Mara $lin degs, nitni pwarzen deg umekkan uqmiv, ad siwlen, dinna, i wangar.
latin_inalco: Mara ɣlin degs, nitni twarzen deg umekkan uqmiḍ, ad siwlen, dinna, i wangar.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵖⵍⵉⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⵔⵣⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵓⵇⵎⵉⴹ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⵉⵡⵍⵏ, ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉ ⵡⴰⵏⴳⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: "Ur ssawalet ara, assa, i yiwet n wangar, ssiwlet i waîas n wangaren".
latin_inalco: "Ur ssawalet ara, assa, i yiwet n wangar, ssiwlet i waṭas n wangaren".
Tifinagh: "ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵏⴳⴰⵔ, ⵙⵙⵉⵡⵍⵜ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵏⴳⴰⵔⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "ppif ayagi, ne$ Loennet n lebda i Nâahed i wid ipêezziben? D neppat ay d arraz, ay d taggara, i nitni".
latin_inalco: Ini: "ttif ayagi, neɣ Lǧennet n lebda i Nɛahed i wid itḥezziben? D nettat ay d arraz, ay d taggara, i nitni".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵜⵜⵉⴼ ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵏⵖ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵏ ⵍⴱⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵏⵄⴰⵀⴷ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ? ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵜ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ, ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⴳⴰⵔⴰ, ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ".

ayah_content: I nitni degs, ayen i sen ihwan, i lebda. D lemâahda i$ef Iuksan Mass ik.
latin_inalco: I nitni degs, ayen i sen ihwan, i lebda. D lemɛahda iɣef Iuksan Mass ik.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵍⴱⴷⴰ. ⴷ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵓⴽⵙⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, nitni akked wid âabden, war Öebbi, ad Yini: "d kunwi i itelfen imdanen iW agi, ne$ d nitni i iff$en abrid"?
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, nitni akked wid ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, ad Yini: "d kunwi i itelfen imdanen iW agi, neɣ d nitni i iffɣen abrid"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴼⵙⵔ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵍⴼⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ"?

ayah_content: A d inin: "gedha s yiseK! Ur a$ issefk a neddu d bab, war Keçç. Maca, T$atev ten, nitni akked imezwura nnsen, armi ppun asmekti, u$alen d agdud ixeûôen".
latin_inalco: A d inin: "gedha s yiseK! Ur aɣ issefk a neddu d bab, war Kečč. Maca, Tɣateḍ ten, nitni akked imezwura nnsen, armi ttun asmekti, uɣalen d agdud ixeṣṛen".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙⴽ! ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⴽ ⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⵓ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⵖⴰⵜⴹ ⵜⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵓⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵅⵚⵕⵏ".

ayah_content: Atan nekôen kwen $ef wayen d tennam. Ihi ur tezmirem i tsensert, ne$ i leslak. Win idensen, degwen, a Nessukk fellas, aâaqeb ameqwôan.
latin_inalco: Atan nekṛen kwen ɣef wayen d tennam. Ihi ur tezmirem i tsensert, neɣ i leslak. Win idensen, degwen, a Nessukk fellas, aɛaqeb ameqwṛan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵏⵏⴰⵎ. ⵉⵀⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵉⵔⵎ ⵉ ⵜⵙⵏⵙⵔⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⵉ ⵍⵙⵍⴰⴽ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷⴳⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵙⵙⵓⴽⴽ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, imazanen, mebla ma llan teppen lqut, u teddun ar leswaq. Nerra kwen, wa ihewwel wa, ma a pûebôem. Mass ik Izga la d Ismuqul.
latin_inalco: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, imazanen, mebla ma llan tetten lqut, u teddun ar leswaq. Nerra kwen, wa ihewwel wa, ma a tṣebṛem. Mass ik Izga la d Ismuqul.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⵜⵜⵏ ⵍⵇⵓⵜ, ⵓ ⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵍⵙⵡⴰⵇ. ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ, ⵡⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⵡⵍ ⵡⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵚⴱⵕⵎ. ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⵍⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⵓⵇⵓⵍ.

ayah_content: Nnan wid ur nessarem ara timlilit yidne£: "a lemmer id ssersen lmalayek $uône$, ne$ nwala Mass nne$"! Ni$ sme$wôen aîas iman nnsen, u ffuhrin aîas.
latin_inalco: Nnan wid ur nessarem ara timlilit yidneɣ: "a lemmer id ssersen lmalayek ɣuṛneɣ, neɣ nwala Mass nneɣ"! Niɣ smeɣwṛen aṭas iman nnsen, u ffuhrin aṭas.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵙⴰⵔⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵉⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵢⵉⴷⵏⵖ: "ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⵏⵖ ⵏⵡⴰⵍⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ"! ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⵎⵖⵡⵕⵏ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓ ⴼⴼⵓⵀⵔⵉⵏ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara walin lmalayek, ur ippili wassen d abecceô ibe$wviyen, s lxiô. A d inin: d aêdid ur nepwazgar.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara walin lmalayek, ur ittili wassen d abecceṛ ibeɣwḍiyen, s lxiṛ. A d inin: d aḥdid ur netwazgar.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ, ⵙ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ. ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: ⴷ ⴰⵃⴷⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵡⴰⵣⴳⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Nezzi $eô igiten nnsen, Nerra ten d a$ebbaô immebruzzâen.
latin_inalco: Nezzi ɣeṛ igiten nnsen, Nerra ten d aɣebbaṛ immebruzzɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵣⵣⵉ ⵖⵕ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵖⴱⴱⴰⵕ ⵉⵎⵎⴱⵔⵓⵣⵣⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Imawlan n Loennet, assen, di tnezdu$t akked trusi iufraren.
latin_inalco: Imawlan n Lǧennet, assen, di tnezduɣt akked trusi iufraren.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵏⵣⴷⵓⵖⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵉⵓⴼⵔⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara iceqqeq igenni s usigna, ideg ara d ssersen lmalayek, ta deffir ta,
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara iceqqeq igenni s usigna, ideg ara d ssersen lmalayek, ta deffir ta,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵛⵇⵇⵇ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⵙ ⵓⵙⵉⴳⵏⴰ, ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⵜⴰ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⴰ,

ayah_content: tagelda, assen, tidep, i Uênin. D ass uwâiô i ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: tagelda, assen, tidet, i Uḥnin. D ass uwɛiṛ i ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ. ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵡⵄⵉⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara i$eéé umednus ifassen is, ad yini: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ddi$ d ubrid Umazan!
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara iɣeẓẓ umednus ifassen is, ad yini: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ddiɣ d ubrid Umazan!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵖⵥⵥ ⵓⵎⴷⵏⵓⵙ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰ ⵢⴰⵎⵅⵉⵅ ⵉⵡ, ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴷⴷⵉⵖ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: A tawa$it pwa$e$, a lemmer ur rri$ ara winnat d aêbib!
latin_inalco: A tawaɣit twaɣeɣ, a lemmer ur rriɣ ara winnat d aḥbib!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⵜⵡⴰⵖⵖ, ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵔⵔⵉⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⵉⵏⵏⴰⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵃⴱⵉⴱ!

ayah_content: Ni$ itelf iyi seg usmekti i illan iusa yi d. Cciîan, i umdan, izga d axeddaâ".
latin_inalco: Niɣ itelf iyi seg usmekti i illan iusa yi d. Cciṭan, i umdan, izga d axeddaɛ".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵢⵉ ⴷ. ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵅⴷⴷⴰⵄ".

ayah_content: Inna Umazan: "a Mass iw! Ar ugdud iw, s tidep, Leqwôan agi d askeôfeé".
latin_inalco: Inna Umazan: "a Mass iw! Ar ugdud iw, s tidet, Leqwṛan agi d askeṛfeẓ".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⴰⵔ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⴽⵕⴼⵥ".

ayah_content: Akka, i yal nnbi, Nefka acengu seg ibe$wviyen. Iqadd Mass ik, i nnhaya akked usellek.
latin_inalco: Akka, i yal nnbi, Nefka acengu seg ibeɣwḍiyen. Iqadd Mass ik, i nnhaya akked usellek.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⴱⵉ, ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⴰⵛⵏⴳⵓ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ. ⵉⵇⴰⴷⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵙⵍⵍⴽ.

ayah_content: Nnan wid ijehlen: "a lemmer i s d ssersen Leqwôan, deg yiwet n tikelt"! Akka, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yis. Nesemderri t d idurra.
latin_inalco: Nnan wid ijehlen: "a lemmer i s d ssersen Leqwṛan, deg yiwet n tikelt"! Akka, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yis. Nesemderri t d idurra.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ: "ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵢⵉⵡⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴽⵍⵜ"! ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵏⵜⴱⴱⵜ ⵓⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⵢⵉⵙ. ⵏⵙⵎⴷⵔⵔⵉ ⵜ ⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur ak d ppawin amedya, mebla ma Nuzen ak d tidep, akked ufesser amxallef.
latin_inalco: Ur ak d ttawin amedya, mebla ma Nuzen ak d tidet, akked ufesser amxallef.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴼⵙⵙⵔ ⴰⵎⵅⴰⵍⵍⴼ.

ayah_content: Wid ara ipwafesren af udmawen nnsen, ar Loahennama, widak d at umkan n dir mavi, d at ubrid im$eôôeq mavi.
latin_inalco: Wid ara itwafesren af udmawen nnsen, ar Lǧahennama, widak d at umkan n dir maḍi, d at ubrid imɣeṛṛeq maḍi.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴼⵙⵔⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵜ ⵓⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏ ⴷⵉⵔ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵜ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerna $uôes gma s, Haôun, d amâiwen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerna ɣuṛes gma s, Haṛun, d amɛiwen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ, ⵓ ⵏⵔⵏⴰ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⴳⵎⴰ ⵙ, ⵀⴰⵕⵓⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵄⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Nenna: "ôuêet ar ugdud i inekôen issekniyen nne£". Nhudd iten qeccuc meccuc.
latin_inalco: Nenna: "ṛuḥet ar ugdud i inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ". Nhudd iten qeccuc meccuc.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵕⵓⵃⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉ ⵉⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ". ⵏⵀⵓⴷⴷ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵇⵛⵛⵓⵛ ⵎⵛⵛⵓⵛ.

ayah_content: Agdud n Nuê, mi nekôen imazanen, Ne$ves iten, u Nerra ten d assekni i medden. Nhegga i imednas aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Agdud n Nuḥ, mi nekṛen imazanen, Neɣḍes iten, u Nerra ten d assekni i medden. Nhegga i imednas aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ, ⵎⵉ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵏⵖⴹⵙ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⵓ ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ. ⵏⵀⴳⴳⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Âad, Tamud, At Öôas, u aîas isuta garasen.
latin_inalco: Ɛad, Tamud, At Ṛṛas, u aṭas isuta garasen.
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⴷ, ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ, ⴰⵜ ⵕⵕⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉⵙⵓⵜⴰ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: I yal wa, Nefka imedyaten. Yal wa, Neôéa t wakali.
latin_inalco: I yal wa, Nefka imedyaten. Yal wa, Neṛẓa t wakali.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵡⴰ, ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵜⵏ. ⵢⴰⵍ ⵡⴰ, ⵏⵕⵥⴰ ⵜ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Ni$ âaddan $ef taddart i$ef id i$li ugeffur ageswaê. Day qqimen ur p walan ara? Xaîi, ur ssaramen ara tanekra.
latin_inalco: Niɣ ɛaddan ɣef taddart iɣef id iɣli ugeffur ageswaḥ. Day qqimen ur t walan ara? Xaṭi, ur ssaramen ara tanekra.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵜⴰⴷⴷⴰⵔⵜ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵖⵍⵉ ⵓⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ ⴰⴳⵙⵡⴰⵃ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ? ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⴰⵔⴰⵎⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵏⴽⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Mi k walan, ppemsexxiôen kan fellak: "day d wagi id Iuzen Öebbi, d Amazan?
latin_inalco: Mi k walan, ttemsexxiṛen kan fellak: "day d wagi id Iuzen Ṛebbi, d Amazan?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⴽ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ, ⵜⵜⵎⵙⵅⵅⵉⵕⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵣⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: Qôib i $ itlef seg iôebbiten nne$, lemmer ur neûbiô fellasen". Deqqal ad éôen mara walin aâaqeb, anwa i innetlafen, kteô, seg ubrid.
latin_inalco: Qṛib i ɣ itlef seg iṛebbiten nneɣ, lemmer ur neṣbiṛ fellasen". Deqqal ad ẓṛen mara walin aɛaqeb, anwa i innetlafen, kteṛ, seg ubrid.
Tifinagh: ⵇⵕⵉⴱ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵚⴱⵉⵕ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ". ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ, ⴽⵜⵕ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ.

ayah_content: Twalav win i irran lhawiyya s d ôebbi s? Day ad as tiliv, keçç, d awkil?
latin_inalco: Twalaḍ win i irran lhawiyya s d ṛebbi s? Day ad as tiliḍ, kečč, d awkil?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵍⵀⴰⵡⵉⵢⵢⴰ ⵙ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⴹ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⴽⵉⵍ?

ayah_content: Day t$ilev tegwti, segsen, sellen ne$ fehmen? Nitni am lmal kan, aâer $elben ten akken nnetlafen seg ubrid.
latin_inalco: Day tɣileḍ tegwti, segsen, sellen neɣ fehmen? Nitni am lmal kan, aɛer ɣelben ten akken nnetlafen seg ubrid.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵜⵖⵉⵍⴹ ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵙⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴼⵀⵎⵏ? ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵎ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵄⵔ ⵖⵍⴱⵏ ⵜⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ.

ayah_content: Ma twalav Mass ik, amek id Ifka tili? Lemmer i S ihwi, Irra p d tusbiî. D$a Nefka yas itij d ppbut.
latin_inalco: Ma twalaḍ Mass ik, amek id Ifka tili? Lemmer i S ihwi, Irra t d tusbiṭ. Dɣa Nefka yas itij d ttbut.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵜⵉⵍⵉ? ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ, ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⴱⵉⵟ. ⴷⵖⴰ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵉⵜⵉⵊ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴱⵓⵜ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Njebd ip id $uône£, ajbad isehlen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Njebd it id ɣuṛneɣ, ajbad isehlen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵊⴱⴷ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴰⵊⴱⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵀⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i wen Irran iv d aceîîiv, ives d areyyeê, u Irra ass d tanekra.
latin_inalco: D Netta i wen Irran iḍ d aceṭṭiḍ, iḍes d areyyeḥ, u Irra ass d tanekra.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⴹ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹ, ⵉⴹⵙ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵢⵢⵃ, ⵓ ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⴰⵙⵙ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵏⴽⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i wen d Iuznen avu, d abecceô s uêunu S. Nessers ed, seg igenni, aman iûfan;
latin_inalco: D Netta i wen d Iuznen aḍu, d abecceṛ s uḥunu S. Nessers ed, seg igenni, aman iṣfan;
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵓⵣⵏⵏ ⴰⴹⵓ, ⴷ ⴰⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵙ ⵓⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ. ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴷ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵚⴼⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: iwakken a Neêyu yissen tamurt immuten; a Nessew yissen aîas seg wid id Nexleq n lmal, akked imdanen.
latin_inalco: iwakken a Neḥyu yissen tamurt immuten; a Nessew yissen aṭas seg wid id Nexleq n lmal, akked imdanen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵏⵃⵢⵓ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵉⵎⵎⵓⵜⵏ; ⴰ ⵏⵙⵙⵡ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nfeôq iten garasen, iwakken a d mmektin. Tegwti n yimdanen ugin; atnan kan di tijehli.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nfeṛq iten garasen, iwakken a d mmektin. Tegwti n yimdanen ugin; atnan kan di tijehli.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⵕⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵓⴳⵉⵏ; ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Lemmer i £ ihwi, yili Nuzen aneddaô, i yal tamdint.
latin_inalco: Lemmer i ɣ ihwi, yili Nuzen aneddaṛ, i yal tamdint.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ, ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen. Nna$ iten yis, amennu$ ameqwôan.
latin_inalco: Ur ttaɣ awal i ijehliyen. Nnaɣ iten yis, amennuɣ ameqwṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵖ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ. ⵏⵏⴰⵖ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⴰⵎⵏⵏⵓⵖ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Issemfaôaqen sin ilellen, yiwen êlaw, d aéidan, wayev ôéag, d ameô$an. Irra, garasen, agadir, aêdid ur nepwazgar.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Issemfaṛaqen sin ilellen, yiwen ḥlaw, d aẓidan, wayeḍ ṛẓag, d ameṛɣan. Irra, garasen, agadir, aḥdid ur netwazgar.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⴼⴰⵕⴰⵇⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵍⵏ, ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵃⵍⴰⵡ, ⴷ ⴰⵥⵉⴷⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵢⴹ ⵕⵥⴰⴳ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵕⵖⴰⵏ. ⵉⵔⵔⴰ, ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⴳⴰⴷⵉⵔ, ⴰⵃⴷⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵡⴰⵣⴳⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Ixelqen amdan seg waman. Ifka yas laâmum, lexwal. Mass ik Izga d Win Izemren.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Ixelqen amdan seg waman. Ifka yas laɛmum, lexwal. Mass ik Izga d Win Izemren.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ. ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵍⴰⵄⵎⵓⵎ, ⵍⵅⵡⴰⵍ. ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵣⵎⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen ur ten inefâan, ur ten ivuôôen. Ajehli, ar loiha n Mass is, izga d win issefôa$en.
latin_inalco: La ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, ayen ur ten inefɛan, ur ten iḍuṛṛen. Ajehli, ar lǧiha n Mass is, izga d win issefṛaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵏⴼⵄⴰⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴹⵓⵕⵕⵏ. ⴰⵊⵀⵍⵉ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵀⴰ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵕⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Nuzen ik id kan, i ubecceô d uneddeô.
latin_inalco: Nuzen ik id kan, i ubecceṛ d uneddeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⵉⴽ ⵉⴷ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵓⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⴷ ⵓⵏⴷⴷⵕ.

ayah_content: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$, $ef waya, kra n teqdiât. Ssutre$ kan, i win ib$an, ad ia$ abrid $eô Mass is".
latin_inalco: Ini: "ur awen ssutreɣ, ɣef waya, kra n teqdiɛt. Ssutreɣ kan, i win ibɣan, ad iaɣ abrid ɣeṛ Mass is".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ. ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴰⵖ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵖⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ".

ayah_content: Ppkel $ef Umuddir ur Nepmeppat. Sbuccaâ iT s ccekôan. Iqadd i tussna ibekkaven n imdanen iS.
latin_inalco: Ptkel ɣef Umuddir ur Netmettat. Sbuccaɛ iT s ccekṛan. Iqadd i tussna ibekkaḍen n imdanen iS.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴽⵍ ⵖⴼ ⵓⵎⵓⴷⴷⵉⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵜ. ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ. ⵉⵇⴰⴷⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵓⵙⵙⵏⴰ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: I Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan. Sinna, Aênin Iâannec af usgeld. Steqsi w iT issnen.
latin_inalco: I Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan. Sinna, Aḥnin Iɛannec af usgeld. Steqsi w iT issnen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵙⴷⵉⵙ ⵡⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵃⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵄⴰⵏⵏⵛ ⴰⴼ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ. ⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ ⵡ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma pwanecden: "knut i Uênin"! A d rren: "d acu T Uênin? Day a neknu i w ara $ d tamôev"? D a$unfu i sen irna.
latin_inalco: Ma twanecden: "knut i Uḥnin"! A d rren: "d acu T Uḥnin? Day a neknu i w ara ɣ d tamṛeḍ"? D aɣunfu i sen irna.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷⵏ: "ⴽⵏⵓⵜ ⵉ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ"! ⴰ ⴷ ⵔⵔⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵏⴽⵏⵓ ⵉ ⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵖ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⵕⴹ"? ⴷ ⴰⵖⵓⵏⴼⵓ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵔⵏⴰ.

ayah_content: Ad Iôqu Win Irran itran deg igenni. Irna degs, lefnaô, akked waggur bu tziri.
latin_inalco: Ad Iṛqu Win Irran itran deg igenni. Irna degs, lefnaṛ, akked waggur bu tziri.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⵇⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ. ⵉⵔⵏⴰ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵍⴼⵏⴰⵕ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ ⴱⵓ ⵜⵣⵉⵔⵉ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Irran iv akked wass mestebâan, i win ib$an ad ismekti, ne$ ib$an ad isnemmer.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Irran iḍ akked wass mestebɛan, i win ibɣan ad ismekti, neɣ ibɣan ad isnemmer.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵎⵙⵜⴱⵄⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵏⵖ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵏⵎⵎⵔ.

ayah_content: Ixdimen n Uênin, i ileêêun di tmurt di lehna, ma numren ten at war tussna, qqaôen: "tifrat"!
latin_inalco: Ixdimen n Uḥnin, i ileḥḥun di tmurt di lehna, ma numren ten at war tussna, qqaṛen: "tifrat"!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⴷⵉⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵃⵃⵓⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵍⵀⵏⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⵏⵓⵎⵔⵏ ⵜⵏ ⴰⵜ ⵡⴰⵔ ⵜⵓⵙⵙⵏⴰ, ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ"!

ayah_content: I ippaâwazen i Mass nnsen, knan ne$ bedden;
latin_inalco: I ittaɛwazen i Mass nnsen, knan neɣ bedden;
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵄⵡⴰⵣⵏ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴽⵏⴰⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴱⴷⴷⵏ;

ayah_content: I iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Veôôef segne$ aâaqeb n Loahennama. Ih, aâaqeb is ipwaêeppem".
latin_inalco: I iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Ḍeṛṛef segneɣ aɛaqeb n Lǧahennama. Ih, aɛaqeb is itwaḥettem".
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⴹⵕⵕⴼ ⵙⴳⵏⵖ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵃⵜⵜⵎ".

ayah_content: Neppat, s tidep, d tadirant, i tnezdu$t akked i$imi.
latin_inalco: Nettat, s tidet, d tadirant, i tnezduɣt akked iɣimi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵜ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⴰⴷⵉⵔⴰⵏⵜ, ⵉ ⵜⵏⵣⴷⵓⵖⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵖⵉⵎⵉ.

ayah_content: Wid, ma seôôfen, ur veggiâen, ur pcuêêun: igi iwulmen atan garasen.
latin_inalco: Wid, ma seṛṛfen, ur ḍeggiɛen, ur tcuḥḥun: igi iwulmen atan garasen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵎⴰ ⵙⵕⵕⴼⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴹⴳⴳⵉⵄⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵛⵓⵃⵃⵓⵏ: ⵉⴳⵉ ⵉⵡⵓⵍⵎⵏ ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ur nenâaô ôebbi nniven, ar tama n Öebbi. Ur neqqen amdan, d ayen Igdel Öebbi, siwa $ef tidep. Ur zennun. Win ixedmen ayagi, ibbwi ibekkaven.
latin_inalco: Wid ur nenɛaṛ ṛebbi nniḍen, ar tama n Ṛebbi. Ur neqqen amdan, d ayen Igdel Ṛebbi, siwa ɣef tidet. Ur zennun. Win ixedmen ayagi, ibbwi ibekkaḍen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵏⵄⴰⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵏⵇⵇⵏ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴳⴷⵍ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵖⴼ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⵣⵏⵏⵓⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad ippuâaqeb berdayen, ass n tnekra. Ad iwekkeô d imdelli;
latin_inalco: Ad ittuɛaqeb berdayen, ass n tnekra. Ad iwekkeṛ d imdelli;
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴱⵔⴷⴰⵢⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵡⴽⴽⵕ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵍⵍⵉ;

ayah_content: siwa win isteôoâen, iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ad Inûef Öebbi tucmitin nnsen, s yise$iyen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: siwa win isteṛǧɛen, iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ad Inṣef Ṛebbi tucmitin nnsen, s yiseɣiyen. Ṛebbi Izga Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵄⵏ, ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⵉ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵚⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙⵖⵉⵢⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵣⴳⴰ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Win isteôoâen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ihi, iutub Öebbi s ppuba n tidep.
latin_inalco: Win isteṛǧɛen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ihi, iutub Ṛebbi s ttuba n tidet.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵄⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵉⵓⵜⵓⴱ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙ ⵜⵜⵓⴱⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ.

ayah_content: Wid ur ncehhed ccada n rrya; u, ma mmugren tifukal, ddan d ukyisen.
latin_inalco: Wid ur ncehhed ccada n rrya; u, ma mmugren tifukal, ddan d ukyisen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵛⵀⵀⴷ ⵛⵛⴰⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵔⵔⵢⴰ; ⵓ, ⵎⴰ ⵎⵎⵓⴳⵔⵏ ⵜⵉⴼⵓⴽⴰⵍ, ⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid, mara asen d smmektin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, ur d neggar tiâéegt ne$ tider$elt fellasen.
latin_inalco: Wid, mara asen d smmektin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, ur d neggar tiɛẓegt neɣ tiderɣelt fellasen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⵄⵥⴳⵜ ⵏⵖ ⵜⵉⴷⵔⵖⵍⵜ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Err tilawin nne$, akked dderya nne$, d ssuâada n wallen. Err ane$ d wid inehhun wid ipêezziben".
latin_inalco: Wid iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Err tilawin nneɣ, akked dderya nneɣ, d ssuɛada n wallen. Err aneɣ d wid inehhun wid itḥezziben".
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵔⵔ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴷⴷⵔⵢⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴷ ⵙⵙⵓⵄⴰⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ. ⵔⵔ ⴰⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ".

ayah_content: Widak ad ppuoazin s t$uôfatin, ilmend n wayen ûebôen. Ad magren, dinna, azul, tifrat.
latin_inalco: Widak ad ttuǧazin s tɣuṛfatin, ilmend n wayen ṣebṛen. Ad magren, dinna, azul, tifrat.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵓⴷⵊⴰⵣⵉⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵖⵓⵕⴼⴰⵜⵉⵏ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵚⴱⵕⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵎⴰⴳⵔⵏ, ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵣⵓⵍ, ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ.

ayah_content: Dinna, ad wekkôen, d amkan amxalef i tnezdu$t d i$imi.
latin_inalco: Dinna, ad wekkṛen, d amkan amxalef i tnezduɣt d iɣimi.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⵎⵅⴰⵍⴼ ⵉ ⵜⵏⵣⴷⵓⵖⵜ ⴷ ⵉⵖⵉⵎⵉ.

ayah_content: Ini: "ur d Irezzu Mass iw, degwen, ma ur tnujem $uôeS. Ni$ tnekôem? Ad iu$al waya d ayen ilezmen".
latin_inalco: Ini: "ur d Irezzu Mass iw, degwen, ma ur tnujem ɣuṛeS. Niɣ tnekṛem? Ad iuɣal waya d ayen ilezmen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵣⵣⵓ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⴷⴳⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏⵓⵊⵎ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⵜⵏⴽⵕⵎ? ⴰⴷ ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵣⵎⵏ".

ayah_content: Ïsm.
latin_inalco: Ṭsm.
Tifinagh: ⵟⵙⵎ.

ayah_content: Atnan issekniyen n Tezmamt ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Atnan issekniyen n Tezmamt itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ahat tqelqev iman ik, imi ur ppilin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Ahat tqelqeḍ iman ik, imi ur ttilin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵀⴰⵜ ⵜⵇⵍⵇⴹ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⴽ, ⵉⵎⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma ihwa ya£, ad asen d Nessers assekni seg igenni, ad îinzent, zdat es, tmegôav nnsen, s wannuz.
latin_inalco: Ma ihwa yaɣ, ad asen d Nessers assekni seg igenni, ad ṭinzent, zdat es, tmegṛaḍ nnsen, s wannuz.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵖ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵟⵉⵏⵣⵏⵜ, ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵙ, ⵜⵎⴳⵕⴰⴹ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: Ur ten id ippas usmekti amaynut, s$uô Uênin, mebla ma u$alen as d inekkaôen.
latin_inalco: Ur ten id ittas usmekti amaynut, sɣuṛ Uḥnin, mebla ma uɣalen as d inekkaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵙ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⴰⵎⴰⵢⵏⵓⵜ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ skaddben. Ihi, ad asen d asen isallen, $ef wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.
latin_inalco: Niɣ skaddben. Ihi, ad asen d asen isallen, ɣef wayen iɣef tmmaɛliken.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⵍⵍⵏ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⵎⴰⵄⵍⵉⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: Day ur walan ara tamurt? Acêal i Nessenker degs n yal tayuga tukyist!
latin_inalco: Day ur walan ara tamurt? Acḥal i Nessenker degs n yal tayuga tukyist!
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ? ⴰⵛⵃⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵏⵙⵙⵏⴽⵔ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⴰⵢⵓⴳⴰ ⵜⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙⵜ!

ayah_content: Deg wayagi, s tidep, assekni. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Deg wayagi, s tidet, assekni. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Mi Issawel Mass ik, i Musa: "ôuê s agdud imednas,
latin_inalco: Mi Issawel Mass ik, i Musa: "ṛuḥ s agdud imednas,
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵡⵍ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ: "ⵕⵓⵃ ⵙ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ,

ayah_content: agdud n Ferâun. Day ur ppezziben ara"?
latin_inalco: agdud n Ferɛun. Day ur ttezziben ara"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ugade$ ad iyi skiddben,
latin_inalco: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ugadeɣ ad iyi skiddben,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵏⴽ ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ,

ayah_content: ad sekkwôen idmaren iw, ur ipserriê yiles iw. Ihi, Azen ar Haôun.
latin_inalco: ad sekkwṛen idmaren iw, ur itserriḥ yiles iw. Ihi, Azen ar Haṛun.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵙⴽⴽⵡⵕⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵙⵔⵔⵉⵃ ⵢⵉⵍⵙ ⵉⵡ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵣⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵀⴰⵕⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: U denbe$ $uôsen. Ugade$ ad iyi n$en".
latin_inalco: U denbeɣ ɣuṛsen. Ugadeɣ ad iyi nɣen".
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⴷⵏⴱⵖ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ. ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵏⵖⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "Xaîi, ôuêet s issekniyen nne£. Aql a£ yidwen, Nessemêas en. Ôö
latin_inalco: Inna: "Xaṭi, ṛuḥet s issekniyen nneɣ. Aql aɣ yidwen, Nessemḥas en. Ṛṛ
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵕⵓⵃⵜ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ ⵢⵉⴷⵡⵏ, ⵏⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙ ⵏ. ⵕⵕ

ayah_content: Öuêet ar Ferâun, tinem as: "nekwni d amazan n Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ṛuḥet ar Ferɛun, tinem as: "nekwni d amazan n Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵕⵓⵃⵜ ⴰⵔ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⵜⵉⵏⵎ ⴰⵙ: "ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Seddu, yidne$, At Isôail".
latin_inalco: Seddu, yidneɣ, At Isṛail".
Tifinagh: ⵙⴷⴷⵓ, ⵢⵉⴷⵏⵖ, ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ".

ayah_content: Inna: "day ur k nôebba ara $uône$, d llufan? U tesâaddav $uône$, iseggwasen di lâameô ik;
latin_inalco: Inna: "day ur k nṛebba ara ɣuṛneɣ, d llufan? U tesɛaddaḍ ɣuṛneɣ, iseggwasen di lɛameṛ ik;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴽ ⵏⵕⴱⴱⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴷ ⵍⵍⵓⴼⴰⵏ? ⵓ ⵜⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰⴹ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⵉⵙⴳⴳⵡⴰⵙⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵍⵄⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⴽ;

ayah_content: u txedmev igi txedmev. Keçç, seg ijehliyen".
latin_inalco: u txedmeḍ igi txedmeḍ. Kečč, seg ijehliyen".
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⴹ ⵉⴳⵉ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⴹ. ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "xedme$ t asmi lli$ seg im$eôôqen.
latin_inalco: Inna: "xedmeɣ t asmi lliɣ seg imɣeṛṛqen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵅⴷⵎⵖ ⵜ ⴰⵙⵎⵉ ⵍⵍⵉⵖ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Rewle$ segwen, mi kwen ugade$. Ifka yi Mass iw, ûûwab. Irra yi seg imazanen.
latin_inalco: Rewleɣ segwen, mi kwen ugadeɣ. Ifka yi Mass iw, ṣṣwab. Irra yi seg imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵔⵡⵍⵖ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵎⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵖ. ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ. ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: D l$it agi, i$ef a yi teppezzmev, i k ibbwin a pperrev, At Isôail, d aklan"?
latin_inalco: D lɣit agi, iɣef a yi tettezzmeḍ, i k ibbwin a tterreḍ, At Isṛail, d aklan"?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵖⴼ ⴰ ⵢⵉ ⵜⵜⵜⵣⵣⵎⴹ, ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵔⵔⴹ, ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ, ⴷ ⴰⴽⵍⴰⵏ"?

ayah_content: Inna Ferâun: "d acu T Mass imavalen"?
latin_inalco: Inna Ferɛun: "d acu T Mass imaḍalen"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "d Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, ma tetebbtem".
latin_inalco: Inna: "d Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, ma tetebbtem".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⴱⴱⵜⵎ".

ayah_content: Inna i wi s d izzin: "la tsellem"?
latin_inalco: Inna i wi s d izzin: "la tsellem"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵣⵉⵏ: "ⵍⴰ ⵜⵙⵍⵍⵎ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "Mass nnwen, u Mass n lejdud nnwen, imezwura".
latin_inalco: Inna: "Mass nnwen, u Mass n lejdud nnwen, imezwura".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵍⵊⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ".

ayah_content: Inna: "s tidep, amazan nnwen id ippuceggâen $uôwen, d aôehbani".
latin_inalco: Inna: "s tidet, amazan nnwen id ittuceggɛen ɣuṛwen, d aṛehbani".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵛⴳⴳⵄⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵕⵀⴱⴰⵏⵉ".

ayah_content: Inna: "Mass n ugmuv, utaram, akked wayen illan garasen, lemmer tefhimem".
latin_inalco: Inna: "Mass n ugmuḍ, utaram, akked wayen illan garasen, lemmer tefhimem".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴳⵎⵓⴹ, ⵓⵜⴰⵔⴰⵎ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵜⴼⵀⵉⵎⵎ".

ayah_content: Inna: "ma tedmev Öebbi, ur nelli d nek, a k nerr ar lêebs".
latin_inalco: Inna: "ma tedmeḍ Ṛebbi, ur nelli d nek, a k nerr ar lḥebs".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵎⴰ ⵜⴷⵎⴹ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵏⴽ, ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⵔⵔ ⴰⵔ ⵍⵃⴱⵙ".

ayah_content: Inna: "i lemmer ad ak d awi$ ayen ipbegginen"?
latin_inalco: Inna: "i lemmer ad ak d awiɣ ayen itbegginen"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵉ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵡⵉⵖ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "awi t id, ma d tidep ay tessawalev".
latin_inalco: Inna: "awi t id, ma d tidet ay tessawaleḍ".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰⵡⵉ ⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⴹ".

ayah_content: Iveggeô taâkwazt is, tu$al d azrem n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Iḍeggeṛ taɛkwazt is, tuɣal d azrem n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⵡⴰⵣⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴷ ⴰⵣⵔⵎ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Issuffe$ ed afus is, d$a d amellal i imfeôoen,
latin_inalco: Issuffeɣ ed afus is, dɣa d amellal i imfeṛǧen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵍⵍⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴼⵕⴷⵊⵏ,

ayah_content: Inna i imvebbôen i s d izzin: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar amusnaw;
latin_inalco: Inna i imḍebbṛen i s d izzin: "wagi, s tidet, d aseḥḥar amusnaw;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴹⴱⴱⵕⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵣⵉⵏ: "ⵡⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ;

ayah_content: ib$a a kwen issuffe$, s ssêur is, seg wakal nnwen. D acu t lameô nnwen"?
latin_inalco: ibɣa a kwen issuffeɣ, s ssḥur is, seg wakal nnwen. D acu t lameṛ nnwen"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⴱⵖⴰ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ, ⵙ ⵙⵙⵃⵓⵔ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ"?

ayah_content: Nnan: "sgani t, neppa akked gma s; azen ineccaden ar temdinin,
latin_inalco: Nnan: "sgani t, netta akked gma s; azen ineccaden ar temdinin,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵙⴳⴰⵏⵉ ⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴳⵎⴰ ⵙ; ⴰⵣⵏ ⵉⵏⵛⵛⴰⴷⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: ad ak d awin yal aseêêar amusnaw".
latin_inalco: ad ak d awin yal aseḥḥar amusnaw".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ".

ayah_content: Mlalen iseêêaren, di lweqt akked wass ipwassnen.
latin_inalco: Mlalen iseḥḥaren, di lweqt akked wass itwassnen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵍⴰⵍⵏ ⵉⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⵡⵇⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan i imdanen: "ma ad tenjemâam?
latin_inalco: Nnan i imdanen: "ma ad tenjemɛam?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ: "ⵎⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵏⵊⵎⵄⴰⵎ?

ayah_content: Ahat a neddu d iseêêaren, ma d nitni ara irebêen".
latin_inalco: Ahat a neddu d iseḥḥaren, ma d nitni ara irebḥen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵀⴰⵜ ⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⵓ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ".

ayah_content: Mi d usan iseêêaren, nnan as i Ferâun: "ma ad a$ tili teqdiât, ma nerbeê"?
latin_inalco: Mi d usan iseḥḥaren, nnan as i Ferɛun: "ma ad aɣ tili teqdiɛt, ma nerbeḥ"?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔⵏ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵉ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ: "ⵎⴰ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⵎⴰ ⵏⵔⴱⵃ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "ih, d$a, kunwi, war ccekk, a ppu$alem seg iqôiben".
latin_inalco: Inna: "ih, dɣa, kunwi, war ccekk, a ttuɣalem seg iqṛiben".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵉⵀ, ⴷⵖⴰ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵇⵕⵉⴱⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna yasen Musa: "veggôet ayen ara tveggôem".
latin_inalco: Inna yasen Musa: "ḍeggṛet ayen ara tḍeggṛem".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ: "ⴹⴳⴳⵕⵜ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴹⴳⴳⵕⵎ".

ayah_content: Veggôen imraren akked tâakwzin nnsen. Nnan: "s tezmert n Ferâun, ard nekwni ara irebêen"!
latin_inalco: Ḍeggṛen imraren akked tɛakwzin nnsen. Nnan: "s tezmert n Ferɛun, ard nekwni ara irebḥen"!
Tifinagh: ⴹⴳⴳⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⵔⴰⵔⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵄⴰⴽⵡⵣⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵙ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ"!

ayah_content: Iveggeô Musa taâkwazt is. Apan tesseblaâ ayen id snulfan.
latin_inalco: Iḍeggeṛ Musa taɛkwazt is. Atan tesseblaɛ ayen id snulfan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⵡⴰⵣⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵜⵙⵙⴱⵍⴰⵄ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Iseêêaren $lin, knan.
latin_inalco: Iseḥḥaren ɣlin, knan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔⵏ ⵖⵍⵉⵏ, ⴽⵏⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "numen s Mass imavalen,
latin_inalco: Nnan: "numen s Mass imaḍalen,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⵓⵎⵏ ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ,

ayah_content: Mass n Musa akked Haôun".
latin_inalco: Mass n Musa akked Haṛun".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵀⴰⵕⵓⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "tumnem yiS, uqbel ma serrêe$ awen? Neppa, war ccekk, d ameqwôan nnwen i wen issêefven ssêur. A ppeéôem, ad awen gezme$ afus sya, avaô sya; a kwen ûûemôe$ akw $ef umidag".
latin_inalco: Inna: "tumnem yiS, uqbel ma serrḥeɣ awen? Netta, war ccekk, d ameqwṛan nnwen i wen issḥefḍen ssḥur. A tteẓṛem, ad awen gezmeɣ afus sya, aḍaṛ sya; a kwen ṣṣemṛeɣ akw ɣef umidag".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵜⵓⵎⵏⵎ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵎⴰ ⵙⵔⵔⵃⵖ ⴰⵡⵏ? ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵃⴼⴹⵏ ⵙⵙⵃⵓⵔ. ⴰ ⵜⵜⵥⵕⵎ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴳⵣⵎⵖ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⵙⵢⴰ, ⴰⴹⴰⵕ ⵙⵢⴰ; ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵚⵚⵎⵕⵖ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵖⴼ ⵓⵎⵉⴷⴰⴳ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "ulac u$ilif, acku ar Mass nne$, ara nezzi.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "ulac uɣilif, acku ar Mass nneɣ, ara nezzi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵓⵍⴰⵛ ⵓⵖⵉⵍⵉⴼ, ⴰⵛⴽⵓ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⵣⵣⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, nessaram ad Isemmeê, Mass nne$, tuccva nne$ imi aql a$ d lmumnin imenza".
latin_inalco: Ih, nessaram ad Isemmeḥ, Mass nneɣ, tuccḍa nneɣ imi aql aɣ d lmumnin imenza".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵙⵙⴰⵔⴰⵎ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵉⵎⵉ ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⵏⵣⴰ".

ayah_content: Nweêêa i Musa: "ôôuê s ugdud iW, deg iv, acku a kwen in vefôen".
latin_inalco: Nweḥḥa i Musa: "ṛṛuḥ s ugdud iW, deg iḍ, acku a kwen in ḍefṛen".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵉ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ: "ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵙ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ, ⴰⵛⴽⵓ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵏ ⴹⴼⵕⵏ".

ayah_content: Iuzen Ferâun ineccaden ar temdinin:
latin_inalco: Iuzen Ferɛun ineccaden ar temdinin:
Tifinagh: ⵉⵓⵣⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ ⵉⵏⵛⵛⴰⴷⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵉⵏ:

ayah_content: "wigi, s tidep, d arbaâ amejîuê,
latin_inalco: "wigi, s tidet, d arbaɛ amejṭuḥ,
Tifinagh: "ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⴰⵎⵊⵟⵓⵃ,

ayah_content: u nitni, s tidep, sserfan a$".
latin_inalco: u nitni, s tidet, sserfan aɣ".
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵙⵙⵔⴼⴰⵏ ⴰⵖ".

ayah_content: Nekwni, Neqquôa akken ma nella.
latin_inalco: Nekwni, Neqquṛa akken ma nella.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵏⵇⵇⵓⵕⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ.

ayah_content: Ihi, Nessuffe$ iten id si tebêirin akked tliwa;
latin_inalco: Ihi, Nessuffeɣ iten id si tebḥirin akked tliwa;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴱⵃⵉⵔⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ;

ayah_content: igerrujen, ixxamen ukyisen.
latin_inalco: igerrujen, ixxamen ukyisen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⵔⵔⵓⵊⵏ, ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Akka, nweôôet yissen, At Isôail.
latin_inalco: Akka, nweṛṛet yissen, At Isṛail.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵏⵡⵕⵕⵜ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ.

ayah_content: Vefôen ten mi d inqeô yiîij.
latin_inalco: Ḍefṛen ten mi d inqeṛ yiṭij.
Tifinagh: ⴹⴼⵕⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵎⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵇⵕ ⵢⵉⵟⵉⵊ.

ayah_content: Mi mwalan irebbuyaâ, nnan imeddukwal n Musa: "aql a$ a nepwalêeq".
latin_inalco: Mi mwalan irebbuyaɛ, nnan imeddukwal n Musa: "aql aɣ a netwalḥeq".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵎⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⵔⴱⴱⵓⵢⴰⵄ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴷⵓⴽⵡⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ: "ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ ⴰ ⵏⵜⵡⴰⵍⵃⵇ".

ayah_content: Inna: "xaîi! Mass iw, s tidep, yidi. Ad iyi Inhu".
latin_inalco: Inna: "xaṭi! Mass iw, s tidet, yidi. Ad iyi Inhu".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵢⵉⴷⵉ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵏⵀⵓ".

ayah_content: Nweêêa i Musa: "wwet ill s taâkwazt ik"! Imfaôaq, yal loiha am udrar ameqwôaêan.
latin_inalco: Nweḥḥa i Musa: "wwet ill s taɛkwazt ik"! Imfaṛaq, yal lǧiha am udrar ameqwṛaḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵉ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ: "ⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵍⵍ ⵙ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⵡⴰⵣⵜ ⵉⴽ"! ⵉⵎⴼⴰⵕⴰⵇ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵀⴰ ⴰⵎ ⵓⴷⵔⴰⵔ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nessqeôb ed wiyav ar dinna.
latin_inalco: Nessqeṛb ed wiyaḍ ar dinna.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⵇⵕⴱ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ ⴰⵔ ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ.

ayah_content: Nsellek Musa, akked wid akw iddan yides.
latin_inalco: Nsellek Musa, akked wid akw iddan yides.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ.

ayah_content: Sinna ne$ôeq wiyav.
latin_inalco: Sinna neɣṛeq wiyaḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵏⵖⵕⵇ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ.

ayah_content: Deg wayagi, s tidep, d assekni. Tegwti degsen ur uminen.
latin_inalco: Deg wayagi, s tidet, d assekni. Tegwti degsen ur uminen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵓⵎⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Eêku yasen d tamacahup n Ibôahim.
latin_inalco: Eḥku yasen d tamacahut n Ibṛahim.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵃⴽⵓ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⴰⵛⴰⵀⵓⵜ ⵏ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Mi inna i baba s akked ugdud is: "d acu tâabdem"?
latin_inalco: Mi inna i baba s akked ugdud is: "d acu tɛabdem"?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉ ⴱⴰⴱⴰ ⵙ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴷⵎ"?

ayah_content: Nnan: "naâbed tiâancuôin, mazal a tent njjem".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "naɛbed tiɛancuṛin, mazal a tent njjem".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⵜⵉⵄⴰⵏⵛⵓⵕⵉⵏ, ⵎⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⴰ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵏⵊⵊⵎ".

ayah_content: Inna: "day awen d sellent, ma tnujem?
latin_inalco: Inna: "day awen d sellent, ma tnujem?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵍⵍⵏⵜ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵏⵓⵊⵎ?

ayah_content: Ne$ nefâant kwen, ne$ vuôôent kwen"?
latin_inalco: Neɣ nefɛant kwen, neɣ ḍuṛṛent kwen"?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵏⴼⵄⴰⵏⵜ ⴽⵡⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴹⵓⵕⵕⵏⵜ ⴽⵡⵏ"?

ayah_content: Nnan: "xaîi, nufa d imezwura nne$, akka ay xeddmen".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "xaṭi, nufa d imezwura nneɣ, akka ay xeddmen".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵏⵓⴼⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "day twalam ayen la tâabdem,
latin_inalco: Inna: "day twalam ayen la tɛabdem,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴷⵎ,

ayah_content: kunwi akked lejdud nnwen imenza?
latin_inalco: kunwi akked lejdud nnwen imenza?
Tifinagh: ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵊⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵏⵣⴰ?

ayah_content: Nitni d icenga w. Siwa kan Mass imavalen,
latin_inalco: Nitni d icenga w. Siwa kan Mass imaḍalen,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵛⵏⴳⴰ ⵡ. ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ,

ayah_content: iyi Ixelqen; Neppa iyi Inhan;
latin_inalco: iyi Ixelqen; Netta iyi Inhan;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ; ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵏⵀⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: Neppa iyi Icceççan, iyi Isswan;
latin_inalco: Netta iyi Icceččan, iyi Isswan;
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵛⵛⵜⵜⵛⴰⵏ, ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵡⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: Neppa iyi Isseêluyen ma uvne$;
latin_inalco: Netta iyi Isseḥluyen ma uḍneɣ;
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵃⵍⵓⵢⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵓⴹⵏⵖ;

ayah_content: ara iyi In$en, sinna, ara iyi d Ssidren;
latin_inalco: ara iyi Inɣen, sinna, ara iyi d Ssidren;
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵏⵖⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵉⴷⵔⵏ;

ayah_content: u, ôe$be$, d Win ara Isemmêen tuccva w, ass iqeîîiyen.
latin_inalco: u, ṛeɣbeɣ, d Win ara Isemmḥen tuccḍa w, ass iqeṭṭiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵓ, ⵕⵖⴱⵖ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ ⵡ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: A Mass iw, £it iyi d, s ûûwab. Ssemlil iyi d iâaôviyen.
latin_inalco: A Mass iw, ɣit iyi d, s ṣṣwab. Ssemlil iyi d iɛaṛḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵖⵉⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ, ⵙ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ. ⵙⵙⵎⵍⵉⵍ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Err awal iw, d win n tidep, i ineggura.
latin_inalco: Err awal iw, d win n tidet, i ineggura.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵔⵔ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵡ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Err iyi si lweôôat n Loennet n ssuâada.
latin_inalco: Err iyi si lweṛṛat n Lǧennet n ssuɛada.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵔⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵙⵉ ⵍⵡⵕⵕⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵄⴰⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Semmeê i baba. Neppa, s tidep, illa seg im$eôôqen.
latin_inalco: Semmeḥ i baba. Netta, s tidet, illa seg imɣeṛṛqen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⵉ ⴱⴰⴱⴰ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur iyi Xezzu, ass n tnekra nnsen,
latin_inalco: Ur iyi Xezzu, ass n tnekra nnsen,
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵅⵣⵣⵓ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: ass ideg ur infaâ wayla, ne$ derya,
latin_inalco: ass ideg ur infaɛ wayla, neɣ derya,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⴼⴰⵄ ⵡⴰⵢⵍⴰ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⵔⵢⴰ,

ayah_content: siwa win iqublen Öebbi, s wul unûiê".
latin_inalco: siwa win iqublen Ṛebbi, s wul unṣiḥ".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵇⵓⴱⵍⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵡⵓⵍ ⵓⵏⵚⵉⵃ".

ayah_content: A d teppaé Loennet, ar wid ipêezziben.
latin_inalco: A d tettaẓ Lǧennet, ar wid itḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵥ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: A d innunnet ujajiê ar im$eôôqen.
latin_inalco: A d innunnet ujajiḥ ar imɣeṛṛqen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⵓⵏⵏⵜ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ ⴰⵔ ⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad asen inin: "anda ten wid tellam tâabdem,
latin_inalco: Ad asen inin: "anda ten wid tellam tɛabdem,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵜⵍⵍⴰⵎ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴷⵎ,

ayah_content: war Öebbi? Day a kwen ssellken, ne$ ad ssellken iman nnsen"?
latin_inalco: war Ṛebbi? Day a kwen ssellken, neɣ ad ssellken iman nnsen"?
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ"?

ayah_content: Ad pwagren degs, nitni, akked wid i$elîen,
latin_inalco: Ad twagren degs, nitni, akked wid iɣelṭen,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⴳⵔⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵖⵍⵟⵏ,

ayah_content: akked lâaskeô n Iblis, akken ma llan.
latin_inalco: akked lɛaskeṛ n Iblis, akken ma llan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵄⴰⵙⴽⵕ ⵏ ⵉⴱⵍⵉⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad inin; u nitni, degs, ppemqellaân:
latin_inalco: Ad inin; u nitni, degs, ttemqellaɛn:
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ; ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵜⵜⵎⵇⵍⵍⴰⵄⵏ:

ayah_content: "s Öebbi, ar nella di ttelfan n ûûeê,
latin_inalco: "s Ṛebbi, ar nella di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ,
Tifinagh: "ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ,

ayah_content: mi kwen nessaâdel ar Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: mi kwen nessaɛdel ar Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⴰⵄⴷⵍ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: D ibe$wviyen kan i a$ itelfen.
latin_inalco: D ibeɣwḍiyen kan i aɣ itelfen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵜⵍⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur nesâi imcafâen,
latin_inalco: Ur nesɛi imcafɛen,
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵄⵉ ⵉⵎⵛⴰⴼⵄⵏ,

ayah_content: ne$ aêbib i $ iêemmlen.
latin_inalco: neɣ aḥbib i ɣ iḥemmlen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰⵃⴱⵉⴱ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Lemmer ad as nales, a nili d lmumnin".
latin_inalco: Lemmer ad as nales, a nili d lmumnin".
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⴰⵍⵙ, ⴰ ⵏⵉⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ".

ayah_content: Deg wayagi, s tidep, assekni. Tegwti, degsen, ur uminen.
latin_inalco: Deg wayagi, s tidet, assekni. Tegwti, degsen, ur uminen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵓⵎⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Agdud n Nuê iskaddeb imazanen.
latin_inalco: Agdud n Nuḥ iskaddeb imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi sen inna gmat sen Nuê: "day ur tepêezzibem ara?
latin_inalco: Mi sen inna gmat sen Nuḥ: "day ur tetḥezzibem ara?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴳⵎⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Nek, $uôwen, d amazan muman.
latin_inalco: Nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiât iw, apan kan, ar Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ur awen ssutreɣ kra n teqdiɛt, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiɛt iw, atan kan, ar Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal".
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "day a k namen, mi ddan yidek imezwura n laâôuô"?
latin_inalco: Nnan: "day a k namen, mi ddan yidek imezwura n laɛṛuṛ"?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⴰⵎⵏ, ⵎⵉ ⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⴽ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵄⵕⵓⵕ"?

ayah_content: Inna: "ur éôi$ ayen xeddmen.
latin_inalco: Inna: "ur ẓṛiɣ ayen xeddmen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵓⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵖ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Aqeîîi nnsen $eô Mass iw kan, lemmer tessinem.
latin_inalco: Aqeṭṭi nnsen ɣeṛ Mass iw kan, lemmer tessinem.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵖⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵜⵙⵙⵉⵏⵎ.

ayah_content: Ur swexxiôe$, nek, lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Ur swexxiṛeɣ, nek, lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕⵖ, ⵏⴽ, ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Nek d aneddaô kan ipbeginnen".
latin_inalco: Nek d aneddaṛ kan itbeginnen".
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⵉⵏⵏⵏ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "ma ur tfukkev, a Nuê, war ccekk, a ppepwaôeomev".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "ma ur tfukkeḍ, a Nuḥ, war ccekk, a ttetwaṛeǧmeḍ".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⴼⵓⴽⴽⴹ, ⴰ ⵏⵓⵃ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵡⴰⵕⴷⵊⵎⴹ".

ayah_content: Inna: "a Mass iw! S tidep, inkeô iyi ugdud iw.
latin_inalco: Inna: "a Mass iw! S tidet, inkeṛ iyi ugdud iw.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵏⴽⵕ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ.

ayah_content: Seyyi ferru gari yidsen. Sellek a$, nek, akked lmumnin i illan yidi".
latin_inalco: Seyyi ferru gari yidsen. Sellek aɣ, nek, akked lmumnin i illan yidi".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵢⵢⵉ ⴼⵔⵔⵓ ⴳⴰⵔⵉ ⵢⵉⴷⵙⵏ. ⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⴰⵖ, ⵏⴽ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵉ".

ayah_content: Nsellek it, neppa, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô iççuôen.
latin_inalco: Nsellek it, netta, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuṛ iččuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴱⴰⴱⵓⵕ ⵉⵜⵜⵛⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, deffir waya, Ne$ves wid igwran.
latin_inalco: Sinna, deffir waya, Neɣḍes wid igwran.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵏⵖⴹⵙ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵔⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Deg wayagi, d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Deg wayagi, d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Âad skaddben imazanen.
latin_inalco: Ɛad skaddben imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⴷ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi sen inna gmat sen Hud: "day ur tepêezzibem ara?
latin_inalco: Mi sen inna gmat sen Hud: "day ur tetḥezzibem ara?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴳⵎⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵀⵓⴷ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Nek, $uôwen, d amazan muman.
latin_inalco: Nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiât iw, apan kan, ar Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ur awen ssutreɣ kra n teqdiɛt, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiɛt iw, atan kan, ar Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Day a tbennum, di yal ti$ilt, assekni i tfukal nnwen?
latin_inalco: Day a tbennum, di yal tiɣilt, assekni i tfukal nnwen?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⴱⵏⵏⵓⵎ, ⴷⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⵖⵉⵍⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵜⴼⵓⴽⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ?

ayah_content: La tepparam lebôuj, amar haat a pwekkôem.
latin_inalco: La tettaram lebṛuj, amar haat a twekkṛem.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰⵎ ⵍⴱⵕⵓⵊ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⵀⴰⴰⵜ ⴰ ⵜⵡⴽⴽⵕⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma tewwtem, tekkatem s leqseê.
latin_inalco: Ma tewwtem, tekkatem s leqseḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⵡⵜⵎ, ⵜⴽⴽⴰⵜⵎ ⵙ ⵍⵇⵙⵃ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ëezzbet i Win i wen Ifkan ayen teéôam.
latin_inalco: Ḥezzbet i Win i wen Ifkan ayen teẓṛam.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵥⵕⴰⵎ.

ayah_content: Ifka yawen lmal, tarwa,
latin_inalco: Ifka yawen lmal, tarwa,
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ, ⵜⴰⵔⵡⴰ,

ayah_content: tibêirin, tiliwa.
latin_inalco: tibḥirin, tiliwa.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴱⵃⵉⵔⵉⵏ, ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵡⴰ.

ayah_content: Nek, ugade$ aâaqeb fellawen, ass ameqwôaêan".
latin_inalco: Nek, ugadeɣ aɛaqeb fellawen, ass ameqwṛaḥan".
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵖ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "iaâdel $uône$ tnubav, ne$ ur tnubav.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "iaɛdel ɣuṛneɣ tnubaḍ, neɣ ur tnubaḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵉⴰⵄⴷⵍ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ ⵜⵏⵓⴱⴰⴹ, ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏⵓⴱⴰⴹ.

ayah_content: Ih, ayagi, siwa d asnulfu imezwura.
latin_inalco: Ih, ayagi, siwa d asnulfu imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⵓ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur nelli d wid ara ippuâaqben".
latin_inalco: Ur nelli d wid ara ittuɛaqben".
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱⵏ".

ayah_content: Nekôen t. Nesqucc iten. Deg wayagi d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Nekṛen t. Nesqucc iten. Deg wayagi d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵜ. ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⵉⵜⵏ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Tamud skaddben imazanen.
latin_inalco: Tamud skaddben imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi sen inna gmat sen ÛüÜaliê: "day ur tepêezzibem ara?
latin_inalco: Mi sen inna gmat sen ṢüÜaliḥ: "day ur tetḥezzibem ara?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴳⵎⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵚüÜⴰⵍⵉⵃ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Nek, $uôwen, d amazan muman.
latin_inalco: Nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiât iw, apan kan, ar Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ur awen ssutreɣ kra n teqdiɛt, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiɛt iw, atan kan, ar Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Day a kwen ooen, deg wayen illan dagi, testumnem?
latin_inalco: Day a kwen ǧǧen, deg wayen illan dagi, testumnem?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⴷⴷⵊⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴰⴳⵉ, ⵜⵙⵜⵓⵎⵏⵎ?

ayah_content: Di tebêirin akked tliwa,
latin_inalco: Di tebḥirin akked tliwa,
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⴱⵃⵉⵔⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ,

ayah_content: deg igran, tizdayin s ppemôa leqqaqen?
latin_inalco: deg igran, tizdayin s ttemṛa leqqaqen?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵔⴰⵏ, ⵜⵉⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵜⵎⵕⴰ ⵍⵇⵇⴰⵇⵏ?

ayah_content: La tneoôem, d ccaîôin, ixxamen deg idurar?
latin_inalco: La tneǧṛem, d ccaṭṛin, ixxamen deg idurar?
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰ ⵜⵏⴷⵊⵕⵎ, ⴷ ⵛⵛⴰⵟⵕⵉⵏ, ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ?

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ur ssemêaset i lameô iballa$en,
latin_inalco: Ur ssemḥaset i lameṛ iballaɣen,
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙⵜ ⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⴱⴰⵍⵍⴰⵖⵏ,

ayah_content: i issefsaden di tmurt, ur pleqqimen".
latin_inalco: i issefsaden di tmurt, ur tleqqimen".
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵙⴰⴷⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "keçç, aql ak kan, seg iôehbaniyen.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "kečč, aql ak kan, seg iṛehbaniyen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵕⵀⴱⴰⵏⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Keçç d amdan kan, am nekwni. Awi d assekni, ma d tidep ay tessawalev".
latin_inalco: Kečč d amdan kan, am nekwni. Awi d assekni, ma d tidet ay tessawaleḍ".
Tifinagh: ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ. ⴰⵡⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⴹ".

ayah_content: Inna: "tal$wemt agi, a ppessew deg wass is, kunwi a ppesswem deg wass nnwen.
latin_inalco: Inna: "talɣwemt agi, a ttessew deg wass is, kunwi a ttesswem deg wass nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵜⴰⵍⵖⵡⵎⵜ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⵙⵡ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⵙⵡⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: £uôwat a p tevvuôem, mulac a kwen iwwet uâaqeb, deg wass abarar".
latin_inalco: ɣuṛwat a t teḍḍuṛem, mulac a kwen iwwet uɛaqeb, deg wass abarar".
Tifinagh: ⵖⵓⵕⵡⴰⵜ ⴰ ⵜ ⵜⴹⴹⵓⵕⵎ, ⵎⵓⵍⴰⵛ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ".

ayah_content: Gezmen as tigwecrar, gwran d di nndama.
latin_inalco: Gezmen as tigwecrar, gwran d di nndama.
Tifinagh: ⴳⵣⵎⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵉⴳⵡⵛⵔⴰⵔ, ⴳⵡⵔⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴷⵉ ⵏⵏⴷⴰⵎⴰ.

ayah_content: Iwwet iten uâaqeb. Deg wayagi d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Iwwet iten uɛaqeb. Deg wayagi d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Agdud n Luî iskaddeb imazanen.
latin_inalco: Agdud n Luṭ iskaddeb imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵟ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi sen inna gmat sen ÛüLuî: "day ur tepêezzibem ara?
latin_inalco: Mi sen inna gmat sen ṢüLuṭ: "day ur tetḥezzibem ara?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴳⵎⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵚüⵍⵓⵟ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Nek, $uôwen, d amazan muman.
latin_inalco: Nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiât iw, apan kan, ar Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ur awen ssutreɣ kra n teqdiɛt, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiɛt iw, atan kan, ar Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Teppeddum ar ddkeô deg imavalen?
latin_inalco: Tetteddum ar ddkeṛ deg imaḍalen?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵜⵜⴷⴷⵓⵎ ⴰⵔ ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ?

ayah_content: Teooam tilawin i wen d Ixleq Mass nnwen? Ihi, kunwi d agdud izegren tilas".
latin_inalco: Teǧǧam tilawin i wen d Ixleq Mass nnwen? Ihi, kunwi d agdud izegren tilas".
Tifinagh: ⵜⴷⴷⵊⴰⵎ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ? ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵣⴳⵔⵏ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵙ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "ma ur tfukkev, a Luî, a k nenfu".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "ma ur tfukkeḍ, a Luṭ, a k nenfu".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⴼⵓⴽⴽⴹ, ⴰ ⵍⵓⵟ, ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⵏⴼⵓ".

ayah_content: Inna: "nek, seg wid ikeôhen igiten nnwen.
latin_inalco: Inna: "nek, seg wid ikeṛhen igiten nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⵕⵀⵏ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: A Mass iw, sellek iyi, nek akked twacult iw, seg igiten nnsen".
latin_inalco: A Mass iw, sellek iyi, nek akked twacult iw, seg igiten nnsen".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵢⵉ, ⵏⴽ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵡ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, meôôa,
latin_inalco: Nsellek it, netta akked twacult is, meṛṛa,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⵎⵕⵕⴰ,

ayah_content: siwa tam$aôt, ar wid igwran.
latin_inalco: siwa tamɣaṛt, ar wid igwran.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵖⴰⵕⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵔⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Nessenger wiyav.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Nessenger wiyaḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵙⵙⵏⴳⵔ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ.

ayah_content: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid ippunedôen!
latin_inalco: Nesseɣli d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid ittunedṛen!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ. ⵉ ⵉⵛⵎⵜ ⵓⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴷⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Deg wayagi d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Deg wayagi d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, Neppa, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, Netta, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Agdud n At Teégi iskaddeb imazanen.
latin_inalco: Agdud n At Teẓgi iskaddeb imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵥⴳⵉ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi sen inna Cuâayeb: "day ur tepêezzibem ara?
latin_inalco: Mi sen inna Cuɛayeb: "day ur tetḥezzibem ara?
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵛⵓⵄⴰⵢⴱ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Nek, $uôwen, d amazan muman.
latin_inalco: Nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiât iw, apan kan, ar Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ur awen ssutreɣ kra n teqdiɛt, ilmend n waya. Ih, taqdiɛt iw, atan kan, ar Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ktilet s lewqama; ur ppilit seg wid issenqasen.
latin_inalco: Ktilet s lewqama; ur ttilit seg wid issenqasen.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵜⵉⵍⵜ ⵙ ⵍⵡⵇⴰⵎⴰ; ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵇⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Weznet s lmizan uwqim.
latin_inalco: Weznet s lmizan uwqim.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵣⵏⵜ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Ur ccmatet i medden, ayla nnsen; ur ssexsaôet di tmurt s usefsed.
latin_inalco: Ur ccmatet i medden, ayla nnsen; ur ssexsaṛet di tmurt s usefsed.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵛⵛⵎⴰⵜⵜ ⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⴰⵢⵍⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵅⵙⴰⵕⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵙⴼⵙⴷ.

ayah_content: Ëezzbet i Win ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi akked isuta imenza".
latin_inalco: Ḥezzbet i Win ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi akked isuta imenza".
Tifinagh: ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵙⵓⵜⴰ ⵉⵎⵏⵣⴰ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "keçç, aql ak kan, seg iôehbaniyen.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "kečč, aql ak kan, seg iṛehbaniyen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵕⵀⴱⴰⵏⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Keçç, d amdan kan, am nekwni. Nêesb ik seg wid iskiddiben.
latin_inalco: Kečč, d amdan kan, am nekwni. Nḥesb ik seg wid iskiddiben.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ. ⵏⵃⵙⴱ ⵉⴽ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Sse$li d fellane$ igezman igenni, ma d tidep ay tessawalev".
latin_inalco: Sseɣli d fellaneɣ igezman igenni, ma d tidet ay tessawaleḍ".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵏⵖ ⵉⴳⵣⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⴹ".

ayah_content: Inna: "Mass iw Iéôa, sennig wiyav, ayen txeddmem".
latin_inalco: Inna: "Mass iw Iẓṛa, sennig wiyaḍ, ayen txeddmem".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ".

ayah_content: Skaddben t. Iwwet iten uâaqeb, deg wass n tillas. D aâaqeb, s tidep, n wass abarar.
latin_inalco: Skaddben t. Iwwet iten uɛaqeb, deg wass n tillas. D aɛaqeb, s tidet, n wass abarar.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵜ. ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⴷ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Deg wayagi, d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Deg wayagi, d assekni, war ccekk. Tegwti degsen, ur llin d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass ik, s tidep, ar Neppa d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Mass ik, s tidet, ar Netta d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ar wagi, war ccekk, d ayen id Issers Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ar wagi, war ccekk, d ayen id Issers Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Irs ed, yides, ôôuê n laman
latin_inalco: Irs ed, yides, ṛṛuḥ n laman
Tifinagh: ⵉⵔⵙ ⴷ, ⵢⵉⴷⵙ, ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ

ayah_content: $ef wul ik, iwakken a ppiliv seg wid inedôen,
latin_inalco: ɣef wul ik, iwakken a ttiliḍ seg wid inedṛen,
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⵡⵓⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⴹ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⴷⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: s umeslay aâôab ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: s umeslay aɛṛab itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵓⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢ ⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, deg Ihellilen imezwura.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, deg Ihellilen imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵀⵍⵍⵉⵍⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Day ur illi ara d assekni i nitni, mi t ssnen imusnawen n At Isôail?
latin_inalco: Day ur illi ara d assekni i nitni, mi t ssnen imusnawen n At Isṛail?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵎⵉ ⵜ ⵙⵙⵏⵏ ⵉⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ?

ayah_content: Lemmer it id Nessers, i yiwen seg ibeôôaniyen,
latin_inalco: Lemmer it id Nessers, i yiwen seg ibeṛṛaniyen,
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ, ⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴱⵕⵕⴰⵏⵉⵢⵏ,

ayah_content: u i$ôa yasen t, ur ppamnen yis.
latin_inalco: u iɣṛa yasen t, ur ttamnen yis.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵉⵖⵕⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵎⵏⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Akka, Nessawev it ar wulawen ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: Akka, Nessaweḍ it ar wulawen ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵏⵙⵙⴰⵡⴹ ⵉⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur ppamnen yis, alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Ur ttamnen yis, alamma walan aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵎⵏⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: A ten id ias, deqzalla, nitni ur bnin.
latin_inalco: A ten id ias, deqzalla, nitni ur bnin.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⴷⵇⵣⴰⵍⵍⴰ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad inin: "amendeô ma neggani"?
latin_inalco: Ad inin: "amendeṛ ma neggani"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰⵎⵏⴷⵕ ⵎⴰ ⵏⴳⴳⴰⵏⵉ"?

ayah_content: Day êaren s aâaqeb nne£?
latin_inalco: Day ḥaren s aɛaqeb nneɣ?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵃⴰⵔⵏ ⵙ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏⵏⵖ?

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara, N$at iten, d iseggwasen.
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara, Nɣat iten, d iseggwasen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵏⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⵙⴳⴳⵡⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, iusa ten id wayen i sen ippuwaââden.
latin_inalco: Sinna, iusa ten id wayen i sen ittuwaɛɛden.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ula i sen d ibbwi wayen is stumnen.
latin_inalco: Ula i sen d ibbwi wayen is stumnen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵍⴰ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵙⵜⵓⵎⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur Nesqucc tamdint, siwa tin isâan ineddaôen
latin_inalco: Ur Nesqucc tamdint, siwa tin isɛan ineddaṛen
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵉⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕⵏ

ayah_content: i usmekti. Ur Nelli d imednas.
latin_inalco: i usmekti. Ur Nelli d imednas.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Ur d risen yides ccwaîen.
latin_inalco: Ur d risen yides ccwaṭen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵔⵉⵙⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⵛⵛⵡⴰⵟⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur asen issefk, ur zmiren.
latin_inalco: Ur asen issefk, ur zmiren.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Nitni, s tidep, pwaâezlen $ef tmesliwt.
latin_inalco: Nitni, s tidet, twaɛezlen ɣef tmesliwt.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵜⵡⴰⵄⵣⵍⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⵙⵍⵉⵡⵜ.

ayah_content: Ur nâaô, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven. Mulac a ppiliv seg wid ara ippuâaqben.
latin_inalco: Ur nɛaṛ, ar tama n Ṛebbi, ṛebbi nniḍen. Mulac a ttiliḍ seg wid ara ittuɛaqben.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵄⴰⵕ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ. ⵎⵓⵍⴰⵛ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⴹ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Nabi llezm ik i k iqeôben mavi.
latin_inalco: Nabi llezm ik i k iqeṛben maḍi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴰⴱⵉ ⵍⵍⵣⵎ ⵉⴽ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵇⵕⴱⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ.

ayah_content: Ezger tacvaî ik $ef wi i k ivefôen si lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Ezger tacḍaṭ ik ɣef wi i k iḍefṛen si lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵣⴳⵔ ⵜⴰⵛⴹⴰⵟ ⵉⴽ ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴹⴼⵕⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma âuûan k, ini: "ur ppka$ deg wayen txeddmem".
latin_inalco: Ma ɛuṣan k, ini: "ur ttkaɣ deg wayen txeddmem".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵄⵓⵚⴰⵏ ⴽ, ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴽⴰⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ".

ayah_content: Ppkel $ef Uzmir Ipêunun.
latin_inalco: Ptkel ɣef Uzmir Itḥunun.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴽⵍ ⵖⴼ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: I k Ipwalin mara tbeddev,
latin_inalco: I k Itwalin mara tbeddeḍ,
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴱⴷⴷⴹ,

ayah_content: mara d tezziv ar wid iknan.
latin_inalco: mara d tezziḍ ar wid iknan.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵣⵣⵉⴹ ⴰⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⵏⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, Issel, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵙⵙⵍ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Ad awen mle$ anwi i$ef d prusun ccwaîen?
latin_inalco: Ad awen mleɣ anwi iɣef d trusun ccwaṭen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵎⵍⵖ ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⵉⵖⴼ ⴷ ⵜⵔⵓⵙⵓⵏ ⵛⵛⵡⴰⵟⵏ?

ayah_content: Prusun ed $ef yal akeddab idensen.
latin_inalco: Prusun ed ɣef yal akeddab idensen.
Tifinagh: Pⵔⵓⵙⵓⵏ ⴷ ⵖⴼ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ppaken tameééu$t. Tegwti degsen d ikeddaben.
latin_inalco: Ptaken tameẓẓuɣt. Tegwti degsen d ikeddaben.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴰⴽⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵥⵥⵓⵖⵜ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Imedyazen, îîafaôen ten im$eôôqen.
latin_inalco: Imedyazen, ṭṭafaṛen ten imɣeṛṛqen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵣⵏ, ⵟⵟⴰⴼⴰⵕⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara, ar nitni, di yal ta$zut pmenîaôen?
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara, ar nitni, di yal taɣzut tmenṭaṛen?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⴰⵖⵣⵓⵜ ⵜⵎⵏⵟⴰⵕⵏ?

ayah_content: U nitni qqaôen ayen ur xeddmen.
latin_inalco: U nitni qqaṛen ayen ur xeddmen.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id ismektayen aîas Öebbi, i irebêen mbaâd ma pwadensen. Ad éôen, wid idensen, tama anida ara ppin.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id ismektayen aṭas Ṛebbi, i irebḥen mbaɛd ma twadensen. Ad ẓṛen, wid idensen, tama anida ara ttin.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ ⵎⴱⴰⵄⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⴰⵎⴰ ⴰⵏⵉⴷⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ïs. Atnan issekniyen n Leqwôan, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Ṭs. Atnan issekniyen n Leqwṛan, akked Tezmamt itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵟⵙ. ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: D nnhaya u d abecceô i lmumnin:
latin_inalco: D nnhaya u d abecceṛ i lmumnin:
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵓ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ:

ayah_content: wid ibedden i téallit, ippaken zzakat, ipputebbten $ef laxeôt nnsen.
latin_inalco: wid ibedden i tẓallit, ittaken zzakat, ittutebbten ɣef laxeṛt nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴱⴷⴷⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽⵏ ⵣⵣⴰⴽⴰⵜ, ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Ncebbeê asen igiten nnsen, d$a ddebdeben.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, Ncebbeḥ asen igiten nnsen, dɣa ddebdeben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⵏⵛⴱⴱⵃ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴷⴷⴱⴷⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Widak, fellasen aâaqeb ucmit mavi. Di laxeôt, d nitni ara ixesôen ugwar.
latin_inalco: Widak, fellasen aɛaqeb ucmit maḍi. Di laxeṛt, d nitni ara ixesṛen ugwar.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ. ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵅⵙⵕⵏ ⵓⴳⵡⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: S tidep, keçç iusa k id Leqwôan, s$uô Bab n ûûwab, Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: S tidet, kečč iusa k id Leqwṛan, sɣuṛ Bab n ṣṣwab, Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Mi inna Musa i twacult is: "nek wala$ times, ad awen d awi$, segs, asali, ne$ ad awen d awi$ asafu iôeqqen, amar a ppesseêmum".
latin_inalco: Mi inna Musa i twacult is: "nek walaɣ times, ad awen d awiɣ, segs, asali, neɣ ad awen d awiɣ asafu iṛeqqen, amar a ttesseḥmum".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ ⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⴽ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵖ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵡⵉⵖ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⴰⵙⴰⵍⵉ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵡⵉⵖ ⴰⵙⴰⴼⵓ ⵉⵕⵇⵇⵏ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⵙⵃⵎⵓⵎ".

ayah_content: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced: "ad iôqu wayen illan di tmes, akked wayen i as d izzin. Gedha s Öebbi, Mass imavalen!
latin_inalco: Mi ibbweḍ ɣuṛes, itwanced: "ad iṛqu wayen illan di tmes, akked wayen i as d izzin. Gedha s Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen!
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⴹ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷ: "ⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⵇⵓ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⴰⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵣⵉⵏ. ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ!

ayah_content: A Musa! Ih, Nek d Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: A Musa! Ih, Nek d Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ! ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Veggeô taâkwazt ik"! Mi p iwala la tesseêôiîiw, amzun d azrem, ibren, ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Ur ppagwad! Ar $uôI, ih, ur ppagwaden imazanen,
latin_inalco: Ḍeggeṛ taɛkwazt ik"! Mi t iwala la tesseḥṛiṭiw, amzun d azrem, ibren, ur iwexxeṛ. "A Musa! Ur ttagwad! Ar ɣuṛI, ih, ur ttagwaden imazanen,
Tifinagh: ⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⵡⴰⵣⵜ ⵉⴽ"! ⵎⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⴰ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵙⵙⵃⵕⵉⵟⵉⵡ, ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵣⵔⵎ, ⵉⴱⵔⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕ. "ⴰ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ! ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷ! ⴰⵔ ⵖⵓⵕⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ,

ayah_content: siwa win idensen, sinna, iu$al iwqem, deffir tuccva. Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$, Pêunnu$.
latin_inalco: siwa win idensen, sinna, iuɣal iwqem, deffir tuccḍa. Nek, s tidet, Psemmiḥeɣ, Pḥunnuɣ.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⵉⵡⵇⵎ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ. ⵏⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, Pⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵖ, Pⵃⵓⵏⵏⵓⵖ.

ayah_content: Ger afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Si tza issekniyen, i Ferâun akked ugdud is. Nitni, war ccekk, d agdud icemten".
latin_inalco: Ger afus ik di lǧib ik, a d iffeɣ d amellal, ur ihlik. Si tza issekniyen, i Ferɛun akked ugdud is. Nitni, war ccekk, d agdud icemten".
Tifinagh: ⴳⵔ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⴱ ⵉⴽ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵍⵍⴰⵍ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵀⵍⵉⴽ. ⵙⵉ ⵜⵣⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ, ⵉ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵛⵎⵜⵏ".

ayah_content: Mi ten id usan issekniyen nne£, âinani, nnan: "wagi iban d ssêur".
latin_inalco: Mi ten id usan issekniyen nneɣ, ɛinani, nnan: "wagi iban d ssḥur".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵄⵉⵏⴰⵏⵉ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⵉⴱⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵃⵓⵔ".

ayah_content: Ugin ten s ddens d pnefxa, u, deg iman nnsen, pputebbten. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d ifessaden.
latin_inalco: Ugin ten s ddens d tnefxa, u, deg iman nnsen, ttutebbten. Wali, ihi, amek teḍṛa d ifessaden.
Tifinagh: ⵓⴳⵉⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵙ ⴷⴷⵏⵙ ⴷ ⵜⵏⴼⵅⴰ, ⵓ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ. ⵡⴰⵍⵉ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⴹⵕⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴼⵙⵙⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka tamusni i Dawed akked Sliman. Nnan: "ccekôan i Öebbi, i a$ Ismenyafen i waîaû n yimdanen iumnen".
