Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Day la tepnujum $eô Baâla, a ppeooem Üûam ixellaqen,
latin_inalco: Day la tetnujum ɣeṛ Baɛla, a tteǧǧem Üṣam ixellaqen,
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓⵎ ⵖⵕ ⴱⴰⵄⵍⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⴷⴷⵊⵎ Üⵚⴰⵎ ⵉⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇⵏ,

ayah_content: Öebbi, Mass nnwen, Mass n lejdud nnwen imezwura"?
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen, Mass n lejdud nnwen imezwura"?
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵍⵊⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ"?

ayah_content: Skaddben t. S tidep, nitni a d rsen,
latin_inalco: Skaddben t. S tidet, nitni a d rsen,
Tifinagh: ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵜ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰ ⴷ ⵔⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: kkes ed imdanen n Öebbi, izedganen.
latin_inalco: kkes ed imdanen n Ṛebbi, izedganen.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Neooa d fellas, i ineggura:
latin_inalco: Neǧǧa d fellas, i ineggura:
Tifinagh: ⵏⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⴷ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵉ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ:

ayah_content: "talwit i Ilyas"!
latin_inalco: "talwit i Ilyas"!
Tifinagh: "ⵜⴰⵍⵡⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵢⴰⵙ"!

ayah_content: Akka, ih, ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen.
latin_inalco: Akka, ih, ay Netkafi iɛaṛḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵢ ⵏⵜⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, seg imdanen nne£ iumnen.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, seg imdanen nneɣ iumnen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, Luî seg imazanen.
latin_inalco: Ih, Luṭ seg imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵍⵓⵟ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi t Nsellek, akked twacult is, s lekmal is,
latin_inalco: Mi t Nsellek, akked twacult is, s lekmal is,
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜ ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⵙ ⵍⴽⵎⴰⵍ ⵉⵙ,

ayah_content: siwa tam$aôt, seg wid igwran.
latin_inalco: siwa tamɣaṛt, seg wid igwran.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵖⴰⵕⵜ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵔⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Nemêa wiyav.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Nemḥa wiyaḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵎⵃⴰ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ.

ayah_content: Aql akwen la tleêêum fellasen, deg uzal,
latin_inalco: Aql akwen la tleḥḥum fellasen, deg uzal,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽⵡⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵍⵃⵃⵓⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵣⴰⵍ,

ayah_content: deg yiv. Day ur tepmeyyizem ara?
latin_inalco: deg yiḍ. Day ur tetmeyyizem ara?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵢⵉⴹ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵎⵢⵢⵉⵣⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Ih, Yunes ar seg imazanen.
latin_inalco: Ih, Yunes ar seg imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵢⵓⵏⵙ ⴰⵔ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi irwel ar sfina iççuôen.
latin_inalco: Mi irwel ar sfina iččuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵔⵡⵍ ⴰⵔ ⵙⴼⵉⵏⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵛⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ijbed taseqqaôt, iûbeê ed seg wid ipwaveggôen.
latin_inalco: Ijbed taseqqaṛt, iṣbeḥ ed seg wid itwaḍeggṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵊⴱⴷ ⵜⴰⵙⵇⵇⴰⵕⵜ, ⵉⵚⴱⵃ ⴷ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴹⴳⴳⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Isseblaâ it uslem, u neppa degs tiyta.
latin_inalco: Isseblaɛ it uslem, u netta degs tiyta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⴱⵍⴰⵄ ⵉⵜ ⵓⵙⵍⵎ, ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Lemmer ur illi, neppa, seg wid isbuccuâen,
latin_inalco: Lemmer ur illi, netta, seg wid isbuccuɛen,
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ,

ayah_content: ad iqqim deg uâabbuv is, ar ass n tu$alin nnsen.
latin_inalco: ad iqqim deg uɛabbuḍ is, ar ass n tuɣalin nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵇⵇⵉⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⴱⴱⵓⴹ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵔ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Nveggeô it id, s aqeôqaô, d amuvin,
latin_inalco: Nḍeggeṛ it id, s aqeṛqaṛ, d amuḍin,
Tifinagh: ⵏⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵙ ⴰⵇⵕⵇⴰⵕ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⴹⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: Nessenker ed $uôes, ttejôa n texsayt.
latin_inalco: Nessenker ed ɣuṛes, ttejṛa n texsayt.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⵏⴽⵔ ⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵜⵜⵊⵕⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵅⵙⴰⵢⵜ.

ayah_content: Nuzen it ar twinas igima, uger.
latin_inalco: Nuzen it ar twinas igima, uger.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⵉⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵡⵉⵏⴰⵙ ⵉⴳⵉⵎⴰ, ⵓⴳⵔ.

ayah_content: Umnen. Neooa ten zzhan kan tallit.
latin_inalco: Umnen. Neǧǧa ten zzhan kan tallit.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵎⵏⵏ. ⵏⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵣⵣⵀⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Steqsi ten maday, i Mass ik, tullas; i nitni, arrac?
latin_inalco: Steqsi ten maday, i Mass ik, tullas; i nitni, arrac?
Tifinagh: ⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵎⴰⴷⴰⵢ, ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵜⵓⵍⵍⴰⵙ; ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵛ?

ayah_content: Ne$ Nexleq lmalayek d nnta, nitni d inagan.
latin_inalco: Neɣ Nexleq lmalayek d nnta, nitni d inagan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Day, s tkerkas nnsen, ihi, a d inin:
latin_inalco: Day, s tkerkas nnsen, ihi, a d inin:
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ, ⵙ ⵜⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ:

ayah_content: "Iurew ed Öebbi"? Nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.
latin_inalco: "Iurew ed Ṛebbi"? Nitni, s tidet, d ikeddaben.
Tifinagh: "ⵉⵓⵔⵡ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ"? ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ismenyaf tullas i warrac!
latin_inalco: Ismenyaf tullas i warrac!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼ ⵜⵓⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵛ!

ayah_content: Acu ikwen iu$en? Amek tepêuddum?
latin_inalco: Acu ikwen iuɣen? Amek tetḥuddum?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ? ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⵜⵃⵓⴷⴷⵓⵎ?

ayah_content: Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
latin_inalco: Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Ne$ tesâam adabu n ûûeê?
latin_inalco: Neɣ tesɛam adabu n ṣṣeḥ?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵜⵙⵄⴰⵎ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ?

ayah_content: Aset ed s tezmamt nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep!
latin_inalco: Aset ed s tezmamt nnwen, ma tessawalem tidet!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵜ ⴷ ⵙ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵎ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ!

ayah_content: Gren d nnesba garaS d leonun. Irna leonun éôan ara d rsen.
latin_inalco: Gren d nnesba garaS d leǧnun. Irna leǧnun ẓṛan ara d rsen.
Tifinagh: ⴳⵔⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⴱⴰ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙ ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ. ⵉⵔⵏⴰ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ ⵥⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵔⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Gedha s Öebbi, mgal ayen qqaôen!
latin_inalco: Gedha s Ṛebbi, mgal ayen qqaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Kkes ed imdanen n Öebbi izedganen.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed imdanen n Ṛebbi izedganen.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, kunwi, akked wayen tâabdem,
latin_inalco: Ihi, kunwi, akked wayen tɛabdem,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴷⵎ,

ayah_content: ur d tesskarem ahewwel, mgal iS;
latin_inalco: ur d tesskarem ahewwel, mgal iS;
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵙⵙⴽⴰⵔⵎ ⴰⵀⵡⵡⵍ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵉⵙ;

ayah_content: siwa win ara iô$en di tmes.
latin_inalco: siwa win ara iṛɣen di tmes.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵕⵖⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ.

ayah_content: Ur illi yiwen, degne$, ur nesâi amekkan ipwassnen.
latin_inalco: Ur illi yiwen, degneɣ, ur nesɛi amekkan itwassnen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴷⴳⵏⵖ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵄⵉ ⴰⵎⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, nekwni d leûfuf.
latin_inalco: Ih, nekwni d leṣfuf.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵍⵚⴼⵓⴼ.

ayah_content: Ih, nekwni d wid i isbuccuâen.
latin_inalco: Ih, nekwni d wid i isbuccuɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵉⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Llan la qqaôen:
latin_inalco: Llan la qqaṛen:
Tifinagh: ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ:

ayah_content: "lemmer day $uône$ asmekti seg imezwura,
latin_inalco: "lemmer day ɣuṛneɣ asmekti seg imezwura,
Tifinagh: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴷⴰⵢ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ,

ayah_content: a nili, war ccekk, d imdanen iâaôviyen n Öebbi".
latin_inalco: a nili, war ccekk, d imdanen iɛaṛḍiyen n Ṛebbi".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵏⵉⵍⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ".

ayah_content: Nekôen T. Deqqal ad éôen.
latin_inalco: Nekṛen T. Deqqal ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵜ. ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, izwar ed wawal nne£, i imdanen nne£ imazanen.
latin_inalco: Ih, izwar ed wawal nneɣ, i imdanen nneɣ imazanen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, d nitni ara ipwasellken.
latin_inalco: Ih, d nitni ara itwasellken.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: S tidep, d iâsekôiwen nne£, ara irebêen.
latin_inalco: S tidet, d iɛsekṛiwen nneɣ, ara irebḥen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵄⵙⴽⵕⵉⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, îîixeô asen kra n tallit.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ṭṭixeṛ asen kra n tallit.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵟⵟⵉⵅⵕ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Ssiked iten, deqqal ad walin.
latin_inalco: Ssiked iten, deqqal ad walin.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵙⵉⴽⴷ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Day êaren af uâaqeb nne£?
latin_inalco: Day ḥaren af uɛaqeb nneɣ?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵃⴰⵔⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏⵏⵖ?

ayah_content: Ma irs ed ar umekkan nnsen, ay dir ip tûebêit n wid ippunedôen!
latin_inalco: Ma irs ed ar umekkan nnsen, ay dir it tṣebḥit n wid ittunedṛen!
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵔⵙ ⴷ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵎⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵢ ⴷⵉⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵜⵚⴱⵃⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴷⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Ïîixeô asen kra n tallit.
latin_inalco: Ṭṭixeṛ asen kra n tallit.
Tifinagh: ⵟⵟⵉⵅⵕ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Ssiked, deqqal ad walin.
latin_inalco: Ssiked, deqqal ad walin.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵙⵉⴽⴷ, ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Gedha s Mass ik, Mass n tezmert, mgal ayen qqaôen.
latin_inalco: Gedha s Mass ik, Mass n tezmert, mgal ayen qqaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Tifrat $ef imazanen!
latin_inalco: Tifrat ɣef imazanen!
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ!

ayah_content: Ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ü. S Leqwôan id ismektayen!
latin_inalco: Ü. S Leqwṛan id ismektayen!
Tifinagh: Ü. ⵙ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ!

ayah_content: Xaîi, wid ijehlen, atnan di tem$weô d ticuîna.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi, wid ijehlen, atnan di temɣweṛ d ticuṭna.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵖⵡⵕ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵛⵓⵟⵏⴰ.

ayah_content: Acêal isuta ay Nesqucc, uqbel nnsen! Ssawlen d. Ur mazal akud i leslak.
latin_inalco: Acḥal isuta ay Nesqucc, uqbel nnsen! Ssawlen d. Ur mazal akud i leslak.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵃⴰⵍ ⵉⵙⵓⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ! ⵙⵙⴰⵡⵍⵏ ⴷ. ⵓⵔ ⵎⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⵓⴷ ⵉ ⵍⵙⵍⴰⴽ.

ayah_content: Wehmen, iusa ten id uneddaô segsen. Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi d aseêêar, d akeddab.
latin_inalco: Wehmen, iusa ten id uneddaṛ segsen. Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi d aseḥḥar, d akeddab.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵀⵎⵏ, ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ: "ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔ, ⴷ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Aâni ad irr iôebbiten, d Öebbi Yiwen? Ayagi d ayen issewhamen".
latin_inalco: Aɛni ad irr iṛebbiten, d Ṛebbi Yiwen? Ayagi d ayen issewhamen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ, ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ? ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵡⵀⴰⵎⵏ".

ayah_content: Kkren imeqwôanen segsen, nnan: "elêut, illit d imezgiyen ar iôebbiten nnwen. Ayagi, d ayen iwatan.
latin_inalco: Kkren imeqwṛanen segsen, nnan: "elḥut, illit d imezgiyen ar iṛebbiten nnwen. Ayagi, d ayen iwatan.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵔⵏ ⵉⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏⵏ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵍⵃⵓⵜ, ⵉⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉⵢⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur nesli i waya, di ddin aneggaru. Ihi, aya, siwa asnulfu.
latin_inalco: Ur nesli i waya, di ddin aneggaru. Ihi, aya, siwa asnulfu.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵍⵉ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⴰⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔⵓ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⵓ.

ayah_content: Day, garane$, d neppa iwumi d irs usmekti"? Xaîi, nitni di ccekk, $ef usmekti W, mazal ur jeôôben ara aâaqeb iW.
latin_inalco: Day, garaneɣ, d netta iwumi d irs usmekti"? Xaṭi, nitni di ccekk, ɣef usmekti W, mazal ur jeṛṛben ara aɛaqeb iW.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ, ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ, ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵙ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ"? ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵖⴼ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵡ, ⵎⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⵓⵔ ⵊⵕⵕⴱⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵡ.

ayah_content: Ne$ sâan lexzayen uêunu n Mass ik, Uzmir, A$eyyat?
latin_inalco: Neɣ sɛan lexzayen uḥunu n Mass ik, Uzmir, Aɣeyyat?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵍⵅⵣⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵖⵢⵢⴰⵜ?

ayah_content: Ne$, nnsen tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen? Anef ad alin ihi, s imraren!
latin_inalco: Neɣ, nnsen tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen? Anef ad alin ihi, s imraren!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ, ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ? ⴰⵏⴼ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵙ ⵉⵎⵔⴰⵔⵏ!

ayah_content: Nitni siwa d iâeskôiwen imexsuôen, seg ikabaren.
latin_inalco: Nitni siwa d iɛeskṛiwen imexsuṛen, seg ikabaren.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵄⵙⴽⵕⵉⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Zwaren ten id, ar uskiddeb, agdud n Nuê, Âad, Ferâun bu ibudiden,
latin_inalco: Zwaren ten id, ar uskiddeb, agdud n Nuḥ, Ɛad, Ferɛun bu ibudiden,
Tifinagh: ⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱ, ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ, ⵄⴰⴷ, ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ ⴱⵓ ⵉⴱⵓⴷⵉⴷⵏ,

ayah_content: Tamud, agdud n Luî, At Laika; d widak ay d ikabaren.
latin_inalco: Tamud, agdud n Luṭ, At Laika; d widak ay d ikabaren.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ, ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵟ, ⴰⵜ ⵍⴰⵉⴽⴰ; ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Akw, skaddben imazanen, ihi, iwata uâaqeb iW.
latin_inalco: Akw, skaddben imazanen, ihi, iwata uɛaqeb iW.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⵡ, ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵡ.

ayah_content: Wigi, ad gganin kan ti$ôi yiwet, ur as ippili wallus.
latin_inalco: Wigi, ad gganin kan tiɣṛi yiwet, ur as ittili wallus.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⴳⴳⴰⵏⵉⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⵉⵖⵕⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵓⵙ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! £iwwel ane$ deg umur nne$, uqbel ass iqeîîiyen".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! ɣiwwel aneɣ deg umur nneɣ, uqbel ass iqeṭṭiyen".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵖⵉⵡⵡⵍ ⴰⵏⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⵓⵔ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ".

ayah_content: Eûbeô i wayen d qqaôen. Mmekti d amdan nne£ Dawed, bab n tezmert. Ih, Neppa ippales.
latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ i wayen d qqaṛen. Mmekti d amdan nneɣ Dawed, bab n tezmert. Ih, Netta ittales.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ. ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴷⴰⵡⴷ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵍⵙ.

ayah_content: Ih, Nêeppem i idurar ad sbuccuâen yides, tameddit, tafara.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nḥettem i idurar ad sbuccuɛen yides, tameddit, tafara.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵃⵜⵜⵎ ⵉ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ, ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ, ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ifôax mlalen. Akw, i Neppa, ppalsen.
latin_inalco: Ifṛax mlalen. Akw, i Netta, ttalsen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⵕⴰⵅ ⵎⵍⴰⵍⵏ. ⴰⴽⵡ, ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵜⵜⴰⵍⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Nesseohed tagelda s, Nefka ias ûûwab, awal iqaâden.
latin_inalco: Nesseǧhed tagelda s, Nefka ias ṣṣwab, awal iqaɛden.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⴷⵊⵀⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵙ, ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵇⴰⵄⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma ibbwev ik id usali n yixûimen, mi ulin ar tmezgida?
latin_inalco: Ma ibbweḍ ik id usali n yixṣimen, mi ulin ar tmezgida?
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⴹ ⵉⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵅⵚⵉⵎⵏ, ⵎⵉ ⵓⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵣⴳⵉⴷⴰ?

ayah_content: Mi kecmen ar Dawed, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ppagwad, d sin ixûimen, yiwen degne$, ijuô $ef wayev. Eêkem garane$ s tidep, war taneêyaft. Enhu ya$ s abrid umâin.
latin_inalco: Mi kecmen ar Dawed, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ttagwad, d sin ixṣimen, yiwen degneɣ, ijuṛ ɣef wayeḍ. Eḥkem garaneɣ s tidet, war taneḥyaft. Enhu yaɣ s abrid umɛin.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⴰⵔ ⴷⴰⵡⴷ, ⵉⵓⴳⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵏ. ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷ, ⴷ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⵚⵉⵎⵏ, ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴷⴳⵏⵖ, ⵉⵊⵓⵕ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⴹ. ⵃⴽⵎ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵏⵃⵢⴰⴼⵜ. ⵏⵀⵓ ⵢⴰⵖ ⵙ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, gma yagi, isâa tza u tzat n wulli, nek tixsi yiwet. Inna yi d: kwellef iyi p. Irna yi s wawal".
latin_inalco: Ihi, gma yagi, isɛa tza u tzat n wulli, nek tixsi yiwet. Inna yi d: kwellef iyi t. Irna yi s wawal".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴳⵎⴰ ⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵙⵄⴰ ⵜⵣⴰ ⵓ ⵜⵣⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵡⵓⵍⵍⵉ, ⵏⴽ ⵜⵉⵅⵙⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵜ. ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵢⵉ ⴷ: ⴽⵡⵍⵍⴼ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜ. ⵉⵔⵏⴰ ⵢⵉ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ".

ayah_content: Inna: "ni$ idens ik s usuter n texsi inek, a p irnu ar wulli ines. Aîas n yicriken i ippemjuôen, siwa wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, drus nnsen ay llan". Ifhem Dawed Njeôôeb it kan; iste$feô Mass is, i$li, iîîanez, indem.
latin_inalco: Inna: "niɣ idens ik s usuter n texsi inek, a t irnu ar wulli ines. Aṭas n yicriken i ittemjuṛen, siwa wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, drus nnsen ay llan". Ifhem Dawed Njeṛṛeb it kan; isteɣfeṛ Mass is, iɣli, iṭṭanez, indem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⴷⵏⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵙ ⵓⵙⵓⵜⵔ ⵏ ⵜⵅⵙⵉ ⵉⵏⴽ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵔⵏⵓ ⴰⵔ ⵡⵓⵍⵍⵉ ⵉⵏⵙ. ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵛⵔⵉⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⵎⵊⵓⵕⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴷⵔⵓⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ". ⵉⴼⵀⵎ ⴷⴰⵡⴷ ⵏⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵉⵜ ⴽⴰⵏ; ⵉⵙⵜⵖⴼⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵖⵍⵉ, ⵉⵟⵟⴰⵏⵣ, ⵉⵏⴷⵎ.

ayah_content: Nsemmeê as ayagi. Ih, i neppa, $uône£, amkan n tu$alin aqôib, umâin.
latin_inalco: Nsemmeḥ as ayagi. Ih, i netta, ɣuṛneɣ, amkan n tuɣalin aqṛib, umɛin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⴰⵙ ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵇⵕⵉⴱ, ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: A Dawed, Nerra k, ih, d agensas di tmurt. Ëudd ger imdanen s tidep, ur îîafaô lhawiyya, a k tetlef seg ubrid n Öebbi. Ihi, wid innetlafen seg ubrid n Öebbi, fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê, imi ppun ass iqeîîiyen.
latin_inalco: A Dawed, Nerra k, ih, d agensas di tmurt. Ḥudd ger imdanen s tidet, ur ṭṭafaṛ lhawiyya, a k tetlef seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ihi, wid innetlafen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi, fellasen aɛaqeb uqsiḥ, imi ttun ass iqeṭṭiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷⴰⵡⴷ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴽ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⴰⴳⵏⵙⴰⵙ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⵔ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵟⵟⴰⴼⴰⵕ ⵍⵀⴰⵡⵉⵢⵢⴰ, ⴰ ⴽ ⵜⵜⵍⴼ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ, ⵉⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵓⵏ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di rrayaâ, akken nwan wid ijehlen. A tawa$it n tmes, i wid ijehlen!
latin_inalco: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di rrayaɛ, akken nwan wid ijehlen. A tawaɣit n tmes, i wid ijehlen!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵅⵍⵉⵇ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵔⵔⴰⵢⴰⵄ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ. ⴰ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ!

ayah_content: Day a Nerr wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, am wid issefsaden di ddunit? Ne$ a Nerr wid ipêezziben am laâôuô?
latin_inalco: Day a Nerr wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, am wid issefsaden di ddunit? Neɣ a Nerr wid itḥezziben am laɛṛuṛ?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵏⵔⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵙⴰⴷⵏ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ? ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⵏⵔⵔ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ ⴰⵎ ⵍⴰⵄⵕⵓⵕ?

ayah_content: Tazmamt Nessers ak p id, teôqa, iwakken ad meyyzen issekniyen is, a d mmektin uâqilen.
latin_inalco: Tazmamt Nessers ak t id, teṛqa, iwakken ad meyyzen issekniyen is, a d mmektin uɛqilen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴰⴽ ⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵜⵕⵇⴰ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵎⵢⵢⵣⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: N$at Dawed s Sliman, amdan ukiys ippalsen.
latin_inalco: Nɣat Dawed s Sliman, amdan ukiys ittalsen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖⴰⵜ ⴷⴰⵡⴷ ⵙ ⵙⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵓⴽⵉⵢⵙ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵍⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi s d sseknen, tameddit, tigmarin lâali,
latin_inalco: Mi s d sseknen, tameddit, tigmarin lɛali,
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵙⵙⴽⵏⵏ, ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ, ⵜⵉⴳⵎⴰⵔⵉⵏ ⵍⵄⴰⵍⵉ,

ayah_content: inna: "nek, smenyafe$ tayri n wayla, i usmekti n Mass iw, armi sberbren fellasent.
latin_inalco: inna: "nek, smenyafeɣ tayri n wayla, i usmekti n Mass iw, armi sberbren fellasent.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵖ ⵜⴰⵢⵔⵉ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵍⴰ, ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵙⴱⵔⴱⵔⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Erret pent id $uôi". Igezm asent ivaôen, timegrav.
latin_inalco: Erret tent id ɣuṛi". Igezm asent iḍaṛen, timegraḍ.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵔⵔⵜ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⵉ". ⵉⴳⵣⵎ ⴰⵙⵏⵜ ⵉⴹⴰⵕⵏ, ⵜⵉⵎⴳⵔⴰⴹ.

ayah_content: Ni$, Njeôôeb Sliman; Nessers loeppa af usgeld is. Iu$al indem.
latin_inalco: Niɣ, Njeṛṛeb Sliman; Nessers lǧetta af usgeld is. Iuɣal indem.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ, ⵏⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵙⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ; ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵍⴷⵊⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⴼ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⵉⵏⴷⵎ.

ayah_content: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeê iyi, £it iyi s tgelda ur nepûaê yiwen, deffir i. S tidep, Keçç d A$iyyat".
latin_inalco: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeḥ iyi, ɣit iyi s tgelda ur netṣaḥ yiwen, deffir i. S tidet, Kečč d Aɣiyyat".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⵉⵢⵉ, ⵖⵉⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵙ ⵜⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵚⴰⵃ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵉ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴷ ⴰⵖⵉⵢⵢⴰⵜ".

ayah_content: Nenub fellas s wavu. Ipûuvu, s lameô is, d abeêri, s anda i s ihwa.
latin_inalco: Nenub fellas s waḍu. Itṣuḍu, s lameṛ is, d abeḥri, s anda i s ihwa.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵓⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵙ ⵡⴰⴹⵓ. ⵉⵜⵚⵓⴹⵓ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ, ⴷ ⴰⴱⵃⵔⵉ, ⵙ ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ.

ayah_content: Ccwaîen akw ibennun, ip$emmisen,
latin_inalco: Ccwaṭen akw ibennun, itɣemmisen,
Tifinagh: ⵛⵛⵡⴰⵟⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⴱⵏⵏⵓⵏ, ⵉⵜⵖⵎⵎⵉⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: Wiyad pwarzen, s slasel.
latin_inalco: Wiyad twarzen, s slasel.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵔⵣⵏ, ⵙ ⵙⵍⴰⵙⵍ.

ayah_content: Tagi d tikci nne£. Efk ne$ eîîef, war aktili.
latin_inalco: Tagi d tikci nneɣ. Efk neɣ eṭṭef, war aktili.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴽⵛⵉ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⴼⴽ ⵏⵖ ⵟⵟⴼ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⴰⴽⵜⵉⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, i neppa, $uône£, amkan n tu$alin aqôib, umâin.
latin_inalco: Ih, i netta, ɣuṛneɣ, amkan n tuɣalin aqṛib, umɛin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵇⵕⵉⴱ, ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Mmekti d amdan nne£ Yub, mi inâaô Mass is: "nek, iêuza yi Cciîan, s cedda akked uâaqeb".
latin_inalco: Mmekti d amdan nneɣ Yub, mi inɛaṛ Mass is: "nek, iḥuza yi Cciṭan, s cedda akked uɛaqeb".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵢⵓⴱ, ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵄⴰⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵉⵃⵓⵣⴰ ⵢⵉ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵛⴷⴷⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ".

Tifinagh: ⵏⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵛⴱⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵉ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ.

latin_inalco: Ad ttekkin dinna. Ad ssutren degsen; izwayen s lufa, akked tisit.

ayah_content: siwa imdanen iK izedganen segsen".
latin_inalco: siwa imdanen iK izedganen segsen".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏⵏ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "tidep, d tidep ay Nni$.
latin_inalco: Inna: "tidet, d tidet ay Nniɣ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⴰⵢ ⵏⵏⵉⵖ.

ayah_content: Ad Acare$ Loahennama yissek, akked wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akken ma llan".
latin_inalco: Ad Acareɣ Lǧahennama yissek, akked wid, segsen, i k iḍefṛen, akken ma llan".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵛⴰⵔⵖ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⴽ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴹⴼⵕⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ taqdiât af waya. Ur lli$, nek, seg wid ippestaâmilen".
latin_inalco: Ini: "ur awen ssutreɣ taqdiɛt af waya. Ur lliɣ, nek, seg wid ittestaɛmilen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵖ, ⵏⴽ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵙⵜⴰⵄⵎⵉⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, d asmekti kan i imavalen.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, d asmekti kan i imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi tâadda tallit, war ccekk, a kwen id iawev usali s.
latin_inalco: Mi tɛadda tallit, war ccekk, a kwen id iaweḍ usali s.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵡⴹ ⵓⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵙ.

ayah_content: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Tarusi n Tezmamt sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tidep. Ihi, aâbed Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tidet. Ihi, aɛbed Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Netta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Day maççi i Öebbi laâqida? Wid ippaddamen imawlan, war Neppa, nnan: "naâbed iten kan, iwakken ad a$ rnun aseqôeb ar Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ad Iêudd garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. Öebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.
latin_inalco: Day mačči i Ṛebbi laɛqida? Wid ittaddamen imawlan, war Netta, nnan: "naɛbed iten kan, iwakken ad aɣ rnun aseqṛeb ar Ṛebbi". Ih, Ṛebbi ad Iḥudd garasen, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden. Ṛebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ? ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴷⴷⴰⵎⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵔⵏⵓⵏ ⴰⵙⵇⵕⴱ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ". ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ, ⴷ ⴰⵊⵀⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Lemmer Ib$i Öebbi ad Isâu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
latin_inalco: Lemmer Ibɣi Ṛebbi ad Isɛu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Netta d Ṛebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⴱⵖⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵄⵓ ⴰⵇⵛⵉⵛ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵉⴼⵔⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵍⵇ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙ! ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⵇⵀⵀⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Innev Iv i wass, Innev ass i yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun, yal wa, ar lajel ipwassnen. Day Neppa maççi d Uzmir Ipsemmiêen?
latin_inalco: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidet. Inneḍ Iḍ i wass, Inneḍ ass i yiḍ. Iḥettem i yiṭij akked waggur, ad lḥun, yal wa, ar lajel itwassnen. Day Netta mačči d Uzmir Itsemmiḥen?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵉⵏⵏⴹ ⵉⴹ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ, ⵉⵏⵏⴹ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵢⵉⴹ. ⵉⵃⵜⵜⵎ ⵉ ⵢⵉⵟⵉⵊ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ, ⴰⴷ ⵍⵃⵓⵏ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵡⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵏ?

ayah_content: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d îam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tâabbuvin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di krav n tellisat. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Amek ihi tugim?
latin_inalco: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d ṭam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tɛabbuḍin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di kraḍ n tellisat. D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Netta. Amek ihi tugim?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵅⵍⵇ. ⵉⵔⵔⴰ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⵜⵉⵙⵍⵉⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵟⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵢⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ. ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴱⵓⴹⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵍⵅⵍⵇ, ⴷⵉ ⴽⵔⴰⴹ ⵏ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⵙⴰⵜ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵀⵉ ⵜⵓⴳⵉⵎ?

ayah_content: Ma tjehlem, Öebbi ur kwen Iêwao ara. Ur Ipôadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iôavi. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Neppa, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
latin_inalco: Ma tjehlem, Ṛebbi ur kwen Iḥwaǧ ara. Ur Itṛadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iṛaḍi. Ur itbibbi yiwen taɛkkwemt n wayeḍ; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tuɣalin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Netta, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵊⵀⵍⵎ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵃⵡⴰⴷⵊ ⴰⵔⴰ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵕⴰⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵏⵎⵎⵔⵎ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵕⴰⴹⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⴱⵉⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⴽⵡⵎⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴹ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ; ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵍ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucâif $uôes; sinna, ma I$at it s$uôeS, ad ippu ayen i$ef inuj $uôeS, uqbel; ad irr i Öebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiî di tijehli k, ihi, keçç seg wat tmes".
latin_inalco: Amdan, ma iḥuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucɛif ɣuṛes; sinna, ma Iɣat it sɣuṛeS, ad ittu ayen iɣef inuj ɣuṛeS, uqbel; ad irr i Ṛebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiṭ di tijehli k, ihi, kečč seg wat tmes".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵃⵓⵣⴰ ⵜ ⵛⵛⵇⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵓⵊ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⴷ ⵓⵛⵄⵉⴼ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⵜ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵏⵓⵊ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ; ⴰⴷ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⴰⵏⵓⴷⴷⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵣⵣⵀⵓ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉ ⴽ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵜ ⵜⵎⵙ".

ayah_content: Day win ippanzen deg iv, ikna u ibedd, ipêebbiô i laxeôt, issaram aêunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day âadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uâqilen".
latin_inalco: Day win ittanzen deg iḍ, ikna u ibedd, itḥebbiṛ i laxeṛt, issaram aḥunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day ɛadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uɛqilen".
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵏⵣⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ, ⵉⴽⵏⴰ ⵓ ⵉⴱⴷⴷ, ⵉⵜⵃⴱⴱⵉⵕ ⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵔⴰⵎ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ…? ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵄⴰⴷⵍⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵙⵉⵏ? ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ, ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, êezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaânen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Öebbi tewsaâ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad ippunefk i iûebôiyen".
latin_inalco: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, ḥezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaɛnen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Ṛebbi tewsaɛ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad ittunefk i iṣebṛiyen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵄⵏⵏ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⴰⴳⵉ. ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⵡⵙⴰⵄ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⴰⴽⵜⵉⵍⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵉ ⵉⵚⴱⵕⵉⵢⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
latin_inalco: Ini: "nek twamṛeɣ d ad ɛabdeɣ Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Netta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽ ⵜⵡⴰⵎⵕⵖ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵖ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Pwamôe$ d, ad ili$ d amvuâ amenzu".
latin_inalco: Pwamṛeɣ d, ad iliɣ d amḍuɛ amenzu".
Tifinagh: Pⵡⴰⵎⵕⵖ ⴷ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵖ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴹⵓⵄ ⴰⵎⵏⵣⵓ".

ayah_content: Ini: "nek, ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
latin_inalco: Ini: "nek, ugadeɣ, ma aɛṣaɣ Mass iw, aɛaqeb n wass ameqwṛaḥan".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵖ, ⵎⴰ ⴰⵄⵚⴰⵖ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
latin_inalco: Ini: "ad ɛabdeɣ Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Netta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰⴷ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵖ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Ihi, âabdet i wen ihwan, war Neppa". Ini: "imexsuôen d wid iwedôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Ni$ d tagi ay d taxessaôt n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ihi, ɛabdet i wen ihwan, war Netta". Ini: "imexsuṛen d wid iwedṛen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Niɣ d tagi ay d taxessaṛt n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵜ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ". ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵡⴷⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ". ⵏⵉⵖ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵅⵙⵙⴰⵕⵜ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: A$embabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayev seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Öebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, êezzbet iyI!
latin_inalco: Aɣembabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayeḍ seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Ṛebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, ḥezzbet iyI!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵖⵎⴱⴰⴱⵓ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵙⵏ, ⵡⴰⵢⴹ ⵙⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ. ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ: ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ!

ayah_content: Wid ijunben aâbad iôebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Öebbi, a ten id ias lfeôê. Ihi, ssefôeê imdanen iW
latin_inalco: Wid ijunben aɛbad iṛebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Ṛebbi, a ten id ias lfeṛḥ. Ihi, ssefṛeḥ imdanen iW
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵓⵏⴱⵏ ⴰⵄⴱⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵜⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⵉⵓⵜⵓⴱⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵍⴼⵕⵃ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵙⵙⴼⵕⵃ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ

ayah_content: i issemêasen i wawal, teddun d ûûam ines. D wigi i Inha Öebbi, d wigi ay d uâqilen.
latin_inalco: i issemḥasen i wawal, teddun d ṣṣam ines. D wigi i Inha Ṛebbi, d wigi ay d uɛqilen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙⵏ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ, ⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⴷ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ ⵉⵏⵙ. ⴷ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵏⵀⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Day win i$ef ippuseyya ad isâaddi aâaqeb, day a psellkev keçç, win illan di tmes?
latin_inalco: Day win iɣef ittuseyya ad isɛaddi aɛaqeb, day a tsellkeḍ kečč, win illan di tmes?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⵙⵍⵍⴽⴹ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ?

ayah_content: Ma d wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sâun ti$uôfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ppazzalen, d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi ur Ixeîîu i lemâahda.
latin_inalco: Ma d wid iḥezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sɛun tiɣuṛfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ttazzalen, d lemɛahda n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi ur Ixeṭṭu i lemɛahda.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵃⵣⵣⴱⵏ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⵄⵓⵏ ⵜⵉⵖⵓⵕⴼⴰⵜⵉⵏ, ⴱⵏⴰⵏⵜ ⵜⴰ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵜⴰ, ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵙⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏⵜ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ, ⴷ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵅⵟⵟⵓ ⵉ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur twalav ara, Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffe$ im$an n yal ini, ara iu$alen ad isliwen. A ten twaliv d iwôa$en, sinna, a ten Irr d iquôanen. Deg waya, s tidep, asmekti i uâqilen.
latin_inalco: Ur twalaḍ ara, Ṛebbi Isseɣli d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffeɣ imɣan n yal ini, ara iuɣalen ad isliwen. A ten twaliḍ d iwṛaɣen, sinna, a ten Irr d iquṛanen. Deg waya, s tidet, asmekti i uɛqilen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵙⵡⵏ ⴰⴽⴰⵍ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⵉⵎⵖⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵏⵉ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵍⵉⵡⵏ. ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⴷ ⵉⵡⵕⴰⵖⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵔⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵇⵓⵕⴰⵏⵏ. ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵉ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Day win iwumi Illi Öebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, d$a neppa di tafat s$uô Mass is…? A ssxev n at wulawen iqquôen, ur d smektayen Öebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Day win iwumi Illi Ṛebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, dɣa netta di tafat sɣuṛ Mass is…? A ssxeḍ n at wulawen iqquṛen, ur d smektayen Ṛebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ…? ⴰ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ ⵏ ⴰⵜ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵇⵇⵓⵕⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ! ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Issader ed Öebbi ûûam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iêninen ar usmekti n Öebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.
latin_inalco: Issader ed Ṛebbi ṣṣam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid ittagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iḥninen ar usmekti n Ṛebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Ṛebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ. ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴷⴳⵙ ⴰⵛⴱⵉ, ⴰⵍⵍⵓⵙ. ⴰⴷ ⵛⵛⵉⵔⵡⵏ ⵙⴳⵙ ⵉⴳⵡⵍⵎⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⴳⵡⵍⵎⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵏⵉⵏⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵏⵀⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Day win ipêezziben, s wudem is, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeôôbet ayen tkeppbem"!
latin_inalco: Day win itḥezziben, s wudem is, seg uɛaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeṛṛbet ayen tkettbem"!
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ, ⵙ ⵡⵓⴷⵎ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ…? ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ: "ⵊⵕⵕⴱⵜ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴽⵜⵜⴱⵎ"!

ayah_content: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.
latin_inalco: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uɛaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Issukk fellasen Öebbi aâaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aâaqeb n laxeôt iugar it, lemmer éeôôen!
latin_inalco: Issukk fellasen Ṛebbi aɛaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aɛaqeb n laxeṛt iugar it, lemmer ẓeṛṛen!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴽⴽ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ; ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⵔ ⵉⵜ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵥⵕⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwṛan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Leqwôan s taâôabt, ur degs tiââawji; amar ad êezzben.
latin_inalco: Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt, ur degs tiɛɛawji; amar ad ḥezzben.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵜⵉⵄⵄⴰⵡⵊⵉ; ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid ipmeréan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day âadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Xaîi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid itmerẓan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day ɛadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi. Xaṭi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵉⵛⵔⴽⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵎⵔⵥⴰⵏ, ⵓ ⴰⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵓⵔⴳⴰⵣ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵄⴰⴷⵍⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⵢⴰⵜⵏ? ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: War ccekk, keçç a ppemmtev, nitni ad mmten.
latin_inalco: War ccekk, kečč a ttemmteḍ, nitni ad mmten.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵎⵎⵜⴹ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵎⵎⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ppemqellaâm.
latin_inalco: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ttemqellaɛm.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵎⵇⵍⵍⴰⵄⵎ.

ayah_content: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Öebbi, iskaddben tidep ma tusa t id? Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?
latin_inalco: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Ṛebbi, iskaddben tidet ma tusa t id? Day mačči di Lǧahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Wid id iusan s tidep, u pputebbten yis, wigi d wid ipêezziben.
latin_inalco: Wid id iusan s tidet, u ttutebbten yis, wigi d wid itḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓ ⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad sâun ayen b$an, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iâaôviyen.
latin_inalco: Ad sɛun ayen bɣan, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iɛaṛḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵙⵄⵓⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴱⵖⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Öebbi, ayen xedmen adiran mavi; a ten I$it s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.
latin_inalco: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Ṛebbi, ayen xedmen adiran maḍi; a ten Iɣit s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⴷⵉⵔⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ; ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵖⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵅⴰⵍⵍⴼ.

ayah_content: Day ur Ipqam ara Öebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Neppa. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.
latin_inalco: Day ur Itqam ara Ṛebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Netta. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵇⴰⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ? ⵍⴰ ⴽ ⵙⵙⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵙ ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵏⵀⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Win Inha Öebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Ni$ Öebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ppaô.
latin_inalco: Win Inha Ṛebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Niɣ Ṛebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ttaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⵀⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵜⵍⴼⵏ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ma testeqsav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Öebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, day zemren, ma Ib$a yi Öebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Ne$, ma Ib$a yi aêunu, ad ssbeîlen aêunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaâ iyi Öebbi; fellaS ay ppeklen wid ipkalen".
latin_inalco: Ma testeqsaḍ ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaɛṛem, war Ṛebbi, day zemren, ma Ibɣa yi Ṛebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Neɣ, ma Ibɣa yi aḥunu, ad ssbeṭlen aḥunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaɛ iyi Ṛebbi; fellaS ay tteklen wid itkalen".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵜⵇⵙⴰⴹ ⵜⵏ: "ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ? ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ: ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ". ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵜⵏⴰⵄⵕⵎ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷⴰⵢ ⵣⵎⵔⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⵖⴰ ⵢⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵛⵛⵇⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴽⴽⵙⵏ ⵛⵛⵇⴰ ⵙ? ⵏⵖ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⵖⴰ ⵢⵉ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⵙⴱⵟⵍⵏ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ"? ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵇⵏⵏⴰⵄ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ; ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⴽⴰⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddme$". Deqqal a ppeéôem
latin_inalco: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddmeɣ". Deqqal a tteẓṛem
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰ ⵢⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ! ⵅⴷⵎⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵜⵏⵏⵓⵎⵏ, ⵏⴽ ⵍⴰ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵖ". ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵥⵕⵎ

ayah_content: anwa u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, u$uô ara d irs uâaqeb imezgi.
latin_inalco: anwa uɣuṛ ara d ias uɛaqeb ara t isdullen, uɣuṛ ara d irs uɛaqeb imezgi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵏ, ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, Nessader ed $uôek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win ipwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nessader ed ɣuṛek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win itwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliḍ, kečč, d awkil nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⴽ, ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜⵙ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ, ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵉⵙ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⴹ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⴽⵉⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Ippaddam leôwaê mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg ives nnsen. Iâatteq wid i$ef Iseyya tameppant, Ippara d wiyav, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Ittaddam leṛwaḥ mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg iḍes nnsen. Iɛatteq wid iɣef Iseyya tamettant, Ittara d wiyaḍ, ar lajel itwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud itmeyyizen.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴷⴷⴰⵎ ⵍⵕⵡⴰⵃ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵎⵎⵜⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵎⵎⵓⵜ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵄⴰⵜⵜⵇ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵎⵢⵢⵉⵣⵏ.

ayah_content: Ne$ ad ddmen, war Öebbi, imcafâan? Ini: "i ma ur sâin acemma, ur fhimen"?
latin_inalco: Neɣ ad ddmen, war Ṛebbi, imcafɛan? Ini: "i ma ur sɛin acemma, ur fhimen"?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰⴷ ⴷⴷⵎⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵎⵛⴰⴼⵄⴰⵏ? ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉ ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵉⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⴼⵀⵉⵎⵏ"?

ayah_content: Ini: "akw ccafuâa n Öebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, $uôeS ara tu$alem".
latin_inalco: Ini: "akw ccafuɛa n Ṛebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, ɣuṛeS ara tuɣalem".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰⴽⵡ ⵛⵛⴰⴼⵓⵄⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ".

ayah_content: Mara d Ipwadder Öebbi Yiwen, ad zemven wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeôt. Ma pwadren d wid, war Neppa, imiren nitni ad ceôêen.
latin_inalco: Mara d Itwadder Ṛebbi Yiwen, ad zemḍen wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt. Ma twadren d wid, war Netta, imiren nitni ad ceṛḥen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴷⴷⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵣⵎⴹⵏ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵛⵕⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "a Öebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen ivehôen, d Keçç ara Iêudden ger imdanen iK, $ef wayen llan mgarraden".
latin_inalco: Ini: "a Ṛebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen iḍehṛen, d Kečč ara Iḥudden ger imdanen iK, ɣef wayen llan mgarraden".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ! ⴰⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴹⵀⵕⵏ, ⴷ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷⵏ ⴳⵔ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⴽ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ".

ayah_content: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am neppa, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, s$uô Öebbi, ayen i$ef ur bnin.
latin_inalco: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am netta, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uɛaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ayen iɣef ur bnin.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵔⵏⵓ ⵢⴰⵙ ⴰⵎ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⴷⴷⵓ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen innev wayen i$ef ttahan.
latin_inalco: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen inneḍ wayen iɣef ttahan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⴱⴰⵏⵏⵜ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⴹ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵜⴰⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma iêuza umdan ccqa, ad a£ d inâaô. Sinna, ma Nezger tacvaî nne£ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaîi! D ajeôôeb, maca aîas degsen ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Ma iḥuza umdan ccqa, ad aɣ d inɛaṛ. Sinna, ma Nezger tacḍaṭ nneɣ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaṭi! D ajeṛṛeb, maca aṭas degsen ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵃⵓⵣⴰ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵛⵛⵇⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵄⴰⵕ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⵏⵣⴳⵔ ⵜⴰⵛⴹⴰⵟ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵢⵉ ⴷ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ". ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⴷ ⴰⵊⵕⵕⴱ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen keppben?
latin_inalco: Niɣ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen kettben?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵜⵜⴱⵏ?

ayah_content: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.
latin_inalco: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵙⴼⵓⵏⵏⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Day ur éôin ara ar Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
latin_inalco: Day ur ẓṛin ara ar Ṛebbi Itɣiti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵖⵉⵜⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵓ ⵉⵡⵣⵣⵏ? ⵉⵀ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i ipêawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ppayset aêunu n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê akw ibekkaven. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i itḥawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ttayset aḥunu n Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Itsemmiḥ akw ibekkaḍen. Ih, Netta Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵃⴰⵡⴰⵍⵏ ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ! ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵢⵙⵜ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Steôoâet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, d$a ula ikwen isellken.
latin_inalco: Steṛǧɛet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uɛaqeb, dɣa ula ikwen isellken.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵄⵜ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⵏⵣⵜ ⴰⵙ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵓⵍⴰ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: Ddut d ûûam n wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";
latin_inalco: Ddut d ṣṣam n wayen i wen d irsen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uɛaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";
Tifinagh: ⴷⴷⵓⵜ ⴷ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵙⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⵇⵣⴰⵍⵍⴰ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⴱⵏⵉⵎ";

ayah_content: u a d yini ôôuê: "a ssexv iw, $ef wayen stehza$ ar loiha n Öebbi! Lli$, s tidep, seg wid ittihin".
latin_inalco: u a d yini ṛṛuḥ: "a ssexḍ iw, ɣef wayen stehzaɣ ar lǧiha n Ṛebbi! Lliɣ, s tidet, seg wid ittihin".
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⴰ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ: "ⴰ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ ⵉⵡ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵙⵜⵀⵣⴰⵖ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵀⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ! ⵍⵍⵉⵖ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵀⵉⵏ".

ayah_content: Ne$ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Öebbi, yili lli$ seg wid ipêezziben".
latin_inalco: Neɣ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Ṛebbi, yili lliɣ seg wid itḥezziben".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵏⵀⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵍⵍⵉⵖ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ".

ayah_content: Ne$ a d yini mara iwali aâaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad ili$ si lâuûam".
latin_inalco: Neɣ a d yini mara iwali aɛaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad iliɣ si lɛuṣam".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵓⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵖ ⵙⵉ ⵍⵄⵓⵚⴰⵎ".

ayah_content: Xaîi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbev ten, tzuxxev, telliv seg ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbeḍ ten, tzuxxeḍ, telliḍ seg ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⵜⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⴹ ⵜⵏ, ⵜⵣⵓⵅⵅⴹ, ⵜⵍⵍⵉⴹ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass n tnekra, a pwaliv berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Öebbi. Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?
latin_inalco: Ass n tnekra, a twaliḍ berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Ṛebbi. Day mačči di Lǧahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⴱⵔⵔⵉⴽⵉⵜ ⵡⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴳⵔⵏ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Ad Isellek Öebbi wid iêezzben; ar rebêen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur $webbnen.
latin_inalco: Ad Isellek Ṛebbi wid iḥezzben; ar rebḥen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur ɣwebbnen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵃⵣⵣⴱⵏ; ⴰⵔ ⵔⴱⵃⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⴰⵜ ⵡⵓⴳⵓⵔ, ⵓⵔ ⵖⵡⴱⴱⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Ixleq yal cci. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Ixleq yal cci. Netta d Awkil n yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵡⴽⵉⵍ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen.
latin_inalco: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, widak d imexsuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⵙⵓⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "day ad yi tamôem ad âabde$, war Öebbi, a wid ur nessin"?
latin_inalco: Ini: "day ad yi tamṛem ad ɛabdeɣ, war Ṛebbi, a wid ur nessin"?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⵕⵎ ⴰⴷ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵖ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵙⵉⵏ"?

ayah_content: Ni$ iusa k id uweêêi, u $eô wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkev, ad mêun igiten ik, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ iusa k id uweḥḥi, u ɣeṛ wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkeḍ, ad mḥun igiten ik, a ttiliḍ seg imexsuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵃⵃⵉ, ⵓ ⵖⵕ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵛⵓⵔⴽⴹ, ⴰⴷ ⵎⵃⵓⵏ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⴽ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⴹ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Aâbed Öebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Aɛbed Ṛebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵍⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵏⵎⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeét iS. Igenwan ad nnefvasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
latin_inalco: Ur qudṛen ara Ṛebbi, azal n lqedṛ iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeẓt iS. Igenwan ad nnefḍasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aɛlay sennig wayen tcaraken!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵇⵓⴷⵕⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵣⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵍⵇⴷⵕ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⴽⵡ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵓⵎⵥⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵏⵏⴼⴹⴰⵙⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴼⵓⵙ ⵉⵙ ⴰⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ. ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙ! ⵉ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ!

ayah_content: Aûuvu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Öebbi. Aûuvu nniven: nitni a d kkren pmuqulen.
latin_inalco: Aṣuḍu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Ṛebbi. Aṣuḍu nniḍen: nitni a d kkren tmuqulen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵚⵓⴹⵓ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴱⵓⵇ: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵅⵙⴼ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴰⵚⵓⴹⵓ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ: ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰ ⴷ ⴽⴽⵔⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵇⵓⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: A pfeooeo tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad âaddin di ccôaâ, s tidep, ur pwadensen.
latin_inalco: A tfeǧǧeǧ tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad ɛaddin di ccṛaɛ, s tidet, ur twadensen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⴼⴷⴷⵊⴷⵊ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ. ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵔⵙ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⴱⵉⵢⵢⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⵕⴰⵄ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ixdem. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.
latin_inalco: Yal yiwen ad iɣellet ayen ixdem. Netta, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴰⵍ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵖⵍⵍⵜ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵢⵉⴼ ⴰⴽⵡ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad pwanehôen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Loahennama. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedôen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iûaô wawal uâaqeb, af ijehliyen".
latin_inalco: Ad twanehṛen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Lǧahennama. Mi bbwḍen ɣuṛes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iɛssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedṛen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iṣaṛ wawal uɛaqeb, af ijehliyen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵕⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵔⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ. ⵎⵉ ⴱⴱⵡⴹⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵓ ⵍⵍⵉⵏⵜ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ ⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵏ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵎⵎⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵏⴷⵕⵏ ⴽⵡⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵉⵀ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵚⴰⵕ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴰⴼ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ".

ayah_content: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama! Degs, wekkôet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!
latin_inalco: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Lǧahennama! Degs, wekkṛet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ! ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵜ". ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ!

ayah_content: Wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad pwanehôen ar Loennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet ep, twekkôem"!
latin_inalco: Wid iḥezzben i Mass nnsen, ad twanehṛen ar Lǧennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwḍen ɣuṛes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iɛssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet et, twekkṛem"!
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵃⵣⵣⴱⵏ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵕⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵔⴰⵡⵏ. ⵎⵉ ⴱⴱⵡⴹⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵓ ⵍⵍⵉⵏⵜ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ ⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙ: "ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ, ⵜⴳⵔⵣⵎ; ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵜ, ⵜⵡⴽⴽⵕⵎ"!

ayah_content: Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Issawven lemâahda S. Ifka ya$ tamurt d lweôt; a nili, di Loennet, anda i $ ihwa. A yarraz asaâdi n wid ixeddmen lxiô!
latin_inalco: Ad inin: "ccekṛan i Ṛebbi i ɣ Issawḍen lemɛahda S. Ifka yaɣ tamurt d lweṛt; a nili, di Lǧennet, anda i ɣ ihwa. A yarraz asaɛdi n wid ixeddmen lxiṛ!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵡⴹⵏ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵙ. ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵖ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷ ⵍⵡⵕⵜ; ⴰ ⵏⵉⵍⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ. ⴰ ⵢⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⴰⵙⴰⵄⴷⵉ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ!

ayah_content: A pwaliv lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuâent s ccekôan Mass nnsent. Iâadda ccôaâ garasen, s tidep. Ad inin: "a neckeô Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
latin_inalco: A twaliḍ lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuɛent s ccekṛan Mass nnsent. Iɛadda ccṛaɛ garasen, s tidet. Ad inin: "a neckeṛ Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵣⵣⵉⵏⵜ ⴷ ⵉ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ, ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏⵜ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ. ⵉⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰ ⵛⵛⵕⴰⵄ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰ ⵏⵛⴽⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Ëm.
latin_inalco: Ḥm.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: Tarusi n Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Amusnaw;
latin_inalco: Tarusi n Tezmamt, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Amusnaw;
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ;

ayah_content: Ipsemmiêen tuccva, Iqeblen nndama, Ipâaqaben s teqseê, Bab n terkunt. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £uôeS taggara.
latin_inalco: Itsemmiḥen tuccḍa, Iqeblen nndama, Itɛaqaben s teqseḥ, Bab n terkunt. Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Netta. ɣuṛeS taggara.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ, ⵉⵇⴱⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⴷⴰⵎⴰ, ⵉⵜⵄⴰⵇⴰⴱⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵇⵙⵃ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵔⴽⵓⵏⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⴳⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Siwa wid ijehlen i ipnamaren $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. Ur k ip$uôôu ucali nnsen, di tmurt.
latin_inalco: Siwa wid ijehlen i itnamaren ɣef issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Ur k itɣuṛṛu ucali nnsen, di tmurt.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⴽ ⵉⵜⵖⵓⵕⵕⵓ ⵓⵛⴰⵍⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ.

ayah_content: Uqbel nitni, agdud n Nuê, akked ikabaren deffir sen, skaddben. Yal lois iclaâ ad ixvef amazan is. Ipnamar s tkerkas, iwakken, s yissent, ad iveggeô tidep. Ëekme$ ten. A tiyta W imiren!
latin_inalco: Uqbel nitni, agdud n Nuḥ, akked ikabaren deffir sen, skaddben. Yal lǧis iclaɛ ad ixḍef amazan is. Itnamar s tkerkas, iwakken, s yissent, ad iḍeggeṛ tidet. Ḥekmeɣ ten. A tiyta W imiren!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔⵏ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ, ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ. ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⵉⵛⵍⴰⵄ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵅⴹⴼ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⵙ ⵜⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ, ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵃⴽⵎⵖ ⵜⵏ. ⴰ ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ ⵡ ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ!

ayah_content: Akka iûaô wawal n Mass ik, af wid ijehlen. Nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
latin_inalco: Akka iṣaṛ wawal n Mass ik, af wid ijehlen. Nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉⵚⴰⵕ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⴼ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵎⵙ.

ayah_content: Tid irefden asgeld, akked tid i s izzin, sbuccuâen s ccekôan Mass nnsent, umnent yiS. Ssuturent ad pwasemmêen wid iumnen: "a Mass nne$! Terriv yal cci d aêunu, u d tamusni. Semmeê i wid isteôoâen u ddan d ubrid iK; Sellek iten seg uâaqeb n wu$ud.
latin_inalco: Tid irefden asgeld, akked tid i s izzin, sbuccuɛen s ccekṛan Mass nnsent, umnent yiS. Ssuturent ad twasemmḥen wid iumnen: "a Mass nneɣ! Terriḍ yal cci d aḥunu, u d tamusni. Semmeḥ i wid isteṛǧɛen u ddan d ubrid iK; Sellek iten seg uɛaqeb n wuɣud.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵔⴼⴷⵏ ⴰⵙⴳⵍⴷ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵣⵣⵉⵏ, ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ, ⵓⵎⵏⵏⵜ ⵢⵉⵙ. ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵓⵔⵏⵜ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵙⵎⵎⵃⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵜⵔⵔⵉⴹ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ. ⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵄⵏ ⵓ ⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⴽ; ⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵡⵓⵖⵓⴷ.

ayah_content: A Mass nne$! Ssekcem iten ar leonanat n Âaden, i Tâahdev, i nitni, u i iâaôviyen seg ibabaten nnsen, tilawin nnsen, tarwa nnsen. Keçç, ih, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: A Mass nneɣ! Ssekcem iten ar leǧnanat n Ɛaden, i Tɛahdeḍ, i nitni, u i iɛaṛḍiyen seg ibabaten nnsen, tilawin nnsen, tarwa nnsen. Kečč, ih, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵄⴰⴷⵏ, ⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⵀⴷⴹ, ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵓ ⵉ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴱⴰⴱⴰⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⴰⵔⵡⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Aâteq iten si tucmitin. Win Tâatqev, assen, si tucmitin, ni$ Têunev fellas. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan".
latin_inalco: Aɛteq iten si tucmitin. Win Tɛatqeḍ, assen, si tucmitin, niɣ Tḥuneḍ fellas. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵜⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵜⵄⴰⵜⵇⴹ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ, ⵏⵉⵖ ⵜⵃⵓⵏⴹ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵔⵔⴱⵃ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Ad pwanecden wid ijehlen: "taâdawt n Öebbi te$leb taâdawt bbwaygarawen. Mi tepwanecdem ar liman, tugim".
latin_inalco: Ad twanecden wid ijehlen: "taɛdawt n Ṛebbi teɣleb taɛdawt bbwaygarawen. Mi tetwanecdem ar liman, tugim".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ: "ⵜⴰⵄⴷⴰⵡⵜ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⵖⵍⴱ ⵜⴰⵄⴷⴰⵡⵜ ⴱⴱⵡⴰⵢⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ. ⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷⵎ ⴰⵔ ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ, ⵜⵓⴳⵉⵎ".

ayah_content: A d inin: "a Mass nne$! Ten$iv a$ berdayen, Tessidrev a$ berdayen. Nqaôô s ibekkaven nne$. Day illa ubrid n tuff$a"?
latin_inalco: A d inin: "a Mass nneɣ! Tenɣiḍ aɣ berdayen, Tessidreḍ aɣ berdayen. Nqaṛṛ s ibekkaḍen nneɣ. Day illa ubrid n tuffɣa"?
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵜⵏⵖⵉⴹ ⴰⵖ ⴱⵔⴷⴰⵢⵏ, ⵜⵙⵙⵉⴷⵔⴹ ⴰⵖ ⴱⵔⴷⴰⵢⵏ. ⵏⵇⴰⵕⵕ ⵙ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵖⴰ"?

ayah_content: Akka, imi mara ipwanâaô Öebbi Yiwen, kunwi tjehlem. Mara S pcaraken, kunwi tumnem. Aêuddu ar Öebbi Aâlayen, Ameqwôan.
latin_inalco: Akka, imi mara itwanɛaṛ Ṛebbi Yiwen, kunwi tjehlem. Mara S tcaraken, kunwi tumnem. Aḥuddu ar Ṛebbi Aɛlayen, Ameqwṛan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉⵎⵉ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵄⴰⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵜⵊⵀⵍⵎ. ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵜⵓⵎⵏⵎ. ⴰⵃⵓⴷⴷⵓ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ, ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i wen Issnaâtan issekniyen iS. Issadar awen d l$it, seg igenni. Siwa win isteôoiâen, id ismektayen.
latin_inalco: D Netta i wen Issnaɛtan issekniyen iS. Issadar awen d lɣit, seg igenni. Siwa win isteṛǧiɛen, id ismektayen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⴰⵄⵜⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⴰⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ. ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵉⵄⵏ, ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Nujet $uô Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa, xas ugin ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Nujet ɣuṛ Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Netta, xas ugin ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵊⵜ ⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵅⴰⵙ ⵓⴳⵉⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Aâlayen nnig idurra, Bab n usgeld, Ippak ôôuê s lameô iS, i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, iwakken ad indeô af wass umlili,
latin_inalco: Aɛlayen nnig idurra, Bab n usgeld, Ittak ṛṛuḥ s lameṛ iS, i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, iwakken ad indeṛ af wass umlili,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⵔⴰ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⴷⵕ ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉ,

ayah_content: ass ideg ara d awven, ur illi wayen iffren, degsen, i Öebbi. W ip ilan tgelda, assen? D Öebbi, Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
latin_inalco: ass ideg ara d awḍen, ur illi wayen iffren, degsen, i Ṛebbi. W it ilan tgelda, assen? D Ṛebbi, Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵡⴹⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵡ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⴳⵍⴷⴰ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ? ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⵇⵀⵀⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara ippuqeîîi yal iman $ef wayen ikseb; ur ippili ddens assen. Ih, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara ittuqeṭṭi yal iman ɣef wayen ikseb; ur ittili ddens assen. Ih, Ṛebbi Itɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴽⵙⴱ; ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⴷⴷⵏⵙ ⴰⵙⵙⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵖⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ.

ayah_content: Nabi ten af ass aqôib, ideg ulawen ad rewlen s igerjumen, ad qebôen. Ur ippilli i imednas, uêbib ne$ amcafaâ, iwumi ara ssemêessen.
latin_inalco: Nabi ten af ass aqṛib, ideg ulawen ad rewlen s igerjumen, ad qebṛen. Ur ittilli i imednas, uḥbib neɣ amcafaɛ, iwumi ara ssemḥessen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴰⴱⵉ ⵜⵏ ⴰⴼ ⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵇⵕⵉⴱ, ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵔⵡⵍⵏ ⵙ ⵉⴳⵔⵊⵓⵎⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵇⴱⵕⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵓⵃⴱⵉⴱ ⵏⵖ ⴰⵎⵛⴰⴼⴰⵄ, ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵙⵎⵃⵙⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Issen nncub n yiéôi, akked wayen teffren idmaren.
latin_inalco: Issen nncub n yiẓṛi, akked wayen teffren idmaren.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵏⵏⵛⵓⴱ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵥⵕⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴼⴼⵔⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Iferru s tidep. Wid ipnujun ar war Neppa, ur qeîîun acemma. Ih, Öebbi d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Iferru s tidet. Wid itnujun ar war Netta, ur qeṭṭun acemma. Ih, Ṛebbi d Win Isellen, Itwalin.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⴼⵔⵔⵓ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵇⵟⵟⵓⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵍⵍⵏ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Day ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten tazmert, akked lateô, di tmurt. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Ur asen illi umêareb, mgal Öebbi.
latin_inalco: Day ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten tazmert, akked lateṛ, di tmurt. Issemḥelleq asen Ṛebbi, ilmend ibekkaḍen nnsen. Ur asen illi umḥareb, mgal Ṛebbi.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⴹⵕⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⴼⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⵔⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴰⵜⵕ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⵍⵍⵇ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵎⵃⴰⵔⴱ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Akka, acku ppasen $uôsen, imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, u nitni jehlen. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab uâaqeb uqsiê.
latin_inalco: Akka, acku ttasen ɣuṛsen, imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, u nitni jehlen. Issemḥelleq asen Ṛebbi. Ih, Netta, d Uzmir, d Bab uɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⴰⵛⴽⵓ ⵜⵜⴰⵙⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ, ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵊⵀⵍⵏ. ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⵍⵍⵇ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nne£, s udabu iberrzen,
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nneɣ, s udabu iberrzen,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵙ ⵓⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵉⴱⵔⵔⵣⵏ,

ayah_content: ar Ferâun, Haman, akked Qaôun. Nnan: "d aseêêar, d akeddab".
latin_inalco: ar Ferɛun, Haman, akked Qaṛun. Nnan: "d aseḥḥar, d akeddab".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⵀⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵇⴰⵕⵓⵏ. ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔ, ⴷ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ".

ayah_content: Mi sen d iusa, s tidep s $uône£, nnan: "en$et arrac n wid iumnen yides, ssidret tilawin nnsen". Tandit ijehliyen siwa di ttelfan.
latin_inalco: Mi sen d iusa, s tidet s ɣuṛneɣ, nnan: "enɣet arrac n wid iumnen yides, ssidret tilawin nnsen". Tandit ijehliyen siwa di ttelfan.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⵙ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⵖⵜ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵛ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ, ⵙⵙⵉⴷⵔⵜ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ". ⵜⴰⵏⴷⵉⵜ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Inna Ferâun: "anfet iyi ad n$e$ Musa, xas ad inuj ar Mass is. Ugade$, nek, ad ibeddel ddin nnwen, ne$ a d issekcem lefsad di tmurt".
latin_inalco: Inna Ferɛun: "anfet iyi ad nɣeɣ Musa, xas ad inuj ar Mass is. Ugadeɣ, nek, ad ibeddel ddin nnwen, neɣ a d issekcem lefsad di tmurt".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ: "ⴰⵏⴼⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵏⵖⵖ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ, ⵅⴰⵙ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵓⵊ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ. ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵖ, ⵏⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴱⴷⴷⵍ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⵍⴼⵙⴰⴷ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ".

ayah_content: Inna Musa: "nek, ad iyi Iûûeô Mass iw u Mass nnwen, si yal amzuxi, ur numin s wass uqeîîi".
latin_inalco: Inna Musa: "nek, ad iyi Iṣṣeṛ Mass iw u Mass nnwen, si yal amzuxi, ur numin s wass uqeṭṭi".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ: "ⵏⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵚⵚⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⵓ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ".

ayah_content: Inna urgaz lmumen, i iffren liman is, si twacult n Ferâun: "day a ppen$em argaz, imi d iqqaô: Mass iw d Öebbi, u irna ibbwi yawen d abeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen? Ma iskaddeb, lkedb is fellas. Ma issawel tidep, a kwen iêaz kra seg wayen ikwen issagwad. Öebbi ur Inehhu amaâfun iskiddiben.
latin_inalco: Inna urgaz lmumen, i iffren liman is, si twacult n Ferɛun: "day a ttenɣem argaz, imi d iqqaṛ: Mass iw d Ṛebbi, u irna ibbwi yawen d abeggen, sɣuṛ Mass nnwen? Ma iskaddeb, lkedb is fellas. Ma issawel tidet, a kwen iḥaz kra seg wayen ikwen issagwad. Ṛebbi ur Inehhu amaɛfun iskiddiben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵓⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵏⵖⵎ ⴰⵔⴳⴰⵣ, ⵉⵎⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵕ: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓ ⵉⵔⵏⴰ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴱⴳⴳⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ? ⵎⴰ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ, ⵍⴽⴷⴱ ⵉⵙ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵡⵍ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵃⴰⵣ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⴰⵎⴰⵄⴼⵓⵏ ⵉⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: A yagdud iw! Assa, nnwen tagelda, tufrarem di tmurt. W ad a$ isellken si tiyta n Öebbi, ma tusa ya$ d"? Inna d Ferâun: "i wen ssekne$ ayen kan wala$; s anda i kwen nehhu$, siwa ar ubrid imaânen".

Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⵉ ⵓⴷⴰⴱⵓ, ⵏⵣⵣⵀ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵖⵓⵏⴼⵓ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵛⵎⵎⴰⵄ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵓⵍ ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉ, ⴰⵄⴼⵔⵉⵜ.

Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵏⴷⵉⵏ. ⵉⵖⵡⵍⵍⴼ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⵔⵏ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ:

latin_inalco: times. Ad twafessren degs, ṣṣbeḥ, tameddit. Ass ideg ara d ias yimir: "ekcem, a lǧis n Ferɛun, aɛaqeb uwɛiṛ maḍi"!
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵙ. ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⴼⵙⵙⵔⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵚⵚⴱⵃ, ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ. ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ: "ⴽⵛⵎ, ⴰ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵡⵄⵉⵕ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ"!

latin_inalco: Mara ttemqellaɛen di tmes, ad inin uṛhifen i imzuxiyen: "niɣ nella nedda yidwen. Ma tzemrem, kunwi, ad aɣ tesneqsem cwiṭ, si tmes"?
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⵎⵇⵍⵍⴰⵄⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵓⵕⵀⵉⴼⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ: "ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⴰ ⵢⵉⴷⵡⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵎ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵜⵙⵏⵇⵙⵎ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ"?

ayah_content: A d inin imzuxiyen: "aql a$, akw, degs. S tidep, Öebbi Iêudd ger imdanen".
latin_inalco: A d inin imzuxiyen: "aql aɣ, akw, degs. S tidet, Ṛebbi Iḥudd ger imdanen".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ: "ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ, ⴰⴽⵡ, ⴷⴳⵙ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⵔ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ".

ayah_content: Ad inin wid illan di tmes, i iâessasen n Loahennama: "naâôet Mass nnwen, ad a$ Issifes ibwass uâaqeb".
latin_inalco: Ad inin wid illan di tmes, i iɛessasen n Lǧahennama: "naɛṛet Mass nnwen, ad aɣ Issifes ibwass uɛaqeb".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⵉ ⵉⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ: "ⵏⴰⵄⵕⵜ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴼⵙ ⵉⴱⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ".

ayah_content: Ad inin: "day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen nnwen, s ubeggen"? Ad inin: "ih". Ad inin: "naâret"! Ar ttelfan, kan, tanaârit ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Ad inin: "day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen nnwen, s ubeggen"? Ad inin: "ih". Ad inin: "naɛret"! Ar ttelfan, kan, tanaɛrit ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵙ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ"? ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵉⵀ". ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵏⴰⵄⵔⵜ"! ⴰⵔ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ, ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵜⴰⵏⴰⵄⵔⵉⵜ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: War ccekk, a Nsellek imazanen nne£, akked wid iumnen, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u deg wass ideg ara d bedden inagan,
latin_inalco: War ccekk, a Nsellek imazanen nneɣ, akked wid iumnen, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u deg wass ideg ara d bedden inagan,
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ, ⵓ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴱⴷⴷⵏ ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: ass ideg ur infaâ uste$feô imednas. Ad pwaxzun, ad zed$en deg uxxam ucmit mavi.
latin_inalco: ass ideg ur infaɛ usteɣfeṛ imednas. Ad twaxzun, ad zedɣen deg uxxam ucmit maḍi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⴼⴰⵄ ⵓⵙⵜⵖⴼⵕ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ. ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵅⵣⵓⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵣⴷⵖⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka, i Musa, nnhaya. Nefka, i At Isôail, Tazmamt d lweôt.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nefka, i Musa, nnhaya. Nefka, i At Isṛail, Tazmamt d lweṛt.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ, ⵉ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ, ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ. ⵏⴼⴽⴰ, ⵉ ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ, ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⴷ ⵍⵡⵕⵜ.

ayah_content: D nnhaya, u d asmekti i uâqilen.
latin_inalco: D nnhaya, u d asmekti i uɛqilen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ, ⵓ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵉ ⵓⵄⵇⵉⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Eûbeô. Ih, lemâahda n Öebbi, d tidep. Ssuter ssmaê ubekkav ik. Sbuccaâ s ccekôan Mass ik, tameddit, taûebêit.
latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ. Ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi, d tidet. Ssuter ssmaḥ ubekkaḍ ik. Sbuccaɛ s ccekṛan Mass ik, tameddit, taṣebḥit.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ. ⵉⵀ, ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ ⵉⴽ. ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ, ⵜⴰⵚⴱⵃⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ipnamaren issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten id iusi udabu, d tem$weô kan i illan deg idmaren nnsen; ur as ssawven. Ggani Öebbi, Neppa, s tidep, Isell, Ipwali.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid itnamaren issekniyen n Ṛebbi, ur ten id iusi udabu, d temɣweṛ kan i illan deg idmaren nnsen; ur as ssawḍen. Ggani Ṛebbi, Netta, s tidet, Isell, Itwali.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⵉ ⵓⴷⴰⴱⵓ, ⴷ ⵜⵎⵖⵡⵕ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵙⵙⴰⵡⴹⵏ. ⴳⴳⴰⵏⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵙⵍⵍ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan iugar lxelq n imdanen, maca aîas n imdanen ur éôin.
latin_inalco: Ih, lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan iugar lxelq n imdanen, maca aṭas n imdanen ur ẓṛin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⵔ ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur iaâdil ara uder$al akked win ipwalin, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, akked bu tucmitin. Cwiî id tesmektayem.
latin_inalco: Ur iaɛdil ara uderɣal akked win itwalin, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, akked bu tucmitin. Cwiṭ id tesmektayem.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴰⵄⴷⵉⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵓⴷⵔⵖⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵓ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴱⵓ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ. ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵎ.

ayah_content: Ihi, imir a d ias, ur illi ccekk fellas, maca tegwti n imdanen ur uminen.
latin_inalco: Ihi, imir a d ias, ur illi ccekk fellas, maca tegwti n imdanen ur uminen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵓⵎⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Inna Mass nnwen: "naâret iyI, ad awen d Jawbe$. Wanag wid igelzen aâbed iW, ad kecmen Loahennama, d imedlulen".
latin_inalco: Inna Mass nnwen: "naɛret iyI, ad awen d Jawbeɣ. Wanag wid igelzen aɛbed iW, ad kecmen Lǧahennama, d imedlulen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ: "ⵏⴰⵄⵔⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵊⴰⵡⴱⵖ. ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴳⵍⵣⵏ ⴰⵄⴱⴷ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⴷ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵍⵓⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Öebbi i wen Irran iv, i ureyyeê degs, ass i tmu$li. Öebbi, ih, d Bab n lfevl i imdanen, maca tegwti n imdanen, ur snemmiren.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi i wen Irran iḍ, i ureyyeḥ degs, ass i tmuɣli. Ṛebbi, ih, d Bab n lfeḍl i imdanen, maca tegwti n imdanen, ur snemmiren.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⴹ, ⵉ ⵓⵔⵢⵢⵃ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵖⵍⵉ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵏⵎⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ixleq yal cci, ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Ihi, acimi tezzim akin?
latin_inalco: D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. Ixleq yal cci, ur illi ṛebbi, siwa Netta. Ihi, acimi tezzim akin?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵛⵉⵎⵉ ⵜⵣⵣⵉⵎ ⴰⴽⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Akka ay wexxôen wid iugin issekniyen n Öebbi.
latin_inalco: Akka ay wexxṛen wid iugin issekniyen n Ṛebbi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⴳⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Öebbi i wen Irran tamurt d leqôaô, igenni d ssqef; ikwen Imeslen. Iûeggem udem nnwen. I$at ikwen s wayen ilhan. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. D Asaâdi Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi i wen Irran tamurt d leqṛaṛ, igenni d ssqef; ikwen Imeslen. Iṣeggem udem nnwen. Iɣat ikwen s wayen ilhan. D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. D Asaɛdi Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷ ⵍⵇⵕⴰⵕ, ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵇⴼ; ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵙⵍⵏ. ⵉⵚⴳⴳⵎ ⵓⴷⵎ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴷ ⴰⵙⴰⵄⴷⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa d Amuddir, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ihi, naâôet eP, s lâaqida i Neppa. Ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Netta d Amuddir, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Netta. Ihi, naɛṛet eP, s lɛaqida i Netta. Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⴷⴷⵉⵔ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⴰⵄⵕⵜ P, ⵙ ⵍⵄⴰⵇⵉⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "nek, ipwakkes iyi uâbad n wid tnaârem war Öebbi, mi yi d iusa ubeggen, s$uô Mass iw. Pwamôe$ d, ad anze$ i Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ini: "nek, itwakkes iyi uɛbad n wid tnaɛrem war Ṛebbi, mi yi d iusa ubeggen, sɣuṛ Mass iw. Pwamṛeɣ d, ad anzeɣ i Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴽⴽⵙ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵓⵄⴱⴰⴷ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵜⵏⴰⵄⵔⵎ ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⵉ ⵢⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ. Pⵡⴰⵎⵕⵖ ⴷ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵏⵣⵖ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa, ikwen Ixelqen seg wakal; sinna, si tiqqit; sinna, seg urgen; sinna, Issuffe$ ikwen id d igwerdan; sinna, a ppim$uôem; sinna, a ppu$alem d im$aôen. Kra segwen, pmeppaten uqbel. Iwakken a ppawvem ar lajel ipwassnen. Amendeô ma a pfehmem.
latin_inalco: Netta, ikwen Ixelqen seg wakal; sinna, si tiqqit; sinna, seg urgen; sinna, Issuffeɣ ikwen id d igwerdan; sinna, a ttimɣuṛem; sinna, a ttuɣalem d imɣaṛen. Kra segwen, tmettaten uqbel. Iwakken a ttawḍem ar lajel itwassnen. Amendeṛ ma a tfehmem.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⵇⵇⵉⵜ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⵔⴳⵏ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵔⴷⴰⵏ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵎⵖⵓⵕⵎ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵖⴰⵕⵏ. ⴽⵔⴰ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵜⵏ ⵓⵇⴱⵍ. ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵡⴹⵎ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ. ⴰⵎⵏⴷⵕ ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⵜⴼⵀⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. Ma Iseyya d lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. Ma Iseyya d lameṛ, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵏⵇⵇⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ: "ⵉⵍⵉ"! ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara amek ssuff$en i ubrid, wid ipnamaren issekniyen n Öebbi?
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara amek ssuffɣen i ubrid, wid itnamaren issekniyen n Ṛebbi?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ?

ayah_content: Wid iskaddben Tazmamt, akked wayen i$ef id Nuzen imazanen nne£, deqqal ad éôen.
latin_inalco: Wid iskaddben Tazmamt, akked wayen iɣef id Nuzen imazanen nneɣ, deqqal ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Mara pwazu$ôen, s teqlavin d slasel,
latin_inalco: Mara twazuɣṛen, s teqlaḍin d slasel,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵣⵓⵖⵕⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵇⵍⴰⴹⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵍⴰⵙⵍ,

ayah_content: ar waman ippayzagen; sinna, ar tmes, ad pwaveggôen;
latin_inalco: ar waman ittayzagen; sinna, ar tmes, ad twaḍeggṛen;
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳⵏ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⴹⴳⴳⵕⵏ;

ayah_content: sinna, ad asen inin: "anda t wayen tepcarakem
latin_inalco: sinna, ad asen inin: "anda t wayen tetcarakem
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵎ

ayah_content: war Öebbi"? A d inin: "dergen fella$. Xaîi! Ur illi wayen u$uô nepnuju, zik". Akka i Itellif Öebbi ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: war Ṛebbi"? A d inin: "dergen fellaɣ. Xaṭi! Ur illi wayen uɣuṛ netnuju, zik". Akka i Itellif Ṛebbi ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴷⵔⴳⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ. ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵏⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓ, ⵣⵉⴽ". ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵍⵍⵉⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Akka, $ef wayen tzehhum di tmurt, ur teklalem, akked wayen tqebêem.
latin_inalco: Akka, ɣef wayen tzehhum di tmurt, ur teklalem, akked wayen tqebḥem.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵣⵀⵀⵓⵎ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴽⵍⴰⵍⵎ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵇⴱⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: Kecmet Loahennama, si tebbura; degs twekkôem. Ay dir tanezdu$t imzuxiyen!
latin_inalco: Kecmet Lǧahennama, si tebbura; degs twekkṛem. Ay dir tanezduɣt imzuxiyen!
Tifinagh: ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ; ⴷⴳⵙ ⵜⵡⴽⴽⵕⵎ. ⴰⵢ ⴷⵉⵔ ⵜⴰⵏⵣⴷⵓⵖⵜ ⵉⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉⵢⵏ!

ayah_content: Eûbeô, war ccekk, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ad ak Nessken kra n wayen i sen Nâahed, ne$ a Neddem ôôuê ik. £uône£ ara d u$alen.
latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ, war ccekk, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi d tidet. Ad ak Nessken kra n wayen i sen Nɛahed, neɣ a Neddem ṛṛuḥ ik. ɣuṛneɣ ara d uɣalen.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵏⵄⴰⵀⴷ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⵎ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵉⴽ. ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nuzen ed imazanen uqbel ik. £ef kra segsen, Neêka yak d. £ef kra nniven, ur ak d Neêka ara. Ur iwata ara i umazan, a d iawi assekni, siwa ma s tsriê n Öebbi. Ma iusa d lameô n Öebbi, aseyyi s tidep. Ad xesôen, imiren, laâôuô.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nuzen ed imazanen uqbel ik. ɣef kra segsen, Neḥka yak d. ɣef kra nniḍen, ur ak d Neḥka ara. Ur iwata ara i umazan, a d iawi assekni, siwa ma s tsriḥ n Ṛebbi. Ma iusa d lameṛ n Ṛebbi, aseyyi s tidet. Ad xesṛen, imiren, laɛṛuṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ. ⵖⴼ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵏⵃⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⴽ ⴷ. ⵖⴼ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵏⵃⴽⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵙ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵙⵢⵢⵉ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⴰⴷ ⵅⵙⵕⵏ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ, ⵍⴰⵄⵕⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Öebbi i wen Ifkan lmal i rekba nnwen. Segsen teppeppem.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi i wen Ifkan lmal i rekba nnwen. Segsen tettettem.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽⴰⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵔⴽⴱⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵜⵎ.

ayah_content: Degsen, i kunwi, aba$uô akked agwav ar wayen id ssuturen idmaren nnwen. Fellasen, akw f ssfinat, teppâabbim.
latin_inalco: Degsen, i kunwi, abaɣuṛ akked agwaḍ ar wayen id ssuturen idmaren nnwen. Fellasen, akw f ssfinat, tettɛabbim.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⴱⴰⵖⵓⵕ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴰⴳⵡⴰⴹ ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵓⵔⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⴽⵡ ⴼ ⵙⵙⴼⵉⵏⴰⵜ, ⵜⵜⵜⵄⴰⴱⴱⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Issenâat awen d issekniyen iS. Anwi issekniyen n Öebbi ara tnekôem?
latin_inalco: Issenɛat awen d issekniyen iS. Anwi issekniyen n Ṛebbi ara tnekṛem?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵄⴰⵜ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏⴽⵕⵎ?

ayah_content: Day ur nudan ara tamurt ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten akken îîuqten, ifen ten tazmert akked lateô di tmurt. Ulay sen d ibbwi wayen la keppben.
latin_inalco: Day ur nudan ara tamurt ad walin amek teḍṛa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten akken ṭṭuqten, ifen ten tazmert akked lateṛ di tmurt. Ulay sen d ibbwi wayen la kettben.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⴹⵕⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⴼⵏ ⵜⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵟⵟⵓⵇⵜⵏ, ⵉⴼⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴰⵜⵕ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵓⵍⴰⵢ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⴰ ⴽⵜⵜⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi ten id usan imazanen nnsen s ubeggen, feôêen s tmusni i illan $uôsen. Izzi fellasen wayen i$ef ppemsexxiôen.
latin_inalco: Mi ten id usan imazanen nnsen s ubeggen, feṛḥen s tmusni i illan ɣuṛsen. Izzi fellasen wayen iɣef ttemsexxiṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ, ⴼⵕⵃⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ. ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵜⵎⵙⵅⵅⵉⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi walan tamnirt nne£, nnan: "numen s Öebbi Yiwen, nveggeô ayen i nella ncurek aS".
latin_inalco: Mi walan tamnirt nneɣ, nnan: "numen s Ṛebbi Yiwen, nḍeggeṛ ayen i nella ncurek aS".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵏⵉⵔⵜ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⵓⵎⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⵏⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⵏⵛⵓⵔⴽ ⴰⵙ".

ayah_content: Ur izmir ara a ten infaâ liman nnsen, mi walan tamnirt nne£. D tannumi n Öebbi, si zik, i imdanen iS. Akka ay xesôen ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Ur izmir ara a ten infaɛ liman nnsen, mi walan tamnirt nneɣ. D tannumi n Ṛebbi, si zik, i imdanen iS. Akka ay xesṛen ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵏⴼⴰⵄ ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵎⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵏⵉⵔⵜ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⴷ ⵜⴰⵏⵏⵓⵎⵉ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉ ⵣⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵅⵙⵕⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ëm.
latin_inalco: Ḥm.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: Tarusi s$uô Uênin Ipêunun,
latin_inalco: Tarusi sɣuṛ Uḥnin Itḥunun,
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓⵏ,

ayah_content: Tazmamt, feûûlen issekniyen is; Leqwôan s taâôabt, i ugdud issnen,
latin_inalco: Tazmamt, feṣṣlen issekniyen is; Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt, i ugdud issnen,
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴼⵚⵚⵍⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ; ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱⵜ, ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵏ,

ayah_content: ipbecciôen, ineddôen. Tegwti degsen numren, d$a ur sellen.
latin_inalco: itbecciṛen, ineddṛen. Tegwti degsen numren, dɣa ur sellen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⴱⵛⵛⵉⵕⵏ, ⵉⵏⴷⴷⵕⵏ. ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵏⵓⵎⵔⵏ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵍⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "ulawen nne$ ddurin i wayen i$eô la $ tneccdev; di tmejjin nne$: tiâéegt; garane$ yidek: sîeô. Ihi, exdem, nekwni la nxeddem".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "ulawen nneɣ ddurin i wayen iɣeṛ la ɣ tneccdeḍ; di tmejjin nneɣ: tiɛẓegt; garaneɣ yidek: sṭeṛ. Ihi, exdem, nekwni la nxeddem".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴷⴷⵓⵔⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⵕ ⵍⴰ ⵖ ⵜⵏⵛⵛⴷⴹ; ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵊⵊⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ: ⵜⵉⵄⵥⴳⵜ; ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ ⵢⵉⴷⴽ: ⵙⵟⵕ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵅⴷⵎ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵏⵅⴷⴷⵎ".

ayah_content: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weêêan iyi d kan ar Öebbi nnwen, d Öebbi Yiwen. Sweqmet $uôeS, ssutret aS ssmaê". A tawa$it n imcurak,
latin_inalco: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weḥḥan iyi d kan ar Ṛebbi nnwen, d Ṛebbi Yiwen. Sweqmet ɣuṛeS, ssutret aS ssmaḥ". A tawaɣit n imcurak,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ. ⵡⵃⵃⴰⵏ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ. ⵙⵡⵇⵎⵜ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵜ ⴰⵙ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ". ⴰ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ,

ayah_content: wid ur nepzekki, u nitni nekôen laxeôt!
latin_inalco: wid ur netzekki, u nitni nekṛen laxeṛt!
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵣⴽⴽⵉ, ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ!

ayah_content: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan: arraz ur nepnegzay.
latin_inalco: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan: arraz ur netnegzay.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ: ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵏⴳⵣⴰⵢ.

ayah_content: Ini: "kunwi aql akwen la tnekôem Win Ixelqen tamurt, di sin wussan. La S tepparam nned. Wagi d Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ini: "kunwi aql akwen la tnekṛem Win Ixelqen tamurt, di sin wussan. La S tettaram nned. Wagi d Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽⵡⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵏⴽⵕⵎ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵡⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ. ⵍⴰ ⵙ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰⵎ ⵏⵏⴷ. ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Irra degs idurar sufella. Iôqa p, Iwzen degs tagwella s, di kué wussan. Akka i wid isteqsayen.
latin_inalco: Irra degs idurar sufella. Iṛqa t, Iwzen degs tagwella s, di kuẓ wussan. Akka i wid isteqsayen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⵙⵓⴼⵍⵍⴰ. ⵉⵕⵇⴰ ⵜ, ⵉⵡⵣⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵡⵍⵍⴰ ⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⴽⵓⵥ ⵡⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵜⵇⵙⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Izzi ar igenni i illan d abbu. Inna yas, u i tmurt: "aset ed, teb$am ne$ tugim"! Nnan: "a n nas, d imvuâen".
latin_inalco: Sinna, Izzi ar igenni i illan d abbu. Inna yas, u i tmurt: "aset ed, tebɣam neɣ tugim"! Nnan: "a n nas, d imḍuɛen".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⴰⵔ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴱⴱⵓ. ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ: "ⴰⵙⵜ ⴷ, ⵜⴱⵖⴰⵎ ⵏⵖ ⵜⵓⴳⵉⵎ"! ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴰ ⵏ ⵏⴰⵙ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ".

ayah_content: Iseyya ten d ûa igenwan, di sin wussan. Iweêêa lameô is, i yal igenni. Ncebbeê igenni aqôib mavi, s teftilin, u d laânaya. D aya ay d Iqeddeô n Uzmir, Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Iseyya ten d ṣa igenwan, di sin wussan. Iweḥḥa lameṛ is, i yal igenni. Ncebbeḥ igenni aqṛib maḍi, s teftilin, u d laɛnaya. D aya ay d Iqeddeṛ n Uzmir, Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴷ ⵚⴰ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵡⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ. ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ, ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ. ⵏⵛⴱⴱⵃ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⴰⵇⵕⵉⴱ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⴼⵜⵉⵍⵉⵏ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵄⵏⴰⵢⴰ. ⴷ ⴰⵢⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵇⴷⴷⵕ ⵏ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Ma numren, ini: "ssagwde$ kwen s ssiâqa, am ssiâqa n Âad u Tamud".
latin_inalco: Ma numren, ini: "ssagwdeɣ kwen s ssiɛqa, am ssiɛqa n Ɛad u Tamud".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵓⵎⵔⵏ, ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵙⵙⴰⴳⵡⴷⵖ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵙⵙⵉⵄⵇⴰ, ⴰⵎ ⵙⵙⵉⵄⵇⴰ ⵏ ⵄⴰⴷ ⵓ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ".

ayah_content: Mi ten id usan imazanen, zdat sen, u deffir sen: "ur âabdet, siwa Öebbi"! Nnan: "lemmer i S ihwi i Mass nne$, a d Issers lmalayek. Nekwni, ihi, nenkeô ayen i s id teppuceggâam".
latin_inalco: Mi ten id usan imazanen, zdat sen, u deffir sen: "ur ɛabdet, siwa Ṛebbi"! Nnan: "lemmer i S ihwi i Mass nneɣ, a d Issers lmalayek. Nekwni, ihi, nenkeṛ ayen i s id tettuceggɛam".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ, ⵓ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ: "ⵓⵔ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵜ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ"! ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ. ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⵏⴽⵕ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵛⴳⴳⵄⴰⵎ".

ayah_content: Wanag Âad, sme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, ur klalen. Nnan: "anwa i $ i$elben di tezmert"? Day ur walan ara, Öebbi, iten id Ixelqen, I$elb iten di tezmert? Llan la nekôen issekniyen nne£.
latin_inalco: Wanag Ɛad, smeɣwṛen iman nnsen di tmurt, ur klalen. Nnan: "anwa i ɣ iɣelben di tezmert"? Day ur walan ara, Ṛebbi, iten id Ixelqen, Iɣelb iten di tezmert? Llan la nekṛen issekniyen nneɣ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵄⴰⴷ, ⵙⵎⵖⵡⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⴽⵍⴰⵍⵏ. ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵖⵍⴱⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ"? ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ, ⵉⵖⵍⴱ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ? ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ.

ayah_content: Nuzen asen aûeôûaô, deg ussan imevyaôen, iwakken a Nessukk fellasen, aâaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Aâaqeb n laxeôt, war ccekk, isdullu kteô. Ur asen ippili umâiwen.
latin_inalco: Nuzen asen aṣeṛṣaṛ, deg ussan imeḍyaṛen, iwakken a Nessukk fellasen, aɛaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Aɛaqeb n laxeṛt, war ccekk, isdullu kteṛ. Ur asen ittili umɛiwen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵚⵕⵚⴰⵕ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴹⵢⴰⵕⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵏⵙⵙⵓⴽⴽ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵎⴷⵍⵍⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ. ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵓ ⴽⵜⵕ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Wanag Tamud, Nebbwi ten d ubrid. Smenyafen tider$elt i nnhaya. Tewwet iten ssiâqa n uâaqeb issrusun, ilmend n wayen keppben.
latin_inalco: Wanag Tamud, Nebbwi ten d ubrid. Smenyafen tiderɣelt i nnhaya. Tewwet iten ssiɛqa n uɛaqeb issrusun, ilmend n wayen kettben.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ, ⵏⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵜⵏ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ. ⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵔⵖⵍⵜ ⵉ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ. ⵜⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙⵙⵉⵄⵇⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓⵏ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵜⵜⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Nsellek wid iumnen, i illan pêezziben.
latin_inalco: Nsellek wid iumnen, i illan tḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara ssemlilen ar tmessi, icenga n Öebbi, nitni ad pwajemmlen.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara ssemlilen ar tmessi, icenga n Ṛebbi, nitni ad twajemmlen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵙⵎⵍⵉⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵙⵙⵉ, ⵉⵛⵏⴳⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵊⵎⵎⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Alamma, mara awven $uôes, ad cehhden fellasen, $ef wayen xeddmen, imeééu$en nnsen, allen nnsen, d igwelman nnsen.
latin_inalco: Alamma, mara awḍen ɣuṛes, ad cehhden fellasen, ɣef wayen xeddmen, imeẓẓuɣen nnsen, allen nnsen, d igwelman nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵡⴹⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵛⵀⵀⴷⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ, ⵉⵎⵥⵥⵓⵖⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵍⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.
