ayah_content: Ad inin i igwelman nnsen: "acimi id tcuhhdem fella$"? A d inin: "Issenîeq a$ d Öebbi, id Issentaqen yal cci. Neppa, Ixelq ikwen tikelt tamezwarut, u $uôeS ara tu$alem".
latin_inalco: Ad inin i igwelman nnsen: "acimi id tcuhhdem fellaɣ"? A d inin: "Issenṭeq aɣ d Ṛebbi, id Issentaqen yal cci. Netta, Ixelq ikwen tikelt tamezwarut, u ɣuṛeS ara tuɣalem".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵉⴳⵡⵍⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⴰⵛⵉⵎⵉ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵛⵓⵀⵀⴷⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵟⵇ ⴰⵖ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵜⴰⵇⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵜⵉⴽⵍⵜ ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ, ⵓ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ".

ayah_content: Ur tezmirem ara a ppeffrem, ur cehhden fellawen imeééu$en nnwen, allen nnwen, akked igwelman nnwen. Maca, t$ilem ur Iéeô ara Öebbi, aîas n wayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: Ur tezmirem ara a tteffrem, ur cehhden fellawen imeẓẓuɣen nnwen, allen nnwen, akked igwelman nnwen. Maca, tɣilem ur Iẓeṛ ara Ṛebbi, aṭas n wayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵉⵔⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴼⴼⵔⵎ, ⵓⵔ ⵛⵀⵀⴷⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵥⵥⵓⵖⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵍⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⵖⵉⵍⵎ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵥⵕ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Akka ameyyez nnwen $ef Mass nnwen. Isqucc ikwen, tegwram d d imexsuôen.
latin_inalco: Akka ameyyez nnwen ɣef Mass nnwen. Isqucc ikwen, tegwram d d imexsuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵎⵢⵢⵣ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ, ⵜⴳⵡⵔⴰⵎ ⴷ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Xas ûebôen, di tmes ara zed$en. Ma ssutren ssmaê, ur llin d wid ara ipwaqeblen.
latin_inalco: Xas ṣebṛen, di tmes ara zedɣen. Ma ssutren ssmaḥ, ur llin d wid ara itwaqeblen.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵙ ⵚⴱⵕⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵣⴷⵖⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵇⴱⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Nefka yasen imeddukwal i sen icebbêen ayen illan zdat sen, akked wayen illan deffir sen. Iûaô fellasen wawal ger leoyus n yimdanen akw n leonun, i i$aben, uqbel nnsen. Ih, nitni d imexsuôen.
latin_inalco: Nefka yasen imeddukwal i sen icebbḥen ayen illan zdat sen, akked wayen illan deffir sen. Iṣaṛ fellasen wawal ger leǧyus n yimdanen akw n leǧnun, i iɣaben, uqbel nnsen. Ih, nitni d imexsuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴷⵓⴽⵡⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵛⴱⴱⵃⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ. ⵉⵚⴰⵕ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴳⵔ ⵍⴷⵊⵢⵓⵙ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵖⴰⴱⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur ssemêaset i Leqwôan agi. Ssekret fellas, ta$wegwa, ahat a prebêem".
latin_inalco: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur ssemḥaset i Leqwṛan agi. Ssekret fellas, taɣwegwa, ahat a trebḥem".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ: "ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙⵜ ⵉ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ. ⵙⵙⴽⵔⵜ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵜⴰⵖⵡⴳⵡⴰ, ⴰⵀⴰⵜ ⴰ ⵜⵔⴱⵃⵎ".

ayah_content: A Nessukk $ef wid ijehlen, aâaqeb uqsiê. A ten Nqeîîi sennig wayen xeddmen.
latin_inalco: A Nessukk ɣef wid ijehlen, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ. A ten Nqeṭṭi sennig wayen xeddmen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵏⵙⵙⵓⴽⴽ ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ. ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: D wagi ay d aqeîîi icenga n Öebbi: times; i nitni degs axxam n lebda; d aqeîîi, imi la nekôen issekniyen nne£.
latin_inalco: D wagi ay d aqeṭṭi icenga n Ṛebbi: times; i nitni degs axxam n lebda; d aqeṭṭi, imi la nekṛen issekniyen nneɣ.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵉⵛⵏⴳⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ: ⵜⵉⵎⵙ; ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷⴳⵙ ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏ ⵍⴱⴷⴰ; ⴷ ⴰⵇⵟⵟⵉ, ⵉⵎⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ.

ayah_content: Ad inin, wid ijehlen: "a Mass nne$! Essken a$ wid i $ i$elîen, d loenn ne$ d amdan; a ten neôkev, ad u$alen seg wid indellen mavi".
latin_inalco: Ad inin, wid ijehlen: "a Mass nneɣ! Essken aɣ wid i ɣ iɣelṭen, d lǧenn neɣ d amdan; a ten neṛkeḍ, ad uɣalen seg wid indellen maḍi".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⵙⵙⴽⵏ ⴰⵖ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵖⵍⵟⵏ, ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ; ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵕⴽⴹ, ⴰⴷ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⴷⵍⵍⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ".

ayah_content: Ih, wid innan: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi", sinna, nudan lewqama, a d rsent $uôsen lmalayek: "ur ppagwadet, ur $webblet; ppubeccôet s Loennet i wen ippuwaââden".
latin_inalco: Ih, wid innan: "Mass nneɣ d Ṛebbi", sinna, nudan lewqama, a d rsent ɣuṛsen lmalayek: "ur ttagwadet, ur ɣwebblet; ttubeccṛet s Lǧennet i wen ittuwaɛɛden".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ", ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵓⴷⴰⵏ ⵍⵡⵇⴰⵎⴰ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵔⵙⵏⵜ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ: "ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵖⵡⴱⴱⵍⵜ; ⵜⵜⵓⴱⵛⵛⵕⵜ ⵙ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ".

ayah_content: Nekwni d imawlan nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit u di laxeôt. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen i cedhant teôwiêin nnwen. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen tessutrem.
latin_inalco: Nekwni d imawlan nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit u di laxeṛt. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen i cedhant teṛwiḥin nnwen. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen tessutrem.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⵓ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ. ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵛⴷⵀⴰⵏⵜ ⵜⵕⵡⵉⵃⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵎ.

ayah_content: D tarusi s$uô Win Ipsemmiêen, Ipêunun.
latin_inalco: D tarusi sɣuṛ Win Itsemmiḥen, Itḥunun.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵏ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa yifen awal umâin n win inaâôen Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id innan: "nek, ih, seg imvuâen".
latin_inalco: Anwa yifen awal umɛin n win inaɛṛen Ṛebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id innan: "nek, ih, seg imḍuɛen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵢⵉⴼⵏ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⴰⵄⵕⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵉⵀ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ".

ayah_content: Ur iaâdil ise$ akked tucmip. Err ip akin, s wayen ip yifen. Ma tella cceêna, garak d yiwen, ad iu$al d aêbib i k iêemmlen.
latin_inalco: Ur iaɛdil iseɣ akked tucmit. Err it akin, s wayen it yifen. Ma tella cceḥna, garak d yiwen, ad iuɣal d aḥbib i k iḥemmlen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴰⵄⴷⵉⵍ ⵉⵙⵖ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ. ⵔⵔ ⵉⵜ ⴰⴽⵉⵏ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵢⵉⴼⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵍⵍⴰ ⵛⵛⵃⵏⴰ, ⴳⴰⵔⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴷ ⴰⵃⴱⵉⴱ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur teppunefk siwa i wid iûebbôen. Ur teppunefk, siwa i bu sser abarar.
latin_inalco: Ur tettunefk siwa i wid iṣebbṛen. Ur tettunefk, siwa i bu sser abarar.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵚⴱⴱⵕⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉ ⴱⵓ ⵙⵙⵔ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Ma iccacev ak Cciîan tuccva, ssuter laânaya n Öebbi. Ih, Neppa d win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Ma iccaceḍ ak Cciṭan tuccḍa, ssuter laɛnaya n Ṛebbi. Ih, Netta d win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵛⵛⴰⵛⴹ ⴰⴽ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ, ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔ ⵍⴰⵄⵏⴰⵢⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵍⵍⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Seg issekniyen iS, ass akked yiv, iîij akked waggur. Ur kennut ara i yiîij, ne$ i waggur. Knut i Öebbi, iten id Ixelqen, ma d Neppa ay tâabbdem.
latin_inalco: Seg issekniyen iS, ass akked yiḍ, iṭij akked waggur. Ur kennut ara i yiṭij, neɣ i waggur. Knut i Ṛebbi, iten id Ixelqen, ma d Netta ay tɛabbdem.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵢⵉⴹ, ⵉⵟⵉⵊ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ. ⵓⵔ ⴽⵏⵏⵓⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵢⵉⵟⵉⵊ, ⵏⵖ ⵉ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ. ⴽⵏⵓⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴱⴷⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma zuxxen, ihi, wid illan ar Mass ik, sbuccuâen T iv akked wass, ur âaggun.
latin_inalco: Ma zuxxen, ihi, wid illan ar Mass ik, sbuccuɛen T iḍ akked wass, ur ɛaggun.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵣⵓⵅⵅⵏ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ ⵜ ⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵄⴰⴳⴳⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Seg issekniyen iS: a pwaliv, keçç, akal iqquô; lemmer ad as Nesse$li aman, a d iakwi, ad icuff. Win it id Issadren, d Win ara d Issidren lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa, Izmer i yal cci.
latin_inalco: Seg issekniyen iS: a twaliḍ, kečč, akal iqquṛ; lemmer ad as Nesseɣli aman, a d iakwi, ad icuff. Win it id Issadren, d Win ara d Issidren lmeggtin. Ih, Netta, Izmer i yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ: ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴰⴽⴰⵍ ⵉⵇⵇⵓⵕ; ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⴽⵡⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵛⵓⴼⴼ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔⵏ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵔⵏ ⵍⵎⴳⴳⵜⵉⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid issexûaôen issekniyen nne£, ur drigen fellane£. Menyif win ara ipwaveggôen ar tmes, ne$ win ara iasen di laman, ass n tnekra? Xedmet ayen i wen ihwan. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid issexṣaṛen issekniyen nneɣ, ur drigen fellaneɣ. Menyif win ara itwaḍeggṛen ar tmes, neɣ win ara iasen di laman, ass n tnekra? Xedmet ayen i wen ihwan. Netta, s tidet, Itwali ayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵅⵚⴰⵕⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⵔⵉⴳⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵏⵖ. ⵎⵏⵢⵉⴼ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴹⴳⴳⵕⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⵏⵖ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⴰⵙⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ? ⵅⴷⵎⵜ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Akka, wid inekôen asmekti, mi ten id iusa, u neppat ard Tazmamt tuzmirt.
latin_inalco: Akka, wid inekṛen asmekti, mi ten id iusa, u nettat ard Tazmamt tuzmirt.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ, ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵜ ⴰⵔⴷ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵜⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔⵜ.

ayah_content: Ur d iusi le$wlav zdat es, ne$ deffir es. D tarusi s$uô Bab n ûûwab, Amaâzuz.
latin_inalco: Ur d iusi leɣwlaḍ zdat es, neɣ deffir es. D tarusi sɣuṛ Bab n ṣṣwab, Amaɛzuz.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⵉ ⵍⵖⵡⵍⴰⴹ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵙ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙ. ⴷ ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴰⵎⴰⵄⵣⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: Awal i k id iusan, d win kan id iusan imazanen, uqbel ik. Mass ik, ih, ard Bab n ssmaê, d Bab uâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Awal i k id iusan, d win kan id iusan imazanen, uqbel ik. Mass ik, ih, ard Bab n ssmaḥ, d Bab uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ. ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Lemmer Nerri Leqwôan s tmeslayt tabeôôanit, a d inin: "lemmer feûûlen issekniyen iS s wawal abeôôani, u s taâôabt"? Ini: "neppa, i wid iumnen, d nnhaya u d ccafuâa. Wid ur numin ara, âaégent tmejjin nnsen. Neppa, i nitni, d tider$elt. Widak pwanecden seg umkan ibaâden".
latin_inalco: Lemmer Nerri Leqwṛan s tmeslayt tabeṛṛanit, a d inin: "lemmer feṣṣlen issekniyen iS s wawal abeṛṛani, u s taɛṛabt"? Ini: "netta, i wid iumnen, d nnhaya u d ccafuɛa. Wid ur numin ara, ɛaẓgent tmejjin nnsen. Netta, i nitni, d tiderɣelt. Widak twanecden seg umkan ibaɛden".
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵏⵔⵔⵉ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢⵜ ⵜⴰⴱⵕⵕⴰⵏⵉⵜ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴼⵚⵚⵍⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴰⴱⵕⵕⴰⵏⵉ, ⵓ ⵙ ⵜⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱⵜ"? ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵓ ⴷ ⵛⵛⴰⴼⵓⵄⴰ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵄⴰⵥⴳⵏⵜ ⵜⵎⵊⵊⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵔⵖⵍⵜ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⴱⴰⵄⴷⵏ".

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili tefra garasen. Nitni, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal sɣuṛ Mass ik, yili tefra garasen. Nitni, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ. ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵜⴼⵔⴰ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ ⵉⵎⵛⴱⴱⵡⵍ.

ayah_content: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win iccven, mgal iman is. Mass ik ur Idennis ara imdanen.
latin_inalco: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win iccḍen, mgal iman is. Mass ik ur Idennis ara imdanen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ; ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵛⵛⴹⵏ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵓⵔ ⵉⴷⵏⵏⵉⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: £uôeS ay tella tmusni n yimir. Ur d iteffe$ uzway si txeddact is, ur treffed nnta tadist, ur tepparew, siwa ma Iéôa. Ass ideg ar asen Isiwel: "anda ten icriken iW"? A d inin: "ad aK nini, ur illi garane$ unagi".
latin_inalco: ɣuṛeS ay tella tmusni n yimir. Ur d iteffeɣ uzway si txeddact is, ur treffed nnta tadist, ur tettarew, siwa ma Iẓṛa. Ass ideg ar asen Isiwel: "anda ten icriken iW"? A d inin: "ad aK nini, ur illi garaneɣ unagi".
Tifinagh: ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵍⵍⴰ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ. ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⴼⴼⵖ ⵓⵣⵡⴰⵢ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⴰⵛⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵔⴼⴼⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ ⵜⴰⴷⵉⵙⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵔⵡ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ. ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵉⵡⵍ: "ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵛⵔⵉⴽⵏ ⵉⵡ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⵏⵉⵏⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ ⵓⵏⴰⴳⵉ".

ayah_content: Iooa ten wayen u$uô pnujun zik. Fehmen, ur asen illi ssôan.
latin_inalco: Iǧǧa ten wayen uɣuṛ tnujun zik. Fehmen, ur asen illi ssṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓⵏ ⵣⵉⴽ. ⴼⵀⵎⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵙⵙⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur ifeccel ara umdan di tuppra n lxiô. Ma inul it lqeôê, ad iayes, ad innu$ben.
latin_inalco: Ur ifeccel ara umdan di tuttra n lxiṛ. Ma inul it lqeṛḥ, ad iayes, ad innuɣben.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴼⵛⵛⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵓⵜⵜⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵏⵓⵍ ⵉⵜ ⵍⵇⵕⵃ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴰⵢⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⵓⵖⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma Nseêess as aêunu nne£, deffir ccqa i t iêuzan, war ccekk, ad yini: "ayagi inu. Ur cukke$ ara imir a d ias. Ma bbwve$ s afus n Mass iw, ad afe$ $uôeS ûûam". Ih, a Nbeggen ayen xedmen, i wid ijehlen, u, ih, ad Nsâaddi fellasen aâaqeb iwaâôen.
latin_inalco: Ma Nseḥess as aḥunu nneɣ, deffir ccqa i t iḥuzan, war ccekk, ad yini: "ayagi inu. Ur cukkeɣ ara imir a d ias. Ma bbwḍeɣ s afus n Mass iw, ad afeɣ ɣuṛeS ṣṣam". Ih, a Nbeggen ayen xedmen, i wid ijehlen, u, ih, ad Nsɛaddi fellasen aɛaqeb iwaɛṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵙⵃⵙⵙ ⴰⵙ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵛⵛⵇⴰ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵃⵓⵣⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⵉⵏⵓ. ⵓⵔ ⵛⵓⴽⴽⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⴱⴱⵡⴹⵖ ⵙ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⴼⵖ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ". ⵉⵀ, ⴰ ⵏⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⵓ, ⵉⵀ, ⴰⴷ ⵏⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵡⴰⵄⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma N$at amdan ad iwexxeô, izzi akin. Ma iêuza t lêif, ad ipnuju, irennu.
latin_inalco: Ma Nɣat amdan ad iwexxeṛ, izzi akin. Ma iḥuza t lḥif, ad itnuju, irennu.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵖⴰⵜ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕ, ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⴰⴽⵉⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵃⵓⵣⴰ ⵜ ⵍⵃⵉⴼ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓ, ⵉⵔⵏⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ini: "tmeyyzem ma iusa d s$uô Öebbi, u kunwi tnekôem t"? Anwa innetlafen sennig win illan di ticuîna tu$miqt?
latin_inalco: Ini: "tmeyyzem ma iusa d sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, u kunwi tnekṛem t"? Anwa innetlafen sennig win illan di ticuṭna tuɣmiqt?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵜⵎⵢⵢⵣⵎ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵜⵏⴽⵕⵎ ⵜ"? ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⵛⵓⵟⵏⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⵎⵉⵇⵜ?

ayah_content: Ad asen Nessken issekniyen nne£ di tmurt akked igenwan, u deg iman nnsen, alamma pputebbten ar neppa d tidep. Day ur Iqadd ara Mass ik mi Neppa, war ccekk, d Anagi n yal cci?
latin_inalco: Ad asen Nessken issekniyen nneɣ di tmurt akked igenwan, u deg iman nnsen, alamma ttutebbten ar netta d tidet. Day ur Iqadd ara Mass ik mi Netta, war ccekk, d Anagi n yal cci?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵓ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵇⴰⴷⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵎⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ?

ayah_content: Day, s tidep, cukken timlilit d Mass nnsen? Day Neppa, s tidep, ur Izzi ara i yal cci?
latin_inalco: Day, s tidet, cukken timlilit d Mass nnsen? Day Netta, s tidet, ur Izzi ara i yal cci?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵛⵓⴽⴽⵏ ⵜⵉⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ?

ayah_content: Ëm.
latin_inalco: Ḥm.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: Âsq.
latin_inalco: Ɛsq.
Tifinagh: ⵄⵙⵇ.

ayah_content: Akka i Iweêêa i keçç, akked wid ik id izwaren, Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Akka i Iweḥḥa i kečč, akked wid ik id izwaren, Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵉ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Neppa, d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôahan.
latin_inalco: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Netta, d Aɛlayen, d Ameqwṛahan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Qôib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaâ s ccekôan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad pwassemêen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu?
latin_inalco: Qṛib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaɛ s ccekṛan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad twassemḥen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Ṛebbi Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu?
Tifinagh: ⵇⵕⵉⴱ ⴰⴷ ⵛⵛⵔⴳⵏ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵅⴼⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵀⵉⵏⵜ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ, ⵓ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵓⵔⵏⵜ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵎⵃⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ?

ayah_content: Wid irran imawlan, war Neppa, Iquôaâ ten Öebbi. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.
latin_inalco: Wid irran imawlan, war Netta, Iquṛaɛ ten Ṛebbi. Ur telliḍ, kečč, d awkil nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵇⵓⵕⴰⵄ ⵜⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⴹ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⴽⵉⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Akka ay k n Nweêêa Leqwôan, s taâôabt, iwakken a pnedôev tayimmap n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a pnedôev af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaâ di Loennet, arbaâ deg ujajiê.
latin_inalco: Akka ay k n Nweḥḥa Leqwṛan, s taɛṛabt, iwakken a tnedṛeḍ tayimmat n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a tnedṛeḍ af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaɛ di Lǧennet, arbaɛ deg ujajiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴽ ⵏ ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱⵜ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵏⴷⵕⴹ ⵜⴰⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵣⵉⵏ; ⴰ ⵜⵏⴷⵕⴹ ⴰⴼ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ; ⴰⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⴰⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lois. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uêunu S. Imednas, ur sâin bab ne$ asettaô.
latin_inalco: Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lǧis. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uḥunu S. Imednas, ur sɛin bab neɣ asettaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵉⵣⴷⵓⴽⴽⵍ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ. ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵉⵏ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏⵖ ⴰⵙⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ne$ rran imawlan, war Neppa. Öebbi d Neppa ay d Bab, d Neppa i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Neppa i Izemren i yal cci.
latin_inalco: Neɣ rran imawlan, war Netta. Ṛebbi d Netta ay d Bab, d Netta i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Netta i Izemren i yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ, ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔⵏ ⵍⵎⴳⴳⵜⵉⵏ, ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵣⵎⵔⵏ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ayen akw i$ef temgarradem, aêuddu s ar Öebbi. Akka Öebbi, Mass iw; fellaS ppekle$, $eô Neppa ay steôoiâe$.
latin_inalco: Ayen akw iɣef temgarradem, aḥuddu s ar Ṛebbi. Akka Ṛebbi, Mass iw; fellaS ttekleɣ, ɣeṛ Netta ay steṛǧiɛeɣ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵎ, ⴰⵃⵓⴷⴷⵓ ⵙ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ; ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵜⵜⴽⵍⵖ, ⵖⵕ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵉⵄⵖ.

ayah_content: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Seg iman nnwen Irra yawen tiyugiwin; si lmal nnwen, tiyugiwin. Isfukti kwen yisent. Ur illi wayen i T icban. Neppa Issel, Ipwali.
latin_inalco: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Seg iman nnwen Irra yawen tiyugiwin; si lmal nnwen, tiyugiwin. Isfukti kwen yisent. Ur illi wayen i T icban. Netta Issel, Itwali.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵜⵉⵢⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ; ⵙⵉ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵜⵉⵢⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ. ⵉⵙⴼⵓⴽⵜⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵢⵉⵙⵏⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵛⴱⴰⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵍ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: IneS tisura n tmurt akked igenwan. Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, Iwezzen. Ih, Neppa Issen yal cci.
latin_inalco: IneS tisura n tmurt akked igenwan. Issugut ṛṛeẓq i win i S ihwan, Iwezzen. Ih, Netta Issen yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⵉⵙⵓⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴳⵓⵜ ⵕⵕⵥⵇ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉⵡⵣⵣⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Issers awen d, di ddin, ayen i$ef Iweûûa Nuê. Ayen i k Nweêêa, d ayen i$ef Nweûûa Ibôahim, Musa, akked Âisa: "sbeddet ddin, ur ppemgarradet fellas". èÈÈéay, i imcurak, wayen u$uô la ten tneccdev. Öebbi Ippawi $uôeS, win i S ihwan; Inehhu $uôeS, win isteôoiâen.
latin_inalco: Issers awen d, di ddin, ayen iɣef Iweṣṣa Nuḥ. Ayen i k Nweḥḥa, d ayen iɣef Nweṣṣa Ibṛahim, Musa, akked Ɛisa: "sbeddet ddin, ur ttemgarradet fellas". ẓẒẒẓay, i imcurak, wayen uɣuṛ la ten tneccdeḍ. Ṛebbi Ittawi ɣuṛeS, win i S ihwan; Inehhu ɣuṛeS, win isteṛǧiɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ, ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵡⵚⵚⴰ ⵏⵓⵃ. ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⴽ ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵏⵡⵚⵚⴰ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ, ⵎⵓⵙⴰ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵄⵉⵙⴰ: "ⵙⴱⴷⴷⵜ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵜ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ". ⵥⵥⵥⵥⴰⵢ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ, ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵜⵏⵛⵛⴷⴹ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ; ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵉⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur mfaôaqen armi ten id tusa tussna. Ppemvuddun. Lemmer ur d izwar wawal s$uô Mass ik $ef lmijal ipwassnen, yili myefran. Ih, wid iweôten Tazmamt deffir sen, haaten, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
latin_inalco: Ur mfaṛaqen armi ten id tusa tussna. Ptemḍuddun. Lemmer ur d izwar wawal sɣuṛ Mass ik ɣef lmijal itwassnen, yili myefran. Ih, wid iweṛten Tazmamt deffir sen, haaten, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵎⴼⴰⵕⴰⵇⵏ ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵓⵙⵙⵏⴰ. Pⵜⵎⴹⵓⴷⴷⵓⵏ. ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵖⴼ ⵍⵎⵉⵊⴰⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵎⵢⴼⵔⴰⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵡⵕⵜⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ, ⵀⴰⴰⵜⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ ⵉⵎⵛⴱⴱⵡⵍ.

ayah_content: Ilmend n waya, enced, ssewqem akken i tepwamôev, ur teddu d cchawi nnsen. Ini: "umne$ s wayen id Issader Öebbi n Tira. Pwamôe$ d ad wezne$ garawen. Öebbi d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen. I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppili nnmara garane$. Öebbi ad a$ Issemlil. Tu$alin $uôeS".
latin_inalco: Ilmend n waya, enced, ssewqem akken i tetwamṛeḍ, ur teddu d cchawi nnsen. Ini: "umneɣ s wayen id Issader Ṛebbi n Tira. Pwamṛeɣ d ad wezneɣ garawen. Ṛebbi d Mass nneɣ, u d Mass nnwen. I nekwni igiten nneɣ, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur tettili nnmara garaneɣ. Ṛebbi ad aɣ Issemlil. Tuɣalin ɣuṛeS".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵏⵛⴷ, ⵙⵙⵡⵇⵎ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵜⵡⴰⵎⵕⴹ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴷⴷⵓ ⴷ ⵛⵛⵀⴰⵡⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵎⵏⵖ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵔⴰ. Pⵡⴰⵎⵕⵖ ⴷ ⴰⴷ ⵡⵣⵏⵖ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵏⵏⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵍⵉⵍ. ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ".

ayah_content: Wid ipnamaren af Öebbi, deffir wagwav n loawab $uôsen, ur teswi nnmara nnsen, ar Mass nnsen. Fellasen zzâaf, fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê.
latin_inalco: Wid itnamaren af Ṛebbi, deffir wagwaḍ n lǧawab ɣuṛsen, ur teswi nnmara nnsen, ar Mass nnsen. Fellasen zzɛaf, fellasen aɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⴳⵡⴰⴹ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵡⴰⴱ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵡⵉ ⵏⵏⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵣⵣⵄⴰⴼ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Öebbi id Issadren Tazmamt, s tidep, akked lmizan. W ad ak imlen, ahat imir iqeôb ed?
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi id Issadren Tazmamt, s tidet, akked lmizan. W ad ak imlen, ahat imir iqeṛb ed?
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ. ⵡ ⴰⴷ ⴰⴽ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ, ⴰⵀⴰⵜ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ ⵉⵇⵕⴱ ⴷ?

ayah_content: Ëaren $uôes wid ur numin ara yis. Ma d wid iumnen, ugaden t; éôan ar neppa d tidep. Ih, wid icukken deg imir, haaten, war ccekk, di ttelfan u$miq.
latin_inalco: Ḥaren ɣuṛes wid ur numin ara yis. Ma d wid iumnen, ugaden t; ẓṛan ar netta d tidet. Ih, wid icukken deg imir, haaten, war ccekk, di ttelfan uɣmiq.
Tifinagh: ⵃⴰⵔⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ ⵜ; ⵥⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵛⵓⴽⴽⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⵀⴰⴰⵜⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⵓⵖⵎⵉⵇ.

ayah_content: Öebbi d Laîif i imdanen iS. Ip$iti win i S ihwan. Neppa d Uohid, d Uzmir.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi d Laṭif i imdanen iS. Itɣiti win i S ihwan. Netta d Uǧhid, d Uzmir.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵟⵉⴼ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵜⵖⵉⵜⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵓⴷⵊⵀⵉⴷ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Win ib$an tayerza n laxeôt, ad as Nernu di tyerza ines. Win ib$an tayerza n ddunit, ad as Nefk segs. Ur as illi umur di laxeôt.
latin_inalco: Win ibɣan tayerza n laxeṛt, ad as Nernu di tyerza ines. Win ibɣan tayerza n ddunit, ad as Nefk segs. Ur as illi umur di laxeṛt.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵢⵔⵣⴰ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⵔⵏⵓ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵢⵔⵣⴰ ⵉⵏⵙ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵢⵔⵣⴰ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⴼⴽ ⵙⴳⵙ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵎⵓⵔ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ.

ayah_content: Ne$ sâan icriken, sse$ôen ten di ddin ur Iqbil Öebbi? Lemmer ur d izwir ara wawal n ufraz, a p fru garasen. I imednas, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Neɣ sɛan icriken, sseɣṛen ten di ddin ur Iqbil Ṛebbi? Lemmer ur d izwir ara wawal n ufraz, a t fru garasen. I imednas, war ccekk, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵉⵛⵔⵉⴽⵏ, ⵙⵙⵖⵕⵏ ⵜⵏ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵇⴱⵉⵍ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⵉⵔ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⵣ, ⴰ ⵜ ⴼⵔⵓ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ. ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: A pwaliv imednas feqâen ilmend n wayen kesben, u neppa iddehm ed fellasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di tebêirin n leonanat. Nnsen i sen ihwan $uô Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d lfevl ameqwôan.
latin_inalco: A twaliḍ imednas feqɛen ilmend n wayen kesben, u netta iddehm ed fellasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di tebḥirin n leǧnanat. Nnsen i sen ihwan ɣuṛ Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d lfeḍl ameqwṛan.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ ⴼⵇⵄⵏ ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ, ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⴷⴷⵀⵎ ⴷ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴱⵃⵉⵔⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ. ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ ⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D wagi is Ipbecciô Öebbi imdanen iS, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ taqdiât, af waya, siwa lmaênana i llezm nnwen". Win ixedmen ise$, ad as Nernu degs lehhu. Öebbi, ih, Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.
latin_inalco: D wagi is Itbecciṛ Ṛebbi imdanen iS, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ini: "ur awen ssutreɣ taqdiɛt, af waya, siwa lmaḥnana i llezm nnwen". Win ixedmen iseɣ, ad as Nernu degs lehhu. Ṛebbi, ih, Itsemmiḥ, Ittara tajmilt.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⵉⵙ ⵉⵜⴱⵛⵛⵉⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵖ ⵜⴰⵇⴷⵉⵄⵜ, ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵍⵎⴰⵃⵏⴰⵏⴰ ⵉ ⵍⵍⵣⵎ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ". ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⵙⵖ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⵔⵏⵓ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵍⵀⵀⵓ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵊⵎⵉⵍⵜ.

ayah_content: Ne$ a d inin: "isnulfa d tikerkas af Öebbi". Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad Icemmaâ ul ik. S wawal iS, ad Isqucc Öebbi tikerkas, ad Iêeqqeq tidep. Ih, Neppa Iéôa tababnit n idmaren.
latin_inalco: Neɣ a d inin: "isnulfa d tikerkas af Ṛebbi". Ma ihwa yaS i Ṛebbi, ad Icemmaɛ ul ik. S wawal iS, ad Isqucc Ṛebbi tikerkas, ad Iḥeqqeq tidet. Ih, Netta Iẓṛa tababnit n idmaren.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵉⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ". ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵛⵎⵎⴰⵄ ⵓⵍ ⵉⴽ. ⵙ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵇⵇⵇ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵜⴰⴱⴰⴱⵏⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Iqeblen nndama n yimdanen iS. Ipsemmiê tucmitin. Issen ayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Iqeblen nndama n yimdanen iS. Itsemmiḥ tucmitin. Issen ayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵇⴱⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⴷⴰⵎⴰ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ. ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Issemêas i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb uqsiê.
latin_inalco: Issemḥas i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ad asen Irnu si lfeḍl iS. I ijehliyen, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵔⵏⵓ ⵙⵉ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵉⵙ. ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Ma Issuget Öebbi l$it i imdanen iS, ad be$wven di tmurt. Maca, Issrusu d, s lmizan, ayen i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa Ippuxebbeô $ef imdanen iS, Ipwali ten.
latin_inalco: Ma Issuget Ṛebbi lɣit i imdanen iS, ad beɣwḍen di tmurt. Maca, Issrusu d, s lmizan, ayen i S ihwan. Ih, Netta Ittuxebbeṛ ɣef imdanen iS, Itwali ten.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴳⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴱⵖⵡⴹⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ ⴷ, ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵅⴱⴱⵕ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa id Isse$layen ageffur mara aysen. Iweppaâ aêunu S. Neppa d Bab, d Amaâzuz.
latin_inalco: D Netta id Isseɣlayen ageffur mara aysen. Iwettaɛ aḥunu S. Netta d Bab, d Amaɛzuz.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵢⵙⵏ. ⵉⵡⵜⵜⴰⵄ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵄⵣⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: Seg issekniyen iS, lxelq n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan n lewêuc, degsen. Izmer Neppa, ma ihwa yaS, a ten id Issemlil.
latin_inalco: Seg issekniyen iS, lxelq n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan n lewḥuc, degsen. Izmer Netta, ma ihwa yaS, a ten id Issemlil.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵡⵃⵓⵛ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ. ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵍⵉⵍ.

ayah_content: Kra n tiyta ikwen iwwten, siwa ayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen. Aîas i Ipsemmiê.
latin_inalco: Kra n tiyta ikwen iwwten, siwa ayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen. Aṭas i Itsemmiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵡⵡⵜⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⴱⴱⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Ur tezmirem a ppesfunngem di tmurt. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.
latin_inalco: Ur tezmirem a ttesfunngem di tmurt. Ur awen illi, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ asettaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵉⵔⵎ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⴼⵓⵏⵏⴳⵎ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏⵖ ⴰⵙⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Seg issekniyen iS, ssfinat di yill, amzun d idurar.
latin_inalco: Seg issekniyen iS, ssfinat di yill, amzun d idurar.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵙⴼⵉⵏⴰⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵢⵉⵍⵍ, ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Ma ihwa yaS ad Issens avu, ad êebsent, d tusbivin sufella s. War ccekk, ayagi d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.
latin_inalco: Ma ihwa yaS ad Issens aḍu, ad ḥebsent, d tusbiḍin sufella s. War ccekk, ayagi d issekniyen i yal aṣebṛi isnemmiren.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵙ ⴰⴹⵓ, ⴰⴷ ⵃⴱⵙⵏⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⴱⵉⴹⵉⵏ ⵙⵓⴼⵍⵍⴰ ⵙ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵚⴱⵕⵉ ⵉⵙⵏⵎⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ne$ a ten Issenger ilmend n wayen kesben. Aîas i Ipsemmiê.
latin_inalco: Neɣ a ten Issenger ilmend n wayen kesben. Aṭas i Itsemmiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ. ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Ad éôen wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, ar ur asen illi ssôan.
latin_inalco: Ad ẓṛen wid itnamaren ɣef issekniyen nneɣ, ar ur asen illi ssṛan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵙⵙⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ayen akw i wen ippunefken n wayla, d zzhu n tmeddurt di ddunit. Ayen illan ar Öebbi, yif it; ad idum kteô, i wid iumnen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen;
latin_inalco: Ayen akw i wen ittunefken n wayla, d zzhu n tmeddurt di ddunit. Ayen illan ar Ṛebbi, yif it; ad idum kteṛ, i wid iumnen, itteklen ɣef Mass nnsen;
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽⵏ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵍⴰ, ⴷ ⵣⵣⵀⵓ ⵏ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ. ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵢⵉⴼ ⵉⵜ; ⴰⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵎ ⴽⵜⵕ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ;

ayah_content: wid ijunben ibekkaven ibararen, akked lâaô, u ssurufen i wid i ten isserfan;
latin_inalco: wid ijunben ibekkaḍen ibararen, akked lɛaṛ, u ssurufen i wid i ten isserfan;
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵓⵏⴱⵏ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵉⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵄⴰⵕ, ⵓ ⵙⵙⵓⵔⵓⴼⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⴼⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: wid id ipjawaben i Mass nnsen, péallan, ppemcawaôen $ef lameô nnsen, pseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at;
latin_inalco: wid id itjawaben i Mass nnsen, tẓallan, ttemcawaṛen ɣef lameṛ nnsen, tseddiqen seg wayen iten Nɣat;
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵊⴰⵡⴰⴱⵏ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⴰⵏ, ⵜⵜⵎⵛⴰⵡⴰⵕⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵙⴷⴷⵉⵇⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵖⴰⵜ;

ayah_content: wid, ma iusa ten lbe$wv, ad qablen.
latin_inalco: wid, ma iusa ten lbeɣwḍ, ad qablen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵍⴱⵖⵡⴹ, ⴰⴷ ⵇⴰⴱⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Aqeîîi n tucmip, d tucmip i p icban. Win isemmêen, issweqmen, arraz is ar Öebbi. Neppa, ih, ur Iêemmel ara imednas.
latin_inalco: Aqeṭṭi n tucmit, d tucmit i t icban. Win isemmḥen, issweqmen, arraz is ar Ṛebbi. Netta, ih, ur Iḥemmel ara imednas.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵛⴱⴰⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃⵏ, ⵉⵙⵙⵡⵇⵎⵏ, ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵉⵙ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵀ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Ma d wid id irran ppaô mi pwadensen, ur telli tiyta degsen.
latin_inalco: Ma d wid id irran ttaṛ mi twadensen, ur telli tiyta degsen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ ⵎⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉ ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Tiyta, kan, deg wid ivuôôen imdanen, iqehôen di tmurt, war ssebba. I wigi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Tiyta, kan, deg wid iḍuṛṛen imdanen, iqehṛen di tmurt, war ssebba. I wigi, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ, ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴹⵓⵕⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵉⵇⵀⵕⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵙⵙⴱⴱⴰ. ⵉ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma d win iûebôen, isemmêen, ayagi, s tidep, d aseyyi n lumuô.
latin_inalco: Ma d win iṣebṛen, isemmḥen, ayagi, s tidet, d aseyyi n lumuṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵚⴱⵕⵏ, ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃⵏ, ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵢⵢⵉ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵎⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur isâi bab, deffir eS. A pwaliv imednas, mara éôen aâaqeb, ad inin: "ma illa ubrid n tu$alin"?
latin_inalco: Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur isɛi bab, deffir eS. A twaliḍ imednas, mara ẓṛen aɛaqeb, ad inin: "ma illa ubrid n tuɣalin"?
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵄⵉ ⴱⴰⴱ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙ. ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵥⵕⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ"?

ayah_content: A ten twaliv pwafessren fellas, ndellen, ggaren tiî s tugwdi. Ad inin wid iumnen: "imexsuôen, s tidep, d wid i sxesôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". War ccekk, deg uâaqeb imezgi, ara yilin imednas.
latin_inalco: A ten twaliḍ twafessren fellas, ndellen, ggaren tiṭ s tugwdi. Ad inin wid iumnen: "imexsuṛen, s tidet, d wid i sxesṛen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". War ccekk, deg uɛaqeb imezgi, ara yilin imednas.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵜⵡⴰⴼⵙⵙⵔⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵏⴷⵍⵍⵏ, ⴳⴳⴰⵔⵏ ⵜⵉⵟ ⵙ ⵜⵓⴳⵡⴷⵉ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ: "ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵙⵅⵙⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ". ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Ur asen llin imawlan, ara ten isellken, war Öebbi. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur isâi abrid.
latin_inalco: Ur asen llin imawlan, ara ten isellken, war Ṛebbi. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur isɛi abrid.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵄⵉ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ.

ayah_content: Jawbet i Mass nnwen, uqbel a d ias, s$uô Öebbi, ass ur nepwexxiô. Ur awen ippili ssôan assen, ur tezmirem a pnekôem.
latin_inalco: Jawbet i Mass nnwen, uqbel a d ias, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ass ur netwexxiṛ. Ur awen ittili ssṛan assen, ur tezmirem a tnekṛem.
Tifinagh: ⵊⴰⵡⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵙⵙⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⵉⵔⵎ ⴰ ⵜⵏⴽⵕⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma numren, ur k id Nuzen ara d amêareb nnsen. Ay fellak, siwa timenna. Ih, mara Nesêess i umdan aêunu s$uône£, ad ifôeê yis. Mara t tsami tucmip, id bbwin ifassen is, s tidep, amdan ad ikaraâ.
latin_inalco: Ma numren, ur k id Nuzen ara d amḥareb nnsen. Ay fellak, siwa timenna. Ih, mara Nesḥess i umdan aḥunu sɣuṛneɣ, ad ifṛeḥ yis. Mara t tsami tucmit, id bbwin ifassen is, s tidet, amdan ad ikaraɛ.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵓⵎⵔⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵃⴰⵔⴱ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⵢ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⵉⵎⵏⵏⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⵙⵃⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴼⵕⵃ ⵢⵉⵙ. ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵜⵙⴰⵎⵉ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ, ⵉⴷ ⴱⴱⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⴰⵔⴰⵄ.

ayah_content: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ippak nnta i win i S ihwan, Ippak ddkeô i win i S ihwan.
latin_inalco: N Ṛebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ittak nnta i win i S ihwan, Ittak ddkeṛ i win i S ihwan.
Tifinagh: ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵉⵅⵍⵍⵇ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ne$ Ipcarak ddkeô d nnta. Isaâqaô win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa Issen, Izmer.
latin_inalco: Neɣ Itcarak ddkeṛ d nnta. Isaɛqaṛ win i S ihwan. Ih, Netta Issen, Izmer.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵉⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽ ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ. ⵉⵙⴰⵄⵇⴰⵕ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⵉⵣⵎⵔ.

ayah_content: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan, ad as Immeslay Öebbi, siwa aweêêi, ne$ deffir ucembir, ne$ a d iazen amazan iwumi ara Iweêêi, s tsriê iS, ayen Ib$a. Ih, Neppa d Aâlayen, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Ur ittunefk ara i umdan, ad as Immeslay Ṛebbi, siwa aweḥḥi, neɣ deffir ucembir, neɣ a d iazen amazan iwumi ara Iweḥḥi, s tsriḥ iS, ayen Ibɣa. Ih, Netta d Aɛlayen, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵎⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵡⵃⵃⵉ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵓⵛⵎⴱⵉⵔ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵣⵏ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵡⵃⵃⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Akka ik d Nweêêa ôôuê, si lameô nne£; ur telliv d win issnen d acu p Tezmamt, ne$ liman. Maca, nerra p d tafat. Yis Nenehhu win i £ ihwan, seg imdanen nne£. Ih, d Keçç i ippawin d ubrid uwqim;
latin_inalco: Akka ik d Nweḥḥa ṛṛuḥ, si lameṛ nneɣ; ur telliḍ d win issnen d acu t Tezmamt, neɣ liman. Maca, nerra t d tafat. Yis Nenehhu win i ɣ ihwan, seg imdanen nneɣ. Ih, d Kečč i ittawin d ubrid uwqim;
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉⴽ ⴷ ⵏⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ, ⵙⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏⵏⵖ; ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⴹ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ. ⵢⵉⵙ ⵏⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵖ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ;

ayah_content: abrid n Öebbi, i Isâan i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan. War ccekk, ar Öebbi ay teddun lumuô.
latin_inalco: abrid n Ṛebbi, i Isɛan i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan. War ccekk, ar Ṛebbi ay teddun lumuṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉ ⵉⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵢ ⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⵍⵓⵎⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Ëm.
latin_inalco: Ḥm.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: S Tezmamt ipbegginen!
latin_inalco: S Tezmamt itbegginen!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ!

ayah_content: Nerra p d Leqwôan s taâôabt, amar a pfehmem.
latin_inalco: Nerra t d Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt, amar a tfehmem.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⴷ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⴰⵄⵕⴰⴱⵜ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⴼⵀⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Neppa, ih, ata $uône£, ar Tyimmap n Tezmamt, d aâlayan, d uûwib.
latin_inalco: Netta, ih, ata ɣuṛneɣ, ar Tyimmat n Tezmamt, d aɛlayan, d uṣwib.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵜⴰ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵓⵚⵡⵉⴱ.

ayah_content: Day a kwen Nêewwej seg usmekti, imi kunwi d agdud ipêawalen?
latin_inalco: Day a kwen Nḥewwej seg usmekti, imi kunwi d agdud itḥawalen?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵃⵡⵡⵊ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵉⵎⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⴰⵡⴰⵍⵏ?

ayah_content: Acêal id Nuzen d nnbi i imezwura!
latin_inalco: Acḥal id Nuzen d nnbi i imezwura!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵃⴰⵍ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵏⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ!

ayah_content: Ur ten id ippas nnbi, mebla ma mmaâlken fellas.
latin_inalco: Ur ten id ittas nnbi, mebla ma mmaɛlken fellas.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵙ ⵏⵏⴱⵉ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵎⵎⴰⵄⵍⴽⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Nemêa wid i ten yifen tazmert. U iûaô umedya imezwura.
latin_inalco: Nemḥa wid i ten yifen tazmert. U iṣaṛ umedya imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵎⵃⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵢⵉⴼⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⵔⵜ. ⵓ ⵉⵚⴰⵕ ⵓⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan"? A d inin, war ccekk: "Ixelq iten Uzmir, Amusnaw";
latin_inalco: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan"? A d inin, war ccekk: "Ixelq iten Uzmir, Amusnaw";
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵜⵇⵚⴰⴹ ⵜⵏ: "ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ"? ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ: "ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ";

ayah_content: i wen Irran tamurt d dduê; i wen Igan, degs, iberdan - amendeô ma a ppeppwanhum -;
latin_inalco: i wen Irran tamurt d dduḥ; i wen Igan, degs, iberdan - amendeṛ ma a ttettwanhum -;
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷ ⴷⴷⵓⵃ; ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴳⴰⵏ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ - ⴰⵎⵏⴷⵕ ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵓⵎ -;

ayah_content: id Isse$layen, seg igenni, aman s lmizan - Nessakway yissen tamurt immuten; akka ara d tekkrem -;
latin_inalco: id Isseɣlayen, seg igenni, aman s lmizan - Nessakway yissen tamurt immuten; akka ara d tekkrem -;
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⴰⵢⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ - ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴽⵡⴰⵢ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵉⵎⵎⵓⵜⵏ; ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴽⴽⵔⵎ -;

ayah_content: id Ixelqen akw tiyugiwin, i wen Ifkan, si sfinat akked lmal, ara trekbem.
latin_inalco: id Ixelqen akw tiyugiwin, i wen Ifkan, si sfinat akked lmal, ara trekbem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵜⵉⵢⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉ ⵙⴼⵉⵏⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵔⴽⴱⵎ.

ayah_content: A pâanncem $ef iârar nnsen; sinna, a d tesmektim l$it n Mass nnwen, mara pâanncem fellasen. A ppinim: "gedha s Win i d Inuben fella$ s waya, ur t nemlik!
latin_inalco: A tɛanncem ɣef iɛrar nnsen; sinna, a d tesmektim lɣit n Mass nnwen, mara tɛanncem fellasen. A ttinim: "gedha s Win i d Inuben fellaɣ s waya, ur t nemlik!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⵏⵏⵛⵎ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵄⵔⴰⵔ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉⵎ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⵏⵏⵛⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ. ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵏⵉⵎ: "ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵓⴱⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵏⵎⵍⵉⴽ!

ayah_content: Ih, a nu$al ar Mass nne$".
latin_inalco: Ih, a nuɣal ar Mass nneɣ".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰ ⵏⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ".

ayah_content: Ëesben ay T iâabden d amur segS. Amdan, s tidep, d anekkaô n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ḥesben ay T iɛabden d amur segS. Amdan, s tidet, d anekkaṛ n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵙⴱⵏ ⴰⵢ ⵜ ⵉⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵔ ⵙⴳⵙ. ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Ne$ day d Iddem tullas seg wayen Ixleq, u Ifren awen d arrac?
latin_inalco: Neɣ day d Iddem tullas seg wayen Ixleq, u Ifren awen d arrac?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴷⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⴷⴷⵎ ⵜⵓⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ, ⵓ ⵉⴼⵔⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵛ?

ayah_content: Ma ibbwev ed usali yiwen segsen, $ef wayen id ifka d amedya i Uênin, ad yibrik wudem is, ad ikkufer:
latin_inalco: Ma ibbweḍ ed usali yiwen segsen, ɣef wayen id ifka d amedya i Uḥnin, ad yibrik wudem is, ad ikkufer:
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⴹ ⴷ ⵓⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵉ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⴱⵔⵉⴽ ⵡⵓⴷⵎ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⴽⵓⴼⵔ:

ayah_content: "ayen d ikren di rrêuê, ur nessifrir anamer"!
latin_inalco: "ayen d ikren di rrḥuḥ, ur nessifrir anamer"!
Tifinagh: "ⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴽⵔⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵔⵔⵃⵓⵃ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵙⵉⴼⵔⵉⵔ ⴰⵏⴰⵎⵔ"!

ayah_content: Ëesben lmalayek, i illan d ixdimen n Uênin, d nnta. Day êevôen i uxlaq nnsent? Tira $ef ccada nnsen; fellasen asteqsi.
latin_inalco: Ḥesben lmalayek, i illan d ixdimen n Uḥnin, d nnta. Day ḥeḍṛen i uxlaq nnsent? Tira ɣef ccada nnsen; fellasen asteqsi.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵙⴱⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵅⴷⵉⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵃⴹⵕⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵅⵍⴰⵇ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ? ⵜⵉⵔⴰ ⵖⴼ ⵛⵛⴰⴷⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "lemmer Irad Uênin, yili ur ten naâbbid". Ur sâin kra n tmusni $ef waya. Nitni la pxeôôiven kan.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "lemmer Irad Uḥnin, yili ur ten naɛbbid". Ur sɛin kra n tmusni ɣef waya. Nitni la txeṛṛiḍen kan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵔⴰⴷ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴰⵄⴱⴱⵉⴷ". ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵉⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵅⵕⵕⵉⴹⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ne$ Nefka yasen Tazmamt, uqbel Tagi, d$a, degs, îîfen.
latin_inalco: Neɣ Nefka yasen Tazmamt, uqbel Tagi, dɣa, degs, ṭṭfen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵜⴰⴳⵉ, ⴷⵖⴰ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵟⵟⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Nnan: "nufa d, ih, imezwura nne$, di laâqida. D$a, nekwni, Nedda di lateô nnsen".
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Nnan: "nufa d, ih, imezwura nneɣ, di laɛqida. Dɣa, nekwni, Nedda di lateṛ nnsen".
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⵓⴼⴰ ⴷ, ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ. ⴷⵖⴰ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵏⴷⴷⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵜⵕ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Am akka, ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaô ar temdint, mebla ma nnan isâiyen is: "nufa d imezwura nne$ di laâqida. D$a, nedda d lateô nnsen".
latin_inalco: Am akka, ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaṛ ar temdint, mebla ma nnan isɛiyen is: "nufa d imezwura nneɣ di laɛqida. Dɣa, nedda d lateṛ nnsen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎ ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵄⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⵓⴼⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵄⵇⵉⴷⴰ. ⴷⵖⴰ, ⵏⴷⴷⴰ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵜⵕ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "i ma bbwi$ awen d nnhaya yifen tin id tufam ar imezwura nnwen"? Nnan: "nekwni, ihi, nugwi ayen is id teppuceggâam".
latin_inalco: Inna: "i ma bbwiɣ awen d nnhaya yifen tin id tufam ar imezwura nnwen"? Nnan: "nekwni, ihi, nugwi ayen is id tettuceggɛam".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵉ ⵎⴰ ⴱⴱⵡⵉⵖ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵢⵉⴼⵏ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵓⴼⴰⵎ ⴰⵔ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ"? ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⵓⴳⵡⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵛⴳⴳⵄⴰⵎ".

ayah_content: Nerra d ppaô, segsen. Muqel amek tevôa d inekkaôen.
latin_inalco: Nerra d ttaṛ, segsen. Muqel amek teḍṛa d inekkaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⵎⵓⵇⵍ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⴹⵕⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi inna Ibôahim i baba s, akked ugdud is: "nek, ur pkka$ deg wayen la tâabdem,
latin_inalco: Mi inna Ibṛahim i baba s, akked ugdud is: "nek, ur tkkaɣ deg wayen la tɛabdem,
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ ⵉ ⴱⴰⴱⴰ ⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴽⴽⴰⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴷⵎ,

ayah_content: kkes ed Win iyi d Ixelqen. D Neppa, s tidep, ara iyi Inhun".
latin_inalco: kkes ed Win iyi d Ixelqen. D Netta, s tidet, ara iyi Inhun".
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ. ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵏⵀⵓⵏ".

ayah_content: Irra t d awal imezgi i texlift is, amar a d u$alen s abrid.
latin_inalco: Irra t d awal imezgi i texlift is, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ ⵉ ⵜⵅⵍⵉⴼⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⵙ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ.

ayah_content: U £ate$ ten, nitni akked imezwura nnsen, armi ten id tusa tidep, akked umazan ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: U ɣateɣ ten, nitni akked imezwura nnsen, armi ten id tusa tidet, akked umazan itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵖⴰⵜⵖ ⵜⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi ten id tusa tidep, nnan: "wagi d ssêur, ihi, nekwni nugi t".
latin_inalco: Mi ten id tusa tidet, nnan: "wagi d ssḥur, ihi, nekwni nugi t".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵃⵓⵔ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵏⵓⴳⵉ ⵜ".

ayah_content: Nnan: "A lemmer id ssadren Leqwôan agi ar urgaz ameqwôaêan n snat temdinin"!
latin_inalco: Nnan: "A lemmer id ssadren Leqwṛan agi ar urgaz ameqwṛaḥan n snat temdinin"!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵙⵏⴰⵜ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵉⵏ"!

ayah_content: Day d nitni i ifeôôqen aêunu n Mass ik? D Nekwni i sen Ifeôôqen tamâict nnsen, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u Nessuli kra segsen, tidekkaôin sennig wiyav, iwakken kra, ad sxedmen wiyav. Aêunu n Mass ik yif ayen jemâan.
latin_inalco: Day d nitni i ifeṛṛqen aḥunu n Mass ik? D Nekwni i sen Ifeṛṛqen tamɛict nnsen, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u Nessuli kra segsen, tidekkaṛin sennig wiyaḍ, iwakken kra, ad sxedmen wiyaḍ. Aḥunu n Mass ik yif ayen jemɛan.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵉⴼⵕⵕⵇⵏ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ? ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⴼⵕⵕⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵄⵉⵛⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ, ⵓ ⵏⵙⵙⵓⵍⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵜⵉⴷⴽⴽⴰⵕⵉⵏ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ. ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵢⵉⴼ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵊⵎⵄⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Lemmer maççi yiwen n lois kan ara yilin imdanen, a Nerr tiseddura n lfeîîa i ixxamen n wid inekôen Aênin, akw i tiseddaôin i$ef ara alin;
latin_inalco: Lemmer mačči yiwen n lǧis kan ara yilin imdanen, a Nerr tiseddura n lfeṭṭa i ixxamen n wid inekṛen Aḥnin, akw i tiseddaṛin iɣef ara alin;
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵔⵔ ⵜⵉⵙⴷⴷⵓⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵍⴼⵟⵟⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⵕⵏ ⴰⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵜⵉⵙⴷⴷⴰⵕⵉⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵍⵉⵏ;

ayah_content: i ixxamen nnsen, tibbura; imîeôêen ideg ara élen;
latin_inalco: i ixxamen nnsen, tibbura; imṭeṛḥen ideg ara ẓlen;
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵉⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ; ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵥⵍⵏ;

ayah_content: akked uzewweq. Maca, ayagi akw, d astumen i tmeddurt n ddunit. Laxeôt, ar Mass ik, i wid ipêezziben.
latin_inalco: akked uzewweq. Maca, ayagi akw, d astumen i tmeddurt n ddunit. Laxeṛt, ar Mass ik, i wid itḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵣⵡⵡⵇ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⴽⵡ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵜⵓⵎⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ. ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Win iooan asmekti n Uênin, ad as Nqelled Cciîan, ad as yili d amsaâef.
latin_inalco: Win iǧǧan asmekti n Uḥnin, ad as Nqelled Cciṭan, ad as yili d amsaɛef.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⵇⵍⵍⴷ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵙⴰⵄⴼ.

ayah_content: Ih, Nitni veôôifen ten seg ubrid, u $ilen ar nitni pwanhan.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nitni ḍeṛṛifen ten seg ubrid, u ɣilen ar nitni twanhan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴹⵕⵕⵉⴼⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ, ⵓ ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Alamma ma iusa d $uône£, inna d: "ah, awufan gari yidek, amecwaô illan ger ugmuv d wayev". A yir amsaâef!
latin_inalco: Alamma ma iusa d ɣuṛneɣ, inna d: "ah, awufan gari yidek, amecwaṛ illan ger ugmuḍ d wayeḍ". A yir amsaɛef!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴷ: "ⴰⵀ, ⴰⵡⵓⴼⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⵉ ⵢⵉⴷⴽ, ⴰⵎⵛⵡⴰⵕ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⵔ ⵓⴳⵎⵓⴹ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⴹ". ⴰ ⵢⵉⵔ ⴰⵎⵙⴰⵄⴼ!

ayah_content: Ur kwen infaâ, assa, d awez$i, ma tdensem. Aql akwen tcerkem aâaqeb.
latin_inalco: Ur kwen infaɛ, assa, d awezɣi, ma tdensem. Aql akwen tcerkem aɛaqeb.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵏⴼⴰⵄ, ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⵣⵖⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⴷⵏⵙⵎ. ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽⵡⵏ ⵜⵛⵔⴽⵎ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ.

ayah_content: Day a pperrev, keçç, aâeééug ad issel, ne$ a ppenhuv ader$al, akked win illan di ttelfan n ûûeê?
latin_inalco: Day a tterreḍ, kečč, aɛeẓẓug ad issel, neɣ a ttenhuḍ aderɣal, akked win illan di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵔⵔⴹ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴰⵄⵥⵥⵓⴳ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵍ, ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵏⵀⵓⴹ ⴰⴷⵔⵖⴰⵍ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ?

ayah_content: Amar a k id Nekkes, d$a a d Nerr ppaô segsen;
latin_inalco: Amar a k id Nekkes, dɣa a d Nerr ttaṛ segsen;
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵏⴽⴽⵙ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵔⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ;

ayah_content: ne$ ak Nessken ayen i sen d Nhegga. £uône£, ih, adabu fellasen.
latin_inalco: neɣ ak Nessken ayen i sen d Nhegga. ɣuṛneɣ, ih, adabu fellasen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰⴽ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵀⴳⴳⴰ. ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ, ⵉⵀ, ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ïîef deg wayen i k d ippuweêêan. Keçç, war ccekk, aql ak deg ubrid uwqim.
latin_inalco: Ṭṭef deg wayen i k d ittuweḥḥan. Kečč, war ccekk, aql ak deg ubrid uwqim.
Tifinagh: ⵟⵟⴼ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⵃⵃⴰⵏ. ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Wagi, ih, d asmekti i keçç, akked ugdud ik; deqqal fellawen asteqsi.
latin_inalco: Wagi, ih, d asmekti i kečč, akked ugdud ik; deqqal fellawen asteqsi.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵉ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴽ; ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⴰⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ.

ayah_content: Steqsi wid id Nuzen, uqbel ik, seg imazanen nne£. Day Nerra, war Aênin, iôebbiten ara âabden?
latin_inalco: Steqsi wid id Nuzen, uqbel ik, seg imazanen nneɣ. Day Nerra, war Aḥnin, iṛebbiten ara ɛabden?
Tifinagh: ⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵉⴽ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵏⵔⵔⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⴰⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ?

ayah_content: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nne£, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Inna: "nek d amazan n Mass imavalen".
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nneɣ, ar Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Inna: "nek d amazan n Mass imaḍalen".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⵔ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴹⴱⴱⵕⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ".

ayah_content: Mi sen d ibbwi issekniyen nne£, nitni la ppavsan degsen.
latin_inalco: Mi sen d ibbwi issekniyen nneɣ, nitni la ttaḍsan degsen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⴹⵙⴰⵏ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur asen Nessenâata assekni, siwa ma i$leb gma s. Nesâadda fellasen aâaqeb, amar a d u$alen s abrid.
latin_inalco: Ur asen Nessenɛata assekni, siwa ma iɣleb gma s. Nesɛadda fellasen aɛaqeb, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⵏⵄⴰⵜⴰ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵖⵍⴱ ⴳⵎⴰ ⵙ. ⵏⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⵙ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "a yaseêêar, nâaô a$ Mass ik, s lemâahda i k Ifka. Nekwni ara nepwanhu".
latin_inalco: Nnan: "a yaseḥḥar, nɛaṛ aɣ Mass ik, s lemɛahda i k Ifka. Nekwni ara netwanhu".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵃⵃⴰⵔ, ⵏⵄⴰⵕ ⴰⵖ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ. ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵓ".

ayah_content: Mi Nessafer aâaqeb fellasen, imiren ad xedâan.
latin_inalco: Mi Nessafer aɛaqeb fellasen, imiren ad xedɛan.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴼⵔ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵅⴷⵄⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Imdeê Ferâun i ugdud is, inna: "a yagdud iw, day maççi inu tagelda n Maseô, akked isaffen agi, i ippazalen seddaw i. Day ur twalam ara?
latin_inalco: Imdeḥ Ferɛun i ugdud is, inna: "a yagdud iw, day mačči inu tagelda n Maseṛ, akked isaffen agi, i ittazalen seddaw i. Day ur twalam ara?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⴷⵃ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵢⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ, ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⵉⵏⵓ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵕ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵣⴰⵍⵏ ⵙⴷⴷⴰⵡ ⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Ne$ nek ur ife$ ara imdelli agi, ur nezmir ad ibeggen?
latin_inalco: Neɣ nek ur ifeɣ ara imdelli agi, ur nezmir ad ibeggen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵏⴽ ⵓⵔ ⵉⴼⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⴷⵍⵍⵉ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴱⴳⴳⵏ?

ayah_content: Acimi ur as qqnen ara imeqyasen n uwôe$, ne$ ur d usint ara yides lmalayek, pwazdan t"?
latin_inalco: Acimi ur as qqnen ara imeqyasen n uwṛeɣ, neɣ ur d usint ara yides lmalayek, twazdan t"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵉⵎⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵇⵇⵏⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⵇⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵡⵕⵖ, ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵓⵙⵉⵏⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⵜⵡⴰⵣⴷⴰⵏ ⵜ"?

ayah_content: Issefqaâ agdud is. Unzen as. Wigi, ih, d agdud ucmit.
latin_inalco: Issefqaɛ agdud is. Unzen as. Wigi, ih, d agdud ucmit.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵇⴰⵄ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ. ⵓⵏⵣⵏ ⴰⵙ. ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Mi £ zzaâfen, Nerra d ppaô segsen, Ne$meq iten meôôa.
latin_inalco: Mi ɣ zzaɛfen, Nerra d ttaṛ segsen, Neɣmeq iten meṛṛa.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵖ ⵣⵣⴰⵄⴼⵏ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵏⵖⵎⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵎⵕⵕⴰ.

ayah_content: Nerra ten d asmekti u d amedya, i ineggura.
latin_inalco: Nerra ten d asmekti u d amedya, i ineggura.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵓ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ, ⵉ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Mi sen d ippunefk mmi s n Meryem, d amedya, agdud ik iugwi t.
latin_inalco: Mi sen d ittunefk mmi s n Meryem, d amedya, agdud ik iugwi t.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵎⵎⵉ ⵙ ⵏ ⵎⵔⵢⵎ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ, ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵓⴳⵡⵉ ⵜ.

ayah_content: Qqaôen: "ppif iôebbiten nne$, ne$ Neppa"? Qqaôen ak d akka, i nnmara. Ih, nitni d agdud ipmeôéan.
latin_inalco: Qqaṛen: "ttif iṛebbiten nneɣ, neɣ Netta"? Qqaṛen ak d akka, i nnmara. Ih, nitni d agdud itmeṛẓan.
Tifinagh: ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⵜⵜⵉⴼ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵏⵖ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ"? ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉ ⵏⵏⵎⴰⵔⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵎⵕⵥⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa d amdan kan. N$at it, Nerra t d amedya i At Isôail.
latin_inalco: Netta d amdan kan. Nɣat it, Nerra t d amedya i At Isṛail.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ. ⵏⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⵜ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵉ ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ.

ayah_content: Lemmer i£ £ ihwi, a Nerr lmalayek di tmurt, deg umkan nnwen.
latin_inalco: Lemmer iɣ ɣ ihwi, a Nerr lmalayek di tmurt, deg umkan nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵖ ⵖ ⵉⵀⵡⵉ, ⴰ ⵏⵔⵔ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, d ppbut n yimir. Ur ppilit di ccekk fellas. Ddut yidi; wagi d abrid uwqim.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, d ttbut n yimir. Ur ttilit di ccekk fellas. Ddut yidi; wagi d abrid uwqim.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⵜⴱⵓⵜ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⴷⴷⵓⵜ ⵢⵉⴷⵉ; ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ.

ayah_content: Ur kwen issefra$ Cciîan! Ih, neppa d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ur kwen issefraɣ Cciṭan! Ih, netta d acengu nnwen n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵔⴰⵖ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ! ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵏⴳⵓ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Mi n iusa Âisa s issekniyen, inna: "usi$ d $uôwen s ûûwab, ad awen beggne$ kra, seg wayen i$ef temgarradem. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, ta$em iyi awal.
latin_inalco: Mi n iusa Ɛisa s issekniyen, inna: "usiɣ d ɣuṛwen s ṣṣwab, ad awen beggneɣ kra, seg wayen iɣef temgarradem. Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵏ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵄⵉⵙⴰ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ, ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⵓⵙⵉⵖ ⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴱⴳⴳⵏⵖ ⴽⵔⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵎ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⵖⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Öebbi, s tidep, d Mass iw u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eÏ, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi, s tidet, d Mass iw u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, ɛabdet eṬ, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⵓ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵜ ⵟ, ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵓⵡⵇⵉⵎ".

ayah_content: Mgarraden ikabaren garasen. A tawa$it n wid idensen, ilmend uâaqeb n wass aqeôêan!
latin_inalco: Mgarraden ikabaren garasen. A tawaɣit n wid idensen, ilmend uɛaqeb n wass aqeṛḥan!
Tifinagh: ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ ⵉⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ. ⴰ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: Day a pôaoun imir, ad asen d ias, deqzalla, nitni ur bnin?
latin_inalco: Day a tṛaǧun imir, ad asen d ias, deqzalla, nitni ur bnin?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜⵕⴰⴷⵊⵓⵏ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⴷⵇⵣⴰⵍⵍⴰ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Iêbiben, assen, ad u$alen wa d acengu n wa, kkes ed wid ipêezziben.
latin_inalco: Iḥbiben, assen, ad uɣalen wa d acengu n wa, kkes ed wid itḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵃⴱⵉⴱⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⵡⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵏⴳⵓ ⵏ ⵡⴰ, ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: A yimdanen iW, assa, ur telli tugdi fellawen, ur $webblet!
latin_inalco: A yimdanen iW, assa, ur telli tugdi fellawen, ur ɣwebblet!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉ ⵜⵓⴳⴷⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵖⵡⴱⴱⵍⵜ!

ayah_content: - Wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£, u llan d imvuâen -
latin_inalco: - Wid iumnen s issekniyen nneɣ, u llan d imḍuɛen -
Tifinagh: - ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵓ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ -

ayah_content: Kecmet Loennet, kunwi akked tlawin nnwen, a ppezhum.
latin_inalco: Kecmet Lǧennet, kunwi akked tlawin nnwen, a ttezhum.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵛⵎⵜ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵣⵀⵓⵎ.

ayah_content: Ad asen ddewwiôen, s sniwat n uwôe$, akked ibuqalen; degsen ayen cihwant teôwiêin, ayen iqennâen allen. Kunwi, din, ad twekkôem.
latin_inalco: Ad asen ddewwiṛen, s sniwat n uwṛeɣ, akked ibuqalen; degsen ayen cihwant teṛwiḥin, ayen iqennɛen allen. Kunwi, din, ad twekkṛem.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷⴷⵡⵡⵉⵕⵏ, ⵙ ⵙⵏⵉⵡⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵓⵡⵕⵖ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴱⵓⵇⴰⵍⵏ; ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵛⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏⵜ ⵜⵕⵡⵉⵃⵉⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵇⵏⵏⵄⵏ ⴰⵍⵍⵏ. ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴷⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴽⴽⵕⵎ.

ayah_content: D tagi ay d Loennet i tweôtem, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: D tagi ay d Lǧennet i tweṛtem, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵉ ⵜⵡⵕⵜⵎ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Degs, i kunwi, aîas n izwayen, segsen a ppeççem.
latin_inalco: Degs, i kunwi, aṭas n izwayen, segsen a tteččem.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵛⵎ.

ayah_content: Ibe$wviyen, s tidep, deg uâaqeb n Loahennama, ad wekkôen.
latin_inalco: Ibeɣwḍiyen, s tidet, deg uɛaqeb n Lǧahennama, ad wekkṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur ipfukku fellasen. Nitni, degs, ad kkufferen.
latin_inalco: Ur itfukku fellasen. Nitni, degs, ad kkufferen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⴼⵓⴽⴽⵓ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴽⴽⵓⴼⴼⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur ten Nednis, maca llan, nitni, d imednas.
latin_inalco: Ur ten Nednis, maca llan, nitni, d imednas.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴷⵏⵉⵙ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Ad necden: "a Malik, xas ad a$ Iqfeô Mass ik"! A d ini: "war ccekk, a pwellfem"!
latin_inalco: Ad necden: "a Malik, xas ad aɣ Iqfeṛ Mass ik"! A d ini: "war ccekk, a twellfem"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵏⵛⴷⵏ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵍⵉⴽ, ⵅⴰⵙ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵇⴼⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ"! ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⵜⵡⵍⵍⴼⵎ"!

ayah_content: Ni$ Nusa n $uôwen, s tidep, maca tegwti, degwen, keôhen tidep.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nusa n ɣuṛwen, s tidet, maca tegwti, degwen, keṛhen tidet.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵙⴰ ⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ, ⴷⴳⵡⵏ, ⴽⵕⵀⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ.

ayah_content: Ne$ undin ticeôkep. Ula d Nekwni Neppandi.
latin_inalco: Neɣ undin ticeṛket. Ula d Nekwni Nettandi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵓⵏⴷⵉⵏ ⵜⵉⵛⵕⴽⵜ. ⵓⵍⴰ ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵏⴷⵉ.

ayah_content: Ne$ $ilen ur Nsell ara i lesrar nnsen, akked tumlin nnsen. Ihi, imceggâen nne£, $uôsen, pparun.
latin_inalco: Neɣ ɣilen ur Nsell ara i lesrar nnsen, akked tumlin nnsen. Ihi, imceggɛen nneɣ, ɣuṛsen, ttarun.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵍⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵍⵙⵔⴰⵔ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵓⵎⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵉⵎⵛⴳⴳⵄⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵜⵜⴰⵔⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "lemmer illi mmi s i Uênin, nek d aâbad amenzu".
latin_inalco: Ini: "lemmer illi mmi s i Uḥnin, nek d aɛbad amenzu".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵎⵎⵉ ⵙ ⵉ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⵏⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵄⴱⴰⴷ ⴰⵎⵏⵣⵓ".

ayah_content: Gedha s Mass n tmurt akked igenwan, Mass n usgeld, mgal ayen pxeôôiven!
latin_inalco: Gedha s Mass n tmurt akked igenwan, Mass n usgeld, mgal ayen txeṛṛiḍen!
Tifinagh: ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⵕⵕⵉⴹⵏ!

ayah_content: Anef asen ad nexxôen, ad uraren, alamma mmugren ass nnsen, i sen ippuwaââden.
latin_inalco: Anef asen ad nexxṛen, ad uraren, alamma mmugren ass nnsen, i sen ittuwaɛɛden.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⴼ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵏⵅⵅⵕⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵓⵔⴰⵔⵏ, ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵎⵎⵓⴳⵔⵏ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa ay d Öebbi deg igenni, d Öebbi di tmurt, u d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: D Netta ay d Ṛebbi deg igenni, d Ṛebbi di tmurt, u d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵓ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Iôqa Win Ilan tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Iéôa melmi ay d imir. £uüôeS, ara tu$alem.
latin_inalco: Iṛqa Win Ilan tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Iẓṛa melmi ay d imir. ɣuüṛeS, ara tuɣalem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵕⵇⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ. ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵎⵍⵎⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ. ⵖⵓüⵕⵙ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ.

ayah_content: Wid i la naâôen, war Neppa, ur $uôsen kra n ccafuâa, kkes ed inagan n tidep, u nitni éôan.
latin_inalco: Wid i la naɛṛen, war Netta, ur ɣuṛsen kra n ccafuɛa, kkes ed inagan n tidet, u nitni ẓṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵏⴰⵄⵕⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵛⵛⴰⴼⵓⵄⴰ, ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵥⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma testeqûav ten anwa iten Ixelqen, a d inin, war ccekk, "d Öebbi". Ihi, acimi zzin akin?
latin_inalco: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten anwa iten Ixelqen, a d inin, war ccekk, "d Ṛebbi". Ihi, acimi zzin akin?
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵜⵇⵚⴰⴹ ⵜⵏ ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, "ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ". ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵛⵉⵎⵉ ⵣⵣⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Timenna s: "a Mass iw! Wigi, s tidep, d agdud ur numin".
latin_inalco: Timenna s: "a Mass iw! Wigi, s tidet, d agdud ur numin".
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵏⵏⴰ ⵙ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ".

ayah_content: Wexxeô asen, ini: "tifrat"! Deqqal ad éôen.
latin_inalco: Wexxeṛ asen, ini: "tifrat"! Deqqal ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵅⵅⵕ ⴰⵙⵏ, ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ"! ⴷⵇⵇⴰⵍ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ëm.
latin_inalco: Ḥm.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: S Tezmamt ipbegginen!
latin_inalco: S Tezmamt itbegginen!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ!

ayah_content: Nessader ip id, ih, deg iv iôqan. Ih, Nekwni, Nella d ineddaôen!
latin_inalco: Nessader it id, ih, deg iḍ iṛqan. Ih, Nekwni, Nella d ineddaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ ⵉⵕⵇⴰⵏ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Iban ed degs, yal lameô uûwib.
latin_inalco: Iban ed degs, yal lameṛ uṣwib.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴱⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵓⵚⵡⵉⴱ.

ayah_content: Lameô s$uône£. Ih, Nekwni Nella d wid Ippaznen.
latin_inalco: Lameṛ sɣuṛneɣ. Ih, Nekwni Nella d wid Ittaznen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵣⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ih, Neppa Isell, d Amusnaw.
latin_inalco: Aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ih, Netta Isell, d Amusnaw.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵙⵍⵍ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ.

ayah_content: Mass n tmurt, igenwan akked wayen illan garasen, ma tepputebbtem.
latin_inalco: Mass n tmurt, igenwan akked wayen illan garasen, ma tettutebbtem.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵎ.

ayah_content: Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Issidir, Ineqq. D Mass nnwen, u Mass n lejdud nnwen, imezwura.
latin_inalco: Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Netta. Issidir, Ineqq. D Mass nnwen, u Mass n lejdud nnwen, imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔ, ⵉⵏⵇⵇ. ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵍⵊⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Nitni, di ccekk, ppuraren.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Nitni, di ccekk, tturaren.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵜⵜⵓⵔⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Qaôaâ ass, ideg ara d iawi igenni, abbu ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Qaṛaɛ ass, ideg ara d iawi igenni, abbu itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵇⴰⵕⴰⵄ ⴰⵙⵙ, ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵡⵉ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴱⴱⵓ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad i$umm imùdanen. Wagi d aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Ad iɣumm imùdanen. Wagi d aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵖⵓⵎⵎ ⵉⵎùⴷⴰⵏⵏ. ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: "A Mass nne$! Kkes a$ aâaqeb; nekwni d lmumnin"!
latin_inalco: "A Mass nneɣ! Kkes aɣ aɛaqeb; nekwni d lmumnin"!
Tifinagh: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ! ⴽⴽⵙ ⴰⵖ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ; ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ"!

ayah_content: Amek ara sâun asmekti, wanag iusa ten id Umazan ipbegginen?
latin_inalco: Amek ara sɛun asmekti, wanag iusa ten id Umazan itbegginen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴽ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵄⵓⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ?

ayah_content: D$a wexxôen as, u nnan: "d aselmad aôehbani".
latin_inalco: Dɣa wexxṛen as, u nnan: "d aselmad aṛehbani".
Tifinagh: ⴷⵖⴰ ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ ⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵙⵍⵎⴰⴷ ⴰⵕⵀⴱⴰⵏⵉ".

ayah_content: Ma Nessenqes awen cwiî uâaqeb, ihi, kunwi, a ppu$alem ar din.
latin_inalco: Ma Nessenqes awen cwiṭ uɛaqeb, ihi, kunwi, a ttuɣalem ar din.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵙⵙⵏⵇⵙ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵎ ⴰⵔ ⴷⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara Neédem fellasen, ééedma tabarart, war ccekk, a d Nerr ppaô.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara Neẓdem fellasen, ẓẓedma tabarart, war ccekk, a d Nerr ttaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵏⵥⴷⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵥⵥⴷⵎⴰ ⵜⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔⵜ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵔⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Njeôôeb, uqbel nnsen, agdud n Ferâun. Iusa ten id umazan ukyis.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Njeṛṛeb, uqbel nnsen, agdud n Ferɛun. Iusa ten id umazan ukyis.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵊⵕⵕⴱ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ. ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: "Seddut yidi imdanen n Öebbi; nek, $uôwen, d amazan muman.
latin_inalco: "Seddut yidi imdanen n Ṛebbi; nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
Tifinagh: "ⵙⴷⴷⵓⵜ ⵢⵉⴷⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ; ⵏⴽ, ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur ssem$waôet iman nnwen, zdat Öebbi. Nek, usi$ d $uôwen, s udabu n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ur ssemɣwaṛet iman nnwen, zdat Ṛebbi. Nek, usiɣ d ɣuṛwen, s udabu n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵎⵖⵡⴰⵕⵜ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵏⴽ, ⵓⵙⵉⵖ ⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⵡⵏ, ⵙ ⵓⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Nek, ad iyi Isseô Mass iw u d Mass nnwen, ur iyi tôeoomem.
latin_inalco: Nek, ad iyi Isseṛ Mass iw u d Mass nnwen, ur iyi tṛeǧǧmem.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⵓ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜⵕⴷⴷⵊⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma ur iyi tuminem ara, aâzlet iyi".
latin_inalco: Ma ur iyi tuminem ara, aɛzlet iyi".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵜⵓⵎⵉⵏⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴰⵄⵣⵍⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ".

ayah_content: Inuj $eô Mass is ar wigi d agdud ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: Inuj ɣeṛ Mass is ar wigi d agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵓⵊ ⵖⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ ⴰⵔ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: "Awi imdanen iW deg iv. War ccekk, a kwen in vefôen.
latin_inalco: "Awi imdanen iW deg iḍ. War ccekk, a kwen in ḍefṛen.
Tifinagh: "ⴰⵡⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵏ ⴹⴼⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Eoo ill ildi; nitni, ih, d lâaskeô ara i$emqen".
latin_inalco: Eǧǧ ill ildi; nitni, ih, d lɛaskeṛ ara iɣemqen".
Tifinagh: ⴻⴷⴷⵊ ⵉⵍⵍ ⵉⵍⴷⵉ; ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⵍⵄⴰⵙⴽⵕ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵖⵎⵇⵏ".

ayah_content: Ay ooan di tebêirin, akked tliwa,
latin_inalco: Ay ǧǧan di tebḥirin, akked tliwa,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢ ⴷⴷⵊⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴱⵃⵉⵔⵉⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ,

ayah_content: igran, ixxamen ukyisen,
latin_inalco: igran, ixxamen ukyisen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⵔⴰⵏ, ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: l$it swayes zehhun!
latin_inalco: lɣit swayes zehhun!
Tifinagh: ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵙⵡⴰⵢⵙ ⵣⵀⵀⵓⵏ!

ayah_content: Akka ay ten Nefka d lweôt i ugdud nniven.
latin_inalco: Akka ay ten Nefka d lweṛt i ugdud nniḍen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵡⵕⵜ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur d run, fellasen, igenni akked tmurt. Ur ggunin.
latin_inalco: Ur d run, fellasen, igenni akked tmurt. Ur ggunin.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵔⵓⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵓⵔ ⴳⴳⵓⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nsellek At Isôail, seg uâaqeb isdullun,
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nsellek At Isṛail, seg uɛaqeb isdullun,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵓⵏ,

ayah_content: si Ferâun, i illan, s tidep, d amnefxi ger imaâfan.
latin_inalco: si Ferɛun, i illan, s tidet, d amnefxi ger imaɛfan.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵏⴼⵅⵉ ⴳⵔ ⵉⵎⴰⵄⴼⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: S tmusni ay ten Nefren deg imavalen.
latin_inalco: S tmusni ay ten Nefren deg imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴼⵔⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Nefka yasen seg issekniyen, wid ujeôôeb ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Nefka yasen seg issekniyen, wid ujeṛṛeb itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, widak la qqaôen:
latin_inalco: Ih, widak la qqaṛen:
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⵍⴰ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ:

ayah_content: "Siwa tameppant nne$ tamezwarut, ur fella$ tanekra.
latin_inalco: "Siwa tamettant nneɣ tamezwarut, ur fellaɣ tanekra.
Tifinagh: "ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ ⵜⴰⵏⴽⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Awit ed imezwura nne$, ma tessawalem tidep"!
latin_inalco: Awit ed imezwura nneɣ, ma tessawalem tidet"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵡⵉⵜ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵎ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ"!

ayah_content: Menyif nitni ne$ agdud n Tubbaâ, akked wid i ten id izwaren? Nessenger iten. S tidep, nitni llan d ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: Menyif nitni neɣ agdud n Tubbaɛ, akked wid i ten id izwaren? Nessenger iten. S tidet, nitni llan d ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵏⵢⵉⴼ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵏⵖ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵓⴱⴱⴰⵄ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ? ⵏⵙⵙⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵜⵏ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur Nexliq ara tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, i wurar.
latin_inalco: Ur Nexliq ara tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, i wurar.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵏⵅⵍⵉⵇ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵓⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Nxelq iten kan s tidep, maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Nxelq iten kan s tidet, maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: S tidep, ass n ufraz, ad mlilen meôôa.
latin_inalco: S tidet, ass n ufraz, ad mlilen meṛṛa.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⵣ, ⴰⴷ ⵎⵍⵉⵍⵏ ⵎⵕⵕⴰ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg aêbib ur i$ennu aêbib, s wacemma; nitni ur pwasellken.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg aḥbib ur iɣennu aḥbib, s wacemma; nitni ur twasellken.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵃⴱⵉⴱ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵖⵏⵏⵓ ⴰⵃⴱⵉⴱ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ; ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed wid i$ef Iêun Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, d Uzmir, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed wid iɣef Iḥun Ṛebbi. Netta, s tidet, d Uzmir, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵃⵓⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Ih, ttejôa n Zaqqum,
latin_inalco: Ih, ttejṛa n Zaqqum,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵜⵜⵊⵕⴰ ⵏ ⵣⴰⵇⵇⵓⵎ,

ayah_content: uççi umednub,
latin_inalco: učči umednub,
Tifinagh: ⵓⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⵏⵓⴱ,

ayah_content: am nnêas ifsin, ippayzag di tâabbuvin,
latin_inalco: am nnḥas ifsin, ittayzag di tɛabbuḍin,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎ ⵏⵏⵃⴰⵙ ⵉⴼⵙⵉⵏ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵄⴰⴱⴱⵓⴹⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: akken ppayzagen waman.
latin_inalco: akken ttayzagen waman.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳⵏ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: "Ddemt ep, zu$ôet ep, ar pnaûfa ujajiê,
latin_inalco: "Ddemt et, zuɣṛet et, ar tnaṣfa ujajiḥ,
Tifinagh: "ⴷⴷⵎⵜ ⵜ, ⵣⵓⵖⵕⵜ ⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵜⵏⴰⵚⴼⴰ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ,

ayah_content: sinna, smiret sufella uqeôôu s, aâaqeb ippayzagen".
latin_inalco: sinna, smiret sufella uqeṛṛu s, aɛaqeb ittayzagen".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙⵎⵉⵔⵜ ⵙⵓⴼⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵇⵕⵕⵓ ⵙ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳⵏ".

ayah_content: "Jeôôeb! Ni$ keçç d uzmir, d ukyis"!
latin_inalco: "Jeṛṛeb! Niɣ kečč d uzmir, d ukyis"!
Tifinagh: "ⵊⵕⵕⴱ! ⵏⵉⵖ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙ"!

ayah_content: Ih, wagi d ayen i la tepcukkum.
latin_inalco: Ih, wagi d ayen i la tetcukkum.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⵛⵓⴽⴽⵓⵎ.

ayah_content: Wanag wid iêezzben, deg umekkan n laman;
latin_inalco: Wanag wid iḥezzben, deg umekkan n laman;
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵃⵣⵣⴱⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: di leonanat akked tliwa;
latin_inalco: di leǧnanat akked tliwa;
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ;

ayah_content: lebsa nnsen s leêrir, leêrir iêewwcen. Mqabalen.
latin_inalco: lebsa nnsen s leḥrir, leḥrir iḥewwcen. Mqabalen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴱⵙⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵃⵔⵉⵔ, ⵍⵃⵔⵉⵔ ⵉⵃⵡⵡⵛⵏ. ⵎⵇⴰⴱⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Akka, a ten Njewweo akked têuôtin lâin.
latin_inalco: Akka, a ten Njewweǧ akked tḥuṛtin lɛin.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵊⵡⵡⴷⵊ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵃⵓⵕⵜⵉⵏ ⵍⵄⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: A d ssutren, dinna, yal izwayen, di laman.
latin_inalco: A d ssutren, dinna, yal izwayen, di laman.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ, ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur pjeôôiben, dinna, tameppant, siwa tameppant tamezwarut. Isellek iten seg uâaqeb ujajiê.
latin_inalco: Ur tjeṛṛiben, dinna, tamettant, siwa tamettant tamezwarut. Isellek iten seg uɛaqeb ujajiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵊⵕⵕⵉⴱⵏ, ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵜⴰⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ. ⵉⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: D lfevl n Mass ik, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
latin_inalco: D lfeḍl n Mass ik, d wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵔⵔⴱⵃ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nsehhel it kan, s tmeslayt ik, amendeô ma a d mmektin.
latin_inalco: Nsehhel it kan, s tmeslayt ik, amendeṛ ma a d mmektin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵀⵀⵍ ⵉⵜ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢⵜ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵎⵏⴷⵕ ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ggani, ula d nitni la pganin.
latin_inalco: Ggani, ula d nitni la tganin.
Tifinagh: ⴳⴳⴰⵏⵉ, ⵓⵍⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵜⴳⴰⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ëm.
latin_inalco: Ḥm.
Tifinagh: ⵃⵎ.

ayah_content: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Tarusi n Tezmamt sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Di tmurt akked igenwan, s tidep, llan issekniyen i lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Di tmurt akked igenwan, s tidet, llan issekniyen i lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Di lxelq nnwen, akked wayen id Issefôuôex n lewêuc, d issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.
latin_inalco: Di lxelq nnwen, akked wayen id Issefṛuṛex n lewḥuc, d issekniyen i ugdud ittutebbten.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵕⵓⵕⵅ ⵏ ⵍⵡⵃⵓⵛ, ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Di lemgarda n yiv akked wass, akked wayen id Issrusu Öebbi n ôôeéq, seg igenni - Issidir yis tamurt, deffir tmeppant is -, deg udewwel n wavu, issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
latin_inalco: Di lemgarda n yiḍ akked wass, akked wayen id Issrusu Ṛebbi n ṛṛeẓq, seg igenni - Issidir yis tamurt, deffir tmettant is -, deg udewwel n waḍu, issekniyen i ugdud itmeyyizen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵍⵎⴳⴰⵔⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵢⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏ ⵕⵕⵥⵇ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ - ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔ ⵢⵉⵙ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⵉⵙ -, ⴷⴳ ⵓⴷⵡⵡⵍ ⵏ ⵡⴰⴹⵓ, ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵎⵢⵢⵉⵣⵏ.

ayah_content: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Anwa ameslay ara amnen, deffir Öebbi akked issekniyen iS?
latin_inalco: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Ṛebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidet. Anwa ameslay ara amnen, deffir Ṛebbi akked issekniyen iS?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ; ⵏⵎⵎⴰⵍ ⴰⴽ ⵜⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ. ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵎⵏⵏ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵙ?

ayah_content: A ssxev n yal akeddab amednub!
latin_inalco: A ssxeḍ n yal akeddab amednub!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ ⴰⵎⴷⵏⵓⴱ!

ayah_content: Issemêas i issekniyen n Öebbi, qqaôen as ten, sinna, iggernen di tem$weô, amzun ur asen isli. Ihi, becceô it s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Issemḥas i issekniyen n Ṛebbi, qqaṛen as ten, sinna, iggernen di temɣweṛ, amzun ur asen isli. Ihi, becceṛ it s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⴳⴳⵔⵏⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵖⵡⵕ, ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵍⵉ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma illa wayen iwumi isla, seg issekniyen nne£, ad ittihi fellas. I widak, aâaqeb isdullun.
latin_inalco: Ma illa wayen iwumi isla, seg issekniyen nneɣ, ad ittihi fellas. I widak, aɛaqeb isdullun.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵉⵙⵍⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵀⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ. ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Deffir sen Loahennama. Ur ten i$ennu s wacemma wayen kesben akked wayen rran d imawlan, war Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb abarar.
latin_inalco: Deffir sen Lǧahennama. Ur ten iɣennu s wacemma wayen kesben akked wayen rran d imawlan, war Ṛebbi. I nitni, aɛaqeb abarar.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵖⵏⵏⵓ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Tagi d nnhaya. Wid iugin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, fellasen aâaqeb n daâwessu taqeôêant.
latin_inalco: Tagi d nnhaya. Wid iugin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, fellasen aɛaqeb n daɛwessu taqeṛḥant.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⴳⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⴷⴰⵄⵡⵙⵙⵓ ⵜⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Öebbi i Inuben fellawen s yill; ipcali, fellas, lbabuô, s lameô iS; a pnadim l$it iS. Amar a ppesnemrem!
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi i Inuben fellawen s yill; itcali, fellas, lbabuṛ, s lameṛ iS; a tnadim lɣit iS. Amar a ttesnemrem!
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵏⵓⴱⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵢⵉⵍⵍ; ⵉⵜⵛⴰⵍⵉ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⵍⴱⴰⴱⵓⵕ, ⵙ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉⵙ; ⴰ ⵜⵏⴰⴷⵉⵎ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵎⴰⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵙⵏⵎⵔⵎ!

ayah_content: Inub fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt. Akw s$uôeS. S tidep, deg waya, d issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
latin_inalco: Inub fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt. Akw sɣuṛeS. S tidet, deg waya, d issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵓⴱ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⴰⴽⵡ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini i wid iumnen ad semmêen i wid ur negguni ara ussan n Öebbi, iwakken ad Ikafi agdud $ef wayen keppben.
latin_inalco: Ini i wid iumnen ad semmḥen i wid ur negguni ara ussan n Ṛebbi, iwakken ad Ikafi agdud ɣef wayen kettben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵎⵎⵃⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⴳⴳⵓⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵜⵜⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win ifalîan, mgal is. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen.
latin_inalco: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win ifalṭan, mgal is. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen tuɣalin nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ; ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⴰⵍⵟⴰⵏ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵉⵙ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nefka, i At Isôail, Tazmamt, ûûwab, lambiyya. Nôeéq iten s wayen ilhan. Nesmenyaf iten i imavalen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nefka, i At Isṛail, Tazmamt, ṣṣwab, lambiyya. Nṛeẓq iten s wayen ilhan. Nesmenyaf iten i imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ, ⵉ ⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⵕⴰⵉⵍ, ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⵍⴰⵎⴱⵉⵢⵢⴰ. ⵏⵕⵥⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ. ⵏⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Nefka yasen abeggen si Lameô. Ur mgarraden, armi i ten id tusa tmusni, wa iqheô wa. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.
latin_inalco: Nefka yasen abeggen si Lameṛ. Ur mgarraden, armi i ten id tusa tmusni, wa iqheṛ wa. Ih, Mass ik ad Iḥudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ. ⵓⵔ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ, ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰ ⵉⵇⵀⵕ ⵡⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Nebbwi k deg ubrid n Lameô. Ddu degs, ur teddu akked chawi n wid ur nessin.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Nebbwi k deg ubrid n Lameṛ. Ddu degs, ur teddu akked chawi n wid ur nessin.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⴽ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ. ⴷⴷⵓ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴷⴷⵓ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵛⵀⴰⵡⵉ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵙⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, nitni ur ak d ppawin acemma s$uô Öebbi. Imednas, ih, d imawlan wa n wa. Öebbi d Bab n wid ipêezziben.
latin_inalco: Ih, nitni ur ak d ttawin acemma sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Imednas, ih, d imawlan wa n wa. Ṛebbi d Bab n wid itḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⴰ ⵏ ⵡⴰ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ayagi d assekni i l$aci, d nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud ipputebbten.
latin_inalco: Ayagi d assekni i lɣaci, d nnhaya u d aḥunu i ugdud ittutebbten.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵍⵖⴰⵛⵉ, ⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵓ ⴷ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Ne$ $ilen wid imôôeôen iman nnsen s tucmitin, a ten Neêseb am wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d imuddiren ne$ d lmeggtin. Dir it uêuddu nnsen.
latin_inalco: Neɣ ɣilen wid imṛṛeṛen iman nnsen s tucmitin, a ten Neḥseb am wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d imuddiren neɣ d lmeggtin. Dir it uḥuddu nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵕⵕⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵃⵙⴱ ⴰⵎ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⵓⴷⴷⵉⵔⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵍⵎⴳⴳⵜⵉⵏ. ⴷⵉⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵓⵃⵓⴷⴷⵓ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep, iwakken yal amdan ad ippuqeîîi af wayen ikseb. Nitni ur pwadensen.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidet, iwakken yal amdan ad ittuqeṭṭi af wayen ikseb. Nitni ur twadensen.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴽⵙⴱ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⴷⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Twalav win irran lhawiyya s d ôebbi is? Itelf it Öebbi, asali $uôeS. Iskweô as ul, timejjin, Irra yas aâbôuq af allen is. Anwa ara t inhun, deffir Öebbi? Day u la tesmektayem ara?
latin_inalco: Twalaḍ win irran lhawiyya s d ṛebbi is? Itelf it Ṛebbi, asali ɣuṛeS. Iskweṛ as ul, timejjin, Irra yas aɛbṛuq af allen is. Anwa ara t inhun, deffir Ṛebbi? Day u la tesmektayem ara?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵍⵀⴰⵡⵉⵢⵢⴰ ⵙ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙ? ⵉⵜⵍⴼ ⵉⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⵉⵙⴽⵡⵕ ⴰⵙ ⵓⵍ, ⵜⵉⵎⵊⵊⵉⵏ, ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⴰⵄⴱⵕⵓⵇ ⴰⴼ ⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵏⵀⵓⵏ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Nnan: "i illan kan, d tudert nne$, di ddunit. A nemmet, a nidir. Ad a$ in$en kan d akud". £ef ayagi, ur sâin kra n tmusni. Nitni $ilen kan.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "i illan kan, d tudert nneɣ, di ddunit. A nemmet, a nidir. Ad aɣ inɣen kan d akud". ɣef ayagi, ur sɛin kra n tmusni. Nitni ɣilen kan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵜⵓⴷⵔⵜ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ. ⴰ ⵏⵎⵎⵜ, ⴰ ⵏⵉⴷⵉⵔ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵏⵖⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴽⵓⴷ". ⵖⴼ ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵉⵏ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ. ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, anamer nnsen, siwa mara d inin: "erret ed imezwura nne$, ma tessawalem tidep"!
latin_inalco: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nneɣ iberrzen, anamer nnsen, siwa mara d inin: "erret ed imezwura nneɣ, ma tessawalem tidet"!
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵎⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵉⴱⵔⵔⵣⵏ, ⴰⵏⴰⵎⵔ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵔⵔⵜ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵎ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ"!

ayah_content: Ini: "Öebbi Issidir ikwen, sinna, Ineqq ikwen. Sinna a kwen Issemlil ass n tnekra, ur illi degs ccekk". Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
latin_inalco: Ini: "Ṛebbi Issidir ikwen, sinna, Ineqq ikwen. Sinna a kwen Issemlil ass n tnekra, ur illi degs ccekk". Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵏⵇⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵍⵉⵍ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ". ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ass ideg ara d ias yimir, ass nni, ad xesôen ucmiten.
latin_inalco: N Ṛebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ass ideg ara d ias yimir, ass nni, ad xesṛen ucmiten.
Tifinagh: ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵅⵙⵕⵏ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: A pwaliv yal lois $ef tgwecrar, yal lois ipwanced ar tezmamt is. Assa, a p$eltem ayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: A twaliḍ yal lǧis ɣef tgwecrar, yal lǧis itwanced ar tezmamt is. Assa, a tɣeltem ayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⵖⴼ ⵜⴳⵡⵛⵔⴰⵔ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴷⵊⵉⵙ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵖⵍⵜⵎ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Tagi d tazmamt nne£, tessawal tidep fellawen. Nella Nepjerrid ayen akw txeddmem.
latin_inalco: Tagi d tazmamt nneɣ, tessawal tidet fellawen. Nella Netjerrid ayen akw txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ. ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⵏⵜⵊⵔⵔⵉⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Ihi, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Issekcem, Mass nnsen, s aêunu S. Wagi d rrbeê n ûûeê.
latin_inalco: Ihi, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Issekcem, Mass nnsen, s aḥunu S. Wagi d rrbeḥ n ṣṣeḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ. ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵔⵔⴱⵃ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵃ.

ayah_content: Wanag wid ijehlen: "day ur awen $ôan ara issekniyen iW? Tesme$wôem iman nnwen, tellam d agdud ibe$wviyen".
latin_inalco: Wanag wid ijehlen: "day ur awen ɣṛan ara issekniyen iW? Tesmeɣwṛem iman nnwen, tellam d agdud ibeɣwḍiyen".
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵖⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵡ? ⵜⵙⵎⵖⵡⵕⵎ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵜⵍⵍⴰⵎ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ".

ayah_content: Mi nnan: "ih, lemâahda n Öebbi, d tidep; imir, ur degs ccekk", tennam: "ur neéôi d acu ay d imir; $uône$ d nnwaya kan, ur nepputebbet".
latin_inalco: Mi nnan: "ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi, d tidet; imir, ur degs ccekk", tennam: "ur neẓṛi d acu ay d imir; ɣuṛneɣ d nnwaya kan, ur nettutebbet".
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵉⵀ, ⵍⵎⵄⴰⵀⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ; ⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ", ⵜⵏⵏⴰⵎ: "ⵓⵔ ⵏⵥⵕⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵉⵔ; ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⵏⵡⴰⵢⴰ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⵓⵜⴱⴱⵜ".

ayah_content: Ad asen d vehôent tucmitin xedmen, ad asen izzi wayen i$ef ttihin.
latin_inalco: Ad asen d ḍehṛent tucmitin xedmen, ad asen izzi wayen iɣef ttihin.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⴹⵀⵕⵏⵜ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵜⵉⵀⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad asen Inin: "assa, a kwen Neppu, akken teppum timlilit n wass nnwen agi. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi useîîaô.
latin_inalco: Ad asen Inin: "assa, a kwen Nettu, akken tettum timlilit n wass nnwen agi. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi useṭṭaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵜⵜⵓ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵎ ⵜⵉⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⴳⵉ. ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵙⵟⵟⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Ayagi, acku kunwi la tettihim $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. T$uôô ikwen tudert n ddunit. Assa, ur d teff$en segs". Ur isti$fiô êedd fellasen.
latin_inalco: Ayagi, acku kunwi la tettihim ɣef issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Tɣuṛṛ ikwen tudert n ddunit. Assa, ur d teffɣen segs". Ur istiɣfiṛ ḥedd fellasen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰⵛⴽⵓ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵉⵀⵉⵎ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵜⵖⵓⵕⵕ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵜⵓⴷⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ. ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳⵙ". ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵜⵉⵖⴼⵉⵕ ⵃⴷⴷ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: I Öebbi annuz, Mass igenwan, Mass n tmurt, Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: I Ṛebbi annuz, Mass igenwan, Mass n tmurt, Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: I Neppa akw ayen iufraren, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: I Netta akw ayen iufraren, di tmurt akked igenwan. Netta, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⴽⵡ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵓⴼⵔⴰⵔⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Ëm.
