Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⵉⵏ? ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵟⵟⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: Ne$ sâan ôebbi, ur Nelli d Öebbi? Gedha s Öebbi, seg wayen pcaraken!
latin_inalco: Neɣ sɛan ṛebbi, ur Nelli d Ṛebbi? Gedha s Ṛebbi, seg wayen tcaraken!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵏ!

ayah_content: Lemmer ad walin amur igenni i$li, ad as inin: "d asigna i izdin".
latin_inalco: Lemmer ad walin amur igenni iɣli, ad as inin: "d asigna i izdin".
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵎⵓⵔ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⵉⵖⵍⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵙⵉⴳⵏⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵣⴷⵉⵏ".

ayah_content: Ihi, eoo iten, ard mlilen d wass n ssiâqa nnsen,
latin_inalco: Ihi, eǧǧ iten, ard mlilen d wass n ssiɛqa nnsen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷⴷⵊ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⵎⵍⵉⵍⵏ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵙⵙⵉⵄⵇⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: Ass, ideg ur asen d teppawi acemma, tandit nnsen; ur asen illi usettaô.
latin_inalco: Ass, ideg ur asen d tettawi acemma, tandit nnsen; ur asen illi usettaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ, ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ, ⵜⴰⵏⴷⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵙⵜⵜⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: I wid idensen, s tidep, aâaqeb nniven, maca tegwti degsen, ur éôin.
latin_inalco: I wid idensen, s tidet, aɛaqeb nniḍen, maca tegwti degsen, ur ẓṛin.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵜⴳⵡⵜⵉ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Eûbeô i wayen d Iêudd Mass ik, aql ak, s tidep, ger wallen nne£. Sbuccaâ s ccekôan Mass ik, mara d tekkrev.
latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ i wayen d Iḥudd Mass ik, aql ak, s tidet, ger wallen nneɣ. Sbuccaɛ s ccekṛan Mass ik, mara d tekkreḍ.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵃⵓⴷⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴳⵔ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴽⴽⵔⴹ.

ayah_content: Sbuccaâ iT deg iv, u mara xsin yitran.
latin_inalco: Sbuccaɛ iT deg iḍ, u mara xsin yitran.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵉⵜ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ, ⵓ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵅⵙⵉⵏ ⵢⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: S yitri mara ixeppi!
latin_inalco: S yitri mara ixetti!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵢⵉⵜⵔⵉ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵅⵜⵜⵉ!

ayah_content: Ur innetlaf, ur i$liv umeddakwel nnwen.
latin_inalco: Ur innetlaf, ur iɣliḍ umeddakwel nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵖⵍⵉⴹ ⵓⵎⴷⴷⴰⴽⵡⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur d iqqaô akken i s ihwan.
latin_inalco: Ur d iqqaṛ akken i s ihwan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵕ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D aweêêi kan, id ippuweêêan.
latin_inalco: D aweḥḥi kan, id ittuweḥḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵡⵃⵃⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⵃⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Islemd it bab n tezmert iqwan.
latin_inalco: Islemd it bab n tezmert iqwan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵍⵎⴷ ⵉⵜ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ ⵉⵇⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D bab n tezmert irs ed
latin_inalco: D bab n tezmert irs ed
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ ⵉⵔⵙ ⴷ

ayah_content: u neppa di lejba aâlayen.
latin_inalco: u netta di lejba aɛlayen.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵍⵊⴱⴰ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna iqeôb ed, ippucengel,
latin_inalco: Sinna iqeṛb ed, ittucengel,
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵉⵇⵕⴱ ⴷ, ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵛⵏⴳⵍ,

ayah_content: atan tasurift n sin ixtucen, ne$ ur tebbwiv.
latin_inalco: atan tasurift n sin ixtucen, neɣ ur tebbwiḍ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵙⵓⵔⵉⴼⵜ ⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⵜⵓⵛⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵜⴱⴱⵡⵉⴹ.

ayah_content: D$a iweêêa i umdan iS, ayen iweêêa.
latin_inalco: Dɣa iweḥḥa i umdan iS, ayen iweḥḥa.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵖⴰ ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur iskaddeb wul deg wayen iwala.
latin_inalco: Ur iskaddeb wul deg wayen iwala.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ ⵡⵓⵍ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⴰ.

ayah_content: Day a t tnaqwmem, $ef wayen iwala?
latin_inalco: Day a t tnaqwmem, ɣef wayen iwala?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵜ ⵜⵏⴰⵇⵡⵎⵎ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⴰ?

ayah_content: Ni$ iéôa t di trusi s nniven,
latin_inalco: Niɣ iẓṛa t di trusi s nniḍen,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵙ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ,

ayah_content: ar tedxwent n talast,
latin_inalco: ar tedxwent n talast,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵜⴷⵅⵡⵏⵜ ⵏ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵙⵜ,

ayah_content: u$uô illa leonan usemlili.
latin_inalco: uɣuṛ illa leǧnan usemlili.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏ ⵓⵙⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Mi tesbur tedxwent ta$wlaft,
latin_inalco: Mi tesbur tedxwent taɣwlaft,
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵜⵙⴱⵓⵔ ⵜⴷⵅⵡⵏⵜ ⵜⴰⵖⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ,

ayah_content: ur iwweônenni yiéôi, ur izgir.
latin_inalco: ur iwweṛnenni yiẓṛi, ur izgir.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵡⵡⵕⵏⵏⵏⵉ ⵢⵉⵥⵕⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⴳⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Ni$ iwala kra issekniyen imeqwôaêanen, n Mass is.
latin_inalco: Niɣ iwala kra issekniyen imeqwṛaḥanen, n Mass is.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⴰ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏⵏ, ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Twalam Allat akked Lâuzza?
latin_inalco: Twalam Allat akked Lɛuzza?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵍⵍⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵄⵓⵣⵣⴰ?

ayah_content: Akked Manat, tis krav nniven?
latin_inalco: Akked Manat, tis kraḍ nniḍen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵎⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⵜⵉⵙ ⴽⵔⴰⴹ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ?

ayah_content: Day i kunwi ddkeô, i Neppa nnta?
latin_inalco: Day i kunwi ddkeṛ, i Netta nnta?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴷⴷⴽⵕ, ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ?

ayah_content: Wagi, ihi, d beîîu aneêyaf.
latin_inalco: Wagi, ihi, d beṭṭu aneḥyaf.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⴱⵟⵟⵓ ⴰⵏⵃⵢⴰⴼ.

ayah_content: Wigi d ismawen kan i sent tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur sent d Issers Öebbi kra udabu. Ïîafaôen kan nnwaya, akked wayen cehwant teôwiêin. Ni$ tusa ten id nnhaya s$uô Mass nnsen.
latin_inalco: Wigi d ismawen kan i sent tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur sent d Issers Ṛebbi kra udabu. Ṭṭafaṛen kan nnwaya, akked wayen cehwant teṛwiḥin. Niɣ tusa ten id nnhaya sɣuṛ Mass nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏⵜ ⵜⴼⴽⴰⵎ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵙⵏⵜ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵓⴷⴰⴱⵓ. ⵟⵟⴰⴼⴰⵕⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵛⵀⵡⴰⵏⵜ ⵜⵕⵡⵉⵃⵉⵏ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Aâni, i umdan, ayen issaram?
latin_inalco: Aɛni, i umdan, ayen issaram?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵏⵉ, ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵔⴰⵎ?

ayah_content: Tamezwarut akked tneggarut, n Öebbi.
latin_inalco: Tamezwarut akked tneggarut, n Ṛebbi.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔⵓⵜ, ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Acêal n lmalayek deg igenwan, ur d teppawi acemma ccafuâa nnsent, siwa deffir tsriê n Öebbi, $ef win Ib$a u Iôuva.
latin_inalco: Acḥal n lmalayek deg igenwan, ur d tettawi acemma ccafuɛa nnsent, siwa deffir tsriḥ n Ṛebbi, ɣef win Ibɣa u Iṛuḍa.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵃⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵛⵛⴰⴼⵓⵄⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵙⵔⵉⵃ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰ ⵓ ⵉⵕⵓⴹⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ur numin ara di laxeôt, ppaken i lmalayek ismawen n nnta.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid ur numin ara di laxeṛt, ttaken i lmalayek ismawen n nnta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵓⵎⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⵜⵜⴰⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⵉⵙⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur sâin fellas kra n tmusni. Ïîafaôen kan nnwaya. Wanag nnwaya ur tebbwi acemma si tidep.
latin_inalco: Ur sɛin fellas kra n tmusni. Ṭṭafaṛen kan nnwaya. Wanag nnwaya ur tebbwi acemma si tidet.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙⵄⵉⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ. ⵟⵟⴰⴼⴰⵕⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⴰⵢⴰ. ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵏⵏⵡⴰⵢⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ.

ayah_content: Ihi, eoo win iwexxôen i usmekti nne£, i ib$an kan tudert n ddunit.
latin_inalco: Ihi, eǧǧ win iwexxṛen i usmekti nneɣ, i ibɣan kan tudert n ddunit.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷⴷⵊ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵉ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⵓⴷⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: D aya ay sen tefka tmusni. Mass ik, war ccekk, Iéôa sennig akw, anwa innetlafen seg ubrid iS; Iéôa sennig akw, anwa i ipwanhan.
latin_inalco: D aya ay sen tefka tmusni. Mass ik, war ccekk, Iẓṛa sennig akw, anwa innetlafen seg ubrid iS; Iẓṛa sennig akw, anwa i itwanhan.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵢⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵙⵏ ⵜⴼⴽⴰ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ. ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⴰⴽⵡ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⵙ; ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⴰⴽⵡ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: N Öebbi ayen akw illan deg igenwan, illan di tmurt. Ad Iqeîîi wid ifalîan $ef wayen xedmen, ad Ioazi wid issweqmen, s ûûam.
latin_inalco: N Ṛebbi ayen akw illan deg igenwan, illan di tmurt. Ad Iqeṭṭi wid ifalṭan ɣef wayen xedmen, ad Iǧazi wid issweqmen, s ṣṣam.
Tifinagh: ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⴰⵍⵟⴰⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴷⵊⴰⵣⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵡⵇⵎⵏ, ⵙ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ.

ayah_content: Wid ijunben ibekkaven ibararen akked tucmitin, siwa lfalîat fessusen, ihi, d uwsiâ ssmaê n Mass ik. Neppa Issen ikwen sennig akw, mi kwen id Ixleq seg wakal, mi tellam d icelleqluqen, deg iâabbav n tyimmatin nnwen. Ur staâmilet tezdeg deg iman nnwen! Neppa Iéôa sennig akw, anwa iêezzben.
latin_inalco: Wid ijunben ibekkaḍen ibararen akked tucmitin, siwa lfalṭat fessusen, ihi, d uwsiɛ ssmaḥ n Mass ik. Netta Issen ikwen sennig akw, mi kwen id Ixleq seg wakal, mi tellam d icelleqluqen, deg iɛabbaḍ n tyimmatin nnwen. Ur staɛmilet tezdeg deg iman nnwen! Netta Iẓṛa sennig akw, anwa iḥezzben.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵓⵏⴱⵏ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵉⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵉⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵍⴼⴰⵍⵟⴰⵜ ⴼⵙⵙⵓⵙⵏ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⵓⵡⵙⵉⵄ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⴰⴽⵡ, ⵎⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍ, ⵎⵉ ⵜⵍⵍⴰⵎ ⴷ ⵉⵛⵍⵍⵇⵍⵓⵇⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵉⵄⴰⴱⴱⴰⴹ ⵏ ⵜⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵙⵜⴰⵄⵎⵉⵍⵜ ⵜⵣⴷⴳ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ! ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⴰⴽⵡ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵉⵃⵣⵣⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Twalav win iwexxôen,
latin_inalco: Twalaḍ win iwexxṛen,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: i ifkan cwiî, iccuêen?
latin_inalco: i ifkan cwiṭ, iccuḥen?
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⴼⴽⴰⵏ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ, ⵉⵛⵛⵓⵃⵏ?

ayah_content: Day isâa tamusni n tbavnit, d$a iwala?
latin_inalco: Day isɛa tamusni n tbaḍnit, dɣa iwala?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⵙⵄⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ ⵏ ⵜⴱⴰⴹⵏⵉⵜ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⴰ?

ayah_content: Ne$ ur ippuxebbeô $ef tewôiqin n Musa?
latin_inalco: Neɣ ur ittuxebbeṛ ɣef tewṛiqin n Musa?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵅⴱⴱⵕ ⵖⴼ ⵜⵡⵕⵉⵇⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ?

ayah_content: Akked Ibôahim ineûêen?
latin_inalco: Akked Ibṛahim ineṣḥen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ ⵉⵏⵚⵃⵏ?

ayah_content: Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev.
latin_inalco: Ur itbibbi yiwen taɛkkwemt n wayeḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⴱⵉⴱⴱⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵜⴰⵄⴽⴽⵡⵎⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴹ.

ayah_content: I umdan, siwa ayen inki.
latin_inalco: I umdan, siwa ayen inki.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵏⴽⵉ.

ayah_content: Ankay is a t iwali.
latin_inalco: Ankay is a t iwali.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⴽⴰⵢ ⵉⵙ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Sinna, a t Ikafi s lufa.
latin_inalco: Sinna, a t Ikafi s lufa.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵙ ⵍⵓⴼⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, ar Mass ik, taggara.
latin_inalco: Ih, ar Mass ik, taggara.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵜⴰⴳⴳⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Issevûan, i Issruyen.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Isseḍṣan, i Issruyen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⴹⵚⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵓⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Ineqqen, i Issidiren.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Ineqqen, i Issidiren.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵏⵇⵇⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Ixelqen tayuga, ddkeô akked nnta,
latin_inalco: D Netta i Ixelqen tayuga, ddkeṛ akked nnta,
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵢⵓⴳⴰ, ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ,

ayah_content: Si tiqqit n l$ella ma tuzzel.
latin_inalco: Si tiqqit n lɣella ma tuzzel.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⵇⵇⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵖⵍⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵣⵣⵍ.

ayah_content: FellaS, axlaq nniven.
latin_inalco: FellaS, axlaq nniḍen.
Tifinagh: ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ, ⴰⵅⵍⴰⵇ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i I$ennun, i Iqenâan.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Iɣennun, i Iqenɛan.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵖⵏⵏⵓⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵇⵏⵄⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i d Mass n Ciâra.
latin_inalco: D Netta i d Mass n Ciɛra.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵛⵉⵄⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Isnegren Âad imezwura.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Isnegren Ɛad imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵏⴳⵔⵏ ⵄⴰⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Si Tamud, ur d Iooi ara.
latin_inalco: Si Tamud, ur d Iǧǧi ara.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ, ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⴷⴷⵊⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Agdud n Nuê, uqbel nnsen, war ccekk, iugar iten ddens, lbbwe$v.
latin_inalco: Agdud n Nuḥ, uqbel nnsen, war ccekk, iugar iten ddens, lbbweɣḍ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵓⴳⴰⵔ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴷⴷⵏⵙ, ⵍⴱⴱⵡⵖⴹ.

ayah_content: Issenger tid inneqlaben;
latin_inalco: Issenger tid inneqlaben;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵏⴳⵔ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵏⵇⵍⴰⴱⵏ;

ayah_content: Idel iten s wayen idellen.
latin_inalco: Idel iten s wayen idellen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⵍ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷⵍⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Anta talalt n Mass ik ara tnamerev?
latin_inalco: Anta talalt n Mass ik ara tnamereḍ?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵜⴰ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵍⵜ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏⴰⵎⵔⴹ?

ayah_content: Wagi d aneddaô seg ineddaôen n zik.
latin_inalco: Wagi d aneddaṛ seg ineddaṛen n zik.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕⵏ ⵏ ⵣⵉⴽ.

ayah_content: A d taéé tin d ippaééen.
latin_inalco: A d taẓẓ tin d ittaẓẓen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵥⵥ ⵜⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵥⵥⵏ.

ayah_content: War Öebbi, ur illi ara p id issdehôen.
latin_inalco: War Ṛebbi, ur illi ara t id issdehṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴷⵀⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Iswehm ikwen wawal a?
latin_inalco: Iswehm ikwen wawal a?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵡⵀⵎ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴰ?

ayah_content: La tdessem ur la tepprum!
latin_inalco: La tdessem ur la tettrum!
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰ ⵜⴷⵙⵙⵎ ⵓⵔ ⵍⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵔⵓⵎ!

ayah_content: Kunwi di zzhu.
latin_inalco: Kunwi di zzhu.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵣⵣⵀⵓ.

ayah_content: Knut i Öebbi, âabdet.
latin_inalco: Knut i Ṛebbi, ɛabdet.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵏⵓⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵜ.

ayah_content: Iqeôb ed yimir; ifelleq waggur.
latin_inalco: Iqeṛb ed yimir; ifelleq waggur.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵇⵕⴱ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ; ⵉⴼⵍⵍⵇ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ.

ayah_content: Ma walan assekni, ad wexxôen, ad inin: "ipkemmil ssêur"!
latin_inalco: Ma walan assekni, ad wexxṛen, ad inin: "itkemmil ssḥur"!
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵉⵜⴽⵎⵎⵉⵍ ⵙⵙⵃⵓⵔ"!

ayah_content: Nekôen, îîafaôen lemcihwat nnsen. Ad iûaô yal lameô.
latin_inalco: Nekṛen, ṭṭafaṛen lemcihwat nnsen. Ad iṣaṛ yal lameṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵕⵏ, ⵟⵟⴰⴼⴰⵕⵏ ⵍⵎⵛⵉⵀⵡⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵉⵚⴰⵕ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ.

ayah_content: Ni$ usan ten id kra isallen, u wayen degsen iswexxiôen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ usan ten id kra isallen, u wayen degsen iswexxiṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵙⴰⵍⵍⵏ, ⵓ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Üûwab issakwayen. Maca ula iwumi aâaggen.
latin_inalco: Üṣwab issakwayen. Maca ula iwumi aɛaggen.
Tifinagh: Üⵚⵡⴰⴱ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴽⵡⴰⵢⵏ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⵓⵍⴰ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⴳⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, îîixxeô asen! Asmi ara d isiwel, uberraê, ar wayen iwaâôen,
latin_inalco: Ihi, ṭṭixxeṛ asen! Asmi ara d isiwel, uberraḥ, ar wayen iwaɛṛen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵟⵟⵉⵅⵅⵕ ⴰⵙⵏ! ⴰⵙⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵉⵡⵍ, ⵓⴱⵔⵔⴰⵃ, ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵄⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: s wallen ibran, ara d ff$en si tneîlin, am ujôad iwezzâen.
latin_inalco: s wallen ibran, ara d ffɣen si tneṭlin, am ujṛad iwezzɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵉⴱⵔⴰⵏ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵏⵟⵍⵉⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵓⵊⵕⴰⴷ ⵉⵡⵣⵣⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad éedmen, âaooôen, ar uberraê, ad inin ijehliyen: "wagi d ass uwâiô".
latin_inalco: Ad ẓedmen, ɛaǧǧṛen, ar uberraḥ, ad inin ijehliyen: "wagi d ass uwɛiṛ".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵥⴷⵎⵏ, ⵄⴰⴷⴷⵊⵕⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⴱⵔⵔⴰⵃ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ: "ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵡⵄⵉⵕ".

ayah_content: Agdud n Nuê, uqbel nnsen, iskaddeb. Skaddben amdan nne$. Nnan: "d aôehbani". Rran t id.
latin_inalco: Agdud n Nuḥ, uqbel nnsen, iskaddeb. Skaddben amdan nneɣ. Nnan: "d aṛehbani". Rran t id.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵏⵓⵃ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ. ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷ ⴰⵕⵀⴱⴰⵏⵉ". ⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵜ ⵉⴷ.

ayah_content: Inuj ar Mass is: "nek pwa$elbe$, Awes"!
latin_inalco: Inuj ar Mass is: "nek twaɣelbeɣ, Awes"!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵓⵊ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⴽ ⵜⵡⴰⵖⵍⴱⵖ, ⴰⵡⵙ"!

ayah_content: Nelli tibbura igenni, i waman d ihedman,
latin_inalco: Nelli tibbura igenni, i waman d ihedman,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵍⵍⵉ ⵜⵉⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵉ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵀⴷⵎⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: Nesgguffaâ d laânaûeô n tmurt, mlalen waman akken ipwagzem lameô;
latin_inalco: Nesgguffaɛ d laɛnaṣeṛ n tmurt, mlalen waman akken itwagzem lameṛ;
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⴳⴳⵓⴼⴼⴰⵄ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵄⵏⴰⵚⵕ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵎⵍⴰⵍⵏ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴳⵣⵎ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ;

ayah_content: Nebbwi t af tencirin, akked tavuî n tiffest.
latin_inalco: Nebbwi t af tencirin, akked taḍuṭ n tiffest.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵜ ⴰⴼ ⵜⵏⵛⵉⵔⵉⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴰⴹⵓⵟ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴼⴼⵙⵜ.

ayah_content: Teppeddu zdat wallen nne£, d arraz i win ipwanekôen.
latin_inalco: Tetteddu zdat wallen nneɣ, d arraz i win itwanekṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵜⵜⴷⴷⵓ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⴽⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Neooa p id d assekni. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
latin_inalco: Niɣ Neǧǧa t id d assekni. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Amek illa uqeîîi W u llant licaôat iW!
latin_inalco: Amek illa uqeṭṭi W u llant licaṛat iW!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵡ ⵓ ⵍⵍⴰⵏⵜ ⵍⵉⵛⴰⵕⴰⵜ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Ni$ Nsehhel Leqwôan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nsehhel Leqwṛan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵀⵀⵍ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Âad skaddben. Amek illa uqeîîi W u llant licaôat iW!
latin_inalco: Ɛad skaddben. Amek illa uqeṭṭi W u llant licaṛat iW!
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⴷ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ. ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵡ ⵓ ⵍⵍⴰⵏⵜ ⵍⵉⵛⴰⵕⴰⵜ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Ih, Nuzen asen aûeôûaô, ass amekêus, imezgi.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nuzen asen aṣeṛṣaṛ, ass amekḥus, imezgi.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵚⵕⵚⴰⵕ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵎⴽⵃⵓⵙ, ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ.

ayah_content: Ippawi medden amzun d iqeôôumen n tezdayin ipwaqelâen.
latin_inalco: Ittawi medden amzun d iqeṛṛumen n tezdayin itwaqelɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵇⵕⵕⵓⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵇⵍⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Amek illa uqeîîi W u llant licaôat iW!
latin_inalco: Amek illa uqeṭṭi W u llant licaṛat iW!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵡ ⵓ ⵍⵍⴰⵏⵜ ⵍⵉⵛⴰⵕⴰⵜ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Nsehhel Leqwôan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
latin_inalco: Nsehhel Leqwṛan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵀⵀⵍ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Tamud skaddben aâeggen.
latin_inalco: Tamud skaddben aɛeggen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⴰⵄⴳⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "day a neddu d yiwen n umdan segne$? Ihi, nekwni, war ccekk, di ttelfan, akked tisselbi.
latin_inalco: Nnan: "day a neddu d yiwen n umdan segneɣ? Ihi, nekwni, war ccekk, di ttelfan, akked tisselbi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⵓ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⴳⵏⵖ? ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵍⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Day d neppa, garane$, u$uô id iusa uneddeô? Wanag neppa, d akeddab uqbiê".
latin_inalco: Day d netta, garaneɣ, uɣuṛ id iusa uneddeṛ? Wanag netta, d akeddab uqbiḥ".
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ, ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵓⵏⴷⴷⵕ? ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ ⵓⵇⴱⵉⵃ".

ayah_content: Ad walin azekka, anwa ay d akeddab uqbiê!
latin_inalco: Ad walin azekka, anwa ay d akeddab uqbiḥ!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵣⴽⴽⴰ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱ ⵓⵇⴱⵉⵃ!

ayah_content: A Nazen, ih, tal$wemt i ujeôôeb nnsen. Qaôaâ ten, ili k d aûebôi.
latin_inalco: A Nazen, ih, talɣwemt i ujeṛṛeb nnsen. Qaṛaɛ ten, ili k d aṣebṛi.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵏⴰⵣⵏ, ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⵍⵖⵡⵎⵜ ⵉ ⵓⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵇⴰⵕⴰⵄ ⵜⵏ, ⵉⵍⵉ ⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵚⴱⵕⵉ.

ayah_content: Xebbeô iten ar aman ad pwafeôqen. Mkul tissit s tidwelt.
latin_inalco: Xebbeṛ iten ar aman ad twafeṛqen. Mkul tissit s tidwelt.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴱⴱⵕ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⵔ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⴼⵕⵇⵏ. ⵎⴽⵓⵍ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵡⵍⵜ.

ayah_content: Ssawlen i umeddakwel nnsen. Iusa d, igezm as ivaôen.
latin_inalco: Ssawlen i umeddakwel nnsen. Iusa d, igezm as iḍaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵙⴰⵡⵍⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴷⴰⴽⵡⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ, ⵉⴳⵣⵎ ⴰⵙ ⵉⴹⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Amek illa uqeîîi W u llant licaôat iW!
latin_inalco: Amek illa uqeṭṭi W u llant licaṛat iW!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵡ ⵓ ⵍⵍⴰⵏⵜ ⵍⵉⵛⴰⵕⴰⵜ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Nuzen asen d, s tidep, yiwen usu$u. U$alen am alim di tbergent.
latin_inalco: Nuzen asen d, s tidet, yiwen usuɣu. Uɣalen am alim di tbergent.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵓⵙⵓⵖⵓ. ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵎ ⴰⵍⵉⵎ ⴷⵉ ⵜⴱⵔⴳⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Nsehhel Leqwôan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
latin_inalco: Nsehhel Leqwṛan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵀⵀⵍ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Agdud n Luî skaddben aâeggen.
latin_inalco: Agdud n Luṭ skaddben aɛeggen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵟ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⴰⵄⴳⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, Nuzen asen ajebwani, kkes ed tawacult n Luî, i Nsellek qbel tafara,
latin_inalco: Ihi, Nuzen asen ajebwani, kkes ed tawacult n Luṭ, i Nsellek qbel tafara,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵊⴱⵡⴰⵏⵉ, ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵓⵟ, ⵉ ⵏⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵇⴱⵍ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵔⴰ,

ayah_content: d l$it s$uône£. Akka ay Nepkafi wid isnemmiren.
latin_inalco: d lɣit sɣuṛneɣ. Akka ay Netkafi wid isnemmiren.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵏⵜⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵏⵎⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ iâaggen asen, Newâaô. Rran aâeggen di ccekk.
latin_inalco: Niɣ iɛaggen asen, Newɛaṛ. Rran aɛeggen di ccekk.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵄⴰⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ, ⵏⵡⵄⴰⵕ. ⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⴰⵄⴳⴳⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ.

ayah_content: Ni$ ssutren t $ef inebgawen is. Nesder$el allen nnsen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb iW, akked uâaggen iW".
latin_inalco: Niɣ ssutren t ɣef inebgawen is. Nesderɣel allen nnsen: "jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb iW, akked uɛaggen iW".
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵏ ⵜ ⵖⴼ ⵉⵏⴱⴳⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵏⵙⴷⵔⵖⵍ ⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⵊⵕⵕⴱⵜ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵄⴰⴳⴳⵏ ⵉⵡ".

ayah_content: Iusa ten id, ssbeê zik, uâaqeb imezgi.
latin_inalco: Iusa ten id, ssbeḥ zik, uɛaqeb imezgi.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ, ⵙⵙⴱⵃ ⵣⵉⴽ, ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ.

ayah_content: Jeôôbet aâaqeb iW, akked uâeggen iW!
latin_inalco: Jeṛṛbet aɛaqeb iW, akked uɛeggen iW!
Tifinagh: ⵊⵕⵕⴱⵜ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵄⴳⴳⵏ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Nsehhel Leqwôan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
latin_inalco: Nsehhel Leqwṛan i usmekti. Day llan wid id ismektayen?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵀⵀⵍ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Ni$ iusa n uâeggen ar twacult n Ferâun.
latin_inalco: Niɣ iusa n uɛeggen ar twacult n Ferɛun.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵄⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵏ ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Skaddben issekniyen nne£, meôôa. Naâtad iten s ufus ioehden, izemren.
latin_inalco: Skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, meṛṛa. Naɛtad iten s ufus iǧehden, izemren.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵎⵕⵕⴰ. ⵏⴰⵄⵜⴰⴷ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵓⴼⵓⵙ ⵉⴷⵊⵀⴷⵏ, ⵉⵣⵎⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Aâni ijehliyen nnwen ifen wigi? Ne$ tesâam laânaya deg Ihellilen?
latin_inalco: Aɛni ijehliyen nnwen ifen wigi? Neɣ tesɛam laɛnaya deg Ihellilen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⵏ ⵡⵉⴳⵉ? ⵏⵖ ⵜⵙⵄⴰⵎ ⵍⴰⵄⵏⴰⵢⴰ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵀⵍⵍⵉⵍⵏ?

ayah_content: Ne$ a d inin: "nekwni d agraw ara irebêen"?
latin_inalco: Neɣ a d inin: "nekwni d agraw ara irebḥen"?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴳⵔⴰⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ"?

ayah_content: Agraw ad ixseô, ad wexxôen.
latin_inalco: Agraw ad ixseṛ, ad wexxṛen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⵔⴰⵡ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵅⵙⵕ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, imir d ppaâud nnsen. Imir d lhejna, u ôéag kteô.
latin_inalco: Ih, imir d ttaɛud nnsen. Imir d lhejna, u ṛẓag kteṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵜⴰⵄⵓⴷ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵎⵉⵔ ⴷ ⵍⵀⵊⵏⴰ, ⵓ ⵕⵥⴰⴳ ⴽⵜⵕ.

ayah_content: Ih, ibe$wdiyen di ttelfan akked tisselbi.
latin_inalco: Ih, ibeɣwdiyen di ttelfan akked tisselbi.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴷⵉⵢⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵍⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Asmi ara kkerkren ar tmes, $ef udmawen nnsen: "jeôôbet tanalit ujajiê"!
latin_inalco: Asmi ara kkerkren ar tmes, ɣef udmawen nnsen: "jeṛṛbet tanalit ujajiḥ"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽⴽⵔⴽⵔⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵙ, ⵖⴼ ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⵊⵕⵕⴱⵜ ⵜⴰⵏⴰⵍⵉⵜ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ"!

ayah_content: Ih, yal cci, Nxelq it s lmizan.
latin_inalco: Ih, yal cci, Nxelq it s lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Lameô nne£ siwa yiwen, am unqej n tiî.
latin_inalco: Lameṛ nneɣ siwa yiwen, am unqej n tiṭ.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵓⵏⵇⵊ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵟ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nesqucc wid i kwen icban. Day llan wid ara d ismektin?
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nesqucc wid i kwen icban. Day llan wid ara d ismektin?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵛⴱⴰⵏ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Yal igi nnsen deg Ihellilen.
latin_inalco: Yal igi nnsen deg Ihellilen.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⴳⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵀⵍⵍⵉⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Akw, meééi meqqweô, ppujerrden.
latin_inalco: Akw, meẓẓi meqqweṛ, ttujerrden.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⵡ, ⵎⵥⵥⵉ ⵎⵇⵇⵡⵕ, ⵜⵜⵓⵊⵔⵔⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ipêezziben, s tidep, di leonanat akked isaffen,
latin_inalco: Wid itḥezziben, s tidet, di leǧnanat akked isaffen,
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ,

ayah_content: deg umekkan n tidep, ar Ugellid Uzmir.
latin_inalco: deg umekkan n tidet, ar Ugellid Uzmir.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⴳⵍⵍⵉⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Aênin.
latin_inalco: Aḥnin.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵃⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Isseêfev Leqwôan.
latin_inalco: Isseḥfeḍ Leqwṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵃⴼⴹ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ixleq amdan.
latin_inalco: Ixleq amdan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Isselmed as ôôkuz.
latin_inalco: Isselmed as ṛṛkuz.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵍⵎⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵕⵕⴽⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: Iîij akked waggur, s leêsab.
latin_inalco: Iṭij akked waggur, s leḥsab.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵟⵉⵊ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ, ⵙ ⵍⵃⵙⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Itran akked ttjuô, knan.
latin_inalco: Itran akked ttjuṛ, knan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵜⵊⵓⵕ, ⴽⵏⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Igenni, Issuli t; Issers ed lmizan.
latin_inalco: Igenni, Issuli t; Issers ed lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵉⵙⵙⵓⵍⵉ ⵜ; ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur xedâat di lmizan.
latin_inalco: Ur xedɛat di lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵅⴷⵄⴰⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Weznet s tidep, ur ssexsaôet lmizan.
latin_inalco: Weznet s tidet, ur ssexsaṛet lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵣⵏⵜ ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵅⵙⴰⵕⵜ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Issewsaâ tamurt i imexlaq.
latin_inalco: Issewsaɛ tamurt i imexlaq.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵡⵙⴰⵄ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵉ ⵉⵎⵅⵍⴰⵇ.

ayah_content: Degs izwayen, tizdayin sut tkummiwin;
latin_inalco: Degs izwayen, tizdayin sut tkummiwin;
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ, ⵜⵉⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ ⵙⵓⵜ ⵜⴽⵓⵎⵎⵉⵡⵉⵏ;

ayah_content: iâqqayen s usa$uô, iferrawen utebtil.
latin_inalco: iɛqqayen s usaɣuṛ, iferrawen utebtil.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵄⵇⵇⴰⵢⵏ ⵙ ⵓⵙⴰⵖⵓⵕ, ⵉⴼⵔⵔⴰⵡⵏ ⵓⵜⴱⵜⵉⵍ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ixleq amdan si talaxt, am ujeqduô.
latin_inalco: Ixleq amdan si talaxt, am ujeqduṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⵅⵜ, ⴰⵎ ⵓⵊⵇⴷⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Ixleq loenn seg ujajiê n tmessi.
latin_inalco: Ixleq lǧenn seg ujajiḥ n tmessi.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵙⵙⵉ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Mass n sin igmav, Mass n sin ituram.
latin_inalco: Mass n sin igmaḍ, Mass n sin ituram.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⴳⵎⴰⴹ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵓⵔⴰⵎ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Iooa sin ilellen ad mqaôaben.
latin_inalco: Iǧǧa sin ilellen ad mqaṛaben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵍⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵎⵇⴰⵕⴰⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Garasen agadir, ur zegren.
latin_inalco: Garasen agadir, ur zegren.
Tifinagh: ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⴳⴰⴷⵉⵔ, ⵓⵔ ⵣⴳⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Teff$ent ed, segsen, tyuqat akked lmeôoan.
latin_inalco: Teffɣent ed, segsen, tyuqat akked lmeṛǧan.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴼⴼⵖⵏⵜ ⴷ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵜⵢⵓⵇⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵕⴷⵊⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: IneS lembwabeô pwabnan di yill, am idurar.
latin_inalco: IneS lembwabeṛ twabnan di yill, am idurar.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵍⵎⴱⵡⴰⴱⵕ ⵜⵡⴰⴱⵏⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵢⵉⵍⵍ, ⴰⵎ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ad ifut degs kra illan.
latin_inalco: Ad ifut degs kra illan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⴼⵓⵜ ⴷⴳⵙ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: A d igwri udem n Mass ik, Bab n ccan akked cciâa.
latin_inalco: A d igwri udem n Mass ik, Bab n ccan akked cciɛa.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴳⵡⵔⵉ ⵓⴷⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵛⵛⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵛⵛⵉⵄⴰ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Teppren T, yal ass, kra illan di tmurt akked igenwan, Neppa la Ixelleq.
latin_inalco: Tettren T, yal ass, kra illan di tmurt akked igenwan, Netta la Ixelleq.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵜⵜⵔⵏ ⵜ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵙⵙ, ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵍⴰ ⵉⵅⵍⵍⵇ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: A d Nelhi yidwen, a sin iéayanen!
latin_inalco: A d Nelhi yidwen, a sin iẓayanen!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵍⵀⵉ ⵢⵉⴷⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵥⴰⵢⴰⵏⵏ!

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: A yagraw n leonun akked imdanen, ma tzemrem a pzegrem akin i tmurt akked igenwan, zegret! Ur tepzeggirem siwa ma s udabu.
latin_inalco: A yagraw n leǧnun akked imdanen, ma tzemrem a tzegrem akin i tmurt akked igenwan, zegret! Ur tetzeggirem siwa ma s udabu.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵢⴰⴳⵔⴰⵡ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵎ ⴰ ⵜⵣⴳⵔⵎ ⴰⴽⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⵣⴳⵔⵜ! ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵣⴳⴳⵉⵔⵎ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵙ ⵓⴷⴰⴱⵓ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: A d teppewwtem s ijujaê n tmes akked nnêas. Ur tepsellikem iman nnwen.
latin_inalco: A d tettewwtem s ijujaḥ n tmes akked nnḥas. Ur tetsellikem iman nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵜⵜⵡⵡⵜⵎ ⵙ ⵉⵊⵓⵊⴰⵃ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵙ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵏⵏⵃⴰⵙ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵙⵍⵍⵉⴽⵎ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ma ifelleq igenni, iu$al d azeggwa$ am u$eggwad,
latin_inalco: Ma ifelleq igenni, iuɣal d azeggwaɣ am uɣeggwad,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⴼⵍⵍⵇ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴷ ⴰⵣⴳⴳⵡⴰⵖ ⴰⵎ ⵓⵖⴳⴳⵡⴰⴷ,

ayah_content: - Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin? -
latin_inalco: - Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin? -
Tifinagh: - ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ? -

ayah_content: assen, amdan ne$ loenn, ur fellas asteqsi $ef ubekkav is.
latin_inalco: assen, amdan neɣ lǧenn, ur fellas asteqsi ɣef ubekkaḍ is.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵏⵖ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⴰⵙⵜⵇⵙⵉ ⵖⴼ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ibe$wviyen, a d banen ar ccwami nnsen. Ad pwaîîfen seg icebbuben akked ivaôen.
latin_inalco: Ibeɣwḍiyen, a d banen ar ccwami nnsen. Ad twaṭṭfen seg icebbuben akked iḍaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⴱⴰⵏⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⵡⴰⵎⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵟⵟⴼⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵛⴱⴱⵓⴱⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴹⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: D tagi ay d Loahennama i skaddben ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: D tagi ay d Lǧahennama i skaddben ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⵉ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad ddewwiôen garas akked wayen ippayzagen.
latin_inalco: Ad ddewwiṛen garas akked wayen ittayzagen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴷⴷⵡⵡⵉⵕⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: I win iugaden ibeddi zdat Mass is, sin leonanat.
latin_inalco: I win iugaden ibeddi zdat Mass is, sin leǧnanat.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ ⵉⴱⴷⴷⵉ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵉⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: S tzegzew, d imselîen.
latin_inalco: S tzegzew, d imselṭen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵣⴳⵣⵡ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⵙⵍⵟⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Degs sin i$bula pfeggiven.
latin_inalco: Degs sin iɣbula tfeggiḍen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵖⴱⵓⵍⴰ ⵜⴼⴳⴳⵉⴹⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Degs yal izwayen, d tiyugiwin.
latin_inalco: Degs yal izwayen, d tiyugiwin.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⵢⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: èélen af imîeôêen ippuêewcen; izwayen n sin leonanat wâan asen.
latin_inalco: ẓẓlen af imṭeṛḥen ittuḥewcen; izwayen n sin leǧnanat wɛan asen.
Tifinagh: ⵥⵥⵍⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵃⵡⵛⵏ; ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⵡⵄⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Dinna, sut usekkud ipsetêin, ur tent innul yiwen, uqbel nnsen, d loenn ne$ d amdan.
latin_inalco: Dinna, sut usekkud itsetḥin, ur tent innul yiwen, uqbel nnsen, d lǧenn neɣ d amdan.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙⵓⵜ ⵓⵙⴽⴽⵓⴷ ⵉⵜⵙⵜⵃⵉⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵉⵏⵏⵓⵍ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Amzun nitenti d lyaqut akked lmeôoan.
latin_inalco: Amzun nitenti d lyaqut akked lmeṛǧan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵜⵉ ⴷ ⵍⵢⴰⵇⵓⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵕⴷⵊⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Nni$ arraz n wayen ilhan, d ayen ilhan?
latin_inalco: Nniɣ arraz n wayen ilhan, d ayen ilhan?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Sin leonanat nniven.
latin_inalco: Sin leǧnanat nniḍen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵉⴹⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: S tzegzewt isemmxen.
latin_inalco: S tzegzewt isemmxen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵣⴳⵣⵡⵜ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵅⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Degsen snat n tliwa gguffant.
latin_inalco: Degsen snat n tliwa gguffant.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵙⵏⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ ⴳⴳⵓⴼⴼⴰⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Degsen izwayen, tizdayin, ôemman.
latin_inalco: Degsen izwayen, tizdayin, ṛemman.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ, ⵜⵉⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ, ⵕⵎⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Degsen tiferni akked ûûam.
latin_inalco: Degsen tiferni akked ṣṣam.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⵏⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Tiêuôiyin ized$en di texxamin.
latin_inalco: Tiḥuṛiyin izedɣen di texxamin.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵃⵓⵕⵉⵢⵉⵏ ⵉⵣⴷⵖⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵅⵅⴰⵎⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ur tent innul yiwen, uqbel nnsen, d loenn ne$ d amdan.
latin_inalco: Ur tent innul yiwen, uqbel nnsen, d lǧenn neɣ d amdan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵉⵏⵏⵓⵍ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏ ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Ad élen af imîeôêen izegzawen akked d tôakniwin ilhan.
latin_inalco: Ad ẓlen af imṭeṛḥen izegzawen akked d tṛakniwin ilhan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵥⵍⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ ⵉⵣⴳⵣⴰⵡⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴷ ⵜⵕⴰⴽⵏⵉⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa seg i$iten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
latin_inalco: Anwa seg iɣiten n Mass nnwen ara teskiddben, i sin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵖⵉⵜⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ, ⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Iôqa ism n Mass ik, Bab n ccan akked cciâa.
latin_inalco: Iṛqa ism n Mass ik, Bab n ccan akked cciɛa.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵕⵇⴰ ⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵛⵛⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵛⵛⵉⵄⴰ.

ayah_content: Mara d tas, tin ara d iasen,
latin_inalco: Mara d tas, tin ara d iasen,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵙ, ⵜⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: $ef tisin is, ur illi ucehrir.
latin_inalco: ɣef tisin is, ur illi ucehrir.
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⵜⵉⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵓⵛⵀⵔⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Tessrusu, treffed.
latin_inalco: Tessrusu, treffed.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵙⵙⵔⵓⵙⵓ, ⵜⵔⴼⴼⴷ.

ayah_content: Ma tenhez tmurt, lhezz iqesêen,
latin_inalco: Ma tenhez tmurt, lhezz iqesḥen,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵏⵀⵣ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵍⵀⵣⵣ ⵉⵇⵙⵃⵏ,

ayah_content: idurar ftutsen,
latin_inalco: idurar ftutsen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⴼⵜⵓⵜⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: u$alen d a$ebbaô ippuwezzâen,
latin_inalco: uɣalen d aɣebbaṛ ittuwezzɛen,
Tifinagh: ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵖⴱⴱⴰⵕ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⵣⵣⵄⵏ,

ayah_content: a d tevêum krav leûnaf:
latin_inalco: a d teḍḥum kraḍ leṣnaf:
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴹⵃⵓⵎ ⴽⵔⴰⴹ ⵍⵚⵏⴰⴼ:

ayah_content: at uyeffus. At uyeffus, anwi ten?
latin_inalco: at uyeffus. At uyeffus, anwi ten?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜ ⵓⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ. ⴰⵜ ⵓⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ, ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⵜⵏ?

ayah_content: At uzelmav. At uzelmav, anwi ten?
latin_inalco: At uzelmaḍ. At uzelmaḍ, anwi ten?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜ ⵓⵣⵍⵎⴰⴹ. ⴰⵜ ⵓⵣⵍⵎⴰⴹ, ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⵜⵏ?

ayah_content: Akked imezwura, imezwura,
latin_inalco: Akked imezwura, imezwura,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ, ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ,

ayah_content: Widak d iqôiben;
latin_inalco: Widak d iqṛiben;
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵇⵕⵉⴱⵏ;

ayah_content: di leonanat isaâdiyen.
latin_inalco: di leǧnanat isaɛdiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⵉⵙⴰⵄⴷⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Seg imenza, deg waîas idsen.
latin_inalco: Seg imenza, deg waṭas idsen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵏⵣⴰ, ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉⴷⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Seg ineggura, drus nnsen.
latin_inalco: Seg ineggura, drus nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ, ⴷⵔⵓⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: £ef imîeôêen iévan,
latin_inalco: ɣef imṭeṛḥen iẓḍan,
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ ⵉⵥⴹⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: éélen fellasen, mqabalen.
latin_inalco: ẓẓlen fellasen, mqabalen.
Tifinagh: ⵥⵥⵍⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ, ⵎⵇⴰⴱⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Tezzin asen ilmeéiyen iwekkôen,
latin_inalco: Tezzin asen ilmeẓiyen iwekkṛen,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵣⵣⵉⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵎⵥⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: s tbuqalin, iqbucen, akked lkas n tissit iûfan.
latin_inalco: s tbuqalin, iqbucen, akked lkas n tissit iṣfan.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⴱⵓⵇⴰⵍⵉⵏ, ⵉⵇⴱⵓⵛⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴽⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵉⵚⴼⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Yis, ur ppavnen, ur sekkôen.
latin_inalco: Yis, ur ttaḍnen, ur sekkṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵢⵉⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴹⵏⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⴽⴽⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Izwayen, seg wid smenyafen.
latin_inalco: Izwayen, seg wid smenyafen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: Aksum n yifôax, seg win cedhan.
latin_inalco: Aksum n yifṛax, seg win cedhan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⵙⵓⵎ ⵏ ⵢⵉⴼⵕⴰⵅ, ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵛⴷⵀⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Tiêuôiyin lâin,
latin_inalco: Tiḥuṛiyin lɛin,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵃⵓⵕⵉⵢⵉⵏ ⵍⵄⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: am tyaqutin iffren.
latin_inalco: am tyaqutin iffren.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎ ⵜⵢⴰⵇⵓⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: D arraz n wayen xeddmen.
latin_inalco: D arraz n wayen xeddmen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur din sellen awal n leqbaêa, ne$ n tuccva;
latin_inalco: Ur din sellen awal n leqbaḥa, neɣ n tuccḍa;
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷⵉⵏ ⵙⵍⵍⵏ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵍⵇⴱⴰⵃⴰ, ⵏⵖ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ;

ayah_content: siwa awal n tifrat, tifrat!
latin_inalco: siwa awal n tifrat, tifrat!
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ, ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ!

ayah_content: At uyeffus, at uyeffus, d acu ten?
latin_inalco: At uyeffus, at uyeffus, d acu ten?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜ ⵓⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ, ⴰⵜ ⵓⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜⵏ?

ayah_content: Ar tzegwart, war isennanen.
latin_inalco: Ar tzegwart, war isennanen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵜⵣⴳⵡⴰⵔⵜ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵉⵙⵏⵏⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Tulmatin iurwen.
latin_inalco: Tulmatin iurwen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵓⵍⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⵔⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Tili iwsâen.
latin_inalco: Tili iwsɛen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵉⵡⵙⵄⵏ.

ayah_content: Aman ippazalen.
latin_inalco: Aman ittazalen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵣⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Aîas n yizwayen,
latin_inalco: Aṭas n yizwayen,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ,

ayah_content: ur zegzawit, ur ppugedlen.
latin_inalco: ur zegzawit, ur ttugedlen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵣⴳⵣⴰⵡⵉⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵓⴳⴷⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Imîeôêen aâlayen.
latin_inalco: Imṭeṛḥen aɛlayen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: D Nekwni itent Ixelqen,
latin_inalco: D Nekwni itent Ixelqen,
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵉⵜⵏⵜ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ,

ayah_content: Nerra tent d tiêuôiyin;
latin_inalco: Nerra tent d tiḥuṛiyin;
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜⵏⵜ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵃⵓⵕⵉⵢⵉⵏ;

ayah_content: pêemmilent, d tizyiwin,
latin_inalco: tḥemmilent, d tizyiwin,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵃⵎⵎⵉⵍⵏⵜ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⵣⵢⵉⵡⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: i at uyeffus.
latin_inalco: i at uyeffus.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⴰⵜ ⵓⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ.

ayah_content: Seg imenza, deg aîas idsen.
latin_inalco: Seg imenza, deg aṭas idsen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵏⵣⴰ, ⴷⴳ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉⴷⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Seg ineggura, deg aîas idsen.
latin_inalco: Seg ineggura, deg aṭas idsen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ, ⴷⴳ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉⴷⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: At uzelmav, at uzelmav, d acu ten?
latin_inalco: At uzelmaḍ, at uzelmaḍ, d acu ten?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜ ⵓⵣⵍⵎⴰⴹ, ⴰⵜ ⵓⵣⵍⵎⴰⴹ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜⵏ?

ayah_content: Deg wavu, akked waman iô$an.
latin_inalco: Deg waḍu, akked waman iṛɣan.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⴹⵓ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵕⵖⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Tili n wabbu iô$an.
latin_inalco: Tili n wabbu iṛɣan.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵏ ⵡⴰⴱⴱⵓ ⵉⵕⵖⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur degs tasmuvi, lekyasa.
latin_inalco: Ur degs tasmuḍi, lekyasa.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵜⴰⵙⵎⵓⴹⵉ, ⵍⴽⵢⴰⵙⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, nitni zik, llan ôwan.
latin_inalco: Ih, nitni zik, llan ṛwan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵣⵉⴽ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵕⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Zgan deg ubekkav abarar.
latin_inalco: Zgan deg ubekkaḍ abarar.
Tifinagh: ⵣⴳⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: Llan qqaôen: "ma nemmut, nu$al d akal, akked i$san, day a d a$ d rren?
latin_inalco: Llan qqaṛen: "ma nemmut, nuɣal d akal, akked iɣsan, day a d aɣ d rren?
Tifinagh: ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ: "ⵎⴰ ⵏⵎⵎⵓⵜ, ⵏⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴰⵍ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵖⵙⴰⵏ, ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵖ ⴷ ⵔⵔⵏ?

ayah_content: Akked imezwura nne$ imenza"?
latin_inalco: Akked imezwura nneɣ imenza"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵉⵎⵏⵣⴰ"?

ayah_content: Ini: "ih, imezwura akked ineggura,
latin_inalco: Ini: "ih, imezwura akked ineggura,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ,

ayah_content: ad ppujemmlen ar temlilit n wass ipwassnen".
latin_inalco: ad ttujemmlen ar temlilit n wass itwassnen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵓⵊⵎⵎⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ".

ayah_content: D$a, ih, a yim$eôôqen, i illan d inekkaôen,
latin_inalco: Dɣa, ih, a yimɣeṛṛqen, i illan d inekkaṛen,
Tifinagh: ⴷⵖⴰ, ⵉⵀ, ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⵖⵕⵕⵇⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: a ppeççem, war ccekk, si ttejôa n Zaqqum.
latin_inalco: a tteččem, war ccekk, si ttejṛa n Zaqqum.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵛⵎ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⵜⵊⵕⴰ ⵏ ⵣⴰⵇⵇⵓⵎ.

ayah_content: A ppacaôem segs ifwaden.
latin_inalco: A ttacaṛem segs ifwaden.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵛⴰⵕⵎ ⵙⴳⵙ ⵉⴼⵡⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, a ppernum tissit seg waman iô$an.
latin_inalco: Sinna, a tternum tissit seg waman iṛɣan.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⵔⵏⵓⵎ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵕⵖⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: A ppetessem tissit ile$wman.
latin_inalco: A ttetessem tissit ileɣwman.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵜⵜⵙⵙⵎ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵉⵍⵖⵡⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D wagi ar asen d irsen, ass uqeîîi.
latin_inalco: D wagi ar asen d irsen, ass uqeṭṭi.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵙⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ.

ayah_content: D Nekwni ikwen Ixelqen. Lemmer a ppamnem.
latin_inalco: D Nekwni ikwen Ixelqen. Lemmer a ttamnem.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ. ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵎⵏⵎ.

ayah_content: Twalam l$ella id iteff$en segwen?
latin_inalco: Twalam lɣella id iteffɣen segwen?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⵍⵖⵍⵍⴰ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ?

ayah_content: D kunwi ip ixelqen, ne$ d Nekwni ay d ixellaqen?
latin_inalco: D kunwi it ixelqen, neɣ d Nekwni ay d ixellaqen?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇⵏ?

ayah_content: Nseyya tameppant garawen. Ur a£ izeggwir yiwen
latin_inalco: Nseyya tamettant garawen. Ur aɣ izeggwir yiwen
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵢⵢⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵣⴳⴳⵡⵉⵔ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ

ayah_content: iwakken a Nerr deg umkan nnwen wid i kwen icban; u kunwi, a kwen Nexleq d ayen ur tessinem.
latin_inalco: iwakken a Nerr deg umkan nnwen wid i kwen icban; u kunwi, a kwen Nexleq d ayen ur tessinem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵏⵔⵔ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵛⴱⴰⵏ; ⵓ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⵙⵉⵏⵎ.

ayah_content: Ni$ tesnem axlaq amenzu, lemmer tesmektayem!
latin_inalco: Niɣ tesnem axlaq amenzu, lemmer tesmektayem!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵜⵙⵏⵎ ⴰⵅⵍⴰⵇ ⴰⵎⵏⵣⵓ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵜⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵎ!

ayah_content: Twalam ayen tkerrzem?
latin_inalco: Twalam ayen tkerrzem?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴽⵔⵔⵣⵎ?

ayah_content: D kunwi i t ikerzen, ne$ d Nekwni ay d imekrazen?
latin_inalco: D kunwi i t ikerzen, neɣ d Nekwni ay d imekrazen?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⴽⵔⵣⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴽⵔⴰⵣⵏ?

ayah_content: Ma ihwa ya£, a t Nerr d uêvim, d$a a kwen tekkat lwehma:
latin_inalco: Ma ihwa yaɣ, a t Nerr d uḥḍim, dɣa a kwen tekkat lwehma:
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵖ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵏⵔⵔ ⴷ ⵓⵃⴹⵉⵎ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵜⴽⴽⴰⵜ ⵍⵡⵀⵎⴰ:

ayah_content: "Aql a$ nepwalas!
latin_inalco: "Aql aɣ netwalas!
Tifinagh: "ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ ⵏⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵙ!

ayah_content: Sennig waya: aql a$ neppuêeôôem"!
latin_inalco: Sennig waya: aql aɣ nettuḥeṛṛem"!
Tifinagh: ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ: ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ ⵏⵜⵜⵓⵃⵕⵕⵎ"!

ayah_content: Twalam aman i teppessem?
latin_inalco: Twalam aman i tettessem?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵜⵜⵙⵙⵎ?

ayah_content: D kunwi iten id isse$layen seg usigna, ne$ d Nekwni?
latin_inalco: D kunwi iten id isseɣlayen seg usigna, neɣ d Nekwni?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵖⵍⴰⵢⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵙⵉⴳⵏⴰ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ?

ayah_content: Ma ihwa ya£, a ten Nerr d imeô$anen. A lemmer tesnemmiren!
latin_inalco: Ma ihwa yaɣ, a ten Nerr d imeṛɣanen. A lemmer tesnemmiren!
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵖ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵔⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵕⵖⴰⵏⵏ. ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵜⵙⵏⵎⵎⵉⵔⵏ!

ayah_content: Twalam times i tesskarem s uêukku?
latin_inalco: Twalam times i tesskarem s uḥukku?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⵉ ⵜⵙⵙⴽⴰⵔⵎ ⵙ ⵓⵃⵓⴽⴽⵓ?

ayah_content: D kunwi i s d ixelqen ttjuô is, ne$ d Nekwni ay d Ixellaqen?
latin_inalco: D kunwi i s d ixelqen ttjuṛ is, neɣ d Nekwni ay d Ixellaqen?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⵜⵊⵓⵕ ⵉⵙ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵅⵍⵍⴰⵇⵏ?

ayah_content: D Nekwni i p Irran d asmekti, u d lâafia i wid ineêwwaoen.
latin_inalco: D Nekwni i t Irran d asmekti, u d lɛafia i wid ineḥwwaǧen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵍⵄⴰⴼⵉⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵏⵃⵡⵡⴰⴷⵊⵏ.

ayah_content: Sbuccaâ, s ccekôan, isem n Mass ik, Ameqwôaêan!
latin_inalco: Sbuccaɛ, s ccekṛan, isem n Mass ik, Ameqwṛaḥan!
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ, ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ, ⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: Ih, gulle$ seg wanda llan itran!
latin_inalco: Ih, gulleɣ seg wanda llan itran!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴳⵓⵍⵍⵖ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: U, tagi, lemmer a ppeéôem, ard tagallit tameqwôaêant!
latin_inalco: U, tagi, lemmer a tteẓṛem, ard tagallit tameqwṛaḥant!
Tifinagh: ⵓ, ⵜⴰⴳⵉ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵥⵕⵎ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵜⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏⵜ!

ayah_content: Ar neppa d Leqwôan ukyis,
latin_inalco: Ar netta d Leqwṛan ukyis,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙ,

ayah_content: di Tezmamt iffren.
latin_inalco: di Tezmamt iffren.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur t pnalen, siwa wid zeddigen.
latin_inalco: Ur t tnalen, siwa wid zeddigen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵜⵏⴰⵍⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵣⴷⴷⵉⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: D tarusi s$uô Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: D tarusi sɣuṛ Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⵔⵓⵙⵉ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: S usali agi, amendeô ma a ppiéidem?
latin_inalco: S usali agi, amendeṛ ma a ttiẓidem?
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵓⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰⵎⵏⴷⵕ ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵥⵉⴷⵎ?

ayah_content: S ôôeéq nnwen, kunwi tnekôem?
latin_inalco: S ṛṛeẓq nnwen, kunwi tnekṛem?
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵕⵕⵥⵇ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ ⵜⵏⴽⵕⵎ?

ayah_content: Mara d tawev s agerjum,
latin_inalco: Mara d taweḍ s agerjum,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵡⴹ ⵙ ⴰⴳⵔⵊⵓⵎ,

ayah_content: kunwi, imiren, teppaôoum,
latin_inalco: kunwi, imiren, tettaṛǧum,
Tifinagh: ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵉⵎⵉⵔⵏ, ⵜⵜⵜⴰⵕⴷⵊⵓⵎ,

ayah_content: Nekwni, sennig wen, i Neqôeb $uôes, maca, ur twalam ara.
latin_inalco: Nekwni, sennig wen, i Neqṛeb ɣuṛes, maca, ur twalam ara.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵏ, ⵉ ⵏⵇⵕⴱ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Xas ma ur tellim d wid ur nepwalas,
latin_inalco: Xas ma ur tellim d wid ur netwalas,
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵙ ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⵎ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵙ,

ayah_content: erret p id, ma tessawalem tidep!
latin_inalco: erret t id, ma tessawalem tidet!
Tifinagh: ⴻⵔⵔⵜ ⵜ ⵉⴷ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵎ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ!

ayah_content: Ma illa seg iqôiben,
latin_inalco: Ma illa seg iqṛiben,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵇⵕⵉⴱⵏ,

ayah_content: ihi, abeêri, laâîeô, di leonan n ssuâada.
latin_inalco: ihi, abeḥri, laɛṭeṛ, di leǧnan n ssuɛada.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⴱⵃⵔⵉ, ⵍⴰⵄⵟⵕ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵙⵙⵓⵄⴰⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Ma illa seg iyeffusen:
latin_inalco: Ma illa seg iyeffusen:
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙⵏ:

ayah_content: "i keçç tifrat, seg iyeffusen"!
latin_inalco: "i kečč tifrat, seg iyeffusen"!
Tifinagh: "ⵉ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙⵏ"!

ayah_content: Ma illa seg inekkaôen innetlafen,
latin_inalco: Ma illa seg inekkaṛen innetlafen,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ ⵉⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ,

ayah_content: axxam is seg waman ippayzagen,
latin_inalco: axxam is seg waman ittayzagen,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⵙ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳⵏ,

ayah_content: ad iô$ deg ujajiê.
latin_inalco: ad iṛɣ deg ujajiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵕⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Ayagi, ih, d tidep itebbten.
latin_inalco: Ayagi, ih, d tidet itebbten.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ ⵉⵜⴱⴱⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Sbuccaâ, s ccekôan, isem n Mass ik Ameqwôaêan!
latin_inalco: Sbuccaɛ, s ccekṛan, isem n Mass ik Ameqwṛaḥan!
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ, ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ, ⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: Sbuccuâen, s ccekôan Öebbi, ayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Sbuccuɛen, s ccekṛan Ṛebbi, ayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Netta d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ, ⵙ ⵛⵛⴽⵕⴰⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan; Issidir, Ineqq; u Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
latin_inalco: IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan; Issidir, Ineqq; u Netta Izmer i yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ; ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔ, ⵉⵏⵇⵇ; ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: D Neppa ay d amezwaru, ay d aneggaru; d ayen d ibanen akked wayen iffren. Neppa Iéôa yal cci.
latin_inalco: D Netta ay d amezwaru, ay d aneggaru; d ayen d ibanen akked wayen iffren. Netta Iẓṛa yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓ, ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔⵓ; ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵏⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iâannec af usgeld. Iéôa i ikeççmen ar tmurt, akked wayen id iteff$en segs, ayen id ippadren seg igenni, akked wayen ippalin $uôes. Neppa yidwen, anda ma tellam. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txedmem.
latin_inalco: D Netta i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iɛannec af usgeld. Iẓṛa i ikeččmen ar tmurt, akked wayen id iteffɣen segs, ayen id ittadren seg igenni, akked wayen ittalin ɣuṛes. Netta yidwen, anda ma tellam. Ṛebbi Itwali ayen txedmem.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵙⴷⵉⵙ ⵡⵓⵙⵙⴰⵏ. ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵄⴰⵏⵏⵛ ⴰⴼ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ. ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵉ ⵉⴽⵜⵜⵛⵎⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳⵙ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵢⵉⴷⵡⵏ, ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵍⵍⴰⵎ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ar Öebbi ara u$alen lumuô.
latin_inalco: IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ar Ṛebbi ara uɣalen lumuṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⵍⵓⵎⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. Iéôa ayen illan deg idmaren.
latin_inalco: Issekcam iḍ deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiḍ. Iẓṛa ayen illan deg idmaren.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⴰⵎ ⵉⴹ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ, ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⴰⵎ ⴰⵙⵙ ⴷⴳ ⵢⵉⴹ. ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS! Efket seg wayen i$ef i kwen Irra, degs, d igensas. Wid iumnen segwen, iseddqen, d ameqwôan warraz nnsen.
latin_inalco: Amnet s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS! Efket seg wayen iɣef i kwen Irra, degs, d igensas. Wid iumnen segwen, iseddqen, d ameqwṛan warraz nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⵏⵜ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ! ⴼⴽⵜ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔⴰ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵙⴰⵙ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵉⵙⴷⴷⵇⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Acu ikwen iu$en, ur tuminem ara s Öebbi? Amazan ipnabi kwen a ppamnem s Mass nnwen. Ni$ $uôes nnesba nnwen, ma tellam d lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Acu ikwen iuɣen, ur tuminem ara s Ṛebbi? Amazan itnabi kwen a ttamnem s Mass nnwen. Niɣ ɣuṛes nnesba nnwen, ma tellam d lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵓⵎⵉⵏⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵏⴰⴱⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵎⵏⵎ ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⴱⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵍⵍⴰⵎ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: D Neppa id Issadren i umdan iS, issekniyen iberrzen, iwakken a kwen Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat. Ih, Öebbi, fellawen, d Umâin Ipêunun.
latin_inalco: D Netta id Issadren i umdan iS, issekniyen iberrzen, iwakken a kwen Issuffeɣ si tillas ar tafat. Ih, Ṛebbi, fellawen, d Umɛin Itḥunun.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⴱⵔⵔⵣⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Acu ikwen iu$en, ur tepseddiqem deg ubrid n Öebbi? N Öebbi lweôt n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur taâdilem ara: wid iseddqen uqbel l$elb, u nnu$en, widak, ad aâlayen, nezzeh, sennig wid iseddqen sin $er da, u nnu$en. Iwaââed asen akw Öebbi ûûam. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txedmem.
latin_inalco: Acu ikwen iuɣen, ur tetseddiqem deg ubrid n Ṛebbi? N Ṛebbi lweṛt n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur taɛdilem ara: wid iseddqen uqbel lɣelb, u nnuɣen, widak, ad aɛlayen, nezzeh, sennig wid iseddqen sin ɣer da, u nnuɣen. Iwaɛɛed asen akw Ṛebbi ṣṣam. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵙⴷⴷⵉⵇⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵍⵡⵕⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⴰⵄⴷⵉⵍⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴷⴷⵇⵏ ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵍⵖⵍⴱ, ⵓ ⵏⵏⵓⵖⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ, ⵏⵣⵣⵀ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴷⴷⵇⵏ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵖⵔ ⴷⴰ, ⵓ ⵏⵏⵓⵖⵏ. ⵉⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Win iôevlen i Öebbi aôeîîal umâin, ad as d Irr s lufa, u ines warraz ukyis.
latin_inalco: Win iṛeḍlen i Ṛebbi aṛeṭṭal umɛin, ad as d Irr s lufa, u ines warraz ukyis.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵕⴹⵍⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵕⵟⵟⴰⵍ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵙ ⵍⵓⴼⴰ, ⵓ ⵉⵏⵙ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Asmi ara twaliv lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, teddun tafat nnsen zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen: "a lxiô nnwen, assa, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen a pwekkôem! D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan".
latin_inalco: Asmi ara twaliḍ lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, teddun tafat nnsen zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen: "a lxiṛ nnwen, assa, di leǧnanat, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen, degsen a twekkṛem! D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵜⴰⵎⵟⵟⵓⵜ, ⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ, ⵓ ⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⴰ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵡⴽⴽⵕⵎ! ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵔⵔⴱⵃ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Ass ideg ixabiten, argaz tameîîut, ad inin i wid iumnen: "arout a$, a neddem si tafat nnwen"! A d inin: "u$alet ar deffir, a d tqelbem tafat"! Ad yili garasen lêiv, s tebburt. Zdaxel d aêunu, beôôa, zdat es: aâaqeb.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ixabiten, argaz tameṭṭut, ad inin i wid iumnen: "arǧut aɣ, a neddem si tafat nnwen"! A d inin: "uɣalet ar deffir, a d tqelbem tafat"! Ad yili garasen lḥiḍ, s tebburt. Zdaxel d aḥunu, beṛṛa, zdat es: aɛaqeb.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵉⵅⴰⴱⵉⵜⵏ, ⴰⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵜⴰⵎⵟⵟⵓⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ: "ⴰⵔⴷⵊⵓⵜ ⴰⵖ, ⴰ ⵏⴷⴷⵎ ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ"! ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵜ ⴰⵔ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵇⵍⴱⵎ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ"! ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ ⵍⵃⵉⴹ, ⵙ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⵜ. ⵣⴷⴰⵅⵍ ⴷ ⴰⵃⵓⵏⵓ, ⴱⵕⵕⴰ, ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵙ: ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ.

ayah_content: Ad sen d siwlen: "day ur nella ara yidwen"? Ad inin: "ih! Maca, thewwlem iman nnwen, tekkukram, tcukkem, $elvent kwen lemcihwat, armi d iusa lameô n Öebbi. I$elv ikwen af Öebbi, u$ellav".
latin_inalco: Ad sen d siwlen: "day ur nella ara yidwen"? Ad inin: "ih! Maca, thewwlem iman nnwen, tekkukram, tcukkem, ɣelḍent kwen lemcihwat, armi d iusa lameṛ n Ṛebbi. Iɣelḍ ikwen af Ṛebbi, uɣellaḍ".
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵉⵡⵍⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⴷⵡⵏ"? ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵉⵀ! ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⵀⵡⵡⵍⵎ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵜⴽⴽⵓⴽⵔⴰⵎ, ⵜⵛⵓⴽⴽⵎ, ⵖⵍⴹⵏⵜ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵍⵎⵛⵉⵀⵡⴰⵜ, ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵖⵍⴹ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵖⵍⵍⴰⴹ".

ayah_content: Assa, ur ipwaîîaf feddu segwen, ne$ seg wid ijehlen. Axxam nnwen d times; d neppat ay d bab nnwen. A tu$alin tucmip!
latin_inalco: Assa, ur itwaṭṭaf feddu segwen, neɣ seg wid ijehlen. Axxam nnwen d times; d nettat ay d bab nnwen. A tuɣalin tucmit!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵟⵟⴰⴼ ⴼⴷⴷⵓ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ. ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ; ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵜ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜ!

ayah_content: Âani maççi d lawan, i wid iumnen, ad rgagin wulawen nnsen ar usmekti n Öebbi, akked wayen id Issers n tidep? Ur ppilin am wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, zik, u tvul fellasen lmudda. D$a qquôen wulawen nnsen; aîas degsen d iballa$en.
latin_inalco: Ɛani mačči d lawan, i wid iumnen, ad rgagin wulawen nnsen ar usmekti n Ṛebbi, akked wayen id Issers n tidet? Ur ttilin am wid iwumi tettunefk Tezmamt, zik, u tḍul fellasen lmudda. Dɣa qquṛen wulawen nnsen; aṭas degsen d iballaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⵏⵉ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷ ⵍⴰⵡⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵔⴳⴰⴳⵉⵏ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ? ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵎ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵣⵉⴽ, ⵓ ⵜⴹⵓⵍ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⴷⴷⴰ. ⴷⵖⴰ ⵇⵇⵓⵕⵏ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵍⵍⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Ecfut ar Öebbi Issidir tamurt, deffir tmeppant is. Ni$ Nbeggen awen d issekniyen, amendeô ma a pfehmem?
latin_inalco: Ecfut ar Ṛebbi Issidir tamurt, deffir tmettant is. Niɣ Nbeggen awen d issekniyen, amendeṛ ma a tfehmem?
Tifinagh: ⴻⵛⴼⵓⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵉⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵏⵜ ⵉⵙ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⴱⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ, ⴰⵎⵏⴷⵕ ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⵜⴼⵀⵎⵎ?

ayah_content: Ih, wid akked tid ipseddiqen, iôeîlen i Öebbi aôeîîal umâin, ad asen d Irr s lufa, u nnsen arraz ukyis.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid akked tid itseddiqen, iṛeṭlen i Ṛebbi aṛeṭṭal umɛin, ad asen d Irr s lufa, u nnsen arraz ukyis.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵙⴷⴷⵉⵇⵏ, ⵉⵕⵟⵍⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵕⵟⵟⴰⵍ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵙ ⵍⵓⴼⴰ, ⵓ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Wid iumnen s Öebbi akked imazanen iS, d nitni ay d iêeqqiyen, u d inagan ar Mass nnsen. Ad awin arraz nnsen akked tafat nnsen. Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.
latin_inalco: Wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS, d nitni ay d iḥeqqiyen, u d inagan ar Mass nnsen. Ad awin arraz nnsen akked tafat nnsen. Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nneɣ, widak d at ujajiḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵃⵇⵇⵉⵢⵏ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵓ ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵜ ⵓⵊⴰⵊⵉⵃ.

ayah_content: Cfut ar tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan, d zzhu, d acebbeê, d zzux garawen, asuget n wayla akked derya. Am umedya ugeffur. Im$an is âaoben ijehliyen; sinna, ad isliwen, a ten twaliv ppiwôi$en; d$a ad êevmen. Di laxeôt, aâaqeb uqsiê akked ssmaê s$uô Öebbi, akked llza. Tameddurt n ddunit d zzehwa kan ip$uôôun.
latin_inalco: Cfut ar tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan, d zzhu, d acebbeḥ, d zzux garawen, asuget n wayla akked derya. Am umedya ugeffur. Imɣan is ɛaǧben ijehliyen; sinna, ad isliwen, a ten twaliḍ ttiwṛiɣen; dɣa ad ḥeḍmen. Di laxeṛt, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ akked ssmaḥ sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, akked llza. Tameddurt n ddunit d zzehwa kan itɣuṛṛun.
Tifinagh: ⵛⴼⵓⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⴷ ⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵣⵣⵀⵓ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⴱⴱⵃ, ⴷ ⵣⵣⵓⵅ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⵙⵓⴳⵜ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵍⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴷⵔⵢⴰ. ⴰⵎ ⵓⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵓⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ. ⵉⵎⵖⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵄⴰⴷⵊⴱⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵍⵉⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵜⵜⵉⵡⵕⵉⵖⵏ; ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵃⴹⵎⵏ. ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵍⵣⴰ. ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ ⴷ ⵣⵣⵀⵡⴰ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵖⵓⵕⵕⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: £iwlet ar ssmaê n Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwesâan am tmurt akked igenni, teppuhegga d i wid iumnen s Öebbi akked imazanen iS. D wagi ay d lfevl n Öebbi. Ippak it i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
latin_inalco: ɣiwlet ar ssmaḥ n Mass nnwen, akked Lǧennet iwesɛan am tmurt akked igenni, tettuhegga d i wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked imazanen iS. D wagi ay d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi. Ittak it i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵖⵉⵡⵍⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵉⵡⵙⵄⴰⵏ ⴰⵎ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵀⴳⴳⴰ ⴷ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur d tveôôu twa$it di tmurt, ne$ deg iman nnwen, siwa ma tura di Tezmamt, uqbel a p id Nawi. Ayagi, s tidep, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
latin_inalco: Ur d tḍeṛṛu twaɣit di tmurt, neɣ deg iman nnwen, siwa ma tura di Tezmamt, uqbel a t id Nawi. Ayagi, s tidet, d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⴹⵕⵕⵓ ⵜⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵔⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵏⴰⵡⵉ. ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙⵀⵍⵏ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Iwakken ur kwen ip$av wayen tzeglem, ur kwen issefôaê wayen i wen Ifka. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal amzuxi, imnefxi,
latin_inalco: Iwakken ur kwen itɣaḍ wayen tzeglem, ur kwen issefṛaḥ wayen i wen Ifka. Ṛebbi ur Iḥemmel ara yal amzuxi, imnefxi,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵖⴰⴹ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵣⴳⵍⵎ, ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴼⵕⴰⵃ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵅⵉ, ⵉⵎⵏⴼⵅⵉ,

ayah_content: wid ipcuêêun, iêeppmen ccêa af medden. Win i iwexxôen…ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
latin_inalco: wid itcuḥḥun, iḥettmen ccḥa af medden. Win i iwexxṛen…ihi, Ṛebbi d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵛⵓⵃⵃⵓⵏ, ⵉⵃⵜⵜⵎⵏ ⵛⵛⵃⴰ ⴰⴼ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ…ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵄⴰⵢ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵄⵣⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: Nuzen ed imazanen nne£, s ubeggen. Nessader ed yidsen Tazmamt akked lmizan, iwakken ad ddun imdanen s lêeqq. Nessader ed uzzal, degs vveôô uqsiê, akked uba$uô i medden, iwakken ad Iéeô Öebbi anwa ara ifken afus i Neppa akked imazanen iS, di tbavnit. Ih, Öebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.
latin_inalco: Nuzen ed imazanen nneɣ, s ubeggen. Nessader ed yidsen Tazmamt akked lmizan, iwakken ad ddun imdanen s lḥeqq. Nessader ed uzzal, degs ḍḍeṛṛ uqsiḥ, akked ubaɣuṛ i medden, iwakken ad Iẓeṛ Ṛebbi anwa ara ifken afus i Netta akked imazanen iS, di tbaḍnit. Ih, Ṛebbi d Uǧhid, d Uzmir.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵙ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ. ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴷ ⵢⵉⴷⵙⵏ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵃⵇⵇ. ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵣⴰⵍ, ⴷⴳⵙ ⴹⴹⵕⵕ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴱⴰⵖⵓⵕ ⵉ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵥⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⴼⴽⵏ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⵉ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⴱⴰⴹⵏⵉⵜ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⵓⴷⵊⵀⵉⴷ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê akked Ibôahim. Nerra, si tarwa nnsen, Lambiyya, Tira. Degsen llan wid ipwanhan; aîas segsen d iballa$en.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nuzen ed Nuḥ akked Ibṛahim. Nerra, si tarwa nnsen, Lambiyya, Tira. Degsen llan wid itwanhan; aṭas segsen d iballaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵓⵃ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ. ⵏⵔⵔⴰ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵔⵡⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵍⴰⵎⴱⵉⵢⵢⴰ, ⵜⵉⵔⴰ. ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⴰⵏ; ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵍⵍⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, Nessevfeô ed, deffir sen, imazanen nne$. Nessevfeô ed Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Nefka yas Linoil. Nessekcem deg ulawen n wid iddan yides leênana akked tiéeî. Taxelwit, ur p Nuri fellasen; snulfan p id i llza n Öebbi. Ur qumen ara yis, akken iwata. Nefka arraz nnsen i wid iumnen segsen. Aîas, segsen, d iballa$en.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Nesseḍfeṛ ed, deffir sen, imazanen nneɣ. Nesseḍfeṛ ed Ɛisa, mmi s n Meryem, Nefka yas Linǧil. Nessekcem deg ulawen n wid iddan yides leḥnana akked tiẓeṭ. Taxelwit, ur t Nuri fellasen; snulfan t id i llza n Ṛebbi. Ur qumen ara yis, akken iwata. Nefka arraz nnsen i wid iumnen segsen. Aṭas, segsen, d iballaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵙⵙⴹⴼⵕ ⴷ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ, ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ. ⵏⵙⵙⴹⴼⵕ ⴷ ⵄⵉⵙⴰ, ⵎⵎⵉ ⵙ ⵏ ⵎⵔⵢⵎ, ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵍⵉⵏⴷⵊⵉⵍ. ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⵍⵃⵏⴰⵏⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⵥⵟ. ⵜⴰⵅⵍⵡⵉⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵏⵓⵔⵉ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ; ⵙⵏⵓⵍⴼⴰⵏ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵍⵍⵣⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵇⵓⵎⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰ. ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. ⴰⵟⴰⵙ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⵍⵍⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Amnet s Umazan iS. Ad awen Ifk sin imuren seg uêunu S, ad awen Irr tafat a ppeddum yis, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: A wid iumnen! Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Amnet s Umazan iS. Ad awen Ifk sin imuren seg uḥunu S, ad awen Irr tafat a tteddum yis, ad awen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ! ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴰⵎⵏⵜ ⵙ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⵓⵔⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴷⴷⵓⵎ ⵢⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Akken ad éôen At Tezmamt, ar ur zmiren acemma di lfevl n Öebbi. Ih, lfevl deg ufus n Öebbi; Ippak it i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
latin_inalco: Akken ad ẓṛen At Tezmamt, ar ur zmiren acemma di lfeḍl n Ṛebbi. Ih, lfeḍl deg ufus n Ṛebbi; Ittak it i win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi d Bab n lfeḍl ameqwṛaḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴼⵓⵙ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ; ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Isla Öebbi i wawal n tin i k d ihedôen $ef urgaz is. Tepcetkay i Öebbi. Öebbi Isla i umeslay nnwen. Öebbi, s tidep, Isell, Iéeô.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Isla Ṛebbi i wawal n tin i k d ihedṛen ɣef urgaz is. Tetcetkay i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Isla i umeslay nnwen. Ṛebbi, s tidet, Isell, Iẓeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵙⵍⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵉ ⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵀⴷⵕⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵓⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵉⵙ. ⵜⵜⵛⵜⴽⴰⵢ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵍⴰ ⵉ ⵓⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⵙⵍⵍ, ⵉⵥⵕ.

ayah_content: Wid ipmettilen tilawin nnsen ar izugar n tyimmatin nnsen, ur llint d tiyimmatin nnsen - imi tiyimmatin d tid, kan, i ten id iurwen -, ihi, ar d nnan yir awal, akked tikerkas. Ih, Öebbi ard Win Ipsemmiêen, Ipqilin.
latin_inalco: Wid itmettilen tilawin nnsen ar izugar n tyimmatin nnsen, ur llint d tiyimmatin nnsen - imi tiyimmatin d tid, kan, i ten id iurwen -, ihi, ar d nnan yir awal, akked tikerkas. Ih, Ṛebbi ard Win Itsemmiḥen, Itqilin.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵎⵜⵜⵉⵍⵏ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵉⵣⵓⴳⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵜⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏⵜ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ - ⵉⵎⵉ ⵜⵉⵢⵉⵎⵎⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷ, ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵔⵡⵏ -, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵔ ⴷ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⵔ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵔⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵏ, ⵉⵜⵇⵉⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid imetlen, akka, tilawin nnsen, sinna, wexxôen i wayen d nnan, ad brun i wakli, uqbel a tent nnalen. D ayen u$uô i kwen nuban. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txedmem.
latin_inalco: Wid imetlen, akka, tilawin nnsen, sinna, wexxṛen i wayen d nnan, ad brun i wakli, uqbel a tent nnalen. D ayen uɣuṛ i kwen nuban. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵜⵍⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴱⵔⵓⵏ ⵉ ⵡⴰⴽⵍⵉ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⵜⵏⵜ ⵏⵏⴰⵍⵏ. ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵓⴱⴰⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Win ur newâa ara, ilaq ad iuéum sin wagguren, wa deffir wa, uqbel a p innal. Win, da$en, ur nezmir ara, ad icceçç sdiset igellilen. Akka, iwakken a ppamnem s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. D tigi ay d tilisa n Öebbi. I ijehliyen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Win ur newɛa ara, ilaq ad iuẓum sin wagguren, wa deffir wa, uqbel a t innal. Win, daɣen, ur nezmir ara, ad iccečč sdiset igellilen. Akka, iwakken a ttamnem s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. D tigi ay d tilisa n Ṛebbi. I ijehliyen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵡⵄⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵉⵍⴰⵇ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵓⵥⵓⵎ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔⵏ, ⵡⴰ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵏⵏⴰⵍ. ⵡⵉⵏ, ⴷⴰⵖⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵛⵛⵜⵜⵛ ⵙⴷⵉⵙⵜ ⵉⴳⵍⵍⵉⵍⵏ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⵎⵏⵎ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⴷ ⵜⵉⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵙⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ipqamaôen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad nneqlaben, akken nneqlaben wid i ten id izwaren. Ni$ Nessers ed issekniyen iberrzen. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid itqamaṛen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad nneqlaben, akken nneqlaben wid i ten id izwaren. Niɣ Nessers ed issekniyen iberrzen. I ijehliyen, aɛaqeb isdullun.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵇⴰⵎⴰⵕⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵏⵏⵇⵍⴰⴱⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵏⵏⵇⵍⴰⴱⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵙⵔⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⴱⵔⵔⵣⵏ. ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara ten id Issker Öebbi, meôôa, ad asen Issken ayen xedmen. Öebbi Iêesb iten, nitni ppun ten. Öebbi d Anagi n yal cci.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara ten id Issker Ṛebbi, meṛṛa, ad asen Issken ayen xedmen. Ṛebbi Iḥesb iten, nitni ttun ten. Ṛebbi d Anagi n yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⵕⵕⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵃⵙⴱ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵜⵜⵓⵏ ⵜⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan? Ur ippili wawal ger krav, mebla ma Illa, Neppa, d wis kué; ne$ ger smus, u Neppa, d wis sdis. Ama seddaw, ne$ sennig waya, ad Yili yidsen, anda ma llan. D$a, ad asen Imel acu xedmen, ass n tnekra. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara ar Ṛebbi Iẓṛa i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan? Ur ittili wawal ger kraḍ, mebla ma Illa, Netta, d wis kuẓ; neɣ ger smus, u Netta, d wis sdis. Ama seddaw, neɣ sennig waya, ad Yili yidsen, anda ma llan. Dɣa, ad asen Imel acu xedmen, ass n tnekra. Ih, Ṛebbi Iẓṛa yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ? ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴳⵔ ⴽⵔⴰⴹ, ⵎⴱⵍⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵙ ⴽⵓⵥ; ⵏⵖ ⴳⵔ ⵙⵎⵓⵙ, ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵙ ⵙⴷⵉⵙ. ⴰⵎⴰ ⵙⴷⴷⴰⵡ, ⵏⵖ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵢⵉⴷⵙⵏ, ⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ. ⴷⵖⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⵍ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵏⴽⵔⴰ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ur twalav ara wid i$ef tepwagdel temlilit i umeslay, sinna, u$alen ar wayen i sen ipwagedlen? Ppemlilin i ubekkav, i wanfal, i âaûûu i Umazan. Ma usan k id, ad sellmen fellak s wayen ur d Ipsellim fellak Öebbi. Qqaôen deg ulawen nnsen: "awi d kan ur a$ Ipâuqub ara Öebbi $ef wayen neqqaô"! Loahennama beôka ten. Ad ô$en degs. A tu$alin icemten!
latin_inalco: Ur twalaḍ ara wid iɣef tetwagdel temlilit i umeslay, sinna, uɣalen ar wayen i sen itwagedlen? Ptemlilin i ubekkaḍ, i wanfal, i ɛaṣṣu i Umazan. Ma usan k id, ad sellmen fellak s wayen ur d Itsellim fellak Ṛebbi. Qqaṛen deg ulawen nnsen: "awi d kan ur aɣ Itɛuqub ara Ṛebbi ɣef wayen neqqaṛ"! Lǧahennama beṛka ten. Ad ṛɣen degs. A tuɣalin icemten!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵜⵜⵡⴰⴳⴷⵍ ⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵓⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴳⴷⵍⵏ? Pⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ, ⵉ ⵡⴰⵏⴼⴰⵍ, ⵉ ⵄⴰⵚⵚⵓ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵓⵙⴰⵏ ⴽ ⵉⴷ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⵍⵍⵎⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵙⵍⵍⵉⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⴽ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵇⵇⴰⵕⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ: "ⴰⵡⵉ ⴷ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵜⵄⵓⵇⵓⴱ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵖⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵏⵇⵇⴰⵕ"! ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⴱⵕⴽⴰ ⵜⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵕⵖⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ. ⴰ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵛⵎⵜⵏ!

ayah_content: A wid iumnen! Ma temlalem i wawal, ur ppemlilit ara i ubekkav, i wanfal, i âaûûu i Umazan. Ppemlilit i tezdeg akked uêezzeb. Ëezzbet i Öebbi u$uô ara tepwafesrem.
latin_inalco: A wid iumnen! Ma temlalem i wawal, ur ttemlilit ara i ubekkaḍ, i wanfal, i ɛaṣṣu i Umazan. Ptemlilit i tezdeg akked uḥezzeb. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi uɣuṛ ara tetwafesrem.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ! ⵎⴰ ⵜⵎⵍⴰⵍⵎ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ, ⵉ ⵡⴰⵏⴼⴰⵍ, ⵉ ⵄⴰⵚⵚⵓ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ. Pⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵜⵣⴷⴳ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵃⵣⵣⴱ. ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⵡⴰⴼⵙⵔⵎ.

ayah_content: Timlilit i wawal si Cciîan kan, iwakken ad $weblen wid iumnen. Acemma ur ten iîîuôôu, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
latin_inalco: Timlilit i wawal si Cciṭan kan, iwakken ad ɣweblen wid iumnen. Acemma ur ten iṭṭuṛṛu, siwa ma Irad Ṛebbi. ɣef Ṛebbi ara tteklen lmumnin.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵙⵉ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵖⵡⴱⵍⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ. ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵟⵟⵓⵕⵕⵓ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵔⴰⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵖⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⴽⵍⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: A wid iumnen! Ma nnan awen: "get amkan" di temliliyin, get amkan! Öebbi ad awen Ig amkan. Ma nnan awen: "ooet amkan", ooet amkan! Ad Issali Öebbi tidekkaôin, wid iumnen segwen, akked wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txedmem.
latin_inalco: A wid iumnen! Ma nnan awen: "get amkan" di temliliyin, get amkan! Ṛebbi ad awen Ig amkan. Ma nnan awen: "ǧǧet amkan", ǧǧet amkan! Ad Issali Ṛebbi tidekkaṛin, wid iumnen segwen, akked wid iwumi tettunefk tmusni. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ! ⵎⴰ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ: "ⴳⵜ ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ" ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵢⵉⵏ, ⴳⵜ ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ! ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴳ ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ: "ⴷⴷⵊⵜ ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ", ⴷⴷⵊⵜ ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ! ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵜⵉⴷⴽⴽⴰⵕⵉⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵜⵎⵓⵙⵏⵉ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: A wid iumnen! Ma temlalem i wawal akked Umazan, seddqet uqbel timlilit. Akka i wen ilha, i wen iûfa. Ma ur tewâam ara, ihi, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: A wid iumnen! Ma temlalem i wawal akked Umazan, seddqet uqbel timlilit. Akka i wen ilha, i wen iṣfa. Ma ur tewɛam ara, ihi, Ṛebbi Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ! ⵎⴰ ⵜⵎⵍⴰⵍⵎ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⵙⴷⴷⵇⵜ ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵜⵉⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰ, ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵚⴼⴰ. ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⵄⴰⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

ayah_content: Tekukram a pseddqem uqbel timlilit nnwen? Ma ur tseddqem ara, u Issuref awen Öebbi, ééallet, zekkit, a$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txedmem.
latin_inalco: Tekukram a tseddqem uqbel timlilit nnwen? Ma ur tseddqem ara, u Issuref awen Ṛebbi, ẓẓallet, zekkit, aɣet awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txedmem.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴽⵓⴽⵔⴰⵎ ⴰ ⵜⵙⴷⴷⵇⵎ ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵜⵉⵎⵍⵉⵍⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ? ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⴷⴷⵇⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵓ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⵔⴼ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵥⵥⴰⵍⵍⵜ, ⵣⴽⴽⵉⵜ, ⴰⵖⵜ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara wid idduklen akked ugdud i$ef Izzaâf Öebbi? Ur llin segwen ne$ segsen. Pgalan s tkerkas, u nitni éôan.
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid idduklen akked ugdud iɣef Izzaɛf Ṛebbi? Ur llin segwen neɣ segsen. Pgalan s tkerkas, u nitni ẓṛan.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⴷⵓⴽⵍⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵖⴼ ⵉⵣⵣⴰⵄⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ? ⵓⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵏ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ ⵏⵖ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ. Pⴳⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵜⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵥⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihegga yasen d Öebbi aâaqeb uqsiê. Ih, ar dir it wayen xeddmen!
latin_inalco: Ihegga yasen d Ṛebbi aɛaqeb uqsiḥ. Ih, ar dir it wayen xeddmen!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⴳⴳⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃ. ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵔ ⴷⵉⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ!

ayah_content: £ilen tagallit nnsen d ssôan. Swexxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb isdullun.
latin_inalco: ɣilen tagallit nnsen d ssṛan. Swexxiṛen seg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Fellasen aɛaqeb isdullun.
Tifinagh: ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⵜⴰⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵙⵙⵕⴰⵏ. ⵙⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur sen d ippawi acemma wayla nnsen, ne$ dderya nnsen, mgal Öebbi, d awez$i. Widak d at tmes. Degs, nitni, ad wekkôen.
latin_inalco: Ur sen d ittawi acemma wayla nnsen, neɣ dderya nnsen, mgal Ṛebbi, d awezɣi. Widak d at tmes. Degs, nitni, ad wekkṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ ⵡⴰⵢⵍⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴷⴷⵔⵢⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵎⴳⴰⵍ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⵣⵖⵉ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵎⵙ. ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara ten id Issker Öebbi, meôôa, ad aS gallen akken i wen pgallan. Ad $ilen ar ad yili wacu ideg ara îîfen. Aâni maççi, war ccekk, nitni d ikeddaben?
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara ten id Issker Ṛebbi, meṛṛa, ad aS gallen akken i wen tgallan. Ad ɣilen ar ad yili wacu ideg ara ṭṭfen. Aɛni mačči, war ccekk, nitni d ikeddaben?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⵕⵕⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⴳⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵜⴳⴰⵍⵍⴰⵏ. ⴰⴷ ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵡⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵟⵟⴼⵏ. ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⴽⴷⴷⴰⴱⵏ?

ayah_content: Imelk iten Cciîan armi ppun asmekti n Öebbi. Widak d akabar n Cciîan. Ni$ akabar n Cciîan d imexsuôen.
latin_inalco: Imelk iten Cciṭan armi ttun asmekti n Ṛebbi. Widak d akabar n Cciṭan. Niɣ akabar n Cciṭan d imexsuṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⵍⴽ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵓⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ. ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵛⵛⵉⵟⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵅⵙⵓⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ipqamaôen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, widak, ad ndellen sennig wiyav.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid itqamaṛen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, widak, ad ndellen sennig wiyaḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵇⴰⵎⴰⵕⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⵏⴷⵍⵍⵏ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ.

ayah_content: Iura Öebbi: war ccekk, d Nek akked imazanen iW, ara irebêen. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uohid, d Uzmir.
latin_inalco: Iura Ṛebbi: war ccekk, d Nek akked imazanen iW, ara irebḥen. Ṛebbi, s tidet, d Uǧhid, d Uzmir.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵓⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵏⴽ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⵓⴷⵊⵀⵉⴷ, ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Ur teppafev ara agdud iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, ad iddukwel akked wid ipqamaôen Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Xas ma llan d ibabaten nnsen, ne$ d arraw nnsen, d atmaten nnsen, d alag nnsen. Widak, Iura yasen liman deg ulawen nnsen, Iul iten s ôôuê s$uôeS. A ten Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Öuvan Öebbi, Iôuva ten. Widak d akabar n Öebbi. Day akabar n Öebbi maççi d win ara irebêen?
latin_inalco: Ur tettafeḍ ara agdud iumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, ad iddukwel akked wid itqamaṛen Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Xas ma llan d ibabaten nnsen, neɣ d arraw nnsen, d atmaten nnsen, d alag nnsen. Widak, Iura yasen liman deg ulawen nnsen, Iul iten s ṛṛuḥ sɣuṛeS. A ten Issekcem di leǧnanat, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen. Ṛuḍan Ṛebbi, Iṛuḍa ten. Widak d akabar n Ṛebbi. Day akabar n Ṛebbi mačči d win ara irebḥen?
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⴰⴼⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔⵓ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴷⴷⵓⴽⵡⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵇⴰⵎⴰⵕⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵅⴰⵙ ⵎⴰ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴰⴱⴰⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵜⵎⴰⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵍⴰⴳ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⵉⵓⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵍⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵓⵍ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵙ. ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ. ⵕⵓⴹⴰⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵕⵓⴹⴰ ⵜⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴷⴰⵢ ⴰⴽⴰⴱⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵔⴱⵃⵏ?

ayah_content: Sbuccuâen Öebbi kra illan deg igenwan, akked kra illan di tmurt. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi kra illan deg igenwan, akked kra illan di tmurt. Netta d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⵓⵄⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ. ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: D Neppa i Issuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen wid ijehlen seg At Tezmamt, i ujemmal amezwaru. Ur tuminem ara ad ff$en. £ilen leswaô nnsen a ten sellken si Öebbi. Ikka yasen d Öebbi seg wanda ur bnin. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Hudden ixxamen nnsen, s ifassen nnsen, akked ifassen n lmumnin. Meyyzet a wid ipwalin!
latin_inalco: D Netta i Issuffɣen seg ixxamen nnsen wid ijehlen seg At Tezmamt, i ujemmal amezwaru. Ur tuminem ara ad ffɣen. ɣilen leswaṛ nnsen a ten sellken si Ṛebbi. Ikka yasen d Ṛebbi seg wanda ur bnin. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Hudden ixxamen nnsen, s ifassen nnsen, akked ifassen n lmumnin. Meyyzet a wid itwalin!
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵙⴳ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⵉ ⵓⵊⵎⵎⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵓⵎⵉⵏⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⴷ ⴼⴼⵖⵏ. ⵖⵉⵍⵏ ⵍⵙⵡⴰⵕ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵙⵍⵍⴽⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⴽⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵏⴷⴰ ⵓⵔ ⴱⵏⵉⵏ. ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⵜⵓⴳⴷⵉ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵀⵓⴷⴷⵏ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ. ⵎⵢⵢⵣⵜ ⴰ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ!

ayah_content: Lemmer ur asen Iura ara Öebbi neffu, yili Iqeîîa ten di ddunit, u, di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb n tmes.
latin_inalco: Lemmer ur asen Iura ara Ṛebbi neffu, yili Iqeṭṭa ten di ddunit, u, di laxeṛt, fellasen aɛaqeb n tmes.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵓⵔⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏⴼⴼⵓ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴷⵉ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ, ⵓ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵙ.

ayah_content: Ayagi, acku numren Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Win inumren Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi, Iwâaô i uqeîîi.
latin_inalco: Ayagi, acku numren Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Win inumren Ṛebbi, ihi, Ṛebbi, Iwɛaṛ i uqeṭṭi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰⵛⴽⵓ ⵏⵓⵎⵔⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵏⵓⵎⵔⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵡⵄⴰⵕ ⵉ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ.

ayah_content: Ayen tgezmem n tezdayin akked wayen teooam beddent af iéuôan nnsent, s wannuf n Öebbi, iwakken a d Isdull iballa$en.
latin_inalco: Ayen tgezmem n tezdayin akked wayen teǧǧam beddent af iẓuṛan nnsent, s wannuf n Ṛebbi, iwakken a d Isdull iballaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴳⵣⵎⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴷⴷⵊⴰⵎ ⴱⴷⴷⵏⵜ ⴰⴼ ⵉⵥⵓⵕⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏⵜ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⴼ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⴷⵓⵍⵍ ⵉⴱⴰⵍⵍⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Ayen i s Ifka Öebbi, s$uôsen, i Umazan iS, ur tebgisem fellas s ioedâen akked lemrakeb. Maca, Öebbi Ippak adabu i Umazan iS, $ef wid i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
latin_inalco: Ayen i s Ifka Ṛebbi, sɣuṛsen, i Umazan iS, ur tebgisem fellas s iǧedɛen akked lemrakeb. Maca, Ṛebbi Ittak adabu i Umazan iS, ɣef wid i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Izmer i yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⴱⴳⵉⵙⵎ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵙ ⵉⴷⵊⴷⵄⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⵔⴰⴽⴱ. ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴽ ⴰⴷⴰⴱⵓ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵖⴼ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ayen Ifka Öebbi i Umazan iS, s$uô at tuddar, n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, llezm is, igujilen, ime$ban, akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Iwakken ur ippu$al ara ger ifassen imeôkantiyen nnwen. Ayen i wen ifka Umazan, ddmet ep. Ayen i wen ikkes, kkset ep. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Iwâaô i uqeîîi.
latin_inalco: Ayen Ifka Ṛebbi i Umazan iS, sɣuṛ at tuddar, n Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, llezm is, igujilen, imeɣban, akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Iwakken ur ittuɣal ara ger ifassen imeṛkantiyen nnwen. Ayen i wen ifka Umazan, ddmet et. Ayen i wen ikkes, kkset et. Ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi, Iwɛaṛ i uqeṭṭi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵓⴷⴷⴰⵔ, ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵍⵍⵣⵎ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⴳⵓⵊⵉⵍⵏ, ⵉⵎⵖⴱⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ. ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴳⵔ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⵕⴽⴰⵏⵜⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ. ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ, ⴷⴷⵎⵜ ⵜ. ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⵙ, ⴽⴽⵙⵜ ⵜ. ⵃⵣⵣⴱⵜ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵡⵄⴰⵕ ⵉ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ.

ayah_content: I igellilen iminigen, id ssuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen akked seg wayla nnsen, ssaramen lfevl n Öebbi akked llza, fkan afus i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, d widak ay d imawlan n tidep.
latin_inalco: I igellilen iminigen, id ssuffɣen seg ixxamen nnsen akked seg wayla nnsen, ssaramen lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked llza, fkan afus i Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, d widak ay d imawlan n tidet.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⴳⵍⵍⵉⵍⵏ ⵉⵎⵉⵏⵉⴳⵏ, ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵍⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙⵙⴰⵔⴰⵎⵏ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵍⵣⴰ, ⴼⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ.

ayah_content: Wid ized$en ixxamen, iumnen uqbel nnsen, êemmlen wid id iunagen $uôsen. Ur néifen idmaren nnsen af wayen i sen ippunefken, smenyafen ten i iman nnsen, xas ma gwran d xuûûen. Wid irran akin ccêa af yiman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.
latin_inalco: Wid izedɣen ixxamen, iumnen uqbel nnsen, ḥemmlen wid id iunagen ɣuṛsen. Ur nẓifen idmaren nnsen af wayen i sen ittunefken, smenyafen ten i iman nnsen, xas ma gwran d xuṣṣen. Wid irran akin ccḥa af yiman nnsen, widak d imerbaḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⴷⵖⵏ ⵉⵅⵅⴰⵎⵏ, ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵃⵎⵎⵍⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵏⴰⴳⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵏⵥⵉⴼⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽⵏ, ⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵏ ⵜⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵅⴰⵙ ⵎⴰ ⴳⵡⵔⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵅⵓⵚⵚⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⵉⵏ ⵛⵛⵃⴰ ⴰⴼ ⵢⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵔⴱⴰⵃ.

ayah_content: Wid id iusan deffir sen, qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$, akked wamaten nne$, i $ d izwaren ar liman. Ur Ppara deg ulawen nne$, a$ullu n wid iumnen. A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, d Umâin Ipêunun".
