latin_inalco: kkes ed ar tilawin nnsen, neɣ tiklatin nnsen; akka, ur ttulummun.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵜⵉⴽⵍⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⴰⴽⴽⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵓⵍⵓⵎⵎⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ib$an sennig waya, widak d tilas ay zegren.
latin_inalco: Wid ibɣan sennig waya, widak d tilas ay zegren.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵙ ⴰⵢ ⵣⴳⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ippaîîafen deg wawal nnsen, di tgallit nnsen,
latin_inalco: Wid ittaṭṭafen deg wawal nnsen, di tgallit nnsen,
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵟⵟⴰⴼⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: wid ippaîîafen di ccada nnsen,
latin_inalco: wid ittaṭṭafen di ccada nnsen,
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵟⵟⴰⴼⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵛⵛⴰⴷⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: wid ipêaraben $ef téilla nnsen.
latin_inalco: wid itḥaraben ɣef tẓilla nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⴰⵔⴰⴱⵏ ⵖⴼ ⵜⵥⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Widak, di leonanat, d imaâzuzen.
latin_inalco: Widak, di leǧnanat, d imaɛzuzen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵄⵣⵓⵣⵏ.

ayah_content: Acu iu$en ijehliyen, uzlen d $uôek, imegrav qquôen?
latin_inalco: Acu iuɣen ijehliyen, uzlen d ɣuṛek, imegraḍ qquṛen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⵓⵣⵍⵏ ⴷ ⵖⵓⵕⴽ, ⵉⵎⴳⵔⴰⴹ ⵇⵇⵓⵕⵏ?

ayah_content: Yeffus, zelmev, d igrawen.
latin_inalco: Yeffus, zelmeḍ, d igrawen.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ, ⵣⵍⵎⴹ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵔⴰⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Yal amdan, segsen, issarem ad ikcem Loennet n ssaâd.
latin_inalco: Yal amdan, segsen, issarem ad ikcem Lǧennet n ssaɛd.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵔⵎ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴽⵛⵎ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵏ ⵙⵙⴰⵄⴷ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! S tidep, Nxelq iten seg wayen éÈôan.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! S tidet, Nxelq iten seg wayen ẓẒṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵥⵥⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, ggulle$ s Mass igmav akked ituram, ar Nekwni d Wid izemren
latin_inalco: Ihi, ggulleɣ s Mass igmaḍ akked ituram, ar Nekwni d Wid izemren
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴳⴳⵓⵍⵍⵖ ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴳⵎⴰⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵜⵓⵔⴰⵎ, ⴰⵔ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵣⵎⵔⵏ

ayah_content: a d Nawi ay ten yifen, deg umkan nnsen! Ur a£ izeggwir yiwen.
latin_inalco: a d Nawi ay ten yifen, deg umkan nnsen! Ur aɣ izeggwir yiwen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵏⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵏ ⵢⵉⴼⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ! ⵓⵔ ⴰⵖ ⵉⵣⴳⴳⵡⵉⵔ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Eoo iten ad slullven, ad uraren, ar d magren ass nnsen, win i sen ippuwaââden;
latin_inalco: Eǧǧ iten ad slullḍen, ad uraren, ar d magren ass nnsen, win i sen ittuwaɛɛden;
Tifinagh: ⴻⴷⴷⵊ ⵉⵜⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵙⵍⵓⵍⵍⴹⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵓⵔⴰⵔⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⴷ ⵎⴰⴳⵔⵏ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ;

ayah_content: ass ideg ara d ff$en si tneîlin, ppazzalen, amzun ar id$a$en sbedden.
latin_inalco: ass ideg ara d ffɣen si tneṭlin, ttazzalen, amzun ar idɣaɣen sbedden.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵏⵟⵍⵉⵏ, ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ, ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵉⴷⵖⴰⵖⵏ ⵙⴱⴷⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad brun i wallen, ddell fellasen. D wagi ay d ass i sen ippuwaââden.
latin_inalco: Ad brun i wallen, ddell fellasen. D wagi ay d ass i sen ittuwaɛɛden.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴱⵔⵓⵏ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ, ⴷⴷⵍⵍ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: S tidep, Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is: "endeô agdud ik, uqbel a ten id ias uâaqeb aqeôêan".
latin_inalco: S tidet, Nuzen ed Nuḥ i ugdud is: "endeṛ agdud ik, uqbel a ten id ias uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan".
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵏⵓⵣⵏ ⴷ ⵏⵓⵃ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵙ: "ⵏⴷⵕ ⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⴽ, ⵓⵇⴱⵍ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek, i kunwi, d aneddaô ipbegginen.
latin_inalco: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek, i kunwi, d aneddaṛ itbegginen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵢⴰⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ! ⵏⴽ, ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⵉⵜⴱⴳⴳⵉⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Âabdet Öebbi, têezzbem aS, tessemêessem iyi.
latin_inalco: Ɛabdet Ṛebbi, tḥezzbem aS, tessemḥessem iyi.
Tifinagh: ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⵃⵣⵣⴱⵎ ⴰⵙ, ⵜⵙⵙⵎⵃⵙⵙⵎ ⵉⵢⵉ.

ayah_content: Ad Isemmeê seg ibekkaven nnwen, ad awen Ifk lmudda ar lajel ipwassnen. S tidep, lajel n Öebbi, ma iusa d, ur ipwexxiô, lemmer peéôim"!
latin_inalco: Ad Isemmeḥ seg ibekkaḍen nnwen, ad awen Ifk lmudda ar lajel itwassnen. S tidet, lajel n Ṛebbi, ma iusa d, ur itwexxiṛ, lemmer teẓṛim"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⵙⴳ ⵉⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⴼⴽ ⵍⵎⵓⴷⴷⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ. ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵡⵅⵅⵉⵕ, ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵜⵥⵕⵉⵎ"!

ayah_content: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek, ssawale$ i ugdud iw, am yiv am ass.
latin_inalco: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek, ssawaleɣ i ugdud iw, am yiḍ am ass.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵏⴽ, ⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵖ ⵉ ⵓⴳⴷⵓⴷ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⵎ ⵢⵉⴹ ⴰⵎ ⴰⵙⵙ.

ayah_content: Siwa tugin i sen terna ti$ôi w.
latin_inalco: Siwa tugin i sen terna tiɣṛi w.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⵓⴳⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵜⵔⵏⴰ ⵜⵉⵖⵕⵉ ⵡ.

ayah_content: Nek, yal tikelt ara ten neccde$ iwakken a sen Tsemmêev, ad rren ivudan nnsen deg imeééu$en nnsen, ad pplen deg iceîîiven nnsen. Ggernennen, zuxxen s tem$weô.
latin_inalco: Nek, yal tikelt ara ten neccdeɣ iwakken a sen Tsemmḥeḍ, ad rren iḍudan nnsen deg imeẓẓuɣen nnsen, ad ttlen deg iceṭṭiḍen nnsen. Ggernennen, zuxxen s temɣweṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⵜⵉⴽⵍⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵛⵛⴷⵖ ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵙⵏ ⵜⵙⵎⵎⵃⴹ, ⴰⴷ ⵔⵔⵏ ⵉⴹⵓⴷⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵎⵥⵥⵓⵖⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵍⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⴳⴳⵔⵏⵏⵏⵏ, ⵣⵓⵅⵅⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵎⵖⵡⵕ.

ayah_content: Sinna, ssawle$ asen s uâaggev.
latin_inalco: Sinna, ssawleɣ asen s uɛaggeḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙⵙⴰⵡⵍⵖ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⴳⴳⴹ.

ayah_content: Sinna, âinani nni$ asen; s tuffra, sser, mli$ assen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, ɛinani nniɣ asen; s tuffra, sser, mliɣ assen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵄⵉⵏⴰⵏⵉ ⵏⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⵙⵏ; ⵙ ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵔⴰ, ⵙⵙⵔ, ⵎⵍⵉⵖ ⴰⵙⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Nni$: "ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen; Neppa ard Win Ipsemmiêen.
latin_inalco: Nniɣ: "ssutret ssmaḥ i Mass nnwen; Netta ard Win Itsemmiḥen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵉⵖ: "ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵜ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ; ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴰⵔⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Ippazen awen d ageffur, seg igenni, d ihedman.
latin_inalco: Ittazen awen d ageffur, seg igenni, d ihedman.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵣⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ ⴷ ⴰⴳⴼⴼⵓⵔ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴷ ⵉⵀⴷⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ayla akked tarwa, Issuget awen; Ifka yawen timizar; Irra yawen isaffen.
latin_inalco: Ayla akked tarwa, Issuget awen; Ifka yawen timizar; Irra yawen isaffen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵍⴰ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴰⵔⵡⴰ, ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴳⵜ ⴰⵡⵏ; ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵜⵉⵎⵉⵣⴰⵔ; ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: Acu kwen iu$en, Öebbi, ur aS tgim ccan?
latin_inalco: Acu kwen iuɣen, Ṛebbi, ur aS tgim ccan?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵜⴳⵉⵎ ⵛⵛⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: Ni$ i waya, Ixelq ikwen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ i waya, Ixelq ikwen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur twalam ara amek Ixleq Öebbi ûa igenwan d idurra?
latin_inalco: Ur twalam ara amek Ixleq Ṛebbi ṣa igenwan d idurra?
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵚⴰ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Irra degsen, aggur d tafat. Irra iîij d asavef.
latin_inalco: Irra degsen, aggur d tafat. Irra iṭij d asaḍef.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⴷⴳⵙⵏ, ⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ. ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵉⵟⵉⵊ ⴷ ⴰⵙⴰⴹⴼ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Issem$i kwen seg wakal, am im$an.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Issemɣi kwen seg wakal, am imɣan.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵖⵉ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍ, ⴰⵎ ⵉⵎⵖⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, a kwen Irr $uôes; sinna, d tuff$a ara kwen id Issuffe$.
latin_inalco: Sinna, a kwen Irr ɣuṛes; sinna, d tuffɣa ara kwen id Issuffeɣ.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⵔⵔ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ; ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴷ ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵖⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Irra yawen tamurt d tuwsiât,
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Irra yawen tamurt d tuwsiɛt,
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵢⴰⵡⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷ ⵜⵓⵡⵙⵉⵄⵜ,

ayah_content: iwakken, degs, a ppafem iberdan d tiza".
latin_inalco: iwakken, degs, a ttafem iberdan d tiza".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⴼⵎ ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵣⴰ".

ayah_content: Inna Nuê: "a Mass iw! Atnan âuûan iyi. Ddan akked win iwumi, ayla s akked tarwa s, ay s rnan, siwa lexsaôa".
latin_inalco: Inna Nuḥ: "a Mass iw! Atnan ɛuṣan iyi. Ddan akked win iwumi, ayla s akked tarwa s, ay s rnan, siwa lexsaṛa".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵏⵓⵃ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⵄⵓⵚⴰⵏ ⵉⵢⵉ. ⴷⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ, ⴰⵢⵍⴰ ⵙ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴰⵔⵡⴰ ⵙ, ⴰⵢ ⵙ ⵔⵏⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵍⵅⵙⴰⵕⴰ".

ayah_content: Sxedmen tiêila meqqwôen.
latin_inalco: Sxedmen tiḥila meqqwṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵜⵉⵃⵉⵍⴰ ⵎⵇⵇⵡⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Nnan: "ur ppaooat iôebbiten nnwen! Ur ppaooat Wadd, Suwaâ, Ya$ut, Yaâuq, akked Naûô"!
latin_inalco: Nnan: "ur ttaǧǧat iṛebbiten nnwen! Ur ttaǧǧat Wadd, Suwaɛ, Yaɣut, Yaɛuq, akked Naṣṛ"!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: "ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴷⴷⵊⴰⵜ ⵉⵕⴱⴱⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ! ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴷⴷⵊⴰⵜ ⵡⴰⴷⴷ, ⵙⵓⵡⴰⵄ, ⵢⴰⵖⵓⵜ, ⵢⴰⵄⵓⵇ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵏⴰⵚⵕ"!

ayah_content: Ni$ aîas ay telfen. Ur Trennuv i imednas, siwa ttelfan.
latin_inalco: Niɣ aṭas ay telfen. Ur Trennuḍ i imednas, siwa ttelfan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵍⴼⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵜⵔⵏⵏⵓⴹ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⵜⵍⴼⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ilmend n tuccva nnsen, $evûen, sinna kecmen ar tmes. War Öebbi, ur ppafen imâiwnen nnsen.
latin_inalco: Ilmend n tuccḍa nnsen, ɣeḍṣen, sinna kecmen ar tmes. War Ṛebbi, ur ttafen imɛiwnen nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵖⴹⵚⵏ, ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵙ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴼⵏ ⵉⵎⵄⵉⵡⵏⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Inna Nuê: "a Mass iw! Ur Ppaooa, seg ijehliyen, amezda$ di tmurt!
latin_inalco: Inna Nuḥ: "a Mass iw! Ur Ptaǧǧa, seg ijehliyen, amezdaɣ di tmurt!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵏⵓⵃ: "ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ! ⵓⵔ Pⵜⴰⴷⴷⵊⴰ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⴰⵎⵣⴷⴰⵖ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ!

ayah_content: Aql aK id ma Teooiv ten, ad telfen imdanen iK. Siwa tijehli akked lâaô, ara d arwen.
latin_inalco: Aql aK id ma Teǧǧiḍ ten, ad telfen imdanen iK. Siwa tijehli akked lɛaṛ, ara d arwen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵎⴰ ⵜⴷⴷⵊⵉⴹ ⵜⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵍⴼⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⴽ. ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵄⴰⵕ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: A Mass iw, Semmeê a$, nek akked imawlan iw, akked win id ikecmen s axxam iw, iumen, akked wid d tid iumnen. Ur Rennu i imednas, siwa aquccu".
latin_inalco: A Mass iw, Semmeḥ aɣ, nek akked imawlan iw, akked win id ikecmen s axxam iw, iumen, akked wid d tid iumnen. Ur Rennu i imednas, siwa aquccu".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵙⵎⵎⵃ ⴰⵖ, ⵏⴽ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴰⵡⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⵡ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴽⵛⵎⵏ ⵙ ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⵡ, ⵉⵓⵎⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⴷ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ. ⵓⵔ ⵔⵏⵏⵓ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵇⵓⵛⵛⵓ".

ayah_content: Ini: "ippuweêêa yi d, ar agraw n leonun ssemêessen, u nnan: ih, nesla i Leqwôan, d lwehma.
latin_inalco: Ini: "ittuweḥḥa yi d, ar agraw n leǧnun ssemḥessen, u nnan: ih, nesla i Leqwṛan, d lwehma.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵢⵉ ⴷ, ⴰⵔ ⴰⴳⵔⴰⵡ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ ⵙⵙⵎⵃⵙⵙⵏ, ⵓ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵙⵍⴰ ⵉ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⴷ ⵍⵡⵀⵎⴰ.

ayah_content: Inehhu ar ûûwab, d$a numen yis. I Mass nne$, ur nepcarak yiwen.
latin_inalco: Inehhu ar ṣṣwab, dɣa numen yis. I Mass nneɣ, ur netcarak yiwen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵀⵀⵓ ⴰⵔ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵏⵓⵎⵏ ⵢⵉⵙ. ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: U Neppa, gedha s loeôs n Mass nne$ Aâlayan, ur Isâi tameddakwelt, ne$ ùùmmi S!
latin_inalco: U Netta, gedha s lǧeṛs n Mass nneɣ Aɛlayan, ur Isɛi tameddakwelt, neɣ ùùmmi S!
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴳⴷⵀⴰ ⵙ ⵍⴷⵊⵕⵙ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⴰⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵄⵉ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⴰⴽⵡⵍⵜ, ⵏⵖ ùùⵎⵎⵉ ⵙ!

ayah_content: Ih, abuhal nne$ iêekku, af Öebbi, ixmiôen.
latin_inalco: Ih, abuhal nneɣ iḥekku, af Ṛebbi, ixmiṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⴱⵓⵀⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵖ ⵉⵃⴽⴽⵓ, ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉⵅⵎⵉⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Nekwni nenwa leonun akked imdanen, ur sawalen, af Öebbi, tikerkas, d awez$i.
latin_inalco: Nekwni nenwa leǧnun akked imdanen, ur sawalen, af Ṛebbi, tikerkas, d awezɣi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵏⵏⵡⴰ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵏ, ⴰⴼ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⵣⵖⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, seg imdanen, llan irgazen ijjemen ddkeô n leonun. Snernan lbe$wv nnsen.
latin_inalco: Ih, seg imdanen, llan irgazen ijjemen ddkeṛ n leǧnun. Snernan lbeɣwḍ nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵉⵔⴳⴰⵣⵏ ⵉⵊⵊⵎⵏ ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ. ⵙⵏⵔⵏⴰⵏ ⵍⴱⵖⵡⴹ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: S tidep, $ilen, akken t$ilem, ar Öebbi ur d Isskar yiwen, d awez$i.
latin_inalco: S tidet, ɣilen, akken tɣilem, ar Ṛebbi ur d Isskar yiwen, d awezɣi.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵖⵉⵍⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵜⵖⵉⵍⵎ, ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⴰⵔ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⵣⵖⵉ.

ayah_content: Aql a$ nqelleb igenni, nufa t iççuô d iâssasen uqsiêen, akked ijujaê.
latin_inalco: Aql aɣ nqelleb igenni, nufa t iččuṛ d iɛssasen uqsiḥen, akked ijujaḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵇⵍ ⴰⵖ ⵏⵇⵍⵍⴱ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⵏⵓⴼⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵜⵜⵛⵓⵕ ⴷ ⵉⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙⵏ ⵓⵇⵙⵉⵃⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵊⵓⵊⴰⵃ.

ayah_content: Nella nep$imi $uôes, seg imukan nessemêas; win issemêessen tura, a t id immager usafu d aâessas.
latin_inalco: Nella netɣimi ɣuṛes, seg imukan nessemḥas; win issemḥessen tura, a t id immager usafu d aɛessas.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵍⵍⴰ ⵏⵜⵖⵉⵎⵉ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ, ⵙⴳ ⵉⵎⵓⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙ; ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⵙⵙⵏ ⵜⵓⵔⴰ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵎⴰⴳⵔ ⵓⵙⴰⴼⵓ ⴷ ⴰⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Nekwni, ur neéôi ma iura lhemm, af at ddunit, ne$ ma Ib$a, Mass nnsen, ad pwanhun.
latin_inalco: Nekwni, ur neẓṛi ma iura lhemm, af at ddunit, neɣ ma Ibɣa, Mass nnsen, ad twanhun.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵥⵕⵉ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵔⴰ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ, ⴰⴼ ⴰⵜ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⵖⴰ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Llan garane$ iâaôviyen, llan wid ur nemâin; ur naâdil iberdan.
latin_inalco: Llan garaneɣ iɛaṛḍiyen, llan wid ur nemɛin; ur naɛdil iberdan.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ, ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵎⵄⵉⵏ; ⵓⵔ ⵏⴰⵄⴷⵉⵍ ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nmeyyez nufa, war ccekk, ur nesfunnug Öebbi di tmurt, ur T nesfunnug ma nerwel.
latin_inalco: Nmeyyez nufa, war ccekk, ur nesfunnug Ṛebbi di tmurt, ur T nesfunnug ma nerwel.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵎⵢⵢⵣ ⵏⵓⴼⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⴼⵓⵏⵏⵓⴳ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵏⵙⴼⵓⵏⵏⵓⴳ ⵎⴰ ⵏⵔⵡⵍ.

ayah_content: Nnhaya mi s nesla, yis numen. Win iumnen s Mass is, ur ippagwad ara t ixaûen, ne$ ara t ivuôôen.
latin_inalco: Nnhaya mi s nesla, yis numen. Win iumnen s Mass is, ur ittagwad ara t ixaṣen, neɣ ara t iḍuṛṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵎⵉ ⵙ ⵏⵙⵍⴰ, ⵢⵉⵙ ⵏⵓⵎⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵅⴰⵚⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴹⵓⵕⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, garane$ imvuâen, garane$ lâaûûap. Wid iunzen, widak, xtaôen lewqam.
latin_inalco: Ih, garaneɣ imḍuɛen, garaneɣ lɛaṣṣat. Wid iunzen, widak, xtaṛen lewqam.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ ⵉⵎⴹⵓⵄⵏ, ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵏⵖ ⵍⵄⴰⵚⵚⴰⵜ. ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵏⵣⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⵅⵜⴰⵕⵏ ⵍⵡⵇⴰⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma d lâaûûap, di Loahennama, d nitni ay d is$aôen".
latin_inalco: Ma d lɛaṣṣat, di Lǧahennama, d nitni ay d isɣaṛen".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵄⴰⵚⵚⴰⵜ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵖⴰⵕⵏ".

ayah_content: Lemmer deg ubrid ay ddan, yili Nefka yasen aman iqwan.
latin_inalco: Lemmer deg ubrid ay ddan, yili Nefka yasen aman iqwan.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⴰⵢ ⴷⴷⴰⵏ, ⵢⵉⵍⵉ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵇⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: A ten njeôôeb yissen. Win iooan asmekti n Mass is, ad isâaddi aâaqeb aqesêan.
latin_inalco: A ten njeṛṛeb yissen. Win iǧǧan asmekti n Mass is, ad isɛaddi aɛaqeb aqesḥan.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵏⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵙⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Leowamaâ n Öebbi. Ur naâôet yiwen ar tama n Öebbi.
latin_inalco: Leǧwamaɛ n Ṛebbi. Ur naɛṛet yiwen ar tama n Ṛebbi.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴷⵊⵡⴰⵎⴰⵄ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵓⵔ ⵏⴰⵄⵕⵜ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵎⴰ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Atan, mi ikker umdan n Öebbi ad inuj $ureS, qôib lesqen $uôes.
latin_inalco: Atan, mi ikker umdan n Ṛebbi ad inuj ɣureS, qṛib lesqen ɣuṛes.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⴰⵏ, ⵎⵉ ⵉⴽⴽⵔ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵓⵊ ⵖⵓⵔⵙ, ⵇⵕⵉⴱ ⵍⵙⵇⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ.

ayah_content: Ini: "pnuju$ kan ar Mass iw, ur aS pcarake$ yiwen".
latin_inalco: Ini: "tnujuɣ kan ar Mass iw, ur aS tcarakeɣ yiwen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵜⵏⵓⵊⵓⵖ ⴽⴰⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ, ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵛⴰⵔⴰⴽⵖ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "nek, ur pwakelfe$ $ef vveôô nnwen ne$ $ef nnhaya nnwen".
latin_inalco: Ini: "nek, ur twakelfeɣ ɣef ḍḍeṛṛ nnwen neɣ ɣef nnhaya nnwen".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⴽⵍⴼⵖ ⵖⴼ ⴹⴹⵕⵕ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵏⵖ ⵖⴼ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ".

ayah_content: Ini: "nek, ur iyi ipfukku yiwen seg ufus n Öebbi, d awez$i. War Neppa, ur ppafe$ ssôan,
latin_inalco: Ini: "nek, ur iyi itfukku yiwen seg ufus n Ṛebbi, d awezɣi. War Netta, ur ttafeɣ ssṛan,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵏⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵜⴼⵓⴽⴽⵓ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⴼⵓⵙ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⵣⵖⵉ. ⵡⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⴰⴼⵖ ⵙⵙⵕⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: siwa anabi s$uô Öebbi, akked tebrap iS". Ih, i wid iâuûan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, times n Loahennama, ad wekkôen degs, i lebda.
latin_inalco: siwa anabi sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, akked tebrat iS". Ih, i wid iɛuṣan Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, times n Lǧahennama, ad wekkṛen degs, i lebda.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵏⴰⴱⵉ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴱⵔⴰⵜ ⵉⵙ". ⵉⵀ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵄⵓⵚⴰⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵉ ⵍⴱⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Alamma mi walan ayen i sen ippuwaââden, ad éôen anwi ay d uôhifen mavi, i leslak, anwi drus iten mavi.
latin_inalco: Alamma mi walan ayen i sen ittuwaɛɛden, ad ẓṛen anwi ay d uṛhifen maḍi, i leslak, anwi drus iten maḍi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵎⵉ ⵡⴰⵍⴰⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵓⵕⵀⵉⴼⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ, ⵉ ⵍⵙⵍⴰⴽ, ⴰⵏⵡⵉ ⴷⵔⵓⵙ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ.

ayah_content: Ini: "ur éôi$ ma iqeôb ed wayen i wen ippuweââden, ne$ ma a t Iweooel Mass iw;
latin_inalco: Ini: "ur ẓṛiɣ ma iqeṛb ed wayen i wen ittuweɛɛden, neɣ ma a t Iweǧǧel Mass iw;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⵓⵔ ⵥⵕⵉⵖ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵇⵕⴱ ⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⵄⵄⴷⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⵎⴰ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵡⴷⴷⵊⵍ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ;

ayah_content: Amusnaw n tbavnit; tabavnit iS, ur p Immal i yiwen.
latin_inalco: Amusnaw n tbaḍnit; tabaḍnit iS, ur t Immal i yiwen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ ⵏ ⵜⴱⴰⴹⵏⵉⵜ; ⵜⴰⴱⴰⴹⵏⵉⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵉⵎⵎⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed win Iôuva d amazan. Winna, iteddu, zdat deffir, s iâssasen.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed win Iṛuḍa d amazan. Winna, iteddu, zdat deffir, s iɛssasen.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵕⵓⴹⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ. ⵡⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵜⴷⴷⵓ, ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ, ⵙ ⵉⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad Iéeô ma ssawven tibratin n Mass nnsen. Izzi i wayen akw illan $uôsen, Iêeppeb yal cci s imvanen.
latin_inalco: Ad Iẓeṛ ma ssawḍen tibratin n Mass nnsen. Izzi i wayen akw illan ɣuṛsen, Iḥetteb yal cci s imḍanen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵥⵕ ⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⴰⵡⴹⵏ ⵜⵉⴱⵔⴰⵜⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⵉ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵉⵃⵜⵜⴱ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵎⴹⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: A win isburen!
latin_inalco: A win isburen!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⴱⵓⵔⵏ!

ayah_content: Aâwez, xas cwiî.
latin_inalco: Aɛwez, xas cwiṭ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵡⵣ, ⵅⴰⵙ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ.

ayah_content: Azgen n yiv, ne$ ssenqes segs, acemma.
latin_inalco: Azgen n yiḍ, neɣ ssenqes segs, acemma.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵣⴳⵏ ⵏ ⵢⵉⴹ, ⵏⵖ ⵙⵙⵏⵇⵙ ⵙⴳⵙ, ⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ.

ayah_content: Ne$ rnu yas. Di Leqwôan ûûun leqôaya!
latin_inalco: Neɣ rnu yas. Di Leqwṛan ṣṣun leqṛaya!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵔⵏⵓ ⵢⴰⵙ. ⴷⵉ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵚⵚⵓⵏ ⵍⵇⵕⴰⵢⴰ!

ayah_content: Aql a£, ad ak d Nini awal amray.
latin_inalco: Aql aɣ, ad ak d Nini awal amray.

latin_inalco: Mass ugmuḍ akked utaram, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Netta. Ihi, sɛu T d Awkil.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⴳⵎⵓⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵜⴰⵔⴰⵎ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵙⵄⵓ ⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵡⴽⵉⵍ.

latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ i innan nnsen, faṛeq iten s leḥdaqa.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴼⴰⵕⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵃⴷⴰⵇⴰ.

latin_inalco: Eǧǧ iyI inekkaṛen, akked usɛiyen; efk asen cwiṭ n lmudda.
Tifinagh: ⴻⴷⴷⵊ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵙⵄⵉⵢⵏ; ⴼⴽ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⴷⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Atan Nuzen awen ed Amazan, d anagi nnwen, akken Nuzen amazan i Ferâun.
latin_inalco: Atan Nuzen awen ed Amazan, d anagi nnwen, akken Nuzen amazan i Ferɛun.

ayah_content: Segs, ad icerreg igenni, ad iûaô wayen i wen Iwaââed.
latin_inalco: Segs, ad icerreg igenni, ad iṣaṛ wayen i wen Iwaɛɛed.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴳⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵛⵔⵔⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵚⴰⵕ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷ.

ayah_content: Ih, Iéôa Mass ik, keçç akked urbaâ seg wid illan yidek, teppekkrem deg iv, qôib sin imuren, ne$ azgen, ne$ amur wis kué. Öebbi Iwezzen iv akked wass; Iéôa ur ten têepbem ara. Issuref awen. E$ôet, si Leqwôan, ayen isehlen fellawen. Iéôa ad ilin segwen imuvan. Wiyav ppinigen di tmurt, pnadin lfevl n Öebbi. Wiyav pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ihi, e$ôet, segs, ayen isehlen fellawen; éallet; zekkit; ôevlet aS i Öebbi, aôeîîal umâin. Lxiô ara txedmem i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Öebbi. D arraz it yifen, it i$elben. Ssutret ssmaê i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
latin_inalco: Ih, Iẓṛa Mass ik, kečč akked urbaɛ seg wid illan yidek, tettekkrem deg iḍ, qṛib sin imuren, neɣ azgen, neɣ amur wis kuẓ. Ṛebbi Iwezzen iḍ akked wass; Iẓṛa ur ten tḥetbem ara. Issuref awen. Eɣṛet, si Leqwṛan, ayen isehlen fellawen. Iẓṛa ad ilin segwen imuḍan. Wiyaḍ ttinigen di tmurt, tnadin lfeḍl n Ṛebbi. Wiyaḍ tnaɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ihi, eɣṛet, segs, ayen isehlen fellawen; ẓallet; zekkit; ṛeḍlet aS i Ṛebbi, aṛeṭṭal umɛin. Lxiṛ ara txedmem i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Ṛebbi. D arraz it yifen, it iɣelben. Ssutret ssmaḥ i Ṛebbi. Ih, Ṛebbi Itsemmiḥ, Itḥunu.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵓⵔⴱⴰⵄ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵢⵉⴷⴽ, ⵜⵜⵜⴽⴽⵔⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ, ⵇⵕⵉⴱ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⵓⵔⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⵣⴳⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴰⵎⵓⵔ ⵡⵉⵙ ⴽⵓⵥ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵡⵣⵣⵏ ⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ; ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵏ ⵜⵃⵜⴱⵎ ⴰⵔⴰ. ⵉⵙⵙⵓⵔⴼ ⴰⵡⵏ. ⵖⵕⵜ, ⵙⵉ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙⵀⵍⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ. ⵉⵥⵕⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵓⴹⴰⵏ. ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ ⵜⵜⵉⵏⵉⴳⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵜⵏⴰⴷⵉⵏ ⵍⴼⴹⵍ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵡⵉⵢⴰⴹ ⵜⵏⴰⵖⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵖⵕⵜ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙⵀⵍⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵡⵏ; ⵥⴰⵍⵍⵜ; ⵣⴽⴽⵉⵜ; ⵕⴹⵍⵜ ⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵕⵟⵟⴰⵍ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ. ⵍⵅⵉⵕ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵅⴷⵎⵎ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵜⴰⴼⵎ ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵉⵜ ⵢⵉⴼⵏ, ⵉⵜ ⵉⵖⵍⴱⵏ. ⵙⵙⵓⵜⵔⵜ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵜⵃⵓⵏⵓ.

Akka, Itellif Öebbi win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Iâsekôiwen n Mass ik, siwa Neppa iten Issnen. Wagi d asmekti kan i imdanen.
latin_inalco: D lmalayek kan i Nerra d imawlan n tmes. Nefka d kan amḍan nnsent, iwakken ad hewwlen wid ijehlen; ad ttutebbten wid iwumi tettunefk Tezmamt; ad innerni liman n wid iumnen; ur ittili ccekk ar wid iwumi tettunefk Tezmamt, akked lmumnin; akken ad inin at wul iblan, akked ijehliyen: "acu i Ibɣa Ṛebbi s umedya agi"? ayah_content: Aâni i$il umdan d ilelli i ippuserreê?
latin_inalco: Aɛni iɣil umdan d ilelli i ittuserreḥ?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⵉⵖⵉⵍ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⵍⵉ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵙⵔⵔⵃ?

ayah_content: Aâni ur illi d tiqqit iuzlen n l$ella?
latin_inalco: Aɛni ur illi d tiqqit iuzlen n lɣella?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵇⵇⵉⵜ ⵉⵓⵣⵍⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵖⵍⵍⴰ?

ayah_content: Sinna, iu$al d argen. D$a Ixleq, Imsel.
latin_inalco: Sinna, iuɣal d argen. Dɣa Ixleq, Imsel.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴷ ⴰⵔⴳⵏ. ⴷⵖⴰ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ, ⵉⵎⵙⵍ.

ayah_content: Irra segs tayuga, ddkeô akked nnta.
latin_inalco: Irra segs tayuga, ddkeṛ akked nnta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵙⴳⵙ ⵜⴰⵢⵓⴳⴰ, ⴷⴷⴽⵕ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵏⵏⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Aâni Wa ur Izmir a d Issider lmeggtin?
latin_inalco: Aɛni Wa ur Izmir a d Issider lmeggtin?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⵏⵉ ⵡⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴷⵔ ⵍⵎⴳⴳⵜⵉⵏ?

ayah_content: Day tâadda tallit $ef umdan ideg ur illi d ayen ipwabedren?
latin_inalco: Day tɛadda tallit ɣef umdan ideg ur illi d ayen itwabedren?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵜⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵖⴼ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⴱⴷⵔⵏ?

ayah_content: Ih, Nexleq amdan si tiqqit n l$ella ixelven. A t Njeôôeb, Nerra t isell, ipwali.
latin_inalco: Ih, Nexleq amdan si tiqqit n lɣella ixelḍen. A t Njeṛṛeb, Nerra t isell, itwali.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⵇⵇⵉⵜ ⵏ ⵍⵖⵍⵍⴰ ⵉⵅⵍⴹⵏ. ⴰ ⵜ ⵏⵊⵕⵕⴱ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵙⵍⵍ, ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ.

ayah_content: Nebbwi t d ubrid, ama isnemmir, ne$ inkeô.
latin_inalco: Nebbwi t d ubrid, ama isnemmir, neɣ inkeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴱⴱⵡⵉ ⵜ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ, ⴰⵎⴰ ⵉⵙⵏⵎⵎⵉⵔ, ⵏⵖ ⵉⵏⴽⵕ.

ayah_content: Nhegga, ih, i ijehliyen, sslasel, aruz, u$ud.
latin_inalco: Nhegga, ih, i ijehliyen, sslasel, aruz, uɣud.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵀⴳⴳⴰ, ⵉⵀ, ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⵙⵙⵍⴰⵙⵍ, ⴰⵔⵓⵣ, ⵓⵖⵓⴷ.

ayah_content: Iâaôviyen, s tidep, ad swen, di lkas, ayen ixelîen akked lkafuô.
latin_inalco: Iɛaṛḍiyen, s tidet, ad swen, di lkas, ayen ixelṭen akked lkafuṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵙⵡⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⴽⴰⵙ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵟⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⴽⴰⴼⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Tala ideg tessen ixdimen n Öebbi, aman is pfeggiven.
latin_inalco: Tala ideg tessen ixdimen n Ṛebbi, aman is tfeggiḍen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵍⴰ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵜⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵉⵎⵏ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ ⵜⴼⴳⴳⵉⴹⵏ.

ayah_content: Ppaîîafen di tuqqna, ugaden ass ideg lhemm immebruzzaâ.
latin_inalco: Ptaṭṭafen di tuqqna, ugaden ass ideg lhemm immebruzzaɛ.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴰⵟⵟⴰⴼⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵓⵇⵇⵏⴰ, ⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵉⵎⵎⴱⵔⵓⵣⵣⴰⵄ.

ayah_content: Ppaken lqut, ilmend n lemêibba S, i igellil, i ugujil, i umeêbus.
latin_inalco: Ptaken lqut, ilmend n lemḥibba S, i igellil, i ugujil, i umeḥbus.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⴰⴽⵏ ⵍⵇⵓⵜ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵍⵎⵃⵉⴱⴱⴰ ⵙ, ⵉ ⵉⴳⵍⵍⵉⵍ, ⵉ ⵓⴳⵓⵊⵉⵍ, ⵉ ⵓⵎⵃⴱⵓⵙ.

ayah_content: "F udem n Öebbi kan, ay kwen necceççay. Ur neb$i segwen tiririt ne$ tajmilt.
latin_inalco: "F udem n Ṛebbi kan, ay kwen necceččay. Ur nebɣi segwen tiririt neɣ tajmilt.
Tifinagh: "ⴼ ⵓⴷⵎ ⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⵢ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵛⵛⵜⵜⵛⴰⵢ. ⵓⵔ ⵏⴱⵖⵉ ⵙⴳⵡⵏ ⵜⵉⵔⵉⵔⵉⵜ ⵏⵖ ⵜⴰⵊⵎⵉⵍⵜ.

ayah_content: Nekwni, ih, nugad Mass nne$, ass awaâôan, aqessêan".
latin_inalco: Nekwni, ih, nugad Mass nneɣ, ass awaɛṛan, aqessḥan".
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵓⴳⴰⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵡⴰⵄⵕⴰⵏ, ⴰⵇⵙⵙⵃⴰⵏ".

ayah_content: Isellek iten Öebbi si lhemm n wassen. Ccbaêa, lfeôê, Ifka yasen.
latin_inalco: Isellek iten Ṛebbi si lhemm n wassen. Ccbaḥa, lfeṛḥ, Ifka yasen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵍⵍⴽ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙⵉ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏ. ⵛⵛⴱⴰⵃⴰ, ⵍⴼⵕⵃ, ⵉⴼⴽⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ikufa ten af wayen ûebôen: leonan, leêrir.
latin_inalco: Ikufa ten af wayen ṣebṛen: leǧnan, leḥrir.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴽⵓⴼⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵚⴱⵕⵏ: ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏ, ⵍⵃⵔⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Ad éélen din af imîeôêen; ur pwalin iîij, asemmiv.
latin_inalco: Ad ẓẓlen din af imṭeṛḥen; ur twalin iṭij, asemmiḍ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵥⵥⵍⵏ ⴷⵉⵏ ⴰⴼ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ; ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵟⵉⵊ, ⴰⵙⵎⵎⵉⴹ.

ayah_content: Tili ines $uôsen, izwayen wâan asen.
latin_inalco: Tili ines ɣuṛsen, izwayen wɛan asen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵉⵏⵙ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵡⵄⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: A sen tezzin ibuqalen n lfeîîa, lkisan ulelluc.
latin_inalco: A sen tezzin ibuqalen n lfeṭṭa, lkisan ulelluc.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵙⵏ ⵜⵣⵣⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵓⵇⴰⵍⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴼⵟⵟⴰ, ⵍⴽⵉⵙⴰⵏ ⵓⵍⵍⵍⵓⵛ.

ayah_content: Alelluc n lfeîîa; taceôt nnsen, s lmizan.
latin_inalco: Alelluc n lfeṭṭa; taceṛt nnsen, s lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵍⵍⵍⵓⵛ ⵏ ⵍⴼⵟⵟⴰ; ⵜⴰⵛⵕⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Dinna sswan asen lkas n wayen iwumi xelîen skenjbir.
latin_inalco: Dinna sswan asen lkas n wayen iwumi xelṭen skenjbir.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵙⵙⵡⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵍⴽⴰⵙ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵅⵍⵟⵏ ⵙⴽⵏⵊⴱⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Dinna tala; Salsabil i s ssawalen.
latin_inalco: Dinna tala; Salsabil i s ssawalen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ ⵜⴰⵍⴰ; ⵙⴰⵍⵙⴰⴱⵉⵍ ⵉ ⵙ ⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ilmeéiyen imezgiyen tezzin asen. Ma twalav ten, ad as tiniv d tiyuqat imfaôaqen.
latin_inalco: Ilmeẓiyen imezgiyen tezzin asen. Ma twalaḍ ten, ad as tiniḍ d tiyuqat imfaṛaqen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵍⵎⵥⵉⵢⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉⵢⵏ ⵜⵣⵣⵉⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵜⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵉⵏⵉⴹ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵢⵓⵇⴰⵜ ⵉⵎⴼⴰⵕⴰⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma tmuqlev ar din, a pwaliv ssaâd akked tgelda meqqwôen.
latin_inalco: Ma tmuqleḍ ar din, a twaliḍ ssaɛd akked tgelda meqqwṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵎⵓⵇⵍⴹ ⴰⵔ ⴷⵉⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⵙⵙⴰⵄⴷ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵎⵇⵇⵡⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Iceîîiven i llsan d leêrir aêcici iêewwcen; imeqqyasen n lfeîîa; Isswa ten Mass nnsen, s tissit iûfan.
latin_inalco: Iceṭṭiḍen i llsan d leḥrir aḥcici iḥewwcen; imeqqyasen n lfeṭṭa; Isswa ten Mass nnsen, s tissit iṣfan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵛⵟⵟⵉⴹⵏ ⵉ ⵍⵍⵙⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵍⵃⵔⵉⵔ ⴰⵃⵛⵉⵛⵉ ⵉⵃⵡⵡⵛⵏ; ⵉⵎⵇⵇⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴼⵟⵟⴰ; ⵉⵙⵙⵡⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵉⵚⴼⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wagi d arraz nnwen, u d tajmilt igiten nnwen.
latin_inalco: Ih, wagi d arraz nnwen, u d tajmilt igiten nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵓ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵊⵎⵉⵍⵜ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: D Nekwni, s tidep, i k id Issersen Leqwôan, s lmizan.
latin_inalco: D Nekwni, s tidet, i k id Issersen Leqwṛan, s lmizan.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵔⵙⵏ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Eûbeô i uêuddu n Mass ik; segsen, ur teccev, ur jehhel.
latin_inalco: Eṣbeṛ i uḥuddu n Mass ik; segsen, ur tecceḍ, ur jehhel.
Tifinagh: ⴻⵚⴱⵕ ⵉ ⵓⵃⵓⴷⴷⵓ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ; ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵛⵛⴹ, ⵓⵔ ⵊⵀⵀⵍ.

ayah_content: Mmekti d isem n Mass ik, tafrara, tameddit.
latin_inalco: Mmekti d isem n Mass ik, tafrara, tameddit.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵜⴰⴼⵔⴰⵔⴰ, ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Deg iv, knu yaS, u sbuccaâ iT tallit $wezzifen.
latin_inalco: Deg iḍ, knu yaS, u sbuccaɛ iT tallit ɣwezzifen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ, ⴽⵏⵓ ⵢⴰⵙ, ⵓ ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵉⵜ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵖⵡⵣⵣⵉⴼⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wigi êemmlen taêemmaqt, stehzan deg wass amôay.
latin_inalco: Ih, wigi ḥemmlen taḥemmaqt, stehzan deg wass amṛay.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵃⵎⵎⵍⵏ ⵜⴰⵃⵎⵎⴰⵇⵜ, ⵙⵜⵀⵣⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵎⵕⴰⵢ.

ayah_content: Nekwni Nxelq iten, Nesseohed i$san nnsen. Ma ihwa ya£, a Nerr ay ten icban, wakali, deg umkan nnsen.
latin_inalco: Nekwni Nxelq iten, Nesseǧhed iɣsan nnsen. Ma ihwa yaɣ, a Nerr ay ten icban, wakali, deg umkan nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⵜⵏ, ⵏⵙⵙⴷⵊⵀⴷ ⵉⵖⵙⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ. ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵖ, ⴰ ⵏⵔⵔ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵏ ⵉⵛⴱⴰⵏ, ⵡⴰⴽⴰⵍⵉ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Wagi, s tidep, d asmekti. Win ib$an, ad iddem abrid ar Mass is.
latin_inalco: Wagi, s tidet, d asmekti. Win ibɣan, ad iddem abrid ar Mass is.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⴳⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ. ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⴷⴷⵎ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Ur tbeqqum, siwa ma Ib$a Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
latin_inalco: Ur tbeqqum, siwa ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tidet, d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⴱⵇⵇⵓⵎ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵎⴰ ⵉⴱⵖⴰ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵓⵙⵏⴰⵡ, ⴷ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵚⵚⵡⴰⴱ.

ayah_content: Win i S ihwan, a t Issekcem ar uêunu S; ma d imednas, Ihegga yasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
latin_inalco: Win i S ihwan, a t Issekcem ar uḥunu S; ma d imednas, Ihegga yasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵛⵎ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵃⵓⵏⵓ ⵙ; ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ, ⵉⵀⴳⴳⴰ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: S tmersulin, ta s ta!
latin_inalco: S tmersulin, ta s ta!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵎⵔⵙⵓⵍⵉⵏ, ⵜⴰ ⵙ ⵜⴰ!

ayah_content: Ipûuvun s lqewwa. ï
latin_inalco: Itṣuḍun s lqewwa. ï
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵚⵓⴹⵓⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵇⵡⵡⴰ. ï

ayah_content: Veôôêent anevôuê.
latin_inalco: Ḍeṛṛḥent aneḍṛuḥ.
Tifinagh: ⴹⵕⵕⵃⵏⵜ ⴰⵏⴹⵕⵓⵃ.

ayah_content: S tid ifeôqen akken iwata.
latin_inalco: S tid ifeṛqen akken iwata.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⵕⵇⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵡⴰⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Ssawavent asmekti,
latin_inalco: Ssawaḍent asmekti,
Tifinagh: ⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⴹⵏⵜ ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ,

ayah_content: i ssmaê ne$ i uâaggen.
latin_inalco: i ssmaḥ neɣ i uɛaggen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ ⵏⵖ ⵉ ⵓⵄⴰⴳⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: A d ias, s tidep, wayen i wen ippuwaââden.
latin_inalco: A d ias, s tidet, wayen i wen ittuwaɛɛden.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵙ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Itran, ma xsin;
latin_inalco: Itran, ma xsin;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵅⵙⵉⵏ;

ayah_content: igenni ma inceqq;
latin_inalco: igenni ma inceqq;
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵏⵛⵇⵇ;

ayah_content: idurar ma pwiôôéen;
latin_inalco: idurar ma twiṛṛẓen;
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⵉⵕⵕⵥⵏ;

ayah_content: imazanen, ma d lweqt nnsen;
latin_inalco: imazanen, ma d lweqt nnsen;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵍⵡⵇⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ;

ayah_content: Anwa t wass u$uô pweoolen?
latin_inalco: Anwa t wass uɣuṛ tweǧǧlen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵖⵓⵕ ⵜⵡⴷⴷⵊⵍⵏ?

ayah_content: D ass n ufraz.
latin_inalco: D ass n ufraz.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⵣ.

ayah_content: Anwa a d ak imlen d acu t wass n ufraz?
latin_inalco: Anwa a d ak imlen d acu t wass n ufraz?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰ ⴷ ⴰⴽ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⵣ?

ayah_content: Assen, a ssxev inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a ssxeḍ inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Day ur Nesqucc ara imezwura?
latin_inalco: Day ur Nesqucc ara imezwura?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵙⵇⵓⵛⵛ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ?

ayah_content: Sinna, Nerra ineggura deffir sen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Nerra ineggura deffir sen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵉⵏⴳⴳⵓⵔⴰ ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Akka ay Nxeddem i ibe$wviyen.
latin_inalco: Akka ay Nxeddem i ibeɣwḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵏⵅⴷⴷⵎ ⵉ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Day ur kwen Nexliq ara si cwiî n waman?
latin_inalco: Day ur kwen Nexliq ara si cwiṭ n waman?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴽⵡⵏ ⵏⵅⵍⵉⵇ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵉ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: Nerra ten deg umekkan muman,
latin_inalco: Nerra ten deg umekkan muman,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵓⵎⴽⴽⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: ar lajel ipwassnen.
latin_inalco: ar lajel itwassnen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵊⵍ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Nseyya. Amarezg n Wid Ipseyyin!
latin_inalco: Nseyya. Amarezg n Wid Itseyyin!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵢⵢⴰ. ⴰⵎⴰⵔⵣⴳ ⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵙⵢⵢⵉⵏ!

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Day ur nerra ara tamurt d ayen ijemâen
latin_inalco: Day ur nerra ara tamurt d ayen ijemɛen
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵊⵎⵄⵏ

ayah_content: wid idren, akked wid immuten.
latin_inalco: wid idren, akked wid immuten.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⵔⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵎⵎⵓⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Nerra degs idurar âaooôen. S waman iéidanen, Nesswa kwen.
latin_inalco: Nerra degs idurar ɛaǧǧṛen. S waman iẓidanen, Nesswa kwen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⵄⴰⴷⴷⵊⵕⵏ. ⵙ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵥⵉⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⵏⵙⵙⵡⴰ ⴽⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Ddut ar wayen tepnekkiôem!
latin_inalco: Ddut ar wayen tetnekkiṛem!
Tifinagh: ⴷⴷⵓⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵜⵏⴽⴽⵉⵕⵎ!

ayah_content: Ddut ar tili m krav idurna!
latin_inalco: Ddut ar tili m kraḍ idurna!
Tifinagh: ⴷⴷⵓⵜ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⵎ ⴽⵔⴰⴹ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⵏⴰ!

ayah_content: Ur tesburru, ur tesdaray si tmes iôeqqen.
latin_inalco: Ur tesburru, ur tesdaray si tmes iṛeqqen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⴱⵓⵔⵔⵓ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵙⴷⴰⵔⴰⵢ ⵙⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ ⵉⵕⵇⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Neppat teîîegiô ifîiwjen, am lebôuj aâlayen,
latin_inalco: Nettat teṭṭegiṛ ifṭiwjen, am lebṛuj aɛlayen,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰⵜ ⵜⵟⵟⴳⵉⵕ ⵉⴼⵟⵉⵡⵊⵏ, ⴰⵎ ⵍⴱⵕⵓⵊ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ,

ayah_content: amzun d ile$wman iwôa$en.
latin_inalco: amzun d ileɣwman iwṛaɣen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵍⵖⵡⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵡⵕⴰⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Assa, d ass ideg ur d pmmeslayen.
latin_inalco: Assa, d ass ideg ur d tmmeslayen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵎⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: I usuter n ssmaê, ur sen pserriêen.
latin_inalco: I usuter n ssmaḥ, ur sen tserriḥen.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵓⵙⵓⵜⵔ ⵏ ⵙⵙⵎⴰⵃ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵏ ⵜⵙⵔⵔⵉⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Assa d ass n ufraz. Nessemlal ikwen akked imezwura.
latin_inalco: Assa d ass n ufraz. Nessemlal ikwen akked imezwura.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⵣ. ⵏⵙⵙⵎⵍⴰⵍ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ma tundim, andit iyI!
latin_inalco: Ma tundim, andit iyI!
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵏⴷⵉⵎ, ⴰⵏⴷⵉⵜ ⵉⵢⵉ!

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: S tidep, di tili akked tliwa, ara ilin wid ipêezziben.
latin_inalco: S tidet, di tili akked tliwa, ara ilin wid itḥezziben.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⵍⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵍⵉⵡⴰ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Lfakia, d ayen ccihwan.
latin_inalco: Lfakia, d ayen ccihwan.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴼⴰⴽⵉⴰ, ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵛⵛⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Eççet tesswem, di lehna, ilmend n wayen txeddmem!
latin_inalco: Eččet tesswem, di lehna, ilmend n wayen txeddmem!
Tifinagh: ⴻⵜⵜⵛⵜ ⵜⵙⵙⵡⵎ, ⴷⵉ ⵍⵀⵏⴰ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ!

ayah_content: Ih, akka ay Nepkafi izedganen.
latin_inalco: Ih, akka ay Netkafi izedganen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⴰⵢ ⵏⵜⴽⴰⴼⵉ ⵉⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Eççet, zzhut cwiî kan, kunwi, war ccekk, d ibe$wviyen!
latin_inalco: Eččet, zzhut cwiṭ kan, kunwi, war ccekk, d ibeɣwḍiyen!
Tifinagh: ⴻⵜⵜⵛⵜ, ⵣⵣⵀⵓⵜ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵉⵢⵏ!

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Ma nnan asen: "îîinzet"! Ur îîinizen.
latin_inalco: Ma nnan asen: "ṭṭinzet"! Ur ṭṭinizen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵏⵏⴰⵏ ⴰⵙⵏ: "ⵟⵟⵉⵏⵣⵜ"! ⵓⵔ ⵟⵟⵉⵏⵉⵣⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnger inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnger inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Ihi, anwa awal, deffir wagi, ara amnen?
latin_inalco: Ihi, anwa awal, deffir wagi, ara amnen?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵎⵏⵏ?

ayah_content: £ef aydeg pmesteqsayen?
latin_inalco: ɣef aydeg tmesteqsayen?
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⴰⵢⴷⴳ ⵜⵎⵙⵜⵇⵙⴰⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: £ef usali abarar,
latin_inalco: ɣef usali abarar,
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⵓⵙⴰⵍⵉ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ,

ayah_content: i$ef mgarraden.
latin_inalco: iɣef mgarraden.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵖⴼ ⵎⴳⴰⵔⵔⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi, ad éôen.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi, ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, xaîi, ad éôen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, xaṭi, ad ẓṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵅⴰⵟⵉ, ⴰⴷ ⵥⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Day ur Nerra ara tamurt d usu,
latin_inalco: Day ur Nerra ara tamurt d usu,
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴷ ⵓⵙⵓ,

ayah_content: idurar, d ibudiden?
latin_inalco: idurar, d ibudiden?
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ, ⴷ ⵉⴱⵓⴷⵉⴷⵏ?

ayah_content: Nexleq ikwen d tiwugiwin.
latin_inalco: Nexleq ikwen d tiwugiwin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⴽⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵡⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Nerra ives nnwen d ôôaêa.
latin_inalco: Nerra iḍes nnwen d ṛṛaḥa.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵉⴹⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴷ ⵕⵕⴰⵃⴰ.

ayah_content: Nerra iv d talaba.
latin_inalco: Nerra iḍ d talaba.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⵉⴹ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵍⴰⴱⴰ.

ayah_content: Nerra ass i tmeddurt.
latin_inalco: Nerra ass i tmeddurt.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵔⴰ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ.

ayah_content: Nebna sennig wen ûa uohiden.
latin_inalco: Nebna sennig wen ṣa uǧhiden.
Tifinagh: ⵏⴱⵏⴰ ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⵡⵏ ⵚⴰ ⵓⴷⵊⵀⵉⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Nerna asavef ipôeqôiqen.
latin_inalco: Nerna asaḍef itṛeqṛiqen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵔⵏⴰ ⴰⵙⴰⴹⴼ ⵉⵜⵕⵇⵕⵉⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Nesse$li d, seg usigna, aman d ihedman,
latin_inalco: Nesseɣli d, seg usigna, aman d ihedman,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⵖⵍⵉ ⴷ, ⵙⴳ ⵓⵙⵉⴳⵏⴰ, ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵀⴷⵎⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: iwakken a Nessker, yissen, im$an, iâqqayen,
latin_inalco: iwakken a Nessker, yissen, imɣan, iɛqqayen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⴰ ⵏⵙⵙⴽⵔ, ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⵉⵎⵖⴰⵏ, ⵉⵄⵇⵇⴰⵢⵏ,

ayah_content: tibêirin ideôsen.
latin_inalco: tibḥirin ideṛsen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴱⵃⵉⵔⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⵕⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, ass n ufraz ipwassen.
latin_inalco: Ih, ass n ufraz itwassen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵓⴼⵔⴰⵣ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵙⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ass uûuvu n lbuq, a d tasem d iorawen.
latin_inalco: Ass uṣuḍu n lbuq, a d tasem d iǧrawen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵓⵚⵓⴹⵓ ⵏ ⵍⴱⵓⵇ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵙⵎ ⴷ ⵉⴷⵊⵔⴰⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad ildi igenni, d$a ad ilint tebbura.
latin_inalco: Ad ildi igenni, dɣa ad ilint tebbura.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⴷⵉ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵍⵉⵏⵜ ⵜⴱⴱⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ad lêun idurar, u$alen d aylal.
latin_inalco: Ad lḥun idurar, uɣalen d aylal.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵍⵃⵓⵏ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ, ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵍⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Ih, Loahennama teqquôa.
latin_inalco: Ih, Lǧahennama teqquṛa.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⵜⵇⵇⵓⵕⴰ.

ayah_content: D axxam imednas.
latin_inalco: D axxam imednas.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵅⵅⴰⵎ ⵉⵎⴷⵏⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Aîas ara qqimen dinna.
latin_inalco: Aṭas ara qqimen dinna.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏ ⴷⵉⵏⵏⴰ.

ayah_content: Tissit, tasmuvi, ur degs, ppafen;
latin_inalco: Tissit, tasmuḍi, ur degs, ttafen;
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ, ⵜⴰⵙⵎⵓⴹⵉ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵜⵜⴰⴼⵏ;

ayah_content: siwa aman iô$an, akked iôeûvan.
latin_inalco: siwa aman iṛɣan, akked iṛeṣḍan.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵕⵖⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵕⵚⴹⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D aqeîîi iwulmen.
latin_inalco: D aqeṭṭi iwulmen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵉⵡⵓⵍⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Nitni, s tidep, ur oaâlen ara ad ppuqeîîin.
latin_inalco: Nitni, s tidet, ur ǧaɛlen ara ad ttuqeṭṭin.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⵊⴰⵄⵍⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Isekniyen nne£, s leqseê ay ten nekkôen.
latin_inalco: Isekniyen nneɣ, s leqseḥ ay ten nekkṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵙ ⵍⵇⵙⵃ ⴰⵢ ⵜⵏ ⵏⴽⴽⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Yal cci, Nêesb it s tira.
latin_inalco: Yal cci, Nḥesb it s tira.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ, ⵏⵃⵙⴱ ⵉⵜ ⵙ ⵜⵉⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ihi, jeôôbet! Ur awen Nernu, d awez$i, siwa aâaqeb.
latin_inalco: Ihi, jeṛṛbet! Ur awen Nernu, d awezɣi, siwa aɛaqeb.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵊⵕⵕⴱⵜ! ⵓⵔ ⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵔⵏⵓ, ⴷ ⴰⵡⵣⵖⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ.

ayah_content: S tidep, i wid ipêezziben, amkan n laman;
latin_inalco: S tidet, i wid itḥezziben, amkan n laman;
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ, ⴰⵎⴽⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: tifeôôanin, iqwiôen;
latin_inalco: tifeṛṛanin, iqwiṛen;
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴼⵕⵕⴰⵏⵉⵏ, ⵉⵇⵡⵉⵕⵏ;

ayah_content: tizzyiwin ifazen;
latin_inalco: tizzyiwin ifazen;
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵣⵣⵢⵉⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴼⴰⵣⵏ;

ayah_content: lkisan ifalen.
latin_inalco: lkisan ifalen.
Tifinagh: ⵍⴽⵉⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⴼⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur din sellen yir awal ne$ tikerkas.
latin_inalco: Ur din sellen yir awal neɣ tikerkas.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷⵉⵏ ⵙⵍⵍⵏ ⵢⵉⵔ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵏⵖ ⵜⵉⴽⵔⴽⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: D arraz s$uô Mass ik, d tikci klalen.
latin_inalco: D arraz sɣuṛ Mass ik, d tikci klalen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⴽⵛⵉ ⴽⵍⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen; Aênin, ur zmiren a ten Ioo a d mmeslayen.
latin_inalco: Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen; Aḥnin, ur zmiren a ten Iǧǧ a d mmeslayen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴳⴰⵔⴰⵙⵏ; ⴰⵃⵏⵉⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵊ ⴰ ⴷ ⵎⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Asmi ara beddent lmalayek akked ôôuê, d idurra, siwa win Iooa Uênin ara d immeslayen; a d yini awal uûwib.
latin_inalco: Asmi ara beddent lmalayek akked ṛṛuḥ, d idurra, siwa win Iǧǧa Uḥnin ara d immeslayen; a d yini awal uṣwib.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵎⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴱⴷⴷⵏⵜ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ, ⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⵔⴰ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰ ⵓⵃⵏⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵎⵙⵍⴰⵢⵏ; ⴰ ⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵓⵚⵡⵉⴱ.

ayah_content: D wagi ay d ass n tidep; win ib$an, idda d ubrid n tu$alin ar Mass is.
latin_inalco: D wagi ay d ass n tidet; win ibɣan, idda d ubrid n tuɣalin ar Mass is.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ; ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵖⴰⵏ, ⵉⴷⴷⴰ ⴷ ⵓⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Ih, Nâaggen awen: aâaqeb d ayen iqeôben. Ass ideg ara iéeô umdan, acu xedmen ifassen is, ad yini ujehli: "a ssexv iw, a lemmer lli$ d akal"!
latin_inalco: Ih, Nɛaggen awen: aɛaqeb d ayen iqeṛben. Ass ideg ara iẓeṛ umdan, acu xedmen ifassen is, ad yini ujehli: "a ssexḍ iw, a lemmer lliɣ d akal"!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵄⴰⴳⴳⵏ ⴰⵡⵏ: ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴷ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵇⵕⴱⵏ. ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵥⵕ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⴰⵛⵓ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵉⴼⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ ⵓⵊⵀⵍⵉ: "ⴰ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ ⵉⵡ, ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵍⵍⵉⵖ ⴷ ⴰⴽⴰⵍ"!

ayah_content: S tid iqelâen $evsent!
latin_inalco: S tid iqelɛen ɣeḍsent!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵇⵍⵄⵏ ⵖⴹⵙⵏⵜ!

ayah_content: S tid iteddun éewôent!
latin_inalco: S tid iteddun ẓewṛent!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⴷⴷⵓⵏ ⵥⵡⵕⵏⵜ!

ayah_content: S tid ippâumun s sshala!
latin_inalco: S tid ittɛumun s sshala!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵄⵓⵎⵓⵏ ⵙ ⵙⵙⵀⴰⵍⴰ!

ayah_content: S tid ipêizwaren d amêizwer!
latin_inalco: S tid itḥizwaren d amḥizwer!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵃⵉⵣⵡⴰⵔⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵃⵉⵣⵡⵔ!

ayah_content: S tid idebbiôen lameô!
latin_inalco: S tid idebbiṛen lameṛ!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⴷⴱⴱⵉⵕⵏ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ!

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara d i$eô ûûut,
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara d iɣeṛ ṣṣut,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵖⵕ ⵚⵚⵓⵜ,

ayah_content: a t id ivfeô uvfiô,
latin_inalco: a t id iḍfeṛ uḍfiṛ,
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴹⴼⵕ ⵓⴹⴼⵉⵕ,

ayah_content: ulawen, ad rgagin, assen.
latin_inalco: ulawen, ad rgagin, assen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵔⴳⴰⴳⵉⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad brunt wallen nnsen.
latin_inalco: Ad brunt wallen nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴱⵔⵓⵏⵜ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad inin: "day, s tidep, a d nu$al akken nella?
latin_inalco: Ad inin: "day, s tidet, a d nuɣal akken nella?
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴷⴰⵢ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵏⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵏⵍⵍⴰ?

ayah_content: Xas nekwni d i$san irkan"?
latin_inalco: Xas nekwni d iɣsan irkan"?
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵙ ⵏⴽⵡⵏⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵖⵙⴰⵏ ⵉⵔⴽⴰⵏ"?

ayah_content: Ad inin: "ayagi, ihi, d tu$alin n lexsaôa"!
latin_inalco: Ad inin: "ayagi, ihi, d tuɣalin n lexsaṛa"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵅⵙⴰⵕⴰ"!

ayah_content: Neppa, d yiwet n ti$ôi kan.
latin_inalco: Netta, d yiwet n tiɣṛi kan.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴷ ⵢⵉⵡⵜ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵖⵕⵉ ⴽⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Atnan u$alen ar tmurt.
latin_inalco: Atnan uɣalen ar tmurt.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ ⵓⵖⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ.

ayah_content: Ma tusa k id tedyant n Musa?
latin_inalco: Ma tusa k id tedyant n Musa?
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵜⴷⵢⴰⵏⵜ ⵏ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ?

ayah_content: Mi s d Issawel Mass is di Ïuwa, ta$zut iôqan:
latin_inalco: Mi s d Issawel Mass is di Ṭuwa, taɣzut iṛqan:
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵡⵍ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ ⴷⵉ ⵟⵓⵡⴰ, ⵜⴰⵖⵣⵓⵜ ⵉⵕⵇⴰⵏ:

ayah_content: "ôuê ar Feôâun, atan ijuô.
latin_inalco: "ṛuḥ ar Feṛɛun, atan ijuṛ.
Tifinagh: "ⵕⵓⵃ ⴰⵔ ⴼⵕⵄⵓⵏ, ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵉⵊⵓⵕ.

ayah_content: Ini: ma tzemrev a ppizdigev?
latin_inalco: Ini: ma tzemreḍ a ttizdigeḍ?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⴹ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵉⵣⴷⵉⴳⴹ?

ayah_content: A k nhu$ ar Mass ik, d$a a ppagwadev".
latin_inalco: A k nhuɣ ar Mass ik, dɣa a ttagwadeḍ".
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⵀⵓⵖ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⴰ ⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⴹ".

ayah_content: Issenâat as assekni abarar.
latin_inalco: Issenɛat as assekni abarar.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵏⵄⴰⵜ ⴰⵙ ⴰⵙⵙⴽⵏⵉ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ.

ayah_content: D$a, iskaddeb, iâuûa.
latin_inalco: Dɣa, iskaddeb, iɛuṣa.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵖⴰ, ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ, ⵉⵄⵓⵚⴰ.

ayah_content: Sinna, ibren, icqa.
latin_inalco: Sinna, ibren, icqa.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⴱⵔⵏ, ⵉⵛⵇⴰ.

ayah_content: Issemlal ed, iberreê.
latin_inalco: Issemlal ed, iberreḥ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵍⴰⵍ ⴷ, ⵉⴱⵔⵔⵃ.

ayah_content: Inna: "d nek ay d mass nnwen aâlayan"!
latin_inalco: Inna: "d nek ay d mass nnwen aɛlayan"!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵏⴰ: "ⴷ ⵏⴽ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⴰⵏ"!

ayah_content: Irra t Öebbi d amedya uâaqeb, di tmezwarut u di tneggarut.
latin_inalco: Irra t Ṛebbi d amedya uɛaqeb, di tmezwarut u di tneggarut.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵔⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⵢⴰ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵣⵡⴰⵔⵓⵜ ⵓ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵏⴳⴳⴰⵔⵓⵜ.

ayah_content: Ih, tagi degs nnqida i win iugaden.
latin_inalco: Ih, tagi degs nnqida i win iugaden.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵜⴰⴳⵉ ⴷⴳⵙ ⵏⵏⵇⵉⴷⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Day d lxelq nnwen i iwaâôen, ne$ d igenni mi t Ibna?
latin_inalco: Day d lxelq nnwen i iwaɛṛen, neɣ d igenni mi t Ibna?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵍⵅⵍⵇ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵡⴰⵄⵕⵏ, ⵏⵖ ⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⵎⵉ ⵜ ⵉⴱⵏⴰ?

ayah_content: Issuli lqus is, Iwezn it.
latin_inalco: Issuli lqus is, Iwezn it.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵓⵍⵉ ⵍⵇⵓⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵡⵣⵏ ⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Issebrek iv is; Issuffe$ ed tafat is.
latin_inalco: Issebrek iḍ is; Issuffeɣ ed tafat is.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⴱⵔⴽ ⵉⴹ ⵉⵙ; ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴼⴰⵜ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Deffir waya, Issewsaâ tamurt.
latin_inalco: Deffir waya, Issewsaɛ tamurt.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⵉⵙⵙⵡⵙⴰⵄ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ.

ayah_content: Issuffe$ ed segs aman is, akked tkessawt is.
latin_inalco: Issuffeɣ ed segs aman is, akked tkessawt is.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ ⵙⴳⵙ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴽⵙⵙⴰⵡⵜ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Idurar, Iôûa ten;
latin_inalco: Idurar, Iṛṣa ten;
Tifinagh: ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ, ⵉⵕⵚⴰ ⵜⵏ;

ayah_content: d l$it i kunwi, akw i lmal nnwen.
latin_inalco: d lɣit i kunwi, akw i lmal nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⴽⵡ ⵉ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Mara d tas twa$it tabarart,
latin_inalco: Mara d tas twaɣit tabarart,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴰⵙ ⵜⵡⴰⵖⵉⵜ ⵜⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔⵜ,

ayah_content: ayen ixdem umdan, a t id ismekti, assen;
latin_inalco: ayen ixdem umdan, a t id ismekti, assen;
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ;

ayah_content: times a d tban i win ipwalin.
latin_inalco: times a d tban i win itwalin.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴱⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Wanag win ijuôen,
latin_inalco: Wanag win ijuṛen,
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵊⵓⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: ismenyafen tameddurt n ddunit,
latin_inalco: ismenyafen tameddurt n ddunit,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ,

ayah_content: Ihi, d times ay d ûûôan.
latin_inalco: Ihi, d times ay d ṣṣṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵚⵚⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Wanag win iugaden ibeddi zdat Mass is, u ikkes cchawi i teôwiêt,
latin_inalco: Wanag win iugaden ibeddi zdat Mass is, u ikkes cchawi i teṛwiḥt,
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ ⵉⴱⴷⴷⵉ ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵓ ⵉⴽⴽⵙ ⵛⵛⵀⴰⵡⵉ ⵉ ⵜⵕⵡⵉⵃⵜ,

ayah_content: ihi, d Loennet ay d ûûôan.
latin_inalco: ihi, d Lǧennet ay d ṣṣṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵚⵚⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Steqsan k af yimir, melmi tisin is.
latin_inalco: Steqsan k af yimir, melmi tisin is.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵜⵇⵙⴰⵏ ⴽ ⴰⴼ ⵢⵉⵎⵉⵔ, ⵎⵍⵎⵉ ⵜⵉⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Amek ara t id tdekôev, keçç?
latin_inalco: Amek ara t id tdekṛeḍ, kečč?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴽ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵜⴷⴽⵕⴹ, ⴽⵜⵜⵛ?

ayah_content: Ar Mass ik, agwav is.
latin_inalco: Ar Mass ik, agwaḍ is.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⴳⵡⴰⴹ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Keçç d aneddaô kan i win it iugaden.
latin_inalco: Kečč d aneddaṛ kan i win it iugaden.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⴷⴰⵕ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ihi, nitni, ass ideg ara t walin, amzun qqimen kan tameddit, ne$ tasebêit nni.
latin_inalco: Ihi, nitni, ass ideg ara t walin, amzun qqimen kan tameddit, neɣ tasebḥit nni.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ, ⴰⵎⵣⵓⵏ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵉⵜ, ⵏⵖ ⵜⴰⵙⴱⵃⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵉ.

ayah_content: Ikres anyir, ibren,
latin_inalco: Ikres anyir, ibren,
Tifinagh: ⵉⴽⵔⵙ ⴰⵏⵢⵉⵔ, ⵉⴱⵔⵏ,

ayah_content: imi d ader$al it id iusan.
latin_inalco: imi d aderɣal it id iusan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⵉ ⴷ ⴰⴷⵔⵖⴰⵍ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: W ar ak yinin, ahat d azedgan?
latin_inalco: W ar ak yinin, ahat d azedgan?
Tifinagh: ⵡ ⴰⵔ ⴰⴽ ⵢⵉⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⵀⴰⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: Ne$ ismektay, asmekti isfayda t?
latin_inalco: Neɣ ismektay, asmekti isfayda t?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢ, ⴰⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵉⵙⴼⴰⵢⴷⴰ ⵜ?

ayah_content: Wanag, win isâan,
latin_inalco: Wanag, win isɛan,

latin_inalco: d netta iwumi tgiḍ ccan.

ayah_content: Ur d terziv ma d azedgan.
latin_inalco: Ur d terziḍ ma d azedgan.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵔⵣⵉⴹ ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵣⴷⴳⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma d amsuter id iusan,
latin_inalco: Ma d amsuter id iusan,

ayah_content: s wudem ikukran,
latin_inalco: s wudem ikukran,

ayah_content: keçç, degs, d win istehzan.
latin_inalco: kečč, degs, d win istehzan.
Tifinagh: ⴽⵜⵜⵛ, ⴷⴳⵙ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵜⵀⵣⴰⵏ.

latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Ihi wagi d asmekti.

latin_inalco: Ismekti t id win ibɣan.

ayah_content: Di tewôeqtin ikeysen,
latin_inalco: Di tewṛeqtin ikeysen,

latin_inalco: S wacu it Ixleq?

ayah_content: Si tiqqit, Ixelq it, Iwezn it.
latin_inalco: Si tiqqit, Ixelq it, Iwezn it.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵜⵉⵇⵇⵉⵜ, ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⵉⵜ, ⵉⵡⵣⵏ ⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Sinna, abrid Isehhel as t.
latin_inalco: Sinna, abrid Isehhel as t.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵀⵀⵍ ⴰⵙ ⵜ.

ayah_content: Sinna, In$a t, Inîel it.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Inɣa t, Inṭel it.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵏⵖⴰ ⵜ, ⵉⵏⵟⵍ ⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Sinna, ma ihwa yaS, a t id Isker.
latin_inalco: Sinna, ma ihwa yaS, a t id Isker.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵀⵡⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵔ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Ur iuqim ayen i s Iêeppem.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Ur iuqim ayen i s Iḥettem.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵓⵔ ⵉⵓⵇⵉⵎ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵃⵜⵜⵎ.

ayah_content: Ad iwali tagwella s, umdan.
latin_inalco: Ad iwali tagwella s, umdan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⵜⴰⴳⵡⵍⵍⴰ ⵙ, ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: D Nekwni id Ifkan aman, d ihedman.
latin_inalco: D Nekwni id Ifkan aman, d ihedman.

ayah_content: Sinna, Ne$za tamurt, d i$isan.
latin_inalco: Sinna, Neɣza tamurt, d iɣisan.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵏⵖⵣⴰ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴷ ⵉⵖⵉⵙⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Nessuffe$ ed, segs, iâaqqayen,
latin_inalco: Nessuffeɣ ed, segs, iɛaqqayen,
Tifinagh: ⵏⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ, ⵙⴳⵙ, ⵉⵄⴰⵇⵇⴰⵢⵏ,

ayah_content: tiéuôin, akked wayen zegzawen,
latin_inalco: tiẓuṛin, akked wayen zegzawen,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵥⵓⵕⵉⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵣⴳⵣⴰⵡⵏ,

ayah_content: tizemrin, tizdayin,
latin_inalco: tizemrin, tizdayin,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵣⵎⵔⵉⵏ, ⵜⵉⵣⴷⴰⵢⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: iqwiôen iveôsen,
latin_inalco: iqwiṛen iḍeṛsen,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵇⵡⵉⵕⵏ ⵉⴹⵕⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: tikessawin akked izwayen.
latin_inalco: tikessawin akked izwayen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴽⵙⵙⴰⵡⵉⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵣⵡⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: D l$it i kunwi, akked lmal nnwen.
latin_inalco: D lɣit i kunwi, akked lmal nnwen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵍⵖⵉⵜ ⵉ ⴽⵓⵏⵡⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⴰⵍ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma tusa d tin ippiééifen,
latin_inalco: Ma tusa d tin ittiẓẓifen,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⵥⵥⵉⴼⵏ,

ayah_content: ass ideg amdan ad irwel i gma s,
latin_inalco: ass ideg amdan ad irwel i gma s,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵔⵡⵍ ⵉ ⴳⵎⴰ ⵙ,

ayah_content: i imma s, akked baba s,
latin_inalco: i imma s, akked baba s,
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵎⵎⴰ ⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⴱⴰⴱⴰ ⵙ,

ayah_content: i tmeddakwelt is, akked warraw is;
latin_inalco: i tmeddakwelt is, akked warraw is;
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⴰⴽⵡⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵡ ⵉⵙ;

ayah_content: yal amdan segsen, assen, a d ilhu deg wayen i t iaânan.
latin_inalco: yal amdan segsen, assen, a d ilhu deg wayen i t iaɛnan.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⴳⵙⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵍⵀⵓ ⴷⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⴰⵄⵏⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad feooeoen udmawen assen,
latin_inalco: Ad feǧǧeǧen udmawen assen,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴼⴷⴷⵊⴷⵊⵏ ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⴰⵙⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: ad dessen, feôêen.
latin_inalco: ad dessen, feṛḥen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴷⵙⵙⵏ, ⴼⵕⵃⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, udmawen a$webbaô fellasen.
latin_inalco: Assen, udmawen aɣwebbaṛ fellasen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⴰⵖⵡⴱⴱⴰⵕ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Le$wmam idel iten.
latin_inalco: Leɣwmam idel iten.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵖⵡⵎⴰⵎ ⵉⴷⵍ ⵉⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Widak d ijehliyen, d ucmiten.
latin_inalco: Widak d ijehliyen, d ucmiten.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⴷ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵏ.

latin_inalco: Ma iuɣal itij d akennur.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⵉⵜⵉⵊ ⴷ ⴰⴽⵏⵏⵓⵔ.

latin_inalco: Ma ɣlin itran.

latin_inalco: Ma twanehṛen idurar.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵀⵕⵏ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ.

latin_inalco: Ma twasebblent tleɣwmatin, s tdisin.

latin_inalco: Ma twafessren lḥayawan.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⴼⵙⵙⵔⵏ ⵍⵃⴰⵢⴰⵡⴰⵏ.

latin_inalco: Ma ṭwakenfen ilellen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵟⵡⴰⴽⵏⴼⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma rran imanen d tiyugiwin.
latin_inalco: Ma rran imanen d tiyugiwin.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵔⵔⴰⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏⵏ ⴷ ⵜⵉⵢⵓⴳⵉⵡⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma tepwavleb teqcict ipwaneîlen,
latin_inalco: Ma tetwaḍleb teqcict itwaneṭlen,

latin_inalco: anwa abekkaḍ iɣef teɣwanɣa.

ayah_content: Ma pwafessrent tewôeqtin.
latin_inalco: Ma twafessrent tewṛeqtin.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⴼⵙⵙⵔⵏⵜ ⵜⵡⵕⵇⵜⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Igenni ma cerrgen t.
latin_inalco: Igenni ma cerrgen t.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⵎⴰ ⵛⵔⵔⴳⵏ ⵜ.

latin_inalco: Times, ma smendgen t.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵙ, ⵎⴰ ⵙⵎⵏⴷⴳⵏ ⵜ.

ayah_content: Loennet, ma tuéa d.
latin_inalco: Lǧennet, ma tuẓa d.

ayah_content: Ad yissin, yiman, ayen d ihegga.
latin_inalco: Ad yissin, yiman, ayen d ihegga.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵙⵙⵉⵏ, ⵢⵉⵎⴰⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵉⵀⴳⴳⴰ.

ayah_content: Ihi, Gulle$ s yitran iteffren,
latin_inalco: Ihi, Gulleɣ s yitran iteffren,

latin_inalco: ittazalen, ttɛidayen!

latin_inalco: S yiḍ, ma iṛuḥ!

latin_inalco: S tṣebḥit, ma tecṛuṛeq!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵚⴱⵃⵉⵜ, ⵎⴰ ⵜⵛⵕⵓⵕⵇ!

ayah_content: Wigi ard awalen Umazan ukyis.
latin_inalco: Wigi ard awalen Umazan ukyis.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⴰⵔⴷ ⴰⵡⴰⵍⵏ ⵓⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Bu tezmert s$uô Bab n usgeld iôesmen.
latin_inalco: Bu tezmert sɣuṛ Bab n usgeld iṛesmen.

ayah_content: Bab n wannuz, u Muman.
latin_inalco: Bab n wannuz, u Muman.
Tifinagh: ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⵣ, ⵓ ⵎⵓⵎⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur illi d aôehbani, umeddakwel nnwen.
latin_inalco: Ur illi d aṛehbani, umeddakwel nnwen.

latin_inalco: Ih, iwala t, di lejba ibanen.

latin_inalco: Di tbaḍnit ur itmunnu.

latin_inalco: Netta, d asmekti kan i imaḍalen.

ayah_content: I win, segwen, ib$an ad issewqem.
latin_inalco: I win, segwen, ibɣan ad issewqem.

latin_inalco: Ur tbeqqum, siwa ma Ibɣa Ṛebbi, Mass imaḍalen.

latin_inalco: Igenni, ma iqlaɛ,

latin_inalco: ilellen, ma falen,

latin_inalco: iẓekwan, ma nneqlaben,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵥⴽⵡⴰⵏ, ⵎⴰ ⵏⵏⵇⵍⴰⴱⵏ,

latin_inalco: ad iẓeṛ yiman ayen d ibbwi, akked wayen iǧǧa.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵥⵕ ⵢⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⴷ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷⴷⵊⴰ.

ayah_content: A yamdan, d acu k i$uôôen, $ef Mass ik Ukyis
latin_inalco: A yamdan, d acu k iɣuṛṛen, ɣef Mass ik Ukyis

ayah_content: Xaîi! Teskiddibem ddin.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Teskiddibem ddin.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵜⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⵉⴱⵎ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ni$ $urwen imêaraben.
latin_inalco: Niɣ ɣurwen imḥaraben.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵖⵓⵔⵡⵏ ⵉⵎⵃⴰⵔⴰⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: D imura ukyisen.
latin_inalco: D imura ukyisen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵉⵎⵓⵔⴰ ⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: èôan ayen txeddmem.
latin_inalco: ẓṛan ayen txeddmem.
Tifinagh: ⵥⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⵅⴷⴷⵎⵎ.

ayah_content: Ih, di ssaâd, ara ilin iâaôdiyen.
latin_inalco: Ih, di ssaɛd, ara ilin iɛaṛdiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴷⵉ ⵙⵙⴰⵄⴷ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴷⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, di tmessi, ara ilin ucmiten.
latin_inalco: Ih, di tmessi, ara ilin ucmiten.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙⵙⵉ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵓⵛⵎⵉⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: A p kecmen, ass iqeîîiyen.
latin_inalco: A t kecmen, ass iqeṭṭiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜ ⴽⵛⵎⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Tuff$a segs, ur zmiren.
latin_inalco: Tuffɣa segs, ur zmiren.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵓⴼⴼⵖⴰ ⵙⴳⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵣⵎⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Anwa ara k imlen, d acu t wass iqeîîiyen?
latin_inalco: Anwa ara k imlen, d acu t wass iqeṭṭiyen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: Ih! Anwa ara k imlen, d acu t wass iqeîîiyen?
latin_inalco: Ih! Anwa ara k imlen, d acu t wass iqeṭṭiyen?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ! ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ?

ayah_content: D ass ideg yiwen ur izmir ad ifukk yiwen, s wacemma. Assen, lameô i Öebbi.
latin_inalco: D ass ideg yiwen ur izmir ad ifukk yiwen, s wacemma. Assen, lameṛ i Ṛebbi.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⴰⴷ ⵉⴼⵓⴽⴽ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵛⵎⵎⴰ. ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵍⴰⵎⵕ ⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ.

ayah_content: Imed$al, a nnegr nnsen!
latin_inalco: Imedɣal, a nnegr nnsen!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵎⴷⵖⴰⵍ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ!

ayah_content: Wid, mara d ktilen ar medden, pêeppimen taceôt.
latin_inalco: Wid, mara d ktilen ar medden, tḥettimen taceṛt.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴽⵜⵉⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⵜⵃⵜⵜⵉⵎⵏ ⵜⴰⵛⵕⵜ.

ayah_content: Wanag, nitni, mara ktilen ne$ wezznen, ssenqasen.
latin_inalco: Wanag, nitni, mara ktilen neɣ wezznen, ssenqasen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴽⵜⵉⵍⵏ ⵏⵖ ⵡⵣⵣⵏⵏ, ⵙⵙⵏⵇⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Wigi, day ur uminen ar aten id ssekren
latin_inalco: Wigi, day ur uminen ar aten id ssekren
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴳⵉ, ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵓⵎⵉⵏⵏ ⴰⵔ ⴰⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵙⵙⴽⵔⵏ

ayah_content: ass ameqwôaêan?
latin_inalco: ass ameqwṛaḥan?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵃⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: Ass ideg ara bedden medden, zdat Mass imavalen.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg ara bedden medden, zdat Mass imaḍalen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴱⴷⴷⵏ ⵎⴷⴷⵏ, ⵣⴷⴰⵜ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵎⴰⴹⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! War ccekk, imcumen, di Siooin ara ppujerrden.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! War ccekk, imcumen, di Siǧǧin ara ttujerrden.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵎⵏ, ⴷⵉ ⵙⵉⴷⴷⵊⵉⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵜⵓⵊⵔⵔⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Siooin, w ara k t imlen?
latin_inalco: Siǧǧin, w ara k t imlen?
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⴷⴷⵊⵉⵏ, ⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵜ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ?

ayah_content: D tazmamt ipwanesxen.
latin_inalco: D tazmamt itwanesxen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵙⵅⵏ.

ayah_content: Assen, a nnegr inekkaôen!
latin_inalco: Assen, a nnegr inekkaṛen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵏⵏⴳⵔ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⴰⵕⵏ!

ayah_content: Wid iskiddiben ass iqeîîiyen.
latin_inalco: Wid iskiddiben ass iqeṭṭiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⵉⴱⵏ ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵇⵟⵟⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: I t inekkôen, siwa amâaûi amednub.
latin_inalco: I t inekkṛen, siwa amɛaṣi amednub.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵜ ⵉⵏⴽⴽⵕⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵎⵄⴰⵚⵉ ⴰⵎⴷⵏⵓⴱ.

ayah_content: Isekniyen nne£, ma $ôan as ten, yini: "d tiêkayin imezwura".
latin_inalco: Isekniyen nneɣ, ma ɣṛan as ten, yini: "d tiḥkayin imezwura".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⴽⵏⵉⵢⵏ ⵏⵏⵖ, ⵎⴰ ⵖⵕⴰⵏ ⴰⵙ ⵜⵏ, ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷ ⵜⵉⵃⴽⴰⵢⵉⵏ ⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ".

ayah_content: Xaîi! Maca dubben wulawen nnsen seg wayen kesben.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Maca dubben wulawen nnsen seg wayen kesben.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵎⴰⵛⴰ ⴷⵓⴱⴱⵏ ⵡⵓⵍⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⴽⵙⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Assen, war ccekk, ad êêurrmen i Mass nnsen.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Assen, war ccekk, ad ḥḥurrmen i Mass nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⴷ ⵃⵃⵓⵔⵔⵎⵏ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, deg u$ud ara ô$en.
latin_inalco: Sinna, deg uɣud ara ṛɣen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵖⵓⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵕⵖⵏ.

ayah_content: Sinna, ad pwanecden: "atan wacu tnekkôem".
latin_inalco: Sinna, ad twanecden: "atan wacu tnekkṛem".
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵛⴷⵏ: "ⴰⵜⴰⵏ ⵡⴰⵛⵓ ⵜⵏⴽⴽⵕⵎ".

ayah_content: Xaîi! S tidep, ar di Âiliyun, ayen ippujerden i iâaôviyen.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! S tidet, ar di Ɛiliyun, ayen ittujerden i iɛaṛḍiyen.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵔ ⴷⵉ ⵄⵉⵍⵉⵢⵓⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵊⵔⴷⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Âiliyun, anwa ara k t imlen?
latin_inalco: Ɛiliyun, anwa ara k t imlen?
Tifinagh: ⵄⵉⵍⵉⵢⵓⵏ, ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵜ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ?

ayah_content: D tazmamt ipwanesxen.
latin_inalco: D tazmamt itwanesxen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵏⵙⵅⵏ.

ayah_content: Inagan is d iqôiben.
latin_inalco: Inagan is d iqṛiben.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ ⴷ ⵉⵇⵕⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Di ssaâd ara ilin, war ccekk, iâaôviyen!
latin_inalco: Di ssaɛd ara ilin, war ccekk, iɛaṛḍiyen!
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵙⵙⴰⵄⴷ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵍⵉⵏ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵄⴰⵕⴹⵉⵢⵏ!

ayah_content: F imîeôêen, ssikiden.
latin_inalco: F imṭeṛḥen, ssikiden.
Tifinagh: ⴼ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ, ⵙⵙⵉⴽⵉⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: A pwaliv deg udmawen nnsen, ticci isaâdiyen.
latin_inalco: A twaliḍ deg udmawen nnsen, ticci isaɛdiyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉⴹ ⴷⴳ ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵉⵛⵛⵉ ⵉⵙⴰⵄⴷⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Tissit nnsen d lfayeq ipwacemâen;
latin_inalco: Tissit nnsen d lfayeq itwacemɛen;
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵙⵙⵉⵜ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ ⴷ ⵍⴼⴰⵢⵇ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵛⵎⵄⵏ;

ayah_content: cmaâ ines d lmesk, f ayagi ad mêizwiren wid ippemêizwiren.
latin_inalco: cmaɛ ines d lmesk, f ayagi ad mḥizwiren wid ittemḥizwiren.
Tifinagh: ⵛⵎⴰⵄ ⵉⵏⵙ ⴷ ⵍⵎⵙⴽ, ⴼ ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⴷ ⵎⵃⵉⵣⵡⵉⵔⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵎⵃⵉⵣⵡⵉⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Aman n Tasmin, ad as xelîen.
latin_inalco: Aman n Tasmin, ad as xelṭen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵜⴰⵙⵎⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵅⵍⵟⵏ.

ayah_content: D tala ideg tessen iqôiben.
latin_inalco: D tala ideg tessen iqṛiben.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵜⴰⵍⴰ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵜⵙⵙⵏ ⵉⵇⵕⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ibe$wven llan ppavûan deg wid iumnen.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid ibeɣwḍen llan ttaḍṣan deg wid iumnen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⴱⵖⵡⴹⵏ ⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⴹⵚⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ppem$emmazen mara ten mmagren.
latin_inalco: Ptemɣemmazen mara ten mmagren.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⵎⵖⵎⵎⴰⵣⵏ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵎⵎⴰⴳⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Mi zzin ar twaculin nnsen, tezzin, ppuraren.
latin_inalco: Mi zzin ar twaculin nnsen, tezzin, tturaren.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵣⵣⵉⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵜⵣⵣⵉⵏ, ⵜⵜⵓⵔⴰⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Mara ten walin, ad inin: "s tidep, wigi nnetlafen".
latin_inalco: Mara ten walin, ad inin: "s tidet, wigi nnetlafen".
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵡⴰⵍⵉⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵉⵏⵉⵏ: "ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵡⵉⴳⵉ ⵏⵏⵜⵍⴰⴼⵏ".

ayah_content: Ur d pwaznen ara $uôsen, a ten âassen!
latin_inalco: Ur d twaznen ara ɣuṛsen, a ten ɛassen!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵜⵡⴰⵣⵏⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⵜⵏ ⵄⴰⵙⵙⵏ!

ayah_content: Assa, d wid iumnen i ippavûan deg ijehliyen.
latin_inalco: Assa, d wid iumnen i ittaḍṣan deg ijehliyen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⴰ, ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴹⵚⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: £ef imîeôêen, ssikiden
latin_inalco: ɣef imṭeṛḥen, ssikiden
Tifinagh: ⵖⴼ ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ, ⵙⵙⵉⴽⵉⴷⵏ

ayah_content: ma $elten ijehliyen, tirect igiten nnsen.
latin_inalco: ma ɣelten ijehliyen, tirect igiten nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵖⵍⵜⵏ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ, ⵜⵉⵔⵛⵜ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma icerreg igenni,
latin_inalco: Ma icerreg igenni,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵉⵛⵔⵔⴳ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ,

ayah_content: issemêess i Mass is, ippuêeppem.
latin_inalco: issemḥess i Mass is, ittuḥettem.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵃⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵃⵜⵜⵎ.

ayah_content: Ma temsawi tmurt,
latin_inalco: Ma temsawi tmurt,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⵎⵙⴰⵡⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ,

ayah_content: tveggeô i illan degs, texla;
latin_inalco: tḍeggeṛ i illan degs, texla;
Tifinagh: ⵜⴹⴳⴳⵕ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵜⵅⵍⴰ;

ayah_content: têess i Mass is, teppuêeppem,
latin_inalco: tḥess i Mass is, tettuḥettem,
Tifinagh: ⵜⵃⵙⵙ ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵃⵜⵜⵎ,

ayah_content: a yamdan iôe$ben aîas Mass ik, yideS a ppemlilev!
latin_inalco: a yamdan iṛeɣben aṭas Mass ik, yideS a ttemlileḍ!
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵢⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵉⵕⵖⴱⵏ ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵢⵉⴷⵙ ⴰ ⵜⵜⵎⵍⵉⵍⴹ!

ayah_content: Wanag, win ibbwev leêsab is, yeffus is,
latin_inalco: Wanag, win ibbweḍ leḥsab is, yeffus is,
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ, ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⴹ ⵍⵃⵙⴰⴱ ⵉⵙ, ⵢⴼⴼⵓⵙ ⵉⵙ,

ayah_content: ad ishel lêisab is;
latin_inalco: ad ishel lḥisab is;
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵀⵍ ⵍⵃⵉⵙⴰⴱ ⵉⵙ;

ayah_content: s lferê ara iqqwel ar twacult is.
latin_inalco: s lferḥ ara iqqwel ar twacult is.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵍⴼⵔⵃ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵇⵇⵡⵍ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Ma d win ibbwev leêsab is, deffir waârur is,
latin_inalco: Ma d win ibbweḍ leḥsab is, deffir waɛrur is,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⴱⵡⴹ ⵍⵃⵙⴰⴱ ⵉⵙ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵄⵔⵓⵔ ⵉⵙ,

ayah_content: ad issawal i ssxev,
latin_inalco: ad issawal i ssxeḍ,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ,

ayah_content: ad ir$ di tmessi.
latin_inalco: ad irɣ di tmessi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵔⵖ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙⵙⵉ.

ayah_content: Ni$ illa ifôeê ar twacult is.
latin_inalco: Niɣ illa ifṛeḥ ar twacult is.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⵉⴼⵕⵃ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵛⵓⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Neppa, ih, inwa ur d ippu$al.
latin_inalco: Netta, ih, inwa ur d ittuɣal.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵏⵡⴰ ⵓⵔ ⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Zi$ la t Issikid Mass is.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Ziɣ la t Issikid Mass is.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵣⵉⵖ ⵍⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⴽⵉⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Gulle$ s lme$ôeb!
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Gulleɣ s lmeɣṛeb!
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⴳⵓⵍⵍⵖ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵖⵕⴱ!

ayah_content: S yiv akked wayen i$umm!
latin_inalco: S yiḍ akked wayen iɣumm!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵢⵉⴹ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵖⵓⵎⵎ!

ayah_content: S waggur n tziri ma iççuô!
latin_inalco: S waggur n tziri ma iččuṛ!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵉⵔⵉ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⵛⵓⵕ!

ayah_content: War ccekk, a ppeddum si lêala ar tayev!
latin_inalco: War ccekk, a tteddum si lḥala ar tayeḍ!
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰ ⵜⵜⴷⴷⵓⵎ ⵙⵉ ⵍⵃⴰⵍⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵜⴰⵢⴹ!

ayah_content: Acu iten iu$en, ur uminen?
latin_inalco: Acu iten iuɣen, ur uminen?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵓⵎⵉⵏⵏ?

ayah_content: Mara sen $ôen Leqwôan, ur kennun.
latin_inalco: Mara sen ɣṛen Leqwṛan, ur kennun.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵏ ⵖⵕⵏ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⴽⵏⵏⵓⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Wid ijehlen skiddiben.
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Wid ijehlen skiddiben.
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ ⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⵉⴱⵏ.

ayah_content: Öebbi Issen, sennig akw, ayen teffren.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi Issen, sennig akw, ayen teffren.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵙⵙⵏ, ⵙⵏⵏⵉⴳ ⴰⴽⵡ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵜⴼⴼⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan!
latin_inalco: Becceṛ iten s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan!
Tifinagh: ⴱⵛⵛⵕ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵙ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⵇⵕⵃⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: Kkes ed wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan; d imezgi warraz nnsen.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan; d imezgi warraz nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ; ⴷ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ ⵡⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: S igenni bu itran!
latin_inalco: S igenni bu itran!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⴱⵓ ⵉⵜⵔⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: S wass ippuwaââden!
latin_inalco: S wass ittuwaɛɛden!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵡⴰⵄⵄⴷⵏ!

ayah_content: S unagi akked ccada s!
latin_inalco: S unagi akked ccada s!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵓⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵛⵛⴰⴷⴰ ⵙ!

ayah_content: At uxenduq pwan$an.
latin_inalco: At uxenduq twanɣan.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜ ⵓⵅⵏⴷⵓⵇ ⵜⵡⴰⵏⵖⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Times m iseô$an;
latin_inalco: Times m iseṛɣan;
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵎⵙ ⵎ ⵉⵙⵕⵖⴰⵏ;

ayah_content: mi nitni qqimen $uôes.
latin_inalco: mi nitni qqimen ɣuṛes.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵇⵇⵉⵎⵏ ⵖⵓⵕⵙ.

ayah_content: D nitni ay d inagan n lmumnin f wayen i sen xedmen.
latin_inalco: D nitni ay d inagan n lmumnin f wayen i sen xedmen.
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⵏⴰⴳⴰⵏ ⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ ⴼ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙⵏ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur illi ay sen stebâan, siwa imi umnen s Öebbi, Uzmir, Amaâzuz.
latin_inalco: Ur illi ay sen stebɛan, siwa imi umnen s Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Amaɛzuz.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴰⵢ ⵙⵏ ⵙⵜⴱⵄⴰⵏ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵉⵎⵉ ⵓⵎⵏⵏ ⵙ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵓⵣⵎⵉⵔ, ⴰⵎⴰⵄⵣⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi d Anagi n yal cci.
latin_inalco: IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ṛebbi d Anagi n yal cci.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵙ ⵜⴰⴳⵍⴷⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⴳⵏⵡⴰⵏ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴷ ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⵏ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵛⵛⵉ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ihewwlen lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, ur steôoâen, ad ppuâaqben s Loahennama, ad ppuâaqben s tmeô$iwt.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid ihewwlen lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, ur steṛǧɛen, ad ttuɛaqben s Lǧahennama, ad ttuɛaqben s tmeṛɣiwt.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵀⵡⵡⵍⵏ ⵍⵎⵓⵎⵏⵉⵏ, ⴰⵔⴳⴰⵣ ⵜⴰⵎⵟⵟⵓⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵄⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱⵏ ⵙ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ, ⴰⴷ ⵜⵜⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱⵏ ⵙ ⵜⵎⵕⵖⵉⵡⵜ.

ayah_content: Wanag, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôan.
latin_inalco: Wanag, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leǧnanat, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen. D wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛan.
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ, ⵉ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵔⵔⴱⵃ ⴰⵎⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Tiyta n Mass ik, s tidep, tewâaô.
latin_inalco: Tiyta n Mass ik, s tidet, tewɛaṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵢⵜⴰ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵜⵡⵄⴰⵕ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, Ibeddu, Ippales.
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, Ibeddu, Ittales.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵉⴱⴷⴷⵓ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵍⵙ.

ayah_content: Neppa, Ipsemmiê, Iêemmel.
latin_inalco: Netta, Itsemmiḥ, Iḥemmel.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵜⵙⵎⵎⵉⵃ, ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍ.

ayah_content: Bab n usgeld, Amaâzuz.
latin_inalco: Bab n usgeld, Amaɛzuz.
Tifinagh: ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴳⵍⴷ, ⴰⵎⴰⵄⵣⵓⵣ.

ayah_content: Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
latin_inalco: Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵀⵡⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma tebbwev ik id teqsiî iâsekôiwen
latin_inalco: Ma tebbweḍ ik id teqsiṭ iɛsekṛiwen
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⴱⴱⵡⴹ ⵉⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵇⵙⵉⵟ ⵉⵄⵙⴽⵕⵉⵡⵏ

ayah_content: n Feôâun akked Tamud?
latin_inalco: n Feṛɛun akked Tamud?
Tifinagh: ⵏ ⴼⵕⵄⵓⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ?

ayah_content: Maca, wid ijehlen, deg uskiddeb.
latin_inalco: Maca, wid ijehlen, deg uskiddeb.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⴷⴳ ⵓⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱ.

ayah_content: Öebbi, deffir, Izzi yasen.
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi, deffir, Izzi yasen.
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ, ⵉⵣⵣⵉ ⵢⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Maca, wagi d Leqwôan muccaâ,
latin_inalco: Maca, wagi d Leqwṛan muccaɛ,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵍⵇⵡⵕⴰⵏ ⵎⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ,

ayah_content: di telwiêt ipwaêerzen.
latin_inalco: di telwiḥt itwaḥerzen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵍⵡⵉⵃⵜ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵃⵔⵣⵏ.

ayah_content: S igenni, akked yitri n yiv!
latin_inalco: S igenni, akked yitri n yiḍ!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵢⵉⵜⵔⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⴹ!

ayah_content: W ara k imlen d acu t itri n yiv?
latin_inalco: W ara k imlen d acu t itri n yiḍ?
Tifinagh: ⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵉⵜⵔⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⴹ?

ayah_content: Ipôeôiq itri n yiv.
latin_inalco: Itṛeṛiq itri n yiḍ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵕⵕⵉⵇ ⵉⵜⵔⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⴹ.

ayah_content: Yal iman fellas amêareb.
latin_inalco: Yal iman fellas amḥareb.
Tifinagh: ⵢⴰⵍ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⴰⵎⵃⴰⵔⴱ.

ayah_content: Ad iwali umdan seg wacu ipwaxleq.
latin_inalco: Ad iwali umdan seg wacu itwaxleq.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⴰⵛⵓ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵅⵍⵇ.

ayah_content: Ipwaxleq s waman id ifin.
latin_inalco: Itwaxleq s waman id ifin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵅⵍⵇ ⵙ ⵡⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⴼⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ff$en ed ger tgeééal akked tgwejda.
latin_inalco: Ffɣen ed ger tgeẓẓal akked tgwejda.
Tifinagh: ⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⴷ ⴳⵔ ⵜⴳⵥⵥⴰⵍ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⴳⵡⵊⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, Izmer a t id Issker, Neppa.
latin_inalco: Ih, Izmer a t id Issker, Netta.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵉⵣⵎⵔ ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⴽⵔ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ.

ayah_content: Ass ideg lesrar ur drigen ara.
latin_inalco: Ass ideg lesrar ur drigen ara.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴷⴳ ⵍⵙⵔⴰⵔ ⵓⵔ ⴷⵔⵉⴳⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur isâi kra n tezmert ne$ n tallalt.
latin_inalco: Ur isɛi kra n tezmert neɣ n tallalt.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵄⵉ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵜⵣⵎⵔⵜ ⵏⵖ ⵏ ⵜⴰⵍⵍⴰⵍⵜ.

ayah_content: S igenni bab n tririt!
latin_inalco: S igenni bab n tririt!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ ⴱⴰⴱ ⵏ ⵜⵔⵉⵔⵉⵜ!

ayah_content: S tmurt ipceqqiqen!
latin_inalco: S tmurt itceqqiqen!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵉⵜⵛⵇⵇⵉⵇⵏ!

ayah_content: Ar neppa d awal ifeûûlen.
latin_inalco: Ar netta d awal ifeṣṣlen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ ⵉⴼⵚⵚⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur illi d urar waya.
latin_inalco: Ur illi d urar waya.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⴷ ⵓⵔⴰⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ.

ayah_content: Atnan, ih, ppandin ticeôkep.
latin_inalco: Atnan, ih, ttandin ticeṛket.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵜⵏⴰⵏ, ⵉⵀ, ⵜⵜⴰⵏⴷⵉⵏ ⵜⵉⵛⵕⴽⵜ.

ayah_content: Ad Andi$ ticeôkep.
latin_inalco: Ad Andiɣ ticeṛket.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵏⴷⵉⵖ ⵜⵉⵛⵕⴽⵜ.

ayah_content: I ijehliyen eoo lmudda, eoo asen cwiî lmudda.
latin_inalco: I ijehliyen eǧǧ lmudda, eǧǧ asen cwiṭ lmudda.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ ⴷⴷⵊ ⵍⵎⵓⴷⴷⴰ, ⴷⴷⵊ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵛⵡⵉⵟ ⵍⵎⵓⴷⴷⴰ.

ayah_content: Sbuccaâ ism n Mass ik, Aâlayan,
latin_inalco: Sbuccaɛ ism n Mass ik, Aɛlayan,
Tifinagh: ⵙⴱⵓⵛⵛⴰⵄ ⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: Ixelqen, Issemsaway,
latin_inalco: Ixelqen, Issemsaway,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ, ⵉⵙⵙⵎⵙⴰⵡⴰⵢ,

ayah_content: Iwezznen, Inhan,
latin_inalco: Iwezznen, Inhan,
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵣⵣⵏⵏ, ⵉⵏⵀⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: I d Issuff$en takessawt,
latin_inalco: I d Issuffɣen takessawt,
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖⵏ ⵜⴰⴽⵙⵙⴰⵡⵜ,

ayah_content: sinna, Ippara p d asa$uô aberkan.
latin_inalco: sinna, Ittara t d asaɣuṛ aberkan.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⴷ ⴰⵙⴰⵖⵓⵕ ⴰⴱⵔⴽⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: A k Ness$eô, ur teppu,
latin_inalco: A k Nessɣeṛ, ur tettu,
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⵙⵙⵖⵕ, ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⵓ,

ayah_content: siwa ayen Irad Öebbi. Ih, Neppa, Issen ayen ibanen, akked wayen iffren.
latin_inalco: siwa ayen Irad Ṛebbi. Ih, Netta, Issen ayen ibanen, akked wayen iffren.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵔⴰⴷ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ. ⵉⵀ, ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵉⵙⵙⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴱⴰⵏⵏ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴼⴼⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: A k Nawi ar liser.
latin_inalco: A k Nawi ar liser.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴽ ⵏⴰⵡⵉ ⴰⵔ ⵍⵉⵙⵔ.

ayah_content: Smmekti mi infaâ usmekti.
latin_inalco: Smmekti mi infaɛ usmekti.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵎⵉ ⵉⵏⴼⴰⵄ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ.

ayah_content: A d ismmekti win iugaden.
latin_inalco: A d ismmekti win iugaden.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⴳⴰⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Ageswaê ijuneb it.
latin_inalco: Ageswaḥ ijuneb it.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⵙⵡⴰⵃ ⵉⵊⵓⵏⴱ ⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Di tmes tabarart mavi ara iô$.
latin_inalco: Di tmes tabarart maḍi ara iṛɣ.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ ⵜⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔⵜ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵕⵖ.

ayah_content: Degs, ur ipmeppat, ur ippidir.
latin_inalco: Degs, ur itmettat, ur ittidir.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵎⵜⵜⴰⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵉⴷⵉⵔ.

ayah_content: Amarezg n win zeddigen!
latin_inalco: Amarezg n win zeddigen!
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴰⵔⵣⴳ ⵏ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵣⴷⴷⵉⴳⵏ!

ayah_content: I ismektayen ism n Mass is, d$a ipéalla.
latin_inalco: I ismektayen ism n Mass is, dɣa itẓalla.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⴷⵖⴰ ⵉⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⴰ.

ayah_content: Maca, tesmenyafem tameddurt n ddunit.
latin_inalco: Maca, tesmenyafem tameddurt n ddunit.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵛⴰ, ⵜⵙⵎⵏⵢⴰⴼⵎ ⵜⴰⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵏ ⴷⴷⵓⵏⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Tif ip laxeôt, a pdum kteô.
latin_inalco: Tif it laxeṛt, a tdum kteṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⴼ ⵉⵜ ⵍⴰⵅⵕⵜ, ⴰ ⵜⴷⵓⵎ ⴽⵜⵕ.

ayah_content: Ayagi, illa di tewôeqtin timezwura,
latin_inalco: Ayagi, illa di tewṛeqtin timezwura,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵢⴰⴳⵉ, ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵡⵕⵇⵜⵉⵏ ⵜⵉⵎⵣⵡⵓⵔⴰ,

ayah_content: Tiwôeqtin n Ibôahim akked Musa.
latin_inalco: Tiwṛeqtin n Ibṛahim akked Musa.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵡⵕⵇⵜⵉⵏ ⵏ ⵉⴱⵕⴰⵀⵉⵎ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵎⵓⵙⴰ.

ayah_content: Ma tebbweb ik id teqsiî n te$wlalt?
latin_inalco: Ma tebbweb ik id teqsiṭ n teɣwlalt?
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⵜⴱⴱⵡⴱ ⵉⴽ ⵉⴷ ⵜⵇⵙⵉⵟ ⵏ ⵜⵖⵡⵍⴰⵍⵜ?

ayah_content: Ad anzen wudmawen, assen.
latin_inalco: Ad anzen wudmawen, assen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵏⵣⵏ ⵡⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad xedmen, ad merten.
latin_inalco: Ad xedmen, ad merten.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵅⴷⵎⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵎⵔⵜⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad ô$en di tmes izehren.
latin_inalco: Ad ṛɣen di tmes izehren.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵕⵖⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ ⵉⵣⵀⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad asen sswen aman ippayzagen.
latin_inalco: Ad asen sswen aman ittayzagen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵙⵙⵡⵏ ⴰⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵢⵣⴰⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur asen illi wuççi, siwa timeôéuga.
latin_inalco: Ur asen illi wučči, siwa timeṛẓuga.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ ⵡⵓⵜⵜⵛⵉ, ⵙⵉⵡⴰ ⵜⵉⵎⵕⵥⵓⴳⴰ.

ayah_content: Ur ssufayent, ur sseôwayent.
latin_inalco: Ur ssufayent, ur sseṛwayent.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵓⴼⴰⵢⵏⵜ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵙⵕⵡⴰⵢⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Udmawen, assen nnecôaêen. öÔ
latin_inalco: Udmawen, assen nnecṛaḥen. ṛṚ
Tifinagh: ⵓⴷⵎⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ ⵏⵏⵛⵕⴰⵃⵏ. ⵕⵕ

ayah_content: Öuvan laâtab nnsen,
latin_inalco: Ṛuḍan laɛtab nnsen,
Tifinagh: ⵕⵓⴹⴰⵏ ⵍⴰⵄⵜⴰⴱ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: di Loennet aâlayen.
latin_inalco: di Lǧennet aɛlayen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Yir awal, ur din sellen.
latin_inalco: Yir awal, ur din sellen.
Tifinagh: ⵢⵉⵔ ⴰⵡⴰⵍ, ⵓⵔ ⴷⵉⵏ ⵙⵍⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Degs, tala ippazalen.
latin_inalco: Degs, tala ittazalen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵜⴰⵍⴰ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵣⴰⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Degs, imîeôêen aâlayen.
latin_inalco: Degs, imṭeṛḥen aɛlayen.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵉⵎⵟⵕⵃⵏ ⴰⵄⵍⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Iqbucen wejden.
latin_inalco: Iqbucen wejden.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵇⴱⵓⵛⵏ ⵡⵊⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Tisumtiwin iderrsen.
latin_inalco: Tisumtiwin iderrsen.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵙⵓⵎⵜⵉⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴷⵔⵔⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Tiôakniwin issan.
latin_inalco: Tiṛakniwin issan.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵉⵕⴰⴽⵏⵉⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵙⵙⴰⵏ.

ayah_content: Acimi ur pmuqulen ara al$wem, amek ipwaxleq,
latin_inalco: Acimi ur tmuqulen ara alɣwem, amek itwaxleq,
Tifinagh: ⴰⵛⵉⵎⵉ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵎⵓⵇⵓⵍⵏ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵍⵖⵡⵎ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵅⵍⵇ,

ayah_content: u igenni, amek iuli,
latin_inalco: u igenni, amek iuli,
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵉⴳⵏⵏⵉ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵓⵍⵉ,

ayah_content: u idurar, amek âaoôen,
latin_inalco: u idurar, amek ɛaǧṛen,
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⴰⵔ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵄⴰⴷⵊⵕⵏ,

ayah_content: u tamurt, amek temsuwa?
latin_inalco: u tamurt, amek temsuwa?
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⴰⵎⴽ ⵜⵎⵙⵓⵡⴰ?

ayah_content: Ihi, mmekti! Keçç d win kan ismektayen.
latin_inalco: Ihi, mmekti! Kečč d win kan ismektayen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⵎⵎⴽⵜⵉ! ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⴰⵢⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur telliv d amôay nnsen.
latin_inalco: Ur telliḍ d amṛay nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵍⵍⵉⴹ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵕⴰⵢ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Kkes ed win iwexxôen, ijehlen.
latin_inalco: Kkes ed win iwexxṛen, ijehlen.
Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕⵏ, ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ.

ayah_content: Ad as Iheggi Öebbi aâaqeb abarar mavi.
latin_inalco: Ad as Iheggi Ṛebbi aɛaqeb abarar maḍi.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵀⴳⴳⵉ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⴰⴱⴰⵔⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⴹⵉ.

ayah_content: Ni$ $uône£ tu$alin nnsen!
latin_inalco: Niɣ ɣuṛneɣ tuɣalin nnsen!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵖⵓⵕⵏⵖ ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ!

ayah_content: Sinna, s tidep, fella£ aqeîîi nnsen.
latin_inalco: Sinna, s tidet, fellaɣ aqeṭṭi nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉⵏⵏⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵖ ⴰⵇⵟⵟⵉ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: S tafrara!
latin_inalco: S tafrara!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⴰⴼⵔⴰⵔⴰ!

ayah_content: S mraw wavan!
latin_inalco: S mraw waḍan!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵎⵔⴰⵡ ⵡⴰⴹⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: S wayugan akked waryugan!
latin_inalco: S wayugan akked waryugan!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵓⴳⴰⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵔⵢⵓⴳⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: S yiv, ma ilêa!
latin_inalco: S yiḍ, ma ilḥa!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵢⵉⴹ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵃⴰ!

ayah_content: Day maççi dagi d tagallit i lfahem?
latin_inalco: Day mačči dagi d tagallit i lfahem?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷⴰⴳⵉ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴳⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵍⴼⴰⵀⵎ?

ayah_content: Day ur twalav ara amek Ixdem Mass ik, i Âad?
latin_inalco: Day ur twalaḍ ara amek Ixdem Mass ik, i Ɛad?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵎⴽ ⵉⵅⴷⵎ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉ ⵄⴰⴷ?

ayah_content: Iôam m tgejda;
latin_inalco: Iṛam m tgejda;
Tifinagh: ⵉⵕⴰⵎ ⵎ ⵜⴳⵊⴷⴰ;

ayah_content: ur tepwaxleq temtilt is, di tmura.
latin_inalco: ur tetwaxleq temtilt is, di tmura.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵡⴰⵅⵍⵇ ⵜⵎⵜⵉⵍⵜ ⵉⵙ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: U Tamud, di te$zut, i i$zan tiéôa.
latin_inalco: U Tamud, di teɣzut, i iɣzan tiẓṛa.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵜⴰⵎⵓⴷ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵖⵣⵓⵜ, ⵉ ⵉⵖⵣⴰⵏ ⵜⵉⵥⵕⴰ.

ayah_content: Ferâun, bu ibudiden.
latin_inalco: Ferɛun, bu ibudiden.
Tifinagh: ⴼⵔⵄⵓⵏ, ⴱⵓ ⵉⴱⵓⴷⵉⴷⵏ.

ayah_content: Wid ijuôen di tmurt.
latin_inalco: Wid ijuṛen di tmurt.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵓⵕⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ.

ayah_content: Degs ssugten lefsad
latin_inalco: Degs ssugten lefsad
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙ ⵙⵙⵓⴳⵜⵏ ⵍⴼⵙⴰⴷ

ayah_content: Iwwet iten Mass ik, s ujekwav uâaqeb.
latin_inalco: Iwwet iten Mass ik, s ujekwaḍ uɛaqeb.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵡⵜ ⵉⵜⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵙ ⵓⵊⴽⵡⴰⴹ ⵓⵄⴰⵇⴱ.

ayah_content: Ih, Mass ik d Amâassi.
latin_inalco: Ih, Mass ik d Amɛassi.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⴷ ⴰⵎⵄⴰⵙⵙⵉ.

ayah_content: Amdan ma Ijeôôeb it Mass is, I$at it, Iga yas ccan, ad yini: "d Mass iw iyi Iâuzzen".
latin_inalco: Amdan ma Ijeṛṛeb it Mass is, Iɣat it, Iga yas ccan, ad yini: "d Mass iw iyi Iɛuzzen".
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵉⵜ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⵉⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⵜ, ⵉⴳⴰ ⵢⴰⵙ ⵛⵛⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵄⵓⵣⵣⵏ".

ayah_content: Wanag, ma Ijeôôeb it, I$at it kan s lmizan, ad yini: "d Mass iw iyi Igelzen".
latin_inalco: Wanag, ma Ijeṛṛeb it, Iɣat it kan s lmizan, ad yini: "d Mass iw iyi Igelzen".
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵊⵕⵕⴱ ⵉⵜ, ⵉⵖⴰⵜ ⵉⵜ ⴽⴰⵏ ⵙ ⵍⵎⵉⵣⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵡ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⴳⵍⵣⵏ".

ayah_content: Xaîi! Agujil, ur t tepâuzzum!
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Agujil, ur t tetɛuzzum!
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⴰⴳⵓⵊⵉⵍ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵜⵜⵄⵓⵣⵣⵓⵎ!

ayah_content: Ur teppemtebbatem ar ume$bun, a t tecceççem!
latin_inalco: Ur tettemtebbatem ar umeɣbun, a t tecceččem!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜⵜⵜⵎⵜⴱⴱⴰⵜⵎ ⴰⵔ ⵓⵎⵖⴱⵓⵏ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵜⵛⵛⵜⵜⵛⵎ!

ayah_content: Teppeppem lweôt, têellqem!
latin_inalco: Tettettem lweṛt, tḥellqem!
Tifinagh: ⵜⵜⵜⵜⵜⵎ ⵍⵡⵕⵜ, ⵜⵃⵍⵍⵇⵎ!

ayah_content: Têemlem ayla, tayri war tilas.
latin_inalco: Tḥemlem ayla, tayri war tilas.
Tifinagh: ⵜⵃⵎⵍⵎ ⴰⵢⵍⴰ, ⵜⴰⵢⵔⵉ ⵡⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⵍⴰⵙ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! Ma temsawi tmurt, yal amsawi,
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Ma temsawi tmurt, yal amsawi,
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵎⴰ ⵜⵎⵙⴰⵡⵉ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵢⴰⵍ ⴰⵎⵙⴰⵡⵉ,

ayah_content: u Iusa d Mass ik, akked lmalayek, d idurra,
latin_inalco: u Iusa d Mass ik, akked lmalayek, d idurra,
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⴷ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ, ⴷ ⵉⴷⵓⵔⵔⴰ,

ayah_content: assen, a d ters Loahennama. Assen, a d ismekti umdan. Acu ar as d iawi usmekti?
latin_inalco: assen, a d ters Lǧahennama. Assen, a d ismekti umdan. Acu ar as d iawi usmekti?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵔⵙ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ. ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ. ⴰⵛⵓ ⴰⵔ ⴰⵙ ⴷ ⵉⴰⵡⵉ ⵓⵙⵎⴽⵜⵉ?

ayah_content: Ad yini: "a ssexv iw! A lemmer hegga$ i tmeddurt iw"!
latin_inalco: Ad yini: "a ssexḍ iw! A lemmer heggaɣ i tmeddurt iw"!
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰ ⵙⵙⵅⴹ ⵉⵡ! ⴰ ⵍⵎⵎⵔ ⵀⴳⴳⴰⵖ ⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⴷⵓⵔⵜ ⵉⵡ"!

ayah_content: Aâaqeb is, assen, ur t isâadda yiwen.
latin_inalco: Aɛaqeb is, assen, ur t isɛadda yiwen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵄⴰⵇⴱ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵉⵙⵄⴰⴷⴷⴰ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Yiwen ur ipwaqqen akken ipwaqqen.
latin_inalco: Yiwen ur itwaqqen akken itwaqqen.
Tifinagh: ⵢⵉⵡⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵇⵇⵏ ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵇⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: A yiman illan di laman,
latin_inalco: A yiman illan di laman,
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵢⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴰⵎⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: u$al ar Mass ik, d amôavi ôuvan!
latin_inalco: uɣal ar Mass ik, d amṛaḍi ṛuḍan!
Tifinagh: ⵓⵖⴰⵍ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵎⵕⴰⴹⵉ ⵕⵓⴹⴰⵏ!

ayah_content: Ekcem ger imdanen iW!
latin_inalco: Ekcem ger imdanen iW!
Tifinagh: ⴻⴽⵛⵎ ⴳⵔ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Ekcem di Loennet iW!
latin_inalco: Ekcem di Lǧennet iW!
Tifinagh: ⴻⴽⵛⵎ ⴷⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵏⵜ ⵉⵡ!

ayah_content: Xaîi! Gulle$ s temdint a!
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Gulleɣ s temdint a!
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⴳⵓⵍⵍⵖ ⵙ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ ⴰ!

ayah_content: U keçç d ilelli, di temdint a.
latin_inalco: U kečč d ilelli, di temdint a.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⴽⵜⵜⵛ ⴷ ⵉⵍⵍⵍⵉ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⴷⵉⵏⵜ ⴰ.

ayah_content: S ubabat akked wayen id iurew!
latin_inalco: S ubabat akked wayen id iurew!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵓⴱⴰⴱⴰⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵔⵡ!

ayah_content: Ar Nxelq ed amdan d ûûam.
latin_inalco: Ar Nxelq ed amdan d ṣṣam.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵏⵅⵍⵇ ⴷ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴷ ⵚⵚⴰⵎ.

ayah_content: Day inwa ur as izmir yiwen?
latin_inalco: Day inwa ur as izmir yiwen?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⵏⵡⴰ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ?

ayah_content: Iqqaô: "sgullze$ lerbaê, werrken".
latin_inalco: Iqqaṛ: "sgullzeɣ lerbaḥ, werrken".
Tifinagh: ⵉⵇⵇⴰⵕ: "ⵙⴳⵓⵍⵍⵣⵖ ⵍⵔⴱⴰⵃ, ⵡⵔⵔⴽⵏ".

ayah_content: Day inwa ur t iéôi yiwen?
latin_inalco: Day inwa ur t iẓṛi yiwen?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵉⵏⵡⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵉⵥⵕⵉ ⵢⵉⵡⵏ?

ayah_content: Day ur as Nefka ara snat wallen,
latin_inalco: Day ur as Nefka ara snat wallen,
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⴰⵙ ⵏⴼⴽⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵙⵏⴰⵜ ⵡⴰⵍⵍⵏ,

ayah_content: iles, sin icenfiren?
latin_inalco: iles, sin icenfiren?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵍⵙ, ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⵛⵏⴼⵉⵔⵏ?

ayah_content: Nenha t di sin iberdan meqqwôen.
latin_inalco: Nenha t di sin iberdan meqqwṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵀⴰ ⵜ ⴷⵉ ⵙⵉⵏ ⵉⴱⵔⴷⴰⵏ ⵎⵇⵇⵡⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur idhim deg win iulin.
latin_inalco: Ur idhim deg win iulin.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⴷⵀⵉⵎ ⴷⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵓⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Abrid iulin, anwa ara k t imlen?
latin_inalco: Abrid iulin, anwa ara k t imlen?

latin_inalco: Akked tilin seg wid iumnen, i ttemyenhun ar ṣṣbeṛ, u ttemyenhun ar lmaḥnana.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵜⵉⵍⵉⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉ ⵜⵜⵎⵢⵏⵀⵓⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵚⵚⴱⵕ, ⵓ ⵜⵜⵎⵢⵏⵀⵓⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵍⵎⴰⵃⵏⴰⵏⴰ.

latin_inalco: S igenni, akked Win i t ibnan!

ayah_content: S tmurt, akked Win ip issewsâan!
latin_inalco: S tmurt, akked Win it issewsɛan!

latin_inalco: S teṛwiḥt, akked Win it imeslen!

ayah_content: Iwehheb as laâwayeô is, aêezzeb is.
latin_inalco: Iwehheb as laɛwayeṛ is, aḥezzeb is.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵡⵀⵀⴱ ⴰⵙ ⵍⴰⵄⵡⴰⵢⵕ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵃⵣⵣⴱ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Ni$ irbeê win ip izzazdgen.
latin_inalco: Niɣ irbeḥ win it izzazdgen.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵉⵔⴱⵃ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜ ⵉⵣⵣⴰⵣⴷⴳⵏ.

latin_inalco: Amazan n Ṛebbi inna yasen: "talɣwemt n Ṛebbi, ssewwet et"!
