latin_inalco: Skaddben t; i telɣwemt, gezmen iḍaṛen. Izɛaf fellasen Mass nnsen, ilmend ubekkaḍ nnsen; dɣa Isemsawi t.
Tifinagh: ⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⵜ; ⵉ ⵜⵍⵖⵡⵎⵜ, ⴳⵣⵎⵏ ⵉⴹⴰⵕⵏ. ⵉⵣⵄⴰⴼ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵍⵎⵏⴷ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ; ⴷⵖⴰ ⵉⵙⵎⵙⴰⵡⵉ ⵜ.

ayah_content: Ur T icqi w ara iûaôen.
latin_inalco: Ur T icqi w ara iṣaṛen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵜ ⵉⵛⵇⵉ ⵡ ⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵚⴰⵕⵏ.

ayah_content: S yiv, mara idell!
latin_inalco: S yiḍ, mara idell!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵢⵉⴹ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⴷⵍⵍ!

ayah_content: S wass, mara iôeqq!
latin_inalco: S wass, mara iṛeqq!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵡⴰⵙⵙ, ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵉⵕⵇⵇ!

ayah_content: S wayen Ixleq: ddkeô, nnta!
latin_inalco: S wayen Ixleq: ddkeṛ, nnta!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ: ⴷⴷⴽⵕ, ⵏⵏⵜⴰ!

ayah_content: Igiten nnwen, s tidep, mefruzit.
latin_inalco: Igiten nnwen, s tidet, mefruzit.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵡⵏ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⵎⴼⵔⵓⵣⵉⵜ.

ayah_content: Wanag win ipseddiqen, ipêezziben,
latin_inalco: Wanag win itseddiqen, itḥezziben,
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⵙⴷⴷⵉⵇⵏ, ⵉⵜⵃⵣⵣⵉⴱⵏ,

ayah_content: di tezdeg iumen,
latin_inalco: di tezdeg iumen,
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵣⴷⴳ ⵉⵓⵎⵏ,

latin_inalco: ad as Nefk afus ad istiser.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⴼⴽ ⴰⴼⵓⵙ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵜⵉⵙⵔ.

ayah_content: Wanag win icuêêen, i isme$wôen iman is,
latin_inalco: Wanag win icuḥḥen, i ismeɣwṛen iman is,
Tifinagh: ⵡⴰⵏⴰⴳ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵛⵓⵃⵃⵏ, ⵉ ⵉⵙⵎⵖⵡⵕⵏ ⵉⵎⴰⵏ ⵉⵙ,

ayah_content: u iskaddeb ayen zeddigen,
latin_inalco: u iskaddeb ayen zeddigen,
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵣⴷⴷⵉⴳⵏ,

latin_inalco: ad as Negg abrid ar laɛṣeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴷ ⴰⵙ ⵏⴳⴳ ⴰⴱⵔⵉⴷ ⴰⵔ ⵍⴰⵄⵚⵕ.

ayah_content: Iwumi yas wayla s, imi ad i$li?

Tifinagh: ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵏⵖ.

Tifinagh: ⴽⴽⵙ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵉⵎⵣⴳⵉ.

ayah_content: Ihi, d acu, deffir waya, ara k iskiddben f uqeîîi?
latin_inalco: Ihi, d acu, deffir waya, ara k iskiddben f uqeṭṭi?
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀⵉ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ, ⴷⴼⴼⵉⵔ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵉⵙⴽⵉⴷⴷⴱⵏ ⴼ ⵓⵇⵟⵟⵉ?

ayah_content: Day Öebbi maççi d Imxeyyeô n yimêaddan?
latin_inalco: Day Ṛebbi mačči d Imxeyyeṛ n yimḥaddan?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵎⴰⵜⵜⵛⵉ ⴷ ⵉⵎⵅⵢⵢⵕ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⵃⴰⴷⴷⴰⵏ?

ayah_content: £eô, s yisem n Mass ik Ixelqen.
latin_inalco: ɣeṛ, s yisem n Mass ik Ixelqen.
Tifinagh: ⵖⵕ, ⵙ ⵢⵉⵙⵎ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ ⵉⵅⵍⵇⵏ.

ayah_content: Ixleq amdan seg urgen.
latin_inalco: Ixleq amdan seg urgen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵅⵍⵇ ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⵙⴳ ⵓⵔⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: £eô! Mass ik, Imxeyyeô n wukyisen,
latin_inalco: ɣeṛ! Mass ik, Imxeyyeṛ n wukyisen,
Tifinagh: ⵖⵕ! ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵉⵎⵅⵢⵢⵕ ⵏ ⵡⵓⴽⵢⵉⵙⵏ,

ayah_content: i Islemden s umru.
latin_inalco: i Islemden s umru.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵙⵍⵎⴷⵏ ⵙ ⵓⵎⵔⵓ.

ayah_content: Isselmed i umdan, ayen ur issin.
latin_inalco: Isselmed i umdan, ayen ur issin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵙⵙⵍⵎⴷ ⵉ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⴰⵢⵏ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵙⵙⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Xaîi! War ccekk, ijuô umdan,
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! War ccekk, ijuṛ umdan,
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⵉⵊⵓⵕ ⵓⵎⴷⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: mi iwala isâa.
latin_inalco: mi iwala isɛa.
Tifinagh: ⵎⵉ ⵉⵡⴰⵍⴰ ⵉⵙⵄⴰ.

ayah_content: Ih, ar Mass ik, tu$alin.
latin_inalco: Ih, ar Mass ik, tuɣalin.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ, ⵜⵓⵖⴰⵍⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Twalav win ikksen
latin_inalco: Twalaḍ win ikksen
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⴽⴽⵙⵏ

ayah_content: taéallit i uxdim?
latin_inalco: taẓallit i uxdim?
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ ⵉ ⵓⵅⴷⵉⵎ?

ayah_content: Twalav ma illa di nnhaya?
latin_inalco: Twalaḍ ma illa di nnhaya?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴷⵉ ⵏⵏⵀⴰⵢⴰ?

ayah_content: Ne$ ma iumeô $eô uêezzeb?
latin_inalco: Neɣ ma iumeṛ ɣeṛ uḥezzeb?
Tifinagh: ⵏⵖ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵎⵕ ⵖⵕ ⵓⵃⵣⵣⴱ?

ayah_content: Twalav ma iskaddeb, ma iwexxeô?
latin_inalco: Twalaḍ ma iskaddeb, ma iwexxeṛ?
Tifinagh: ⵜⵡⴰⵍⴰⴹ ⵎⴰ ⵉⵙⴽⴰⴷⴷⴱ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵡⵅⵅⵕ?

ayah_content: Day ur iéôi ara, ar Öebbi Ipwali?
latin_inalco: Day ur iẓṛi ara, ar Ṛebbi Itwali?
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵥⵕⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⴰⵔ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵜⵡⴰⵍⵉ?

ayah_content: Xaîi! Ma ur iffuk ara, si tgwenza, war ccekk, ara t Neîîef,
latin_inalco: Xaṭi! Ma ur iffuk ara, si tgwenza, war ccekk, ara t Neṭṭef,
Tifinagh: ⵅⴰⵟⵉ! ⵎⴰ ⵓⵔ ⵉⴼⴼⵓⴽ ⴰⵔⴰ, ⵙⵉ ⵜⴳⵡⵏⵣⴰ, ⵡⴰⵔ ⵛⵛⴽⴽ, ⴰⵔⴰ ⵜ ⵏⵟⵟⴼ,

ayah_content: tagwenza n ubekkav, tuccva.
latin_inalco: tagwenza n ubekkaḍ, tuccḍa.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⴳⵡⵏⵣⴰ ⵏ ⵓⴱⴽⴽⴰⴹ, ⵜⵓⵛⵛⴹⴰ.

ayah_content: Anef ad isiwel i imeddukwal.
latin_inalco: Anef ad isiwel i imeddukwal.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⴼ ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⵉⵡⵍ ⵉ ⵉⵎⴷⴷⵓⴽⵡⴰⵍ.

ayah_content: A Nenced iâssasen.
latin_inalco: A Nenced iɛssasen.
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⵏⵏⵛⴷ ⵉⵄⵙⵙⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Ur s ssemêas, eknu, qeôôeb.
latin_inalco: Ur s ssemḥas, eknu, qeṛṛeb.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵙ ⵙⵙⵎⵃⴰⵙ, ⴽⵏⵓ, ⵇⵕⵕⴱ.

ayah_content: Ni$ Nessader it id deg iv useyyi.
latin_inalco: Niɣ Nessader it id deg iḍ useyyi.
Tifinagh: ⵏⵉⵖ ⵏⵙⵙⴰⴷⵔ ⵉⵜ ⵉⴷ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴹ ⵓⵙⵢⵢⵉ.

ayah_content: Anwa ara k imlen, d acu ay d iv useyyi?
latin_inalco: Anwa ara k imlen, d acu ay d iḍ useyyi?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵏⵡⴰ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴽ ⵉⵎⵍⵏ, ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⵉⴹ ⵓⵙⵢⵢⵉ?

ayah_content: Iv useyyi yif agim wagguren.
latin_inalco: Iḍ useyyi yif agim wagguren.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴹ ⵓⵙⵢⵢⵉ ⵢⵉⴼ ⴰⴳⵉⵎ ⵡⴰⴳⴳⵓⵔⵏ.

ayah_content: Lmalayek akked ôôuê, ppadren d degs, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, i yal lameô.
latin_inalco: Lmalayek akked ṛṛuḥ, ttadren d degs, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, i yal lameṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵍⵎⴰⵍⴰⵢⴽ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵕⵕⵓⵃ, ⵜⵜⴰⴷⵔⵏ ⴷ ⴷⴳⵙ, ⵙ ⵡⴰⵏⵏⵓⴼ ⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉ ⵢⴰⵍ ⵍⴰⵎⵕ.

ayah_content: Di tifrat i illa alamma d tafrara.
latin_inalco: Di tifrat i illa alamma d tafrara.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵉⴼⵔⴰⵜ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰ ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵜⴰⴼⵔⴰⵔⴰ.

ayah_content: Ijehliyen seg At Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ur steôoiâen alamma irs ed, $uôsen, ubeggen:
latin_inalco: Ijehliyen seg At Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ur steṛǧiɛen alamma irs ed, ɣuṛsen, ubeggen:
Tifinagh: ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵉⵢⵏ ⵙⴳ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ, ⵓⵔ ⵙⵜⵕⴷⵊⵉⵄⵏ ⴰⵍⴰⵎⵎⴰ ⵉⵔⵙ ⴷ, ⵖⵓⵕⵙⵏ, ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ:

ayah_content: Amazan s$uô Öebbi, i immalen tiwôeqtin zeddigen;
latin_inalco: Amazan sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, i immalen tiwṛeqtin zeddigen;
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴰⵣⴰⵏ ⵙⵖⵓⵕ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ, ⵉ ⵉⵎⵎⴰⵍⵏ ⵜⵉⵡⵕⵇⵜⵉⵏ ⵣⴷⴷⵉⴳⵏ;

ayah_content: degsent tira tumâint.
latin_inalco: degsent tira tumɛint.
Tifinagh: ⴷⴳⵙⵏⵜ ⵜⵉⵔⴰ ⵜⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Ur myefrazen wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, armi ten id iusa ubeggen.
latin_inalco: Ur myefrazen wid iwumi tettunefk Tezmamt, armi ten id iusa ubeggen.
Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵎⵢⴼⵔⴰⵣⵏ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵡⵓⵎⵉ ⵜⵜⵜⵓⵏⴼⴽ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ, ⴰⵔⵎⵉ ⵜⵏ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵓⵙⴰ ⵓⴱⴳⴳⵏ.

ayah_content: Ppwamôen, kan, ad âabden Öebbi s ddin iûfan, ad malen ar tidep, ad bedden i téallit, ad zzekkin. D wagi ay d ddin umâin.
latin_inalco: Ptwamṛen, kan, ad ɛabden Ṛebbi s ddin iṣfan, ad malen ar tidet, ad bedden i tẓallit, ad zzekkin. D wagi ay d ddin umɛin.
Tifinagh: Pⵜⵡⴰⵎⵕⵏ, ⴽⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵄⴰⴱⴷⵏ ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵙ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵉⵚⴼⴰⵏ, ⴰⴷ ⵎⴰⵍⵏ ⴰⵔ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⴱⴷⴷⵏ ⵉ ⵜⵥⴰⵍⵍⵉⵜ, ⴰⴷ ⵣⵣⴽⴽⵉⵏ. ⴷ ⵡⴰⴳⵉ ⴰⵢ ⴷ ⴷⴷⵉⵏ ⵓⵎⵄⵉⵏ.

ayah_content: Ih, wid ijehlen, seg At Tezmamt akked imcurak, di tmes n Loahennama ad wekkôen. Widak, d aâar n yimdanen.
latin_inalco: Ih, wid ijehlen, seg At Tezmamt akked imcurak, di tmes n Lǧahennama ad wekkṛen. Widak, d aɛar n yimdanen.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵊⵀⵍⵏ, ⵙⴳ ⴰⵜ ⵜⵣⵎⴰⵎⵜ ⴰⴽⴽⴷ ⵉⵎⵛⵓⵔⴰⴽ, ⴷⵉ ⵜⵎⵙ ⵏ ⵍⴷⵊⴰⵀⵏⵏⴰⵎⴰ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ. ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ, ⴷ ⴰⵄⴰⵔ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Ma d wid ippamnen, i xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak d lxetyaô n yimdanen.
latin_inalco: Ma d wid ittamnen, i xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak d lxetyaṛ n yimdanen.
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰ ⴷ ⵡⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵎⵏⵏ, ⵉ ⵅⴷⴷⵎⵏ ⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵍⵀⴰⵏ, ⵡⵉⴷⴰⴽ ⴷ ⵍⵅⵜⵢⴰⵕ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ.

ayah_content: Arraz nnsen, ar Mass nnsen, d leonanat n Âaden, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, i lebda. Öebbi Iôuva ten, nitni ôuvan T. Akka i win i ippagwaden Mass is.
latin_inalco: Arraz nnsen, ar Mass nnsen, d leǧnanat n Ɛaden, ddawat sen isaffen ttazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen, i lebda. Ṛebbi Iṛuḍa ten, nitni ṛuḍan T. Akka i win i ittagwaden Mass is.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔⵔⴰⵣ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⴷ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⴰⵏⴰⵜ ⵏ ⵄⴰⴷⵏ, ⴷⴷⴰⵡⴰⵜ ⵙⵏ ⵉⵙⴰⴼⴼⵏ ⵜⵜⴰⵣⵣⴰⵍⵏ, ⴷⴳⵙⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵡⴽⴽⵕⵏ, ⵉ ⵍⴱⴷⴰ. ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵉⵕⵓⴹⴰ ⵜⵏ, ⵏⵉⵜⵏⵉ ⵕⵓⴹⴰⵏ ⵜ. ⴰⴽⴽⴰ ⵉ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⴳⵡⴰⴷⵏ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ.

ayah_content: Mara tezlez tmurt zzelzla s,
latin_inalco: Mara tezlez tmurt zzelzla s,
Tifinagh: ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⵜⵣⵍⵣ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ ⵣⵣⵍⵣⵍⴰ ⵙ,

ayah_content: U tessuffe$ ed d tmurt, tiâakkwemin is,
latin_inalco: U tessuffeɣ ed d tmurt, tiɛakkwemin is,
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵜⵙⵙⵓⴼⴼⵖ ⴷ ⴷ ⵜⵎⵓⵔⵜ, ⵜⵉⵄⴰⴽⴽⵡⵎⵉⵏ ⵉⵙ,

ayah_content: amdan ad yini: "d acu p iu$en"?
latin_inalco: amdan ad yini: "d acu t iuɣen"?
Tifinagh: ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵢⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵉⵓⵖⵏ"?

ayah_content: A d teêku tidyanin is, assen;
latin_inalco: A d teḥku tidyanin is, assen;
Tifinagh: ⴰ ⴷ ⵜⵃⴽⵓ ⵜⵉⴷⵢⴰⵏⵉⵏ ⵉⵙ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ;

ayah_content: akken i s Iweêêa Mass ik.
latin_inalco: akken i s Iweḥḥa Mass ik.
Tifinagh: ⴰⴽⴽⵏ ⵉ ⵙ ⵉⵡⵃⵃⴰ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⴽ.

ayah_content: Assen, a d asen imdanen, d igrawen, ar usnaâti igiten nnsen.
latin_inalco: Assen, a d asen imdanen, d igrawen, ar usnaɛti igiten nnsen.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⴰⵙⵏ ⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ, ⴷ ⵉⴳⵔⴰⵡⵏ, ⴰⵔ ⵓⵙⵏⴰⵄⵜⵉ ⵉⴳⵉⵜⵏ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Win ixedmen taéeyt ubelkim n lxiô, a t iéeô.
latin_inalco: Win ixedmen taẓeyt ubelkim n lxiṛ, a t iẓeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵜⴰⵥⵢⵜ ⵓⴱⵍⴽⵉⵎ ⵏ ⵍⵅⵉⵕ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵥⵕ.

ayah_content: Win ixedmen taéeyt ubelkim n cceôô, a t iéeô.
latin_inalco: Win ixedmen taẓeyt ubelkim n cceṛṛ, a t iẓeṛ.
Tifinagh: ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵅⴷⵎⵏ ⵜⴰⵥⵢⵜ ⵓⴱⵍⴽⵉⵎ ⵏ ⵛⵛⵕⵕ, ⴰ ⵜ ⵉⵥⵕ.

ayah_content: S tid id ippazalen neffôent!
latin_inalco: S tid id ittazalen neffṛent!
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵜⴰⵣⴰⵍⵏ ⵏⴼⴼⵕⵏⵜ!

ayah_content: Ifeîîiwjen, ssafagent.
latin_inalco: Ifeṭṭiwjen, ssafagent.
Tifinagh: ⵉⴼⵟⵟⵉⵡⵊⵏ, ⵙⵙⴰⴼⴰⴳⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Di tûebêit ara d dehment.
latin_inalco: Di tṣebḥit ara d dehment.
Tifinagh: ⴷⵉ ⵜⵚⴱⵃⵉⵜ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⴷⵀⵎⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: A$ebbaô, sskarent.
latin_inalco: Aɣebbaṛ, sskarent.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵖⴱⴱⴰⵕ, ⵙⵙⴽⴰⵔⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Ar tlemmast n ugraw, kecment.
latin_inalco: Ar tlemmast n ugraw, kecment.
Tifinagh: ⴰⵔ ⵜⵍⵎⵎⴰⵙⵜ ⵏ ⵓⴳⵔⴰⵡ, ⴽⵛⵎⵏⵜ.

ayah_content: Ih, amdan, i Mass is, d lkaraâ.
latin_inalco: Ih, amdan, i Mass is, d lkaraɛ.
Tifinagh: ⵉⵀ, ⴰⵎⴷⴰⵏ, ⵉ ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵉⵙ, ⴷ ⵍⴽⴰⵔⴰⵄ.

ayah_content: U neppa, ard anagi n waya.
latin_inalco: U netta, ard anagi n waya.
Tifinagh: ⵓ ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⴰⵔⴷ ⴰⵏⴰⴳⵉ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⴰ.

ayah_content: Neppa, s tidep, aîas i iêemmel sâaya!
latin_inalco: Netta, s tidet, aṭas i iḥemmel sɛaya!
Tifinagh: ⵏⵜⵜⴰ, ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵟⴰⵙ ⵉ ⵉⵃⵎⵎⵍ ⵙⵄⴰⵢⴰ!

ayah_content: Day ur iéôi ara ar mara d iffe$ i illan deg iéekwan,
latin_inalco: Day ur iẓṛi ara ar mara d iffeɣ i illan deg iẓekwan,
Tifinagh: ⴷⴰⵢ ⵓⵔ ⵉⵥⵕⵉ ⴰⵔⴰ ⴰⵔ ⵎⴰⵔⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴼⴼⵖ ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⵥⴽⵡⴰⵏ,

ayah_content: i illan deg idmaren, a d ivheô meôôa.
latin_inalco: i illan deg idmaren, a d iḍheṛ meṛṛa.
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵍⵍⴰⵏ ⴷⴳ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ, ⴰ ⴷ ⵉⴹⵀⵕ ⵎⵕⵕⴰ.

ayah_content: S tidep, assen, Mass nnsen, ippuxebbeô fellasen.
latin_inalco: S tidet, assen, Mass nnsen, ittuxebbeṛ fellasen.
Tifinagh: ⵙ ⵜⵉⴷⵜ, ⴰⵙⵙⵏ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏⵏⵙⵏ, ⵉⵜⵜⵓⵅⴱⴱⵕ ⴼⵍⵍⴰⵙⵏ.

ayah_content: Taheûûakt.
latin_inalco: Taheṣṣakt.
Tifinagh: ⵜⴰⵀⵚⵚⴰⴽⵜ.

ayah_content: D acu p theûûakt?
latin_inalco: D acu t theṣṣakt?
Tifinagh: ⴷ ⴰⵛⵓ ⵜ ⵜⵀⵚⵚⴰⴽⵜ?

Tifinagh: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵍⵍⵉ, ⴷ ⵏⵏⴷ ⵉⵙ, ⵢⵉⵡⵏ.

ayah_content: Ini: "ad iyi Iûûeô, Mass n wanqaô!
latin_inalco: Ini: "ad iyi Iṣṣeṛ, Mass n wanqaṛ!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵚⵚⵕ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵏⵇⴰⵕ!

ayah_content: Si lhemm n wayen Ixelq,
latin_inalco: Si lhemm n wayen Ixelq,
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵏ ⵡⴰⵢⵏ ⵉⵅⵍⵇ,

ayah_content: si lhemm n tillas ma ssant,
latin_inalco: si lhemm n tillas ma ssant,
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵉⵍⵍⴰⵙ ⵎⴰ ⵙⵙⴰⵏⵜ,

ayah_content: si lhemm n tid ipûuvun di tyersiwin,
latin_inalco: si lhemm n tid itṣuḍun di tyersiwin,
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵏ ⵜⵉⴷ ⵉⵜⵚⵓⴹⵓⵏ ⴷⵉ ⵜⵢⵔⵙⵉⵡⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: si lhemm um$ecci, ma iusem.
latin_inalco: si lhemm umɣecci, ma iusem.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵓⵎⵖⵛⵛⵉ, ⵎⴰ ⵉⵓⵙⵎ.

ayah_content: Ini: "ad iyi Iûûeô, Mass n yimdanen!
latin_inalco: Ini: "ad iyi Iṣṣeṛ, Mass n yimdanen!
Tifinagh: ⵉⵏⵉ: "ⴰⴷ ⵉⵢⵉ ⵉⵚⵚⵕ, ⵎⴰⵙⵙ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ!

ayah_content: Agellid n yimdanen,
latin_inalco: Agellid n yimdanen,
Tifinagh: ⴰⴳⵍⵍⵉⴷ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ,

ayah_content: Öebbi n yimdanen,
latin_inalco: Ṛebbi n yimdanen,
Tifinagh: ⵕⴱⴱⵉ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ,

ayah_content: si lhemm u$way n win ipfezwin,
latin_inalco: si lhemm uɣway n win itfezwin,
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵍⵀⵎⵎ ⵓⵖⵡⴰⵢ ⵏ ⵡⵉⵏ ⵉⵜⴼⵣⵡⵉⵏ,

ayah_content: i i$ewwun idmaren n yimdanen,
latin_inalco: i iɣewwun idmaren n yimdanen,
Tifinagh: ⵉ ⵉⵖⵡⵡⵓⵏ ⵉⴷⵎⴰⵔⵏ ⵏ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ,

ayah_content: si leonun u seg yimdanen.
latin_inalco: si leǧnun u seg yimdanen.
Tifinagh: ⵙⵉ ⵍⴷⵊⵏⵓⵏ ⵓ ⵙⴳ ⵢⵉⵎⴷⴰⵏⵏ.
